meta.plot: The State's Attorney's dedicated team of prosecutors and investigators navigates heated city politics and controversy head-on, while fearlessly pursuing justice.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E01 - Fake (III)
1.plot:
Firehouse 51 responded to a horrific warehouse fire that killed 39 people. This led the Chicago P.D. on a manhunt for the suspect. Now with someone in custody for both arson and multiple murders, it is up to Peter Stone and his team, including lead investigator Antonio Dawson to step in to bring some peace and resolution to so many families and friends of those lost - including one very close to home.

The crossover starts on Chicago Fire S05E15 Deathtrap (I) and Chicago P.D. S04E016 Emotional Proximity (II).

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E02 - Uncertainty Principle
1.plot: Stone and the State's Attorney team investigates the chain of events following the arrest and death of a young man, ultimately seeking charges against Police, Fire Department and Medical personnel, only to have a recalcitrant Grand Jury indict a single individual: Officer Kevin Atwater. Paul Robinette defends Atwater.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E03 - See Something
1.plot: When a Muslim grad student is brutally murdered, Stone and the team arrest his friend, another Muslim student, who claims he committed murder to prevent a terrorist attack. The jury must decide whether he's a killer or a hero.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E04 - Judge Not
1.plot: When a prominent judge is shot and killed while leaving a bar with Valdez, her integrity is called into question and Stone prohibits her from working the case. The team learns the judge's death is connected to a trial where he handed down a lenient sentence to a college rapist.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E05 - Friendly Fire
1.plot: When a man is found stabbed to death in his home, Nagel and Antonio discover he was an ex-Navy SEAL who was writing a book that exposed the truth about a top-secret mission. Stone becomes convinced that the SEAL was killed to suppress the real story of what actually happened on the failed mission.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E06 - Dead Meat
1.plot: 30 miles outside of Chicago, the cancer riddled body of Chicago PD Officer Tim Cody is found dead in a bathtub. When Antonio and Nagel arrive on scene they quickly determine his death was murder.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E07 - Double Helix
1.plot: When a pregnant woman is found murdered and her baby cut out of her, the State's Attorney's Investigators race to find the baby and the killer. The case is complicated when it's revealed that the killer's DNA matches that of her father: a convicted serial killer already in prison. Both killers then attempt to use the DNA evidence as their ticket to freedom.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E08 - Lily's Law
1.plot: When a female juror on Stone's case against a gangbanger winds up dead, the team believes she was murdered because of her guilty vote. They later learn that she committed suicide - driven to it by the cyber harassment of her former boyfriend. Stone goes after him for murder.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E09 - Comma
1.plot: When Abigail Chapman returns from Spain after being acquitted for murdering her boyfriend while studying abroad, she finds herself the prime suspect in another murder case involving a young college student. During the trial of the real killer, the Second Amendment is put to the test.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E10 - Drill
1.plot: After an innocent girl is killed in a gang-related shooting that was instigated on social media, Stone's obsession for justice endangers the family of a cooperating witness. To salvage his crumbling case, Stone must go head-to-head in the courtroom against both the social media providers who inadvertently fueled the gang war and a cocky young man who may have pulled the trigger.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E11 - AQD
1.plot: When an anti-environmentalist Alderman is killed during a vicious hit-and-run, Antonio and Nagel go all out to track down the driver. But instead of this being an organized hit to save the environment, it turns out the driver is a frantic mother desperate to save her kidnapped daughter. When Valdez discovers the mother was victim of a scam, the legal question becomes complicated: who is responsible for the Alderman's death? The mother trying to save her daughter? Or the perpetrators of the scam?

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E12 - Fool Me Twice
1.plot: After a man is shot multiple times and left for dead, and a kilo of diluted heroin is found in his car, Antonio discovers other similar cases where murder victims were found with the same type of adulterated drugs. Ultimately, the narcotics detectives involved in the case-one a decorated hero-appear to be the common thread. Meanwhile, Stone is hesitant to let Nagel be involved in the case, as she has a close connection to the victim.

1.title: FR - Chicago Justice - S01E13 - Tycoon
1.plot: A crane collapses at a construction site and kills the son-in-law of wealthy real estate developer, Frank Linden. Nagel and Antonio, with the help of and CFD Chief Boden discover that the collapse wasn't actually an accident. The team digs into Linden, who has made many enemies, more dangerous friends, and is accustomed to using his money to get his way.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E01 - The Rub of Sugarland
1.plot: After being deserted by her husband, Texas housewife Riley Parks takes a job at a seemingly traditional day spa only to learn that sexual favors are being offered there on the side. Conflicted at first, she seizes the opportunity and takes the job.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E02 - Turn the Page
1.plot: Riley stumbles upon the phone number of a mystery woman from her husband's past, leaving her to wonder if he was having an affair before he deserted her. Meanwhile, Riley's mom, Linette, embarks on a new romance with fellow churchgoer, Garrett.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E03 - Tough Love
1.plot: Riley's new career starts to take off when she gets promoted at The Rub. But when her daughter, Katie, starts acting up at school. Riley struggles to find the balance of being a responsible single mom and a newly minted manager.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E04 - Ring True
1.plot: When Linette is made co-chair of a Beaumont social event, Riley balks at facing the community and the rumors about Kyle. Meanwhile, a law student comes to The Rub looking for extras, and Riley delivers—only to discover his connection to one of her co-workers. putting their secret in jeopardy.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E05 - Try, Try Again
1.plot: A massage mishap breaks the ice with a sexy. eligible client, leaving Riley to wonder if she's ready to start dating. Meanwhile, Linette's relationship with Garrett seems headed for the long haul until damaging secrets from Garrett's past force Riley to intervene.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E06 - The Cold Hard Truth
1.plot: Georgia puts Riley and the Spa Girls on high alert after she begins to suspect the police may be planning a raid at The Rub of Sugar Land. Meanwhile, Riley's two worlds collide when a friend finds Riley's hidden stash of cash. Dale encourages Evan to come dean about his feelings for Riley, just as she starts to bond with a fellow single dad from school.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E07 - Life of Riley
1.plot: A co-workers announcement to elope leads Riley to wonder about the imperfections of her marriage with Kyle. Meanwhile, the Curl Up & Dry Salon is up for sale, but Linette and Lacey balk at the prospective new buyer. Lacey reveals she has also been hiding a secret from Riley. Riley is concerned about a new girl in Evan's life. Riley coaches an insecure client on some basic dating techniques.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E08 - Games People Play
1.plot: Tensions grow between Riley and her co-worker, Selena, when Selena and Evan begin dating. Meanwhile, Riley considers the lack of a male role model in the house when her son, Travis, gets caught in a "curious situation" with Taylor's daughter. Riley lends advice to one of her clients, a rodeo cowboy. when his relationship hits a wall. Linette tries to compete with Taylor when she applies for a loan to buy the salon.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E09 - Acting Up
1.plot: Riley gives romance a try with the very charming and ever persistent Dr. Mark. But what starts as an elegant date at a country club event, ends with her past coming back, turning Riley's world upside-down. Meanwhile, Dee Ann lands in hot water when she gets involved with a high-powered client. And Linette and Lacey face their first day of the "Reign of Taylor" at the Curl Up & Dry.

1.title: FR - The Client List - S01E10 - Past is Prologue
1.plot: Kyle returns to find Riley and the family he abandoned anything but welcoming. Meanwhile, Riley is entrusted with the reins of The Rub of Sugar Land after Georgia is tipped off that authorities have her on their radar. This added new authority, however, puts Riley's secret life in jeopardy of being exposed.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E01 - 'Till I Make It On My Own
2.plot: Riley and Kyle are mid confrontation and find themselves interrupted by local cop, Nathan. His presence is not a welcome one, but the purpose of his visit is for a reason that neither of them could have imagined. Evan and Riley's bond grows stronger in the wake of this conflict with Kyle. At the spa, Riley inherits a new client, Judge Overton aka "Mr. Louboutin," whose love for expensive shoes rivals her own. And Taylor makes some changes to the salon that will require Lacey and Linette to become more independent with their clients and their finances. Riley befriends the mother of one of Travis' classmates, who is a welcome relief amidst the gossiping moms in the wake of Kyle's return.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E02 - Who's Cheatin' Who?
2.plot: Riley’s secret life at the spa is threatened as Detectives Monroe and Dunbar mistakenly assume Riley has information that would help their investigation against Kyle. Riley attempts to get Kyle’s bail money, but her mission backfires and winds up putting her in danger with Kyle’s former employer. Georgia introduces Riley to the new man in her life and reveals where she has been spending her time away from the Rub of Sugarland. Riley and Selena are overworked leading Riley to hire new spa girls. Evan takes Riley on a date and tries to take their relationship to the next level.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E03 - Cowboy Up
2.plot: Linette has a car accident and temporarily moves in with Riley while she recovers. Evan secretly takes on a dangerous job so he can help Riley with some of the financial burden she is managing. When Riley and Lacey uncover the truth about his recent injuries, Evan winds up revealing an even bigger decision about a career change. Kyle’s mistakes continue to burden Riley and Evan as they try to move forward with their relationship. Riley decides to make the Rub of Sugarland co-ed and hires a male masseur, much to Georgia’s dismay. Meanwhile, an ex-war vet client needs more care than Riley can handle.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E04 - My Main Trial Is Yet To Come
2.plot:
Selena doesn’t trust Riley’s new hire, Nikki, and Riley tries to keep the peace and some stability in the wake of all the new changes. We get a glimpse into Nikki’s life before The Rub of Sugarland when Riley meets her ex-boss, Greg Carlye, who runs a strip club.

Meanwhile Riley discovers that Derek has been keeping a secret of his own that jeopardizes the Rub of Sugarland. Riley wisely decides that Derek’s secret can be used as a valuable business opportunity. Riley must decide whether she wants Katie and Travis visiting Kyle in jail. Riley and Evan struggle to find time with each other. Riley receives an unusual request from one of her clients, a pro football player who likes to test his boundaries.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E05 - Hell on Heels
2.plot: When Riley discovers that Linette wants Katie to enter the Beaumont Belles Mother/Daughter pageant, Riley struggles with her decision and turns to Kyle for advice. At The Rub of Sugarland, a co-ed locker room creates awkward encounters between Selena and Derek, meanwhile Riley has an awkward encounter of her own when an 18-year-old virgin, J.D. Junior, is on her table. When Travis begins acting up at school, Evan offers to take Travis to visit Kyle in jail. Riley and Evan continue to face the challenges of their relationship now that Kyle is back in their lives. Lacey and Dale visit a fertility specialist.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E06 - Unanswered Prayers
2.plot: When Riley's client, Lewis Clark, mentions he has a connection to a big time music agent, The Wolf, Riley considers her forgotten dream of becoming a singer. Lacey gets suspicious that Dale has been living a secret life. Riley continues to work on Kyle's defense with his attorney Graham, but Kyle encounters some trouble with a fellow inmate that could jeopardize their efforts. Meanwhile, Evan continues training at the police academy and begins to get close to his fellow cadet, Shelby. At the Rub of Sugarland, Selena teases Derek about the frequency of massages booked by his client Lisa.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E07 - I Ain’t Broke But I’m Badly Bent
2.plot: When Riley forms a personal connection to a wealthy and fellow single dad client, Dylan, she finds herself in tempting and unfamiliar territory. When Kyle loses all his visiting privileges after fighting with a fellow inmate, Riley feels the impact more than she could have predicted. Riley, Selena, and Nikki get creative when the electricity in the spa goes out. Meanwhile, Georgia helps Lacey throw a baby shower for Dale’s obnoxious sister, Earlene.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E08 - Heaven's Just a Sin Away
2.plot: As Riley struggles with her marriage and recent decisions at work, she and Lacey decide to attend church with Georgia and Harold. Also, Harold plans a romantic gesture for Georgia. Kyle prepares to testify against his former employer and gets guidance from his lawyer, Graham. Meanwhile Selena warns Derek about his overzealous client Lisa, but reveals more about herself in the process than she intended. Evan takes his first real step moving on from Riley when he and Shelby have their first date.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E09 - Save a Horse, Ride a Cowboy
2.plot: As Riley attempts to let Kyle back into her life, Lacey struggles to show her support. Kyle turns to Dale to help him find a job. Meanwhile, Joey, an ex from Selena’s past, shows up with a shocking demand and Riley, Derek, and Nikki step in to help. Riley also asks advice from her sexy client, Victor, who is a former lawyer. Evan and Shelby prepare for their graduation from the Academy.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E10 - What Part of No
2.plot: When Lacey gets attacked by a man breaking into Riley’s home, both Riley and Kyle feel responsible. Riley goes on a mission to find out the identity of the man who broke into her home. When Evan’s investigation with the police is moving too slow, Riley turns to Georgia for help. Meanwhile, Selena discovers a secret about Nikki and Derek. Riley helps her client, Ben Miller, calm his nerves before he goes out on a date with the girl of his dreams.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E11 - I Miss Back When
2.plot: Lacey copes with the aftermath of the break-in and her attack. Attempting to cheer her up, Riley convinces her to attend their high school reunion. When Taylor sees her soon to be ex-husband, Beau, moving on with another woman at the reunion, Taylor reacts causing Riley to intervene. Meanwhile at the Rub of Sugarland, Selena warns Derek that his client, Lisa wants to take their relationship to the next step, outside the spa. Evan tries to focus on his relationship with Shelby but his past with Riley keeps intruding. Linette struggles with rehab and leans on Kyle for support.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E12 - When I Say I Do
2.plot: With Georgia and Harold's wedding fast approaching, Riley is consumed with wedding preparations. Kyle continues to search for a way to help his family and relieve some of Riley's financial burden. Meanwhile, Evan and Trimble go undercover in a massage parlor as part of a prostitution investigation. Shelby and Evan face challenges in their relationship. Selena and Derek attempt friendship at Georgia's wedding. Dale plans a bold maneuver for Lacey. At the Rub of Sugarland, Riley helps her client Adam, a sexy fireman, with his marital problems.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E13 - Whatever It Takes
2.plot:
Riley and the spa staff volunteer at a charity golf tournament supporting the troops. When Riley runs into her client Judge Overton aka Mr. Louboutin, she discovers he is spearheading a task force that could put her and the Rub in serious jeopardy.

Meanwhile, with Kyle back home, Travis tricks him into hosting a sleepover. Dale and Lacey step in to help, thinking it will be good parenting practice now that they are considering adoption. When an alarm from the security system at the spa goes off, Derek and Riley go to check on things and find an unwelcome surprise.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E14 - What Kind Of Fool Do You Think I Am
2.plot: Riley discovers the "client list" has been stolen and she must find out who took it before her secret life is exposed. Meanwhile, Evan's investigation into Carlyle reveals that Nikki used to be his employee, putting Evan one step closer to Riley's hidden life. Dale and Lacey get news that could accelerate their plans to have a family of their own. Derek asks Selena to make a commitment in their relationship, but Selena isn't sure she's ready.

2.title: FR - The Client List - S02E15 - Wild Nights Are Calling
2.plot: Riley's desperation to find the "client list" takes her down a dangerous path and puts everyone in her world at risk, including Georgia, Nikki, and Judge Overton. As Evan continues to investigate Carlyle he crosses paths with Riley in her double life. Kyle is worried about Riley and turns to Evan for help. Riley also confesses to Lacey the reason that she was attacked, putting a strain on their friendship. When an attractive, French couple shows up at the spa, Selena and Derek are faced with a decision that could put their jobs and relationship in jeopardy.

meta.plot: Riley Parks delicately balances two starkly different lives -- one as a single mom in a conservative town struggling to provide for her family and the other as a savvy and ambitious businesswoman working with a rowdy, sexy and unpredictable group of women.

During the period of Joseon Yeonsanjo, Hong Gildong was a hero who helped the unfortunate locals and fought against greedy governors. This legendary rebel, Hong Gildong's journey unveils his battle for love and justice.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E01 - I Am My Father’s Son
1.plot: It is the winter of 1505. Gil Dong is born to Ah Mo Gae and his wife, who are both servants living in their master’s house. Since he was born, Gil Dong has shown unusual, physical strength. There has been a legend about the Mighty Child who, if born, will be killed by the King.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E02 - Would You Like to Purchase Me?
1.plot: The fish sell well and Ah Mo Gae comes home with money. He decides to become a free man along with his entire family and secretly gathers money so that he can pay for their freedom. He continuously reminds Gil Dong to control his anger and to hide his strength from others. Meanwhile, Ah Mo Gae’s wife tells him that she is pregnant.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E03 - He Is a Beast, Mother
1.plot: Gil Dong spots his father coming out of Lord Jo’s house covered in blood. Lord Jo’s wife tells the district magistrate that it must’ve been Ah Mo Gae who murdered her husband since he has a grudge against him. Ah Mo Gae is beaten and imprisoned. Meanwhile, Lord Jo’s uncle tells the district magistrate that it was actually Gil Dong who attacked him.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E04 - You Are the Mighty Child
1.plot: After being threatened by Ah Mo Gae, Lord Jo’s wife tells the magistrate that it wasn’t Ah Mo Gae who killed Lord Jo. After being set free and no longer a slave, he moves to Ikhwa-ri with his children. There, he and his entourage start selling goods, and he gradually gains power.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E05 - My Father Wants Your Head
1.plot: Many years have passed and Gil Dong is now a young man. Unlike the past, he has lost his mighty strength and travels on foot, selling women’s merchandise. His father, Ah Mo Gae, has become the most powerful man in Ikhwa-ri. Meanwhile, Gil Dong meets Gong Hwa and Ga Ryung. The former tells him that she’d like the King to become her lover.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E06 - Please Find My Slave, Ah Mo Gae
1.plot: Ah Mo Gae’s men find Yeo Mi, Prince Choong Won’s runaway servant. They cut her hair and lie that she has died. Ah Mo Gae’s children and men struggle to get him out of prison. He asks Heo Tae Hak to let him see Prince Choong Won. Much to his surprise, he meets once again with Lord Jo’s wife.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E07 - We Meet Again
1.plot: Gil Dong and Uh Ri Ni jump into the water, and Gil Dong gets hit by arrows. He safely brings himself and his sister to shore before he passes out. While retrieving water for him, Uh Ri Ni gets kidnapped. Meanwhile, Gil Dong loses his memory.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E08 - I Can Be Worse
1.plot: Gil Dong’s memories are back and he returns home to find that his father is still alive. To prepare for his revenge, Gil Dong goes around looking for his father’s old members. Gil Dong states that he will seek his revenge with Prince Choong Won and that he is ready to be worse than just a thug.

1.title: FR - The Rebel - S01E09 - Will You Be My Brother?
1.plot: Gil Dong and the gang decide to get revenge on Heo Tae Hak. They are smart about it and plan a way to slowly torture him. Meanwhile, there is a mysterious tension between Gil Dong and Ga Ryung.

meta.plot: Set in the near future, multi-national corporations are Europe’s new leaders. One of the most powerful, Promethee, wishes to further secure their growing dominance by replacing the police force with their own private militias, the Black Squad, led by Henry Munro. Following the shooting of his daughter, his life in shambles and darkest secrets exposed, an idealistic law enforcement officer, Sirius, with nowhere to turn, aligns himself with an old cop Franck Varnove. Sirius takes charge of Franck’s clandestine, elite squadron, Section Zéro, to battle these dark, violent militias, promising a return to traditional law enforcement before the world they’ve known disappears forever.

1.title: FR - Section Zéro - S01E01 - The Chimera
FR - Section Zéro - S01E02 - In the Kingdom of the Dead
FR - Section Zéro - S01E03 - Renaissance
FR - Section Zéro - S01E04 - Shadow Soldiers
FR - Section Zéro - S01E05 - Between the Living and the Dead
FR - Section Zéro - S01E06 - Sirius Requiem
FR - Section Zéro - S01E07 - Block 13
FR - Section Zéro - S01E08 - Lone Survivor

meta.plot: Inspired by the award-winning documentary, this medical drama is set in the busiest and most notorious ER in the nation where the extraordinary staff confront a challenged system in order to protect their ideals and the patients who need them the most.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Four new first-year residents are immediately put to work by the ER's tough-minded residency director Dr. Leanne Rorish.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E02 - We Plug Holes
1.plot: Christa saves a woman's life and then pleads with Neal to perform a surgery that will save the patient's reproductive future. Meanwhile, Mario gets into a fight with a patient after he delivers a diagnosis that could end the man's hockey career.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E03 - Pre-Existing Conditions
1.plot: The doctors work 36 consecutive hours in code black and must deal with a distraught mother of two sons who were in a devastating car accident. Meanwhile, Mario bullies Angus into performing an unnecessary operation and lets Angus take the blame when Leanne finds out.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E04 - Sometimes It's a Zebra
1.plot: A new surgical attending Cole Guthrie joins Angels Memorial with the help of his estranged father and clashes with Leanne over their contrasting approaches to medicine. Christa has a crisis of confidence in the middle of a procedure on her first infant since the loss of her son.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E05 - Doctors with Borders
1.plot: Neal clashes with his neurosurgeon father over how to treat his gravely ill mother, whose mysterious symptoms force Angels Memorial to quarantine Trauma One.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E06 - In Extremis
1.plot: Leanne must deal with the difficult decision of whether to save Tom Moreno (Michael Trucco), the police officer who helped her during her family's accident, or his shooter, who has more serious injuries. Also, when Malaya's pregnant ex-girlfriend, Carla Niven (Shiri Appleby), arrives at the hospital with pain in her arm, Malaya is shocked by her MRI results.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E07 - Buen Arbol
1.plot: Angus utilizes his background in psychology when a woman cannot remember how she injured herself and others; Christa bonds with the mother of a patient with cystic fibrosis.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E08 - You Are the Heart
1.plot: Christa must handle all emergencies at Angels Memorial that happen outside the emergency room; Malaya arranges a bone marrow drive for Carla; Leanne turns down a date.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E09 - The Son Rises
1.plot: When the lead actor of the musical “The Lion King” tour arrives at Angels Memorial with a throat infection, Leanne gives him a diagnosis that puts both his career and life in jeopardy. Also, the doctors and the cast of “The Lion King” help a 17-year-old boy deal with the difficult decision of taking his father off life support,

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E10 - Cardiac Support
1.plot: Leanne becomes rattled at the thought of losing Jesse, as he fights for his life after suffering a massive heart attack. Meanwhile, Mario asks the residents to cover for him so he can search the city for a patient’s son, which goes against Neal’s direct order not to leave the hospital

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E11 - Black Tag
1.plot: Heavy fog at the scene of a massive multi-vehicle accident puts the doctors in danger; Jesse's confidence has taken a hit; Carla's condition turns critical.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E12 - The Fog of War
1.plot: As the doctors treat patients from the chaotic multi-vehicle accident, a love triangle begins to build between Mario, Angus and Heather. Also, when Malaya learns that Carla is at the hospital, she goes against Carla's wishes and stays by her side during the delivery of her baby. Shiri Appleby guest stars.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E13 - First Date
1.plot: Angus' older brother, an "all-star" ER doctor, tries to secure a position at Angels Memorial. Meanwhile, Christa's romantic feelings towards Neal begin to grow; and Malaya deals with a patient who is obsessed with her.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E14 - The Fifth Stage
1.plot: Leanne visits a prison to finally confront the drunk driver who killed her family. Meanwhile, Malaya begins to feel uncomfortable around her patient.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E15 - Diagnosis of Exclusion
1.plot: After a violent incident inside the hospital results with some grave injuries, the doctors are questioned. Christa and Neal admit their relationship to human resources.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E16 - Hail Mary
1.plot: Christa is feeling insecure after Neal's former girlfriend makes a return to the hospital after a year of volunteering in Haiti.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E17 - Love Hurts
1.plot: Christa has to try and ignore her personal feelings as she and Grace attempt to help a patient who says he was abused at a camp for troubled teenagers.

1.title: FR - Code Black - S01E18 - Blood Sport
1.plot: Mario confronts Angus about his Adderall abuse and Christa is surprised to learn how romantically involved Neal and Grace were before she left for Haiti. Also, Dr. Mark Taylor returns to help Leanne find the money in their budget to keep Jesse and the nurses from walking out.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E01 - Second Year
2.plot: The new residents are introduced to the ER. A new doctor from the army who knows many advanced procedures is flown to a shark attack on the beach with Mike Leighton and Leighton falls 20 feet from the helicopter. Dr. Guthrie Jr. is promoted to the director of the ER in addition to the OR.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E02 - Life and Limb
2.plot: Willis must help a promising soccer player make a life-altering decision after he's seriously injured, and another patient's hesitation to share that she's transgender makes it difficult for the doctors to diagnose her severe abdominal pain.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E03 - Corporeal Form
2.plot: Willis defies Campbell’s orders when he helps Mario and Heather perform a radical procedure on a maintenance worker stuck under a boiler that exploded. Also, Angus’ father, Dr. Desmond Leighton, tries to seize Power of Attorney over Mike, who is still in a coma, even though Mike granted that right to his brother, Angus.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E04 - Demons and Angels
2.plot: On Halloween night, Willis, Noa and Elliott rush to the scene of a fire at a haunted theater, where Dr. Nolan and her boyfriend’s son are trapped,

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E05 - Landslide
2.plot: The Angels Memorial doctors treat victims caught in a landslide, and a group of children come in from a camping trip with measles putting the entire ER at risk.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E06 - Hero Complex
2.plot: Malaya must inform a college student who regains consciousness at Angels Memorial that she's the victim of a rape. Meanwhile, Willis and Campbell butt heads over a terminally ill woman who wants to end her life on her own terms; and a comedian is treated after he collapses on stage during a performance.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E07 - What Lies Beneath
2.plot: Willis and Campbell are sent to a Russian submarine in U.S. waters to treat a sailor badly wounded during an explosion, and violent convicts injured during a prison riot descend upon Angels Memorial.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E08 - 1.0 Bodies
2.plot: The doctors treat cult members who unwillingly survived a mass suicide attempt, and Mario decides to connect with his late father’s girlfriend.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E09 - Sleight of Hand
2.plot: Willis, Leanne and Jesse risk their lives to operate on an injured officer who has an explosive bullet lodged in her leg. Meanwhile, Mario, Noah and Guthrie treat a magician who comes to the hospital with breathing difficulties.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E10 - Ave Maria
2.plot: A 13-year-old girl arrives at Angels Memorial following a seizure caused by spina bifida and the doctors are shocked to learn she is Campbell's daughter. Meanwhile, a workaholic deaf patient and her translator are treated after their car rolls into the Los Angeles River.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E11 - Exodus
2.plot: A code black at Angels Memorial takes a turn for the worse when a city- wide blackout leaves the hospital without power or back-up generators. As Campbell and Leanne divert high-risk patients to a nearby care center, Elliot and Heather are trapped in an elevator with a woman in labor, and Willis and Dr. Nolan try to help a 92-year-old woman who thinks it’s 1942.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E12 - One in a Million
2.plot: Leanne defies Campbell's order and uses the hospital helicopter to reunite a family for the last time. Meanwhile, Willis and Loa use a cell phone app to communicate with an autistic young girl.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E13 - Unfinished Business
2.plot: Guthrie becomes the hospital's new chaplain and considers undergoing a risky surgery to treat his Parkinson's. Meanwhile, the doctors treat patients involved in an apartment fire.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E14 - Vertigo
2.plot: After pulling a double shift, Mario risks his own life when he follows Willis to a construction site where two brothers are trapped on a crane 300 feet above the ground.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E15 - The Devil's Workshop
2.plot: The ER is quarantined when a viral outbreak jeopardizes the lives of the doctors and patients at Angels Memorial. Also, Ariel, the young girl Leanne bonded with a year ago when she lost her father, returns to Angels.

2.title: FR - Code Black - S02E16 - Fallen Angels
2.plot: The doctors work with the Center for Disease Control and Prevention to find an antidote to the deadly viral outbreak at Angels Memorial. Also, Leanne makes a life-changing decision, and Jesse welcomes a new batch of residents.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E01 - Third Year
3.plot: The doctors must race to save a girl caught in the crossfire of a shoot-out; Willis shifts his focus to field medicine, choosing to work primarily on an ambulance with his new partner, paramedic Rox; Leanne begins her journey to adopt Ariel.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E02 - Better Angels
3.plot: Angus and Mario treat a patient who is a self-proclaimed psychic and envisions the staff singing and dancing, seeing beauty amid the chaos at Angels Memorial. Also, Willis and Rox put their lives in danger to rescue a congressman and his staffer from a multi-car accident.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E03 - La Familia
3.plot: Jesse is in denial when his brother arrives at Angels Memorial in bad shape after being pinned down in a warehouse collapse and further tests reveal he has advanced congestive heart failure. Also, Willis opens up to Rox about his brother who was killed in Afghanistan.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E04 - The Same As Air
3.plot: Willis and Rox arrive at a road rage accident resulting in multiple serious injuries. Also, Elliot doubts his ability as a doctor when he’s sued for his role in the death of the SWAT officer involved in the drug bust-turned-shootout, and Leanne discovers Ariel on an ice cream “date” with Max, a young patient at the hospital.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E05 - Cabin Pressure
3.plot: Over the radio, Leanne and Jesse talk a young girl through how to use the supplies on board a small plane to build a makeshift defibrillator when her mom, the pilot, loses consciousness mid-flight. Also, Rox and Willis are taken hostage at gunpoint while on their way to meet the plane at the landing site.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E06 - Hell's Heart
3.plot: Willis and Rox are called to the scene of a wildfire in the mountains of Los Angeles to tend to the injured firefighters, and they choose to stay to look for a missing young boy who was separated from his father in the chaos.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E07 - Step Up
3.plot: Rox decides to make amends with her former step coach when she arrives to Angels Memorial with the local high school step team after a pyramid stunt goes wrong. Also, Noa pleads with Leanne and Campbell to try any other method before performing an emergency hysterectomy on a young teenage girl, who is experiencing complications after giving birth.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E08 - Home Stays Home
3.plot: Mario joins Rox and Willis on the scene of a boat crash and, in Center Stage, Leanne works to save a brother and sister who drank boiling water through a straw as part of a challenge. Also, Max's father tells Leanne to keep Ariel away from his son after he finds them kissing.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E09 - Only Human
3.plot: Max is brought to Angels Memorial with breathing difficulty, and Ariel tells him she loves him. Also, Rox accompanies Willis and Martin to the funeral of an army buddy of Willis' brother, and Willis decides to get to the bottom of what happened to his brother's unit.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E10 - Change of Heart
3.plot: Elliot fears the worst after hearing the emotional testimony by Detective Gomez's wife at his malpractice trial, but he hopes footage Diego shot for his documentary will change her mind. Also, Rox attempts to connect with Willis but he pushes her away, and Leanne attempts to comfort Ariel in the wake of a devastating loss.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E11 - One of Our Own
3.plot: While rescuing an injured firefighter, Rox is hit by a drunk driver and rushed to Angels Memorial. Willis begins to realize his feelings for Rox and goes to great lengths to help her. Also, Leanne is excited to tell Ariel good news about her adoption.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E12 - As Night Comes and I'm Breathing
3.plot: Willis continues to tend to Rox's medical needs in San Diego and Leanne and Max's father go searching for Ariel. Also, when Noa reveals to Mario she wants to take a job offer in Philadelphia, and Campbell offers Mario the attending position at Angels, they realize their career choices will mean ending their relationship.

3.title: FR - Code Black - S03E13 - The Business of Saving Lives
3.plot: Angels Memorial descends into chaos when a plane crashes into the 8th floor. Also, Noa has a car accident and it is up to Mario to save her life. Also, Willis admits to Rox that he needs her in his life and the doctors gather in court to support Leanne for her custody hearing.

meta.plot: Eric Beaumont's crisis negotiator team is brought in to save lives and resolve the most difficult kidnap and ransom cases when no one else can.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E01 - The Return
1.plot: Eric Beaumont, a top crisis and hostage negotiator, uses his insight into human behavior to resolve the most difficult kidnap and ransom cases.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E02 - Grand Slam
1.plot: Eric and the team try to save the life and sporting dreams of an up-and-coming baseball player in Louisville, Kentucky, whose survival hinges on negotiating for a bone marrow match that is being ransomed for $5 million.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E03 - The Box
1.plot: Eric and the team must figure out how to negotiate with bank robbers who are not demanding cash.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E04 - Joe
1.plot: When an important engineer at a company that manufactures collision avoidance software in cars is taken hostage, Eric and the team email the kidnapper, Joe, but discover a third party is intercepting their correspondence and purposely sabotaging their negotiation process.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E05 - The Enemy Within
1.plot: Eric's ex-boss from the FBI brings him in to negotiate with an extremist from a racist group that is threatening to set off bombs all over New York City.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E06 - Celina
1.plot: A French couple hire Eric and his team to rescue their kidnapped surrogate baby who has a dangerous medical condition and needs immediate care.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E07 - Regeneration
1.plot: Maxine leads the team in her first negotiation after Eric and other guests at a retreat are taken hostage by the fanatical leader of a militia group.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E08 - Say What You Did
1.plot: When a senator's daughter is kidnapped, Eric and the team must delve into the senator's darkest secrets in an attempt to bring the girl home safely. Eric's attempt to keep his own daughter safe backfires.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E09 - Girl on a Train
1.plot: A couple in France turn to Eric and his team to rescue their daughter who was abducted from a train and fear has been sold into human trafficking.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E10 - The Artist
1.plot: Eric and the team begin negotiating the return of valuable paintings stolen from an art gallery, but the situation gets complicated when the thief then kidnaps a gallery staffer.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E11 - The Castle
1.plot: When five teens are lured into a trap while playing a smartphone game, Eric and the team negotiate their release.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E12 - Refuge
1.plot: Eric is called to negotiate with a burglar who is holding a family hostage after they catch him breaking into their safe.

1.title: FR - Ransom - S01E13 - Bulletproof
1.plot: Eric must work with a past adversary to stop a hacker from activating explosions worldwide unless the NSA surrenders access to their confidential files.

2.title: FR - Ransom - S02E01 - Three Wishes
2.plot: After Eric's daughter is kidnapped, he must complete three ransom demands from his rival, Damien Delaine, to save his daughter's life.

2.title: FR - Ransom - S02E02 - Alters
2.plot: As Eric and Zara provide risk assessment services at an investment bank, they are taken hostage by a gunman targeting a low-level accountant, and Eric must negotiate for their release.

2.title: FR - Ransom - S02E03 - Secrets and Spies
2.plot: Eric and Oliver plunge into a world of espionage when a CIA spy disguised as an American diamond broker traveling with her family is kidnapped in Vienna. Also, Oliver gets an interesting job offer.

2.title: FR - Ransom - S02E04 - A Free Man in Paris
2.plot: When a former Guantanamo guard is taken hostage by terrorists, Eric is surprised when he learns that his best chance of saving the man’s life is to work with a former Guantanamo detainee who is now working with the captors.

2.title: FR - Ransom - S02E05 - Undercover

meta.plot: Nam Jeong Gi est un père célibataire vivant avec son fils, son frère et son père. Il est calme, gentil et serviable . Ses collègues en profitent pour lui redonner du travail. Il travaille pour une petite compagnie nommée Lovely Cosmetics. Le jour de sa présentation pour la société Gold Chemical Cosmetics afin de lancer leur crème hydratante, il fait la rencontre d'Ok Da Jeong, une femme qui ne mâche pas ses mots et qui s'énerve très facilement sans penser aux conséquences. Leur entretien se passe mal et il enchaîne les bourdes, ce qui entraîne l'annulation du contrat. Il se sent alors obligé de donner sa démission. Après une dure journée d'échecs, il découvre avec stupeur que sa nouvelle voisine n'est autre que Da Jeong.

meta.plot: A big city lawyer returns to her hometown to take the case of a group of girls suffering from a mysterious illness.

1.plot: Tired of being passed over for promotion at her law firm, Joanna Hanley returns to her hometown to defend a drug company.

Meanwhile, back in Millwood, Billy Crawford is dealing with the aftermath of the Matheson Steel lawsuit.

2.title: FR - Burden Of Truth - S02E05 - Hungry, Cold & Tired

2.title: FR - Burden Of Truth - S02E08 - The Right Road
2.plot: As Luna's trial starts, Joanna and Billy defend against an avalanche of evidence. With things not looking good, Joanna risks everything by putting an unexpected witness on the stand.

meta.plot: A modern update finds the famous sleuth and his doctor partner solving crime in 21st century London.

1.title: FR - Sherlock - S01E01 - A Study in Pink
1.plot: A war hero, invalided home from Afghanistan, meets a strange but charismatic genius who is looking for a flatmate; it is London, 2010, and Dr Watson and Sherlock Holmes are meeting for the first time. A string of impossible suicides has Scotland Yard baffled - and only one man can help.

1.title: FR - Sherlock - S01E02 - The Blind Banker
1.plot: A mysterious cipher is being scrawled on the walls around London. The first person to see the cipher is dead within hours of reading it. Sherlock plunges into a world of codes and symbols, consulting with London's best graffiti artists. He soon learns that the city is in the grip a gang of international smugglers, a secret society called the Black Lotus.

1.title: FR - Sherlock - S01E03 - The Great Game
1.plot: A strange clue in an empty room, a blood-soaked car, a priceless Old Master, a deranged bomber. With the clock ticking, the curtain rises on a battle of wits between Sherlock, John and the shadowy stranger who seems to know all the answers...

2.title: FR - Sherlock - S02E01 - A Scandal in Belgravia
2.plot: Blackmail threatens the monarchy and Sherlock is about to meet the woman who beats him.

2.title: FR - Sherlock - S02E02 - The Hounds of Baskerville
2.plot: A hound from hell. Sherlock's most famous case. But is a monster really stalking Dartmoor?

2.title: FR - Sherlock - S02E03 - The Reichenbach Fall
2.plot: The return of Moriarty. The crime of the century. Can Sherlock possibly survive?

3.title: FR - Sherlock - S03E01 - The Empty Hearse
3.plot: Two years on from reports of his Reichenbach Fall demise, Sherlock resurfaces as London comes under threat of a huge terrorist attack. John, though, has mixed feelings – he's delighted by the return of his best friend, but harbours worries that the consulting detective's reappearance will have an adverse affect on his settled domestic life, in particular his romance with Mary Morstan.

3.title: FR - Sherlock - S03E02 - The Sign of Three
3.plot: Sherlock faces his biggest challenge of all – delivering a Best Man’s speech on John’s wedding day! But all isn’t quite as it seems. Mortal danger stalks the reception – and someone might not make it to the happy couple’s first dance. Sherlock must thank the bridesmaids, solve the case and stop a killer.

3.title: FR - Sherlock - S03E03 - His Last Vow
3.plot: A case of stolen letters leads Sherlock Holmes into a long conflict with Charles Augustus Magnussen, the Napoleon of blackmail, and the one man he truly hates. But how do you tackle a foe who knows the personal weakness of every person of importance in the Western world?

4.title: FR - Sherlock - S04E01 - The Six Thatchers
4.plot: Why is someone destroying images of Margaret Thatcher? Is there a madman on the loose? Or is there a much darker purpose at work?

4.title: FR - Sherlock - S04E02 - The Lying Detective
4.plot: Sherlock faces perhaps the most chilling enemy of his long career: the powerful and seemingly unassailable Culverton Smith – a man with a very dark secret indeed.

4.title: FR - Sherlock - S04E03 - The Final Problem
4.plot: Holmes and Watson travel to Europe to escape Moriarty's vengeance.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E01 - One Big Mess
1.plot: When Ultron steals Tony Stark's brand-new, high-tech garbage truck, Iron Man shows Spidey how to use problem-solving skills and inventiveness to stop the ravaging robot and clean up the city.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E02 - Uh Oh, It's Magic!
1.plot: Thor and Spidey enjoy a summer day at the pier until everyone's fun is frozen over by the evil Loki. While our heroes try to break the icy spell, Thor reminds Spidey to always look out for the little guy.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E03 - That Drone Cat
1.plot: After an intense battle with Doc Ock, Spidey and his pal Miles Morales accidentally scare a cat named Mittens, sending her scampering into the city. As our heroes desperately try to catch the runaway feline, Miles teaches Spidey to learn from his mistakes.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E04 - Rock and Roll
1.plot: When Spidey and Ant-Man try to rescue people off a collapsing bridge, Hulk decides to pitch in but his "smashing" makes things worse. In order to save everyone, all three heroes discover the importance of self-control and thinking before you act.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E05 - Electric Youth
1.plot: When Spidey and Ms. Marvel both show up to stop a bank robbery, they have to put aside their differences and work together to take down the evil Electro.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E06 - The Toys Are Back In Town
1.plot: Spidey teams up with the famous Captain America to track down a toy thief known as the Tinkerer. As our heroes rescue the stolen toys, Captain America reminds Spider-Man that being a hero means doing the right thing, no matter what.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E07 - Way Outer Space
1.plot: When a manned space shuttle malfunctions, Spider-Man, with the help of Captain Marvel, has to overcome his fear of space and try something new to save the astronauts on board.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E08 - Family Friendly
1.plot: When Absorbing Man destroys a bridge, separating kids from their parents, Spider-Man teams with Black Panther and is reminded that there's nothing more important than family.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E09 - Stomp and Listen
1.plot: Spidey joins forces with Wasp to stop the rampaging Rhino and soon learns that the best way to get what you want is to speak clearly and stand up for yourself.

1.title: FR - Marvel Super Hero Adventures - S01E10 - Are You Sure? I'm Positive!
1.plot: During a frustrating chase to stop Stegron from destroying a museum, Spider-Man gets a boost from his pal Reptil, who teaches him the power of positive thinking.

1.title: FR - Ms. Marvel - S01E01 - Generation Why
1.plot: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

meta.plot: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E01 - Anarchy
1.plot: The succession to the crown of England is in doubt and causes King Henry’s daughter and nephew to compete for the throne. The Hamleigh family’s hope for an advantageous marriage for their son William falls apart. Tom Builder and his family search for work and encounter Ellen and her mysterious son Jack. Church politics see Philip, a monk, elected the new prior, which leaves him indebted to Deacon Waleran.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E02 - Master Builder
1.plot: A fire destroys Kingsbridge church, giving Tom, son Alfred and stepson Jack the chance to build a new cathedral. Prior Philip learns the power of politics when he gets caught between Bishop Waleran and the Hamleighs’ quest for Shiring Castle. Kingsbridge is rocked by the accusation of Ellen being a witch. William takes Aliena and Richard by surprise in a brutal attack. Aliena makes a promise to her father.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E03 - Redemption
1.plot: Aliena protests her father’s imprisonment. Prior Philip and William find themselves in a standoff over access to stone in the Shiring quarry. Jack’s artistic talents take hold as he begins to carve a statue to honor the cathedral relic. King Stephen visits the cathedral work-site, but collapses in a fit of terror. Aliena starts a fleece business to help earn money for Richard’s chance to become a knight.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E04 - Battlefield
1.plot: William applies to have his father’s title of Earl transferred to him, and discovers a mysterious knight is also a rival for the Earldom. King Stephen, frightened by Jack’s appearance, orders an assassin to kill him. The battle between King Stephen and Maud sees each side’s leader being taken hostage. Philip is tortured into a confession when Waleran tells Maud that he is the man who betrayed Earl Bartholomew.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E05 - Legacy
1.plot: Waleran and Regan engineer the prisoner exchange so that they remain on the winning side of the war. Tom wants Jack and Alfred to be friends, but their rivalry over their work lives and Aliena is too intense. Meanwhile, William decides to attack Kingsbridge as a way to stop the fleece fair and Aliena’s success. The Hamleighs and Prior Philip are granted rights to Shiring land, but it comes with a price.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E06 - Witchcraft
1.plot: Richard returns from war to find his sister penniless, with no more money to support his knighthood. Alfred offers himself to Prior Philip as master-builder. Aliena has to choose between her love for Jack and her oath to her father. Regan forces Waleran to speak to the King about William’s long-delayed Earldom. A disaster at Kingsbridge becomes a way for Waleran to remove Prior Philip from his position.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E07 - New Beginnings
1.plot: As a result of his journeys, Jack has learned how to fulfill Tom Builder’s dream of a cathedral filled with light. Aliena tracks Jack by following the trail of his carvings. Waleran offers Philip a new position, but it means that Philip must always obey Waleran. Kingsbridge becomes prosperous again which infuriates Regan and William, who plan an attack that is met with resistance from Richard, Jack and Philip.

1.title: FR - Les Piliers de la terre - S01E08 - The Work of Angels
1.plot: Eight years later, Jack’s fixation with the cathedral leaves him little time or energy for anything else, while Aliena’s fixation with the distant Earldom of Shiring has married her to Alfred, a man she hates. Waleran and Alfred develop a plot to get rid of Jack for good and it seems to be working until evidence comes to light that makes all wrongs rectified.

meta.plot: Passion et complots dans l'Angleterre du XIIème siècle. Maud, la fille du monarque Henri 1er, se dispute la succession au trône avec son cousin, Stephen. Une lutte de pouvoir qui cause des tensions et déchire le royaume. L'évêque Waleran Bigot et les Hamleigh en profitent pour tirer avantage de la situation et satisfaire leurs propres ambitions. Au milieu de cette guerre, le Prieur Philip doit surmonter les innombrables obstacles pour assurer la construction de la cathédrale de Kingsbridge. Face à l’ampleur de la tâche, il peut heureusement compter sur le maître-maçon Tom Builder, son beau-fils Jack, et la jeune Aliena. Ensemble, ils vont se serrer les coudes pour réaliser leur rêve…

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E01 - Panther
1.plot: Charly's former life as a talented safecracker catches up to him when he is forced to steal a valuable coin from crime boss Hassan Al-Walid.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E02 - The Al-Walids
1.plot: Charly sends Samira and Jonas to Marseille and finds an unlikely ally in Joseph, a washed-up gangster who was sent to retrieve the coin.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E03 - Red
1.plot: With multiple killers hot on his heels, Charly agrees to sell the coin for his safety. Joseph sees an opportunity for payback.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E04 - The Ambulance
1.plot: Charly and Joseph flee to Italy to seek shelter. Meanwhile, Hassan sends his volatile cousin to Marseille.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E05 - Old Friends
1.plot: Joseph sees only one way out, but Charly pulls him back from the brink. Samira and Jonas are discovered by the Al-Walids.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E06 - Rami
1.plot: Charly discovers that the most feared woman in Marseille has taken Samira and Jonas. Joseph stumbles across a safe spot for the coin.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E07 - Madame
1.plot: Joseph enlists Nina's help. Hassan finds a traitor in his midst. Charly is forced to plan an impossible heist.

1.title: FR - Crooks - S01E08 - The Sea
1.plot: In his effort to save Samira and Jonas, Charly comes face-to-face with Hassan. Everything comes down to the toss of a coin.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E01 - Bussi Bussi
2.plot: Pressured by the German police to retrieve the coin, Charly heads to Bangkok to meet an old friend. In Vienna, old foes plot as money dries up.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E02 - Humans, Animals, Sensations
2.plot: As danger circles Charly's family in Austria, Charly and Joseph hunt the coin through Bangkok. In Vienna, mob boss Zakeyev reaches out to his daughter.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E03 - Live Is Life
2.plot: Katharina faces an impossible choice. While Charly and Joseph are trapped between rival gangs, Rio and Zwanziger make moves with dangerous consequences.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E04 - The Combine
2.plot: Charly strikes up a deal with the Thai syndicate to pull off a heist for their sacred idol, and Samira persuades Rio to approach Katharina in Vienna.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E05 - The Scorpion
2.plot: Back in Vienna, Charly and Joseph race to reach Samira. Rio closes in on the coin, but the game gets murky. Zakeyev stops at nothing to win.

2.title: FR - Crooks - S02E06 - Catherine the Great
2.plot: As Rio's rampage — fueled by betrayal — shakes Vienna, Charly faces Zakeyev's ultimatum. Samira makes a bold move as it all rides on a coin toss.

meta.plot: A priceless coin puts rival gangs across Europe at odds, forcing a retired safecracker to team up with a two-bit gangster for one last heist.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E01 - I work for her
1.plot: As she vows to avenge her family after her birthday ends in bloodshed, Lyna edges closer to the one person she holds responsible: the Fury.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E02 - Broken heart > Bullet in the head
1.plot: With a police officer hot on her tail, Lyna's first mission sees her go deep undercover in Mama's bordello where a simple task turns very complicated.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E03 - I'd never have bet on you
1.plot: The Fury races to retrieve a missing safe ahead of the Writing Ceremony. Dynamics shift as Lyna grapples with disturbing news about her parents.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E04 - The Fury is like scabies
1.plot: As Parques' ambitions come to the fore, the Fury turns to Fehim for support. Not knowing whom she can trust, Lyna looks for her own form of back-up.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E05 - Hello, my love
1.plot: A prison visit results in a major encounter for Lyna, but her search for answers leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E06 - Nature abhors a vacuum
1.plot: Lyna tries to predict the masked attacker's next move but patience is wearing thin. Her desperation leads to a last ditch attempt to restore order.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E07 - Where are the knives?
1.plot: In the creeping shadows of a hostile forest, an unlikely alliance is formed as common enemies circle close, poised to swoop in for the kill.

1.title: FR - Furies - S01E08 - Namaste, asshole
1.plot: A hazardous train ride brings the Arago family saga to an explosive conclusion. Yet when old lies are covered up with new ones, the rot still lingers.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E01 - Picking up Strays
2.plot: With a new order in charge of the underworld, the Furies turn to unlikely allies to help eliminate the organisation and take down its shadowy leader.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E02 - How Do You Stop an Armored Van?
2.plot: When an extraction mission attracts unwanted guests, Lyna struggles to keep her link with Elie a secret. Selma pays a visit to her old foe, The Carny.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E03 - You Missed the Deal of the Century
2.plot: With news that Oz is coming to town, the crew devises a plan of attack. Lyna vies for Varda's trust, while Selma targets a Damocles weapons delivery.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E04 - A truce
2.plot: The Furies' ploy sends Selma on the run, holed up by The Carny. As Lyna gains unprecedented access to Damocles, she's forced to face off with Orso.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E05 - The Lie
2.plot: As Lyna races through Paris, Selma makes her intentions clear about Oz — and anyone who stands in her way. A suspicious Elie places his trust in Iris.

2.title: FR - Furies - S02E06 - I Can Always Kill You Tomorrow
2.plot: A grand plan unfolds as old allegiances crumble and unlikely bonds form. Refusing to accept the new order, Lyna prepares for one last fight.

meta.plot: Seeking to avenge her father's death, a young woman becomes entangled in the web of the Fury, peacekeeper of the Paris criminal underworld.

The Defenders is a drama about two colorful Las Vegas defense attorneys who go all-in when it comes to representing their clients. Nick and Pete are the local go-to guys with an eclectic client list who are still looking to hit their own jackpot.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Nick and Pete use whatever tactics necessary in order to defend a young man facing murder charges in a case unique to Vegas.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E02 - Las Vegas v. Reid
1.plot: Nick Morelli works the system to free a single mother accused of running down a jogger while chit chatting on her cell phone, meanwhile, Pete Kaczmarek does his best to help a man down on his luck.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E03 - Nevada v. Carter
1.plot: Nick defends a stripper accused of solicitation; Pete must take on an unwanted case after losing a hand of poker.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E04 - Nevada v. Cerrato
1.plot: Nick is ready to accept a simple arson case until he realizes that his client could be convicted of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete helps a lottery winner take on a casino when he loses his fortune after a night of high rolling.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E05 - Nevada v. Senator Harper
1.plot: In the middle of a divorce case, a client is charged with the kidnapping and burglary; Pete defends a cabana girl accused of assault and battery.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E06 - Nevada v. Rodgers
1.plot: Nick defends a man charged with attempted murder; a man is caught with stolen Elvis memorabilia.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E07 - Las Vegas v. Black Betty
1.plot: Nick reluctantly defends an entertainer's girlfriend when she is charged with murder; Lisa's newest client reveals potentially dangerous information.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E08 - Nevada v. Killa Diz
1.plot: Nick comes to the defense of a young rapper wanted on two counts of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete takes the case of an Internet hacker facing RICO charges.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E09 - Whitten v. Fenlee
1.plot: When a woman's husband dies from a fall on a construction site, Nick and Pete look to prove wrongful death against the company. Meanwhile, Pete tries to help an online blogger avoid jail after exposing an illusionist's magic trick.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E10 - Nevada v. Dennis
1.plot: When a young man is pulled over carrying guns with filed-off serial numbers, Nick and Pete try to get the charges thrown out. Meanwhile, Nick agrees to help the ADA's sister save a bear from being euthanized.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E11 - Nevada v. Riley
1.plot: Nick and Pete come to the aid of a troubled ex-football player charged with battery. Meanwhile, Pete becomes exasperated when his father shows up in town.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E12 - Nevada v. Wayne
1.plot: Nick's personal ties to a young man charged with sexual assault prompt him to defend the accusations. Meanwhile, Pete is stunned when he has jury duty.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E13 - Nevada v. Donnie the Numbers Guy
1.plot: Seventeen years after disappearing on the eve of his wife's murder trial, a man from Nick's past returns to Vegas looking to prove his innocence by relying on new technological tools.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E14 - Nevada v. Doug the Mule
1.plot: When a young man is pulled over carrying 30 bricks of cocaine, Nick and Pete look to prove their client was duped by a girl he met on spring break.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E15 - Nevada v. Hunter
1.plot: Facing thirty counts of possession of a controlled substance, an overconfident judge turns to Nick, who has no choice but to help acquit him of the charges.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E16 - Noland v. Galloway Pharmaceuticals
1.plot: Nick and Pete go after a pharmaceutical company for faulty packaging when two victims overdose on the same drug. Lisa is secretly seeing ADA Ward all the while considering a fascinating new job offer.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E17 - Nevada v. Greene
1.plot: Unable to recall any events from the previous night, the son of a hotel owner turns to Nick and Pete for help after he awakes to find a casino host strangled to death in a hot tub.

1.title: FR - The Defenders - S01E18 - Morelli v. Kaczmarek
1.plot: The firm temporarily dissolves its partnership when they have to defend a husband and wife accused of murder.

meta.plot: A young woman is forced to return to her trailer-park beginnings after her political career is derailed by a sex scandal.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E01 - Dangerously Close
1.plot: Anna finds herself in a deadly predicament that reveals her deeply guarded secret. Then Anna searches for a safe-haven after her secret is revealed.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E02 - Alabama
1.plot: Shelby unknowingly puts her and Bonnie's lives in danger.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E03 - Highway 16
1.plot: Anna's recent controversy sparks many questions.

1.title: FR - Too Close to Home - S01E04 - Have You Heard?
1.plot: Anna introduces her co-worker's partner, Victor, to Happy, Alabama.

meta.plot: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E01 - Asta and Yuno
1.plot: In this world, everyone can use magic… and in a land called the Clover Kingdom, two young men, Asta and Yuno, strive to become the Wizard King, the greatest of all magic users. Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at a church in Hage, a village in the boonies, and lived as brothers from that day onward. For some reason, however, Asta never developed the ability to use magic, even when Yuno had already mastered wind magic. Now, at last, the boys are turning fifteen, the age at which children receive their own grimoires. Asta has high hopes that receiving his grimoire will awaken his latent ability to use magic, but when the time comes…

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E02 - The Boys’ Promise
1.plot: The grimoire that Yuno received was a legendary grimoire with a four-leaf clover. A bandit named Revchi comes to steal it, and Asta comes to Yuno’s rescue.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E03 - To the Royal Capital of the Clover Kingdom!
1.plot: Asta and Yuno spend six months training for the upcoming Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Everyone seems to think Yuno is sure to pass, but worries that Asta is just wasting his time.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E04 - The Magic Knights Entrance Exam
1.plot: Asta and Yuno head toward the colosseum in the royal capital for the Magic Knights Entrance Exam, while looking around and admiring all the things they’ve never seen before.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E05 - The Path to the Wizard King
1.plot: The entrance exam finally comes to a close. The time has arrives for the captains to decide which candidates they want to join their squads.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E06 - The Black Bulls
1.plot: Asta has arrived at the home of the Black Bulls, which Yami himself called the absolute worst Magic Knights Squad. He is greeted by the squad’s unique members.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E07 - The Other New Recruit
1.plot: As a new member of the Black Bulls, Asta is thrilled to receive his very first private room, even though it’s tiny. Everything Asta sees as Magna shows him around the squad’s base is new and exciting to him.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E08 - Go! Go! First Mission
1.plot: The Magic Knights: heroes that everyone in the kingdom looks up to and dreams of becoming one day. But the new recruit, Asta, has yet to do anything that seems like what a Magic Knight should be doing, as he’s stuck doing random chores.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E09 - Beasts
1.plot: On Yami’s orders, Asta and Noelle go on their first mission with Magna to hunt wild boars. They successfully complete the mission and go to Saussy Village to meet with the mayor, Seyhe.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E10 - Those Who Protect
1.plot: Asta, Noelle, and Magna are doing their best to protect the villagers of Rayaka from the ice magic user Heath and his underlings, but Asta’s attacks don’t seem to be working, and Magna’s magical powers are running low.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E11 - What Happened on a Certain Day in the Castle Town
1.plot: It’s payday! Vanessa takes Asta and Noelle to the castle town of Kikka for a little shopping, where they encounter many familiar faces along the way.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E12 - The Wizard King Saw
1.plot: All eyes are on Asta as he and Sekke race to capture a purse-snatcher. Meanwhile, Yuno’s first Golden Dawn mission takes him to an unexpected place.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E13 - The Wizard King Saw, Continued
1.plot: Yuno never expected his last-minute detour to involve such tragedy. It’s up to the Golden Dawn to get the bottom of their mission’s many mysteries.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E14 - Dungeon
1.plot: Asta and Noelle are charged with exploring a newly discovered dungeon full of magical traps. Their leader, the battle-mad Luck, is less than helpful.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E15 - The Diamond Mage
1.plot: Suddenly the dungeon is host to several teams racing through traps to the treasure waiting in its depth—including a noted mage from an enemy nation.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E16 - Friends
1.plot: Asta, Yuno, and their squadmates must take on daunting foes on their way to the heart of the dungeon, but Luck remains dead set on fighting all alone.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E17 - Destroyer
1.plot: The Diamond Kingdom’s secret weapon wields more powerful magic than anyone has seen. The Golden Dawn team is all but decimated. Can he be defeated?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E18 - Memories of You
1.plot: The Clover Kingdom’s Magic Knights reach the dungeon’s treasure hall, but another daunting battle keeps them from reveling in their victory for long.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E19 - Destruction and Salvation
1.plot: The dungeon itself turns against the Magic Knights as they fight to escape—and to keep a badly wounded Asta alive. Mars remembers how he came to be.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E20 - Assembly at the Royal Capital
1.plot: Asta and Noelle visits the royal capital to report on the dungeon mission, but get roped into something else entirely with their Golden Dawn friends.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E21 - Capital Riot
1.plot: The royal capital is under siege! The Magic Knight squads must set aside their quarrels and come together to defend the Clover Kingdom and its people.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E22 - Wild Magic Dance
1.plot: The best of the Magic Knights—plus Asta and Noelle—fight the hordes of undead beseiging the royal capital. Noelle suffers a crisis of confidence.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E23 - The Crimson Lion King
1.plot: Asta’s showdown with the man behind the capital invasion takes a turn. King Clover bemoans the Wizard King’s absence in his kingdom’s time of need.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E24 - Blackout
1.plot: Rades wasn’t the only invader—and the others are more powerful, their sights set far higher. The Magic Knights fall victim to a Spatial Magic spell.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E25 - Adversity
1.plot: What has become of Fuegoleon Vermillion? Yuno struggles to recover from his battle with the witch, while Asta’s cursed wounds threaten to do him in.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E26 - Wounded Beasts
1.plot: The masterminds behind the invasion reveal themselves, though their motivation remains unclear. Asta spends quality time with one of his heroes.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E27 - Light
1.plot: As life slowly returns to normal in the royal capital, the Wizard King reaches an uncomfortable conclusion about the invasion and how it came about.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E28 - The One I’ve Set My Heart On
1.plot: Finral invites two of his squadmates to a mixer, but they aren’t the only Magic Knights who show up. Asta gets closer to a certain young woman.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E29 - Path
1.plot: Old friends and fellow squad members reminisce about Asta: his humble beginnings, his craziest battles—and underlying it all, his burning ambition.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E30 - The Mirror Mage
1.plot: The Black Bulls get a day off, which Gauche spends visiting his beloved sister Marie. Then a mysterious tragedy befalls the village—is Marie safe?

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E31 - Pursuit Over the Snow
1.plot: Asta and Gauche scour the countryside in search of Nean’s children, who have fallen into the clutches of a ruthless monster thirsty for their magic.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E32 - Three-Leaf Sprouts
1.plot: As expected, there were bigger baddies behind the abduction of Nean’s children. Luckily Sister Theresa is on hand to join the fight for their freedom.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E33 - To Help Somebody Someday
1.plot: Gauche reflects on his past as he struggles with protecting Marie versus helping Asta in his downhill battle against Sally’s mutant magic monster.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E34 - Light Magic vs. Dark Magic
1.plot: Backup arrives for Asta’s showdown against the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Asta must push past his limits to pull off a tricky technique.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E35 - The Light of Judgment
1.plot: The Black Bulls seem to be on the losing end of an epic clash between two highly gifted magic users. Gauche has an idea that could turn the tables.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E36 - Three Eyes
1.plot: Three elite members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun pay a visit to their comrade Licht, prepared to make Yami and friends pay for what they’ve done.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E37 - The One with No Magic
1.plot: The Third Eye battle rages on, now with three talented Magic Knight captains providing backup. Licht reveals an intriguing tidbit about Asta’s gear.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E38 - The Magic Knight Captains Conference
1.plot: The Wizard King calls a meeting of the Magic Knight captains. Asta has barely enough time to recuperate before being summoned to the royal capital.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E39 - Three-Leaf Salute
1.plot: There’s a traitor among the captains! Marx’s spell reveals who’s been collaborating with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Julius considers his next move.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E40 - A Black Beach Story
1.plot: The Black Bulls relax at the beach as they gear up for their secret mission. Noelle’s showing off new swimsuit—if Asta would pay any attention.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E41 - The Water Girl Grows Up
1.plot: Noelle’s magic is indispensable for the fight ahead. A new friend has some tips to help improve her magic control, but Noelle has a long way to go.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E42 - The Underwater Temple
1.plot: The eccentric high priest of the Underwater Temple makes it crystal clear that the Black Bulls won’t get their hands on the magic stone that easily.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E43 - Temple Battle Royale
1.plot: It’s the misfit magicians of the Black Bulls up against the fearsome fish-masked Temple Mages. Noelle faces a surprising foe, and Asta uses his head.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E44 - The Pointlessly Direct Fireball and the Wild Lightning
1.plot: A dangerous interloper has muscled his way into the Underwater Temple fight, and it’s up to Yami’s crew to deal with him and his mind-boggling might.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E45 - The Guy Who Doesn’t Know When to Quit
1.plot: While Asta has his hands more than full with Vetto, Gauche must think outside the box as he takes on some of the beastly mage’s talented minions.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E46 - Awakening
1.plot: The Black Bulls and their new Underwater Temple friends pull out all the stops to take down Vetto, but there’s far more to him than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E47 - The Only Weapon
1.plot: Vanessa and Finral find inspiration as a tattered remnant of Black Bulls bands together to tackle the mighty Vetto—who shows no sign of slowing down.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E48 - Despair vs. Hope
1.plot: Finral and Vanessa reflect on their pasts while guiding Asta’s attacks, but they’ll need to change it up to keep the furry fiend Vetto on his toes.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E49 - Beyond Limits
1.plot: Asta’s never-give-up attitude has a impact on his fellow Black Bulls. Vetto recalls his youth, while Yami comes to a realization and takes action.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E50 - End of the Battle, End of Despair
1.plot: The Black Bulls recover after their fight against the Eye of the Midnight Sun took everything out of them—literally. Asta gets himself back on track.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E51 - Proof of Rightness
1.plot: The Clover Kingdom can barely breathe a sigh of relief before the border village of Kiten is attacked by the Diamond Kingdom’s most fearsome generals.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E52 - Whoever’s Strongest Wins
1.plot: Yuno and the Golden Dawn take point in Kiten, while the Black Bulls’ contingent tend to the survivors. Yami has a little chat with William Vangeance.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E53 - Behind the Mask
1.plot: William Vangeance opens up to Yami about his past, while Finral stands up to his brother Langris. Julius questions the Diamond Kingdom’s intentions.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E54 - Never Again
1.plot: Asta gets shocking news from the top doctor in the entire Clover Kingdom. His fellow Black Bulls rally behind him, scrambling to find a way to help.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E55 - The Man Named Fanzell
1.plot: A flashback to Asta’s days learning the sword under a skilled mage with a complicated past—and a dangerous future. Noelle hopes he can help Asta now.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E56 - The Man Named Fanzell Continued
1.plot: Fanzell meets Asta again once Asta’s joined the Black Bulls, but this time he’s far from alone. In the present, Vanessa seeks a cure for Asta’s curse.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E57 - Infiltration
1.plot: Noelle’s contingent is intent on infiltrating the Forest of Witches. They’ll need mighty magic to get past the relentless security and meet the queen.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E58 - Battlefield Decision
1.plot: Faced with the destruction of her forest and the deaths of her “daughters,” the Queen of Witches helps Asta to help her fend off two invading armies.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E59 - Flames of Hatred
1.plot: Together, Asta and friends must find a way to extinguish the flames of Fana’s deep-seated hatred—and the literal flames of her fire spirit familiar.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E60 - Defectors’ Atonement
1.plot: Fanzell goes up against two of his former pupils, now among the Diamond Kingdom’s top-ranking generals—and one of them wields dangerous new powers.

1.title: FR - Black Clover [SUB] - S01E61 - The Promised World
