4.plot: The latest murder case takes Detective Taylor to a whole new world and he must figure out why Cheryl Duncan looks so life-like. They also discover something shocking about the murderer while online.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E06 - Boo
4.plot: The CSI team goes to a haunted house to solve more than just the latest case.  Before they can solve the crime Lindsay is told something will happen to her if she doesn't leave soon.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E07 - Commuted Sentences
4.plot:
The team has two cases tonight and two great tourist locations: Madison Square Park where a man is stabbed to death, and the Metropolitan Museum of Art, where a woman is shot dead on the steps.

What is even more perplexing about these cases is that the team soon realizes that these two victims hold something criminal in common.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E08 - Buzzkill
4.plot: New York City has everything: Times Square, billboards, parties, and a dead model in a giant martini glass. Now the team must find a party crasher who crashed one party too many.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E09 - One Wedding and a Funeral
4.plot: What would otherwise be a happy wedding goes sour when the groom... turns up dead: inside a wedding present.  After Stella finds bloody puzzle pieces inside a box on her car, Mac heads home to Chicago to solve what could be the murkiest mystery of his life.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E10 - The Thing About Heroes
4.plot: While in Chicago Mac uncovers more clues about his stalker and reveals his troubled past. Meanwhile, in New York the rest of the team is in danger. The hunt is on to figure out the identity of the 333 stalker before time runs out.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E11 - Child's Play
4.plot: Danny is devastated when a young boy he knows is killed in the midst of a bodega robbery. Meanwhile, Lindsay, Stella and Flack investigate the death of a man killed by an exploding cigar that is connected to a joke shop proprietor and another tragedy that occurred years before.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E12 - Happily Never After
4.plot: Mac and the team feel they're headed back to Kansas when they find the victim's body with red shoes on her feet crushed to death under an unusual object. The team learns about pop up parties after finding a body.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E13 - All in the Family
4.plot: In this episode Mac and his team must figure out how a woman's death and a judge's murder are connected.   Danny has trouble dealing with Ruben Sandoval's death.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E14 - Playing With Matches
4.plot:
The team must figure out how a self-cleaning restroom leads to a drowning.

The team also investigates the death of a man who was set on fire and flew into a fire truck.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E15 - DOA For a Day
4.plot: After the CSI's receive an anonymous tip they're led to an old warehouse hoping to catch one of New York's most-wanted criminals.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E16 - Right Next Door
4.plot: Stella's life is in danger after her apartment is on fire; she must try to save everyone in the building.  The team also has a mystery to solve after finding a dead body in Stella's apartment building.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E17 - Like Water For Murder
4.plot:
The team must figure out how a young woman and a shark end up dead on the beach at the same time. This case gets even more interesting when a second body washes up on the beach.

Quinn Shelby observes the team at work to determine if the lab should get their annual accreditation.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E18 - Admissions
4.plot: When a guidance counselor is murdered at a private school, the mayor orders Mac and his team to drop everything to find out what happened. Mac is frustrated because he can't devote the man hours or the personnel to finding the "Taxi Cab Killer".

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E19 - Personal Foul
4.plot:
As the search for the taxi cab killer continues riding a cab gets very deadly. The team must figure out how to keep New York City safe.

Also Danny, Lindsey, and Flack investigate the murder of a man who made a half court shot during a game that both Danny and Flack were attending.

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E20 - Taxi
4.plot: Mac and his team finally believe they have captured the taxi cab killer but there is one problem - he is found dead. Mac must figure out how to keep the streets of New York City safe while continuing to track the elusive taxicab killer

4.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S04E21 - Hostage
4.plot: When a man takes hostages during a failed attempt to rob a bank, Mac offers himself in exchange for a hostage. Only condition is that he must prove that the bank robber did not kill the bank manager, whose body is found lying in a pool of blood in the vault. On the outside of the bank, the rest of the team works to process the evidence that Mac finds and stop the SWAT team from making matters worse.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E01 - Veritas
5.plot:
Picking up where the season 4 finale left off.  The team is investigating the death of a woman named Lauren Santana whom is linked to the bank robbery.  She is a friend of Flack's sister Samantha.

Also Mac has escaped the robber but the bodies are still piling up.  So the team must quickly find the bank robber before he is able to get away.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E02 - Page Turner
5.plot: A series of deaths from radiation poisoning may be related to a deadly tome in the New York library.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E03 - Turbulence
5.plot: When a supposed air marshal is murdered on a flight to the District of Columbia, Mac searches the plane for the killer and the murder weapon.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E04 - Sex, Lies and Silicone
5.plot:
The team investigates the puzzling death of a woman named Ann Steele. To solve the case, the team must look for a life size silicone doll. When the team runs into the factory that makes them, it prompts some amusement for some of the team.

Meanwhile, Hawkes meets up with an old college friend who later asks him to compromise some evidence in the case.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E05 - The Cost Of Living
5.plot: The CSI team investigates the shooting death of an archaeologist whose secret life may have caught up to him.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E06 - Enough
5.plot: Three drug dealers set to stand trial are found dead in separate places. They were all trying to get rid of witnesses in their crime, but it looks like someone got them first.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E07 - Dead Inside
5.plot: The team investigates the brutal murder of a house relocator who was found dead inside a Victorian house that he was about to move from Staten Island to The Upper East Side.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E08 - My Name is Mac Taylor
5.plot: In the one hundredth episode of CSI: NY Mac faces his most deadly foe yet. There is a serial killer loose in New York City killing people with the name Mac Taylor making Mac a target.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E09 - The Box
5.plot: A woman is found in the trunk of a crushed car at an auto wrecking yard, the autopsy reveals that she was pregnant, the team needs to find out who she is so they can find the baby.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E10 - The Triangle
5.plot: The team is forced to investigate two crimes at once when a mysterious energy field seems to be the cause of a billionaire's disappearance and the death of his limo driver.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E11 - Forbidden Fruit
5.plot: Mac runs into Ella McBride who could cost him time in figuring out if Isabelle Vaughn died by eating the miracle fruit. Stella gets in trouble with Mac while investigating another murder linked to the Greek diplomat that attacked her.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E12 - Help
5.plot: Young brides-to-be fight over a killer dress at the biggest wedding gown sale of the year and one of the shoppers winds up dead. The unusual clues of this case force Dr. Hawkes to confront a painful chapter from his past.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E13 - Rush to Judgement
5.plot: The CSIs must piece together a human jigsaw puzzle when a beloved wrestling coach's severed body parts are found buried throughout the city. Meanwhile, Detective Flack is in the hot seat when a teenage suspect dies in his custody.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E14 - She's Not There
5.plot: A Russian tourist is found stabbed to death and the CSIs come face to face with the frightening realities of human trafficking. Solving this case becomes personal when it directly affects a prominent member of the NYPD

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E15 - The Party's Over
5.plot: When the Deputy Mayor's dead body falls from the ceiling, along with hundreds of balloons, at a charity fundraiser, Stella and her date find themselves in the middle of the crime scene and Mac goes head to head with Robert Dunbrook.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E16 - No Good Deed
5.plot: When a buzzard flying over Manhattan drops a human eyeball from its claw, the race is on to find the body it belongs to before the avian saboteur flies away with the rest of the evidence.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E17 - Green Piece
5.plot: A lethal pipe-bomb blows a Manhattan townhouse and valuable evidence to pieces, forcing the CSIs to get creative in reconstructing the damaged clues that ultimately lead to the bomber.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E18 - Point of No Return
5.plot: When the wife of a former medical examiner is found murdered, a white powder found at the scene provides the CSIs with a major lead in tracking the killer when it is discovered that the powder is heroin made from human bodies.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E20 - Prey
5.plot: While investigating the shooting of a voice coach in an empty theater, Stella realizes that the crime scene is oddly familiar and staged.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E21 - The Past, Present and Murder
5.plot: When a man falls 20 stories to his death, and his body goes missing after it hits the ground, with no body to process, the CSI's must treat this strange development as a missing persons case.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E22 - Yahrzeit
5.plot: The most exclusive jewelry auction of the year ends abruptly when an appraiser is killed during the event. The investigation takes an emotional turn when the CSIs must confront one of the greatest tragedies in human history - the Holocaust.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E23 - Greater Good
5.plot: Mac informs an ex-con that he served time for a crime he didn't commit, and Lindsay tells Danny "it's time" for the first CSI baby to be born.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E24 - Grounds for Deception
5.plot: When Stella discovers that New Yorkers are being murdered over ancient Greek artifacts, she hands over her badge to follow a clue that leads to Greece and, together with Mac, she uncovers one of the greatest mysteries in history.

5.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S05E25 - Pay Up
5.plot: When transferring Robert Dunbrook's son from prison to court, the NYPD is ambushed by a group of professional kidnappers who kill a member of the team and one of the CSI's lives hangs in the balance.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E01 - Epilogue
6.plot: Danny and Mac have yet to get any leads on a cop killing when Danny gets an impromptu call from a young woman who claims she's got information about the case...

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E02 - Blacklist
6.plot: The case of a cyber killer, who appears to be targeting medical healthcare workers, turns personal when the suspect invokes the name of Mac's father who had died nearly two decades earlier.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E03 - Lat 40° 47' N/Long 73° 58' W
6.plot: When two bodies are discovered at the North and South ends of the city, Mac and the team deftly begin to navigate the trail of evidence left behind by the killer.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E04 - Dead Reckoning
6.plot: Incriminating DNA evidence contradicts the confession of a scorned woman claiming to have brutally murdered her cheating husband.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E05 - Battle Scars
6.plot: When an unidentified shooting victim turns out to be a rising star in the underground world of hip-hop dance battles, the CSIs turn their attention to a long list of rival dancers.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E06 - It Happened to Me
6.plot: When a software company executive bleeds to death on a Manhattan street, the CSIs must delve into the wet and messy world of food "sploshing" parties - where groups of people experience food in an sensual way - to find his killer.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E07 - Hammer Down (II)
6.plot: The crossover starts on CSI: Miami S08E07 Bone Voyage (I). It continues on CSI: Crime Scene Investigation S10E07 The Lost Girls (III).

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E08 - Cuckoo's Nest
6.plot: The Compass Killer is back, and adds yet another to his circle of victims -- but this time the CSI squad knows his name; Flack's alcoholism threatens to derail his career...

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E09 - Manhattanhenge
6.plot: In the culmination of a multi-episode mystery, Mac and his team uncover the dark lair of a murderous madman, the Compass Killer. But as they race to save his fourth victim, the sunrise presents one final surprise that no one ever expected.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E11 - Second Chances
6.plot: A reformed drug addict with everything to live for is found dead in an alley. The CSI's discover he was the victim of a premeditated plot.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E12 - Criminal Justice
6.plot: The investigation of a brutal stabbing takes a dangerous turn when it's discovered that evidence at the crime scene was planted, which pits the CSIs against a trusted colleague.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E13 - Flag on the Play
6.plot: When a beautiful star quarterback of the Lingerie Football League is found murdered in the locker room hot tub with traces of lidocaine in her system, the CSIs are called in to find out who wanted her dead.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E14 - Sanguine Love
6.plot: When a young woman's body is found in Central Park, drained of blood and missing part of her ear, the CSIs jumpstart an investigation that takes them into the dark and mysterious subculture of vampirism.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E15 - The Formula
6.plot: Two days before a Grand Prix Race, when a racing legend dies in a car explosion on the streets of Manhattan, the CSIs discover that car tampering is the cause; however, the investigation leads viewers through the professional racing community and beyond.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E16 - Uncertainty Rules
6.plot: The team investigates the particularly gruesome outcome of a 21st birthday where the party plans became all but anything worth celebrating. With just a few and not easy answers as their only lead in the case, the CSis are challenged to stretch their abilities to the limit.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E17 - Pot of Gold
6.plot: It's St. Patrick's day, and all of New York City is ablaze with a hundred shades of green -- except for an abandoned warehouse in Brooklyn, where two corpses have left a tiny part of the city drenched in red...

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E18 - Rest In Peace, Marina Garito
6.plot: When a woman linked to an unsolved murder case is found dead, the evidence and autopsy both suggest a suicide, but Stella is unconvinced and risks her life to pursue the case.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E19 - Redemption
6.plot: A death row inmate's final request brings Dr. Hawkes to a Pennsylvania prison and face-to-face with a tragic incident that he has kept secret for many years, just as a prison riot erupts and traps Hawkes inside.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E20 - Tales from the Undercard
6.plot: When a slab of concrete starts bleeding in midtown, the CSIs' investigation takes them into the underground world of hardcore fighting, where men moonlight as 'weekend warriors' for the pleasure of a live viewing audience.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E21 - Unusual Suspects
6.plot: When Mac and Aubrey come across the scene of a 14-year-old boy who has been shot in front of his 12-year-old brother, it takes Mac's drive for justice to another level.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E22 - Point of View
6.plot: While Mac recuperates at home after being injured, he witnesses a mysterious briefcase exchange that leads to a murder, and unexpectedly brings him in contact with his former girlfriend, Peyton Driscoll.

6.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S06E23 - Vacation Getaway
6.plot: The CSIs follow a trail left by Shane Casey and realize that he is targeting Danny, who is vacationing out of town with Lindsay and their daughter.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E01 - The 34th Floor
7.plot: The newest member of the CSI team, Jo Danville, a former FBI agent, is welcomed to her new job by stumbling upon the body of a young woman murdered somewhere in the building that houses the NYPD Crime Lab.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E02 - Unfriendly Chat
7.plot: When a young woman appears to be strangled while participating in a live online chat that Adam witnesses, the CSIs must determine if it was real or a hoax, and locate where the possible victim is.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E03 - Damned if You Do
7.plot: When a married couple is found beaten in their home, a mother identifies her son as the killer and the CSIs believe they have their suspect, but all is not what it seems when another witness comes forward.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E04 - Sangre Por Sangre
7.plot: When the leader of a powerful New York gang, El Puño, is found murdered, the CSIs must find the killer before a street war with a rival gang breaks out. Mac asks the co-founder of El Puño, Luther Devarro, a man he put behind bars years before, for help.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E05 - Out of the Sky
7.plot: A jewel heist at the penthouse of one of New York's most powerful attorneys takes a bizarre turn and the case leads the CSIs to a seemingly unrelated man in the morgue.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E06 - Do Not Pass Go
7.plot: When a badly decomposed body found is an abandoned car on a rooftop, Mac and his team must go up against a killer who is using the parents of his victims to manipulate crime scenes.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E07 - Hide Sight
7.plot: Mac is on the hunt for a sniper who is using nitroglycerin in his bullets to explode on impact, and the prime suspect was once a missing boy from one of Mac's old cases.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E08 - Scared Stiff
7.plot: As the CSIs investigate a case involving a woman who appears to have been scared to death in a supposedly haunted section of Central Park, Mac stumbles on another dead body buried nearby in the same part of the park.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E09 - Justified
7.plot: When a woman's body washes up at the South Street Seaport, the CSIs unravel a dark secret from Deputy Chief Carver's past that threatens to shatter his stellar reputation and close-knit family.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E10 - Shop Till You Drop
7.plot: Mac and the team search for the killer of a department store manager who was found dead in a holiday display window.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E11 - To What End?
7.plot: When a man in full clown costume shoots a bakery owner, the CSIs investigate and discover a decision from Flack's past that may put him in jeopardy.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E12 - Holding Cell
7.plot: When a Spanish club promoter is found dead, Mac must battle with the head of Barcelona's crime lab to solve the case.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E13 - Party Down
7.plot: When a tractor-trailer carrying exclusive party guests mysteriously ends up at the bottom of the Hudson River, the CSIs must solve the mystery from the soggy remains.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E14 - Smooth Criminal
7.plot: When the CSIs track down a suave and charming hitman, their investigation uncovers a conspiracy with far-reaching implications.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E15 - Vigilante
7.plot: When a serial rapist is found murdered, restrained in the same manner as his victims, the CSIs weigh a feeling of justice against their sense of duty to pursue the killer.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E16 - The Untouchable
7.plot: When a conspiracy-obsessed woman is found dead, the CSIs investigate and discover that some of her theories may have had some truth to them.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E17 - Do or Die
7.plot: When a popular student and star pupil at Manhattan's most elite private school is murdered, the CSIs find themselves immersed in the highly competitive world of over-privileged youth.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E18 - Identity Crisis
7.plot: Jo balances personal and professional challenges when her adopted daughter, Ellie, is the key witness in a murder investigation.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E19 - Food For Thought
7.plot: While the team investigates the explosion of a gourmet food truck, Sheldon's new relationship could get him in big trouble at the lab.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E20 - Nothing For Something
7.plot: The CSIs investigate a woman's death as the work of a serial killer, and Mac reconnects with his first partner after an ex-con they put away begins stalking him.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E21 - Life Sentence
7.plot: After a hail of gunfire tears through the crime lab, Mac and his ex-partner become part of a vendetta 17 years in the making.

7.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S07E22 - Exit Strategy
7.plot: Following a near-death experience, Mac becomes determined to close his last remaining unsolved case.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E01 - Indelible
8.plot: On the 10th anniversary of 9/11, Mac and the team remember specific moments from that day that were indelibly burned in their mind.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E02 - Keep It Real
8.plot: When an awkward teen is found dead, the team discovers that his efforts to win a sexy punk rock chick's heart may have gone a step too far.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E03 - Cavallino Rampante
8.plot: When the body of a beautiful young woman is found in a stolen Ferrari, the investigation leads to a family of car thieves, but the CSIs must find the murderer before the rest of the family meets the same fate.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E04 - Officer Involved
8.plot: A night out for a friendly drink takes an unexpected turn when Danny and his rookie cops are caught up in a shooting.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E05 - Air Apparant
8.plot: The CSIs investigate when the recently paroled brother of a young basketball prodigy is implicated in a murder.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E06 - Get Me Out Of Here
8.plot: The CSIs investigate when a fraternity prank goes awry on Halloween and a pledge master is left for dead in an open grave.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E07 - Crushed
8.plot: When news of a high school house party goes viral, resulting in overcrowding, a collapsed porch and a teenage girl's death, the CSIs must use social media to uncover the truth about how she died. Meanwhile, Jo's final case at the FBI returns to haunt her.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E08 - Crossroads
8.plot: As the CSIs investigate the assassination of a judge, Jo comes face-to-face with a criminal from her past.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E09 - Means To An End
8.plot: When an important witness turns up dead, Jo is caught up in the dangerous investigation of the suspected rapist who was freed on her watch in D.C.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E10 - Clean Sweep
8.plot: A charred body turns into a hot mess for the CSIs when it appears a cage fighter has been murdered by his stalker.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E11 - Who's There?
8.plot: A home invasion investigation becomes more complicated when the victim's family turns out to be less perfect than they originally seem.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E12 - Brooklyn Til I Die
8.plot: The CSIs investigate when a role-playing game turns lethal, with one player falling victim to a bona fide killer and the other kidnapped and held for ransom.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E13 - The Ripple Effect
8.plot: When the CSIs investigate two seemingly unrelated deaths, their separate trails of evidence lead to a surprisingly connected conclusion.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E14 - Flash Pop
8.plot: When a lab tech is murdered in a case that has eerie similarities to a 1950's cold case, the CSIs get a glimpse into what goes on in the shadows of the lab.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E15 - Kill Screen
8.plot: The CSIs find themselves immersed in the world of competitive video gaming when they discover a murder may be related to a high-stakes tournament.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E16 - Sláinte
8.plot: A wave of brutality threatens a small New York City community when a body is found dismembered and strategically left out on four street corners.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E17 - Unwrapped
8.plot: The CSIs are called to a Brooklyn housing project to investigate the murder of a successful businessman who still felt the pull of his old neighborhood.

8.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S08E18 - Near Death
8.plot: When Mac is shot, he finds himself in limbo between life and death and, as he fights for his life, it's up to his team to bring the shooter to justice.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E01 - Reignited
9.plot: The CSIs investigate when a fire chief - a friend of Mac's - is killed in a blaze that used the same technique as a recently paroled arsonist.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E02 - Where There's Smoke...
9.plot: The CSIs rush to stop serial arsonist Leonard Brooks after he begins using fire against people from his dark past.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E03 - 2,918 Miles
9.plot: A homicide on the Brooklyn Bridge leads Mac and Jo all the way to San Francisco to find a missing teenage girl, but they are not sure if she is dead or alive.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E04 - Unspoken
9.plot: The CSIs race to catch a shooter when Lindsay is injured during the attempted murder of a political candidate, and the events in the aftermath lead to a child's death.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E05 - Misconceptions
9.plot: Mac investigates a 20 year old case when the prime suspect is found murdered on the anniversary of the boy's disappearance.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E06 - The Lady in the Lake
9.plot: The CSIs investigate a twisted fairy tale when a woman in a ball gown is found at the bottom of the pond outside Belvedere Castle in Central Park.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E07 - Clue: SI
9.plot: When a psychiatrist's patients are being systematically murdered, the CSIs are forced to play along in a game of Clue in order to catch the killer.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E08 - Late Admissions
9.plot: The CSIs must delve into the high-pressure world of an elite prep schools when a student is murdered while studying for the SAT'S. Meanwhile, Lindsay returns home to Montana to visit her father and deal with some issues from her past.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E09 - Blood Out
9.plot: When Det. Lovato's cover is inadvertently blown, the CSI's investigate the Latin street gang she infiltrated when undercover.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E10 - The Real McCoy
9.plot: The CSIs investigate a 1920s-inspired speakeasy when one of its owners is murdered and $10,000 goes missing. Meanwhile, Adam spends his day off in an unexpected way.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E11 - Command+P
9.plot: The CSIs are confronted with a puzzling mystery when two different victims are linked by the same unusual weapon.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E12 - Civilized Lies
9.plot: When a beloved off-duty NYPD officer perishes in a robbery, the CSIs use the art of interrogation to break down their suspects and get to the truth.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E13 - Nine Thirteen
9.plot: The CSIs investigate when a masked man is found at the bottom of a notorious skyscraper known for its history of mysterious deaths. Meanwhile, on her day off, Jo runs into a stranger with a surprising link to her past.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E14 - White Gold
9.plot: When a young pizza maker is carjacked, the CSIs must determine what the perpetrators were really after.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E15 - Seth and Apep (2)
9.plot: Mac and the team partner with D.B. Russell to outsmart Christine's kidnappers before they run out of time to save her life.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E16 - Blood Actually
9.plot: On Valentine's Day, Mac and the team tackle three twisted tales of love gone wrong.

9.title: FR - Les Experts : Manhattan - S09E17 - Today Is Life
9.plot: Community unrest over the police shooting of an unarmed man forces Mac and the team to move quickly to solve the case.

meta.plot: Lim Ju-kyung is a high school student. Since she was little, she has had a complex about her appearance. To hide her bare face, Ju-kyung always wears make-up. Her excellent make-up skills make her pretty and she hides her bare face in front of others. She gets involved with 2 men; Lee Su-ho and Han Seo-jun.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E01 - The Errand Girl
1.plot: Kids hate her just because she’s ugly. And for the same reason, her crush cruelly rejects her confession. Thinking of ending her life, Ju Kyung stands at the edge of a rooftop. That’s when Soo Ho jumps in to save her. Days later, Ju Kyung comes across some makeup techniques, and she can’t believe her own eyes. On her first day as a transfer student, kids are captivated by Ju Kyung’s looks.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E02 - With or Without Make-Up
1.plot: As soon as Soo Ho sees Ju Kyung at the comic book store, he recognizes that it’s the same girl he saw on the rooftop. He’s kind of disappointed that she doesn’t seem to remember him. Ju Kyung is anxious to see how Soo Ho will react at school the next day, but strangely he doesn’t seem to recognize her at all.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E03 - Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
1.plot: It seems Soo Ho knows that the no makeup Ju Kyung at the comic store is the same person as the made up Ju Kyung at school. Ju Kyung feels anxious that he might tell everyone about how ugly she actually is. She promises him that she’ll do anything he asks, but it starts to wear her out.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E04 - Ju Kyung Goes on a Blind Date
1.plot: Ju Kyung prepares to go on a blind date. She asks her mother for help at her hair salon, but then Seo Jun steps into the salon when Ju Kyung’s not wearing makeup on her face. She tries to avoid meeting him. Meanwhile, Soo Ho participates in a maths competition, but he keeps feeling bothered by the fact that Ju Kyung is meeting with a man on a blind date.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E05 - If He Has Feelings for Me
1.plot: Soo Ho goes all the way to meet Ju Kyung late at night with a lame excuse. Ju Kyung starts to wonder if Soo Ho has feelings for her. She asks him out. Meanwhile, a first-year student is bullied by her classmates for her ugly looks. This reminds Ju Kyung of her past school life and she decides to offer help.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E06 - Ju Kyung Runs into Bullies
1.plot: Soo Ho’s father visits Saebom High School to meet Soo Ho’s teacher. Everyone at school gets surprised by the fact that Soo Ho’s father is actor Lee Joo Hun. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung runs into the bullies who used to harass her before transferring to Saebom High School. Soo Ho happens to see them and decides to help Ju Kyung.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E07 - Mutual Feelings of Love
1.plot: Ju Kyung’s heart doesn’t seem to calm down whenever she sees Soo Ho. Unfortunately, she finds out that there is already someone whom Soo Ho likes. Devastated and disappointed, Ju Kyung begins to naturally avoid him. Meanwhile, Hyung Jin, the ace baseball player from Seonil High, confesses his feelings to Ju Kyung. Knowing this, Seo Jun and Soo Ho also feel the surge of affectionate feelings for Ju Kyung.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E08 - Misunderstanding
1.plot: The students of Saebom High School go on a school trip. Soo Ho makes up his mind to tell Ju Kyung that he has feelings for her and even buys jewellery for her. However, Ju Kyung gets heartbroken, thinking that Soo Ho likes Soo Jin. Meanwhile, Hee Kyung gets transferred to a different department at work without prior notice.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E09 - Secret Boyfriend
1.plot: Not long after reassuring each other’s feelings, Ju Kyung and Soo Ho initiate a movie-like plan to keep their relationship secret at school. However, doing so makes it difficult for them to enjoy a typical ordinary date. Soo Ho even puts up with embarrassing moments for Ju Kyung. Meanwhile, Seo Jun is having trouble getting over Ju Kyung when he bumps into her at the least expected place.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E10 - Between Love and Friendship
1.plot: Ju Kyung still doesn’t want to let her friends know that her boyfriend is Soo Ho. Soo Jin tells Ju Kyung that she plans to tell Soo Ho that she has feelings for him. Ju Kyung gets torn between love and friendship. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Seo Jun happen to meet at Ju Kyung’s house and start to make dumplings with Ju Kyung’s family.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E11 - The Truth About Se Yeon
1.plot: After stumbling upon the truth behind Se Yeon’s death, Soo Ho gets into an accident as he runs out of his dad’s office, and Seo Jun also gets involved while trying to save Soo Ho. Hospitalized in the same room, Soo Ho and Seo Jun get to know each other a little better. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung and Soo Ho come to an agreement that they are both responsible for the fight earlier. However, Soo Ho can’t seem to shake off a bitter feeling.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E12 - Transfer Student
1.plot: At school, Soo Ho comes back to his class, and Ju Kyung runs into Hye Min who just transferred. Hye Min asks Ju Kyung if they know each other, but Ju Kyung denies and keeps avoiding her at school. Meanwhile, Soo Jin and Se Mi make a deal, and Se Mi shares with Soo Jin the photos of Ju Kyung without makeup on her face.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E13 - Only Fools Judge Others
1.plot: A video of Ju Kyung sends the whole school in turmoil. When Ju Kyung finds out that her past from the old school has been exposed, she runs away. However, it doesn’t bother Soo Ho a bit what others are saying. The only thing that worries him is whether Ju Kyung is okay or not. Meanwhile, Seo Jun does whatever he can to get to the bottom of this happening and is shocked when he finds the person responsible for the video.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E14 - Trip to the Sea
1.plot: Ju Kyung comes back to school and makes up with Soo Ah. Everyone at school finally finds out that Soo Jin was the one who uploaded the photos and videos of Ju Kyung being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Ju Kyung go on a trip to the sea, but Soo Ho forgets to bring his cell phone. Seo Jun desperately tries to reach Soo Ho.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E15 - Unexpected Encounter
1.plot: Ju Kyung and Soo Ho have no other option but to accept the breakup. After, Ju Kyung stumbles upon the fact that Soo Ho is the very boy she met at the Prince Comics when she was young and struggles even more. Meanwhile, Seo Jun finds it difficult to hide feelings towards Ju Kyung and decides to act upon it. Confused by Seo Jun’s unexpected confession, Ju Kyung heads out to Namsan where she bumps into someone.

1.title: FR - True Beauty - S01E16 - Happy Ending
1.plot: Ju Kyung and Soo Ho finally confirm that their feelings for one another haven't changed after all these years. After shedding tears from their reunion, they start their happy relationship, which is more grown-up from their high school days. Meanwhile, Seo Jun, who has now moved on from his unrequited love, gets ready to debut while Hee Kyung asks Soo Ho to include "Missing Love" on Seo Joon's debut album.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E01 - Lost in Los Angeles
1.plot: The once-grand Cecil Hotel provides a nightmarish backdrop for the disappearance of Elisa Lam. Her final footage in an elevator triggers a viral hunt.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E02 - Secrets of the Cecil
1.plot: Web sleuths dissect Elisa's social media posts. A grisly discovery changes everything at the hotel already known as the Night Stalker's onetime lair.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E03 - Down the Rabbit Hole
1.plot: The mystery deepens: Did a crime occur? The obsessed descend on the Cecil hoping to solve the case and tumble down the rabbit hole of conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Scène de crime : La disparue du Cecil Hotel - S01E04 - The Hard Truth
1.plot: A long-awaited autopsy report arrives, but suspicions linger. Today, an unlikely target speaks his mind as experts weigh in on persistent mysteries.

meta.plot: Le créateur de "Ted Bundy : Autoportrait d'un tueur" nous plonge dans les bas-fonds du crime avec la disparition d'Elisa Lam, cliente du tristement célèbre Cecil Hotel.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Longtime ER nurse Jackie Peyton bends the rules to bring some good from a patient's senseless death, while concealing her addiction to a pain killer she gets from her boyfriend, the hospital pharmacist.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E02 - Sweet 'n All
1.plot: Jackie and her husband, Kevin, become concerned that their older daughter Grace is suffering from anxiety disorder; hospital administrator Mrs. Akalitus drinks Jackie's Percoset-laced coffee.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E03 - Chicken Soup
1.plot: An elderly patient checks in who has been treating his heart disease with chicken soup; Jackie discusses her daughter's anxiety with Dr. O'Hara; Eddie learns that he is to be replaced by a pill-dispensing machine.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E04 - School Nurse
1.plot: Jackie and Kevin consider enrolling Grace in private school; the stoic Dr. O'Hara must endure the emotional thanks of a boy whose twin brother she saved; Zoey loses a patient for the first time.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E05 - Daffodil
1.plot: Jackie breaks several rules and regulations to help a 10-year-old girl caring for her lupus-stricken mother; Mrs. Akalitus accidentally tasers herself; O'Hara treats Zoey to a meal at a four-star restaurant.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E06 - Tiny Bubbles
1.plot: Jackie is caught off-guard when a nurse (Judith Ivey) she used to work with, who is dying of lung cancer, asks Jackie to help end her life. Meanwhile, Coop’s mother (Blythe Danner) is admitted with a gall bladder attack. We learn that he is the only son of lesbians…a fact that delights Jackie and O’Hara.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E07 - Steak Knife
1.plot: A man is admitted with a steak knife sticking out of his chest. Eddie gives Jackie a Cartier bracelet for their one-year anniversary, but she rejects the gift. A baby is left in the nurses’ station and Akalitus takes the infant to her office.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E08 - Pupil
1.plot: Jackie discovers that a new temp nurse is abusing drugs, but when she confronts him, he calls her on hypocrisy; Mrs. Akalitus still has the foundling infant left at the hospital; Coop reveals to Eddie that Jackie has a child.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E09 - Nose Bleed
1.plot: Jackie admits a patient she has treated before. As his condition worsens, Zoey questions whether Jackie did enough to help him on his previous visit. Jackie’s drug use starts to cause spontaneous nose bleeds.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E10 - Ring Finger
1.plot: Jackie and Grace begin mother-daughter tap class. Coop threatens to expose Jackie for falsifying a donor’s record. Jackie has forgotten to remove her wedding ring, and needs to get it off before meeting Eddie for a quickie.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E11 - Pill-O-Matix
1.plot: Kevin decides to buy Jackie a new wedding ring. At work, the automated pill machine replaces Eddie. A movie critic is admitted with a broken elbow.

1.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S01E12 - Health Care And Cinema
1.plot: Kevin invites Jackie to a midnight rendezvous in order to give her a new wedding ring; the comatose movie critic wakes up but his tastes have radically changed.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E01 - Comfort Food
2.plot: After the confrontation with Eddie at the end of season one, it’s now a few months later. Jackie has cut ties with Eddie and is determined to dive back in and spend more time with her family. Back at All Saints, she deflects blame about the narcotic shortage and endures Sam, the altered nurse and his newfound sobriety.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E02 - Twitter
2.plot: Jackie covers for a hung-over O'Hara, while Eddie befriends Kevin and Dr. Coop gets hooked on microblogging.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E03 - Candyland
2.plot: O'Hara offers financial help, but Jackie and Kevin refuse to take it. Eddie and Kevin's secret friendship is revealed.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E04 - Apple Bong
2.plot: When a patient is suffering, Jackie supplies the patient with illegal marijuana to ease the pain. Meanwhile, Kevin prefers going out with Eddie rather than spend the night with Jackie and Zoey believes she is pregnant.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E05 - Caregiver
2.plot: Jackie's life gets a little more complicated because of a security guard and O'Hara's longtime affair comes to light.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E06 - Bleeding
2.plot: Unhappy about Eddie and Kevin's friendship, Jackie asks Eddie to stop spending time with Kevin. A pharmaceutical company rep provides Jackie with drugs.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E07 - Silly String
2.plot: Coop insults the biggest donor of the hospital while Jackie revisits her affair with Eddie.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E08 - Monkey Bits
2.plot: Coop arranges a date for Georgia and Eddie while Jackie's daughter Grace starts therapy.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E09 - P. O. Box
2.plot: In order to keep her secret credit card a secret, Jackie sets up a P.O. box for the credit card bills. In the meantime, Mrs. Akalitus offers Eddie to come back as the hospital's pharmacist.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E10 - Sleeping Dogs
2.plot: In order to get a phony prescription, Jackie falsifies an MRI. In the meantime the campaign's end has its effects on Coop and Eddie is back as the hospital's pharmacist.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E11 - What The Day Brings
2.plot: Jackie has to confess that she used O'Hara's loan when her stash gets lost.

2.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S02E12 - Years of Service
2.plot: In the season finale, Jackie returns to All Saints where she must confront everyone.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E01 - Game On
3.plot: In the Season 3 premiere, Jackie's marriage is strained, as is her relationship with O'Hara after the intervention; Akalitus warns the staff that nearby hospitals have closed down, straining the staff and resources; Zoey publicly confesses her affair with Lenny.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E02 - Enough Rope
3.plot: Eddie tells Jackie that he now considers Kevin a real friend and can no longer lie to him; Jackie is remorseful when she learns that O'Hara is looking for a new employer; Akalitus announces that All Saints may get a visit from the First Lady.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E03 - Play Me
3.plot: Kevin's younger sister Tunie visits after a breakup with her boyfriend; Lenny prepares a surprise romantic picnic for Zoey; two street vendors are brought in after a turf war turns violent; Akalitus fights Catholic bureaucrats over the hospital's chapel.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E04 - Mitten
3.plot: Jackie finds a new hiding place for her pills and buries the hatchet with O'Hara, who becomes ER chief; Zoey works her first double shift; Kevin invites Eddie to a backyard barbecue; Jackie must tell more lies to retrieve her misplaced stash.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E05 - Rat Falls
3.plot: Jackie runs out of drugs and Dr. Cooper decides to compete with Dr. O'Hara for the E.R. chief position.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E06 - When The Saints Go
3.plot: Mrs. Akalitus is in a holy uproar as workers from the archdiocese remove her religious statues. Meanwhile, a new temp nurse makes his presence known in the ER, and some people don't appreciate it; Coop deals with personal, professional and podiatric problems; and Jackie tries to deal with Kevin playing matchmaker between Eddie and his sister.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E07 - Orchids and Salami
3.plot: Kelly wins over the All Saints staff; Kevin finds pills in a dental floss dispenser; a patient soothes Coop's depression; Jackie pockets drugs.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E08 - The Astonishing
3.plot: Jackie accuses Kelly of being inappropriate with two flirty high school girls; Coop begins to let go of childish things; Thor counsels Akalitus on her new phone system and some deeper matters; Jackie is unexpectedly delayed getting to Grace's pageant.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E09 - Have You Met Ms. Jones?
3.plot: Just when Jackie has run out of pills, she runs into a confrontation about the drugs from Oncology that disappeared. Coop tracks down an old girlfriend on Facebook when he decides to start his own family. Heart problems make Zoey revisit her relationship with Lenny.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E10 - Fuck The Lemurs
3.plot: Following HR's inquiry of the missing drugs, Mrs. Akalitus puts Jackie on probation. Meanwhile, Coop plans his wedding and Jackie's daughter Grace wants to be put on medication for her anxiety disorder.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E11 - Batting Practice
3.plot: Jackie tries to stay sober and get through probation until Dr. O'Hara has a tempting offer for her. Meanwhile Eddie believes Kevin found out about the affair and Zoey throws a party for her colleagues.

3.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S03E12 - …Deaf Blind Tumor Pee-Test
3.plot: When HR demands urine samples from all the nurses, Jackie tries to avoid it as long as possible as well as her husband, who seems to have found out about her affair with Eddie.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E01 - Kettle-Kettle-Black-Black
4.plot: After breaking up with Kevin, Jackie has to realize she needs professional help. Meanwhile, a new director at the hospital makes some personnel changes and Kevin finds out about Jackie and Eddie's affair.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E02 - Disneyland Sucks
4.plot: Going through rehab, Jackie opens up about the beginning of her addiction. Meanwhile, Coop is the only one being excited about Cruz's ideas.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E03 - The Wall
4.plot: Worried about her daughter, Jackie leaves rehab early against her therapist's advice and finds that returning to work greatly rattles her nerves, forcing her to struggle to maintain her sobriety; Zoey has second thoughts about her relationship with Lenny; Eddie tells Jackie that he confessed their affair to Kevin.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E04 - Slow Growing Monsters
4.plot: Jackie catches Grace with a boy at a carnival and takes her, not before deleting the number from the boys phone. While at the carnival, Grace announces to Fiona and Zoey that Jackie went to rehab. Jackie goes to an AA meeting with Charlie only to find out that he is using again. Kevin forced Eddie to tell him what Jackie took, when they were having the affair, before telling Eddie to tell Jackie to "Kiss her kids goodbye". Jackie almost relapses when a patient gives her their medications. She throws them in a dumpster and then tries to retrieve them and falls in. She then gets out and walks away pill free. Charlie is revealed to be Dr.Cruz"s son.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E05 - One-Armed Jacks
4.plot: Missing her family and adjusting poorly to single life, Jackie invites Kevin to meet her at a cafe but finds herself served with divorce papers instead of lunch; an attempted double suicide trauma case comes into the E.R.; Cruz institutes a draconian new dress code that is not a hit with his staff; Zoey looks for a new roommate and finds one in the lonely Jackie.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E06 - No-Kimono-Zone
4.plot: Jackie has a disturbing dream about using; Zoey loses her ring.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E07 - Day of the Iguana
4.plot: Jackie covers for Cruz when he has a panic attack; Zoey surveys her coworkers for the best ways to conduct a breakup; Akalitus enlists the staff in an elaborate charade when her mentor is admitted with dementia.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E08 - Chaud & Froid
4.plot: When Cruz learns about Jackie's rehab, he takes revenge on coworkers who have been covering up her drug problems. Meanwhile, Eddie is deposed by Kevin's lawyer; a dumped Lenny decides to take off for Europe; and Coop accompanies O'Hara to her ob-gyn appointment.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E09 - Are Those Feathers?
4.plot: Things get out of control in the emergency room due to the recent firings and an overflow of patients who have been diverted from another hospital, causing Cruz to suffer a pulmonary episode and Jackie to step in. At home, a rebellious Grace refuses to go to class unless Jackie transfers her to public school.

4.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S04E10 - Handle Your Scandal
4.plot: While Cruz is in care, Jackie goes over his head to get the ER under control, resulting in her dismissal from All Saints for insubordination. Jackie pulls Grace out of Catholic school. O'Hara goes into labour and Jackie returns to All Saints in spite of Cruz. Charlie arrives at the ER and Cruz asks Jackie to help him save Charlie's life.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E01 - Happy Fucking Birthday
5.plot: Victims of a bus accident are treated; two doctors join the rotation; O'Hara is happy spending time with her son; Akalitus gives Eddie his job back.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E02 - Luck of the Drawing
5.plot: Kevin demands full custody. A bus crash patient returns after contracting sepsis. Coop threatens to quit.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E03 - Smile
5.plot: After their custody meeting, Jackie rear-ends Kevin and wakes up as a patient in her own ER. Kevin accuses her of using. Coop begins covering for Carrie and taking on a lot more work. When Carrie checks on Jackie, she writes her a prescription for Oxy, unaware she's an addict. The most unlikely person asks Jackie out on a date.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E04 - Lost Girls
5.plot: A heavily medicated Jane Doe is brought into the ER and Jackie tasks Zoey with finding out who she is. Coop invites Carrie to dinner. Jackie faces conflict with both her daughters - Fiona has been acting out in class while Grace sneaks around the city with her older boyfriend.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E05 - Good Thing
5.plot: Jackie is nervous about her date with Frank, so Zoey and Thor help her get ready and Eddie offers some friendly pointers. Prentiss misdiagnoses an injured dancer, but Akalitus and Coop catch his mistake before the patient leaves. Mike Cruz calls Jackie in a moment of need.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E06 - Walk of Shame
5.plot: Jackie and Grace recover from their nights of indiscretion; Carrie uses flashcards to strengthen her skills.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E07 - Teachable Moments
5.plot: Akalitus forgets to hire an escort for a psych patient who then lays waste to the pharmacy; Frank cancels a lunch date with Jackie; Zoey hears Coop and Carrie having sex; Jackie worries about Frank when she learns that a cop has been shot.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E08 - Forget It
5.plot: Kevin interrupts Jackie and Frank's night. Akalitus' blood results are in and her memory loss is a result of a medication she's been taking. Zoey helps Prentiss organize his disaster of an office. Meanwhile, Jackie is convinced that Grace is sneaking behind her back to see Danny, but Grace assures her they broke up. Frank urges Jackie to work on her issues - so she attends an AA meeting.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E09 - Heart
5.plot: Jackie and Frank have sex for the first time and he tells her he loves her. Akalitus has an extra spring in her step. Coop wants to take his mentoring of Carrie to the next level. Kevin and Grace show up at the hospital after Kevin finds a bag of pills in Grace's bag.

5.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S05E10 - Soul
5.plot: It's Jackie's one year anniversary of sobriety and she and Frank fight about their relationship. Zoey acts very professional and rigid around Prentiss after their intimate evening. Carrie's peer review does not go well. Grace has a breakdown about Jackie. Jackie takes something she shouldn't have.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E01 - Sink or Swim
6.plot: Jackie's back to using again, but she's doing it differently this time: maintaining a clean and sober cover, going to 12-step meetings - even finding herself a sponsor - all the while getting her drugs from the towel girl at the gym. Meanwhile at All Saints, Zoey finds out that everyone knows about her 'secret' relationship with Prentiss. Season premiere.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E02 - Pillgrimage
6.plot: Jackie steals Dr. Roman's DEA number. Coop is recruited by a 'sperm scout.'

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E03 - Super Greens
6.plot: Coop learns his sperm count is too low for donation; Carrie gets a lucky break; Akalitus' poker habit pays off; Grace drops a bomb on Jackie.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E04 - Love Jungle
6.plot: Jackie goes off the deep end; Frank discloses a secret about his past.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E05 - Rag and Bone
6.plot: Frank searches Jackie's house for drugs, but she removes them in time and hides her stash in a ladies room at the hospital. Later, Jackie bonds with a homeless, alcoholic nun; and finds comfort in the arms of a fellow drug user. Meanwhile, Zoey confronts Prentiss about his dissatisfaction and encourages him to do what he loves.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E06 - Nancy Wood
6.plot: Jackie's fake identity is compromised when it's learned that Carrie's DEA number has been stolen by a woman named Nancy Wood. Meanwhile, Jackie worries about her dwindling bank account and lack of pills; and Prentiss gives Zoey a shocking message.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E07 - Rat on a Cheeto
6.plot: Jackie is ambushed by Antoinette. Coop's dream finally comes true.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E08 - The Lady with the Lamp
6.plot: Jackie detoxes at home - with help. Frank raises an objection about Grace.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E09 - Candyman
6.plot: Jackie learns about a DEA investigation at the hospital that will require her to take a urine test, so she plots to get around it. Meanwhile, Kevin and Mia plan their wedding; the homeless nun returns in worse shape than ever; and Coop and Carrie find a way to skirt their no sex in the hospital rule.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E10 - Sidecars and Spermicide
6.plot: Jackie breaks up with Frank and tries to separate herself from the people closest to her so she can keep using drugs. Meanwhile, Carrie forgets Coop's 40th birthday; the DEA investigation intensifies; and Zoey decides to become a nurse practitioner.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E11 - Sisterhood
6.plot: Jackie reluctantly attends Kevin's wedding. Carrie makes demands on Coop.

6.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S06E12 - Flight
6.plot: Coop gets a surprise. Jackie hits the road. Season finale.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E01 - Clean
7.plot: Picking up with her arrest, Jackie suffers through detox.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E02 - Deal
7.plot: Jackie gets inventive, setting her sights on returning to All Saints.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E03 - Godfathering
7.plot: Jackie's back at All Saints - but back to square one in a new role.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E04 - Nice Ladies
7.plot: Still strapped for cash, Jackie's dealing takes a surprising turn.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E05 - Coop Out
7.plot: Jackie stirs up trouble for the developers. Coop preps for his last day.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E06 - High Noon
7.plot: Zoey leads the ER nurses on a walkout. Jackie battles her cravings.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E07 - Are You With Me, Doctor Wu?
7.plot: Jackie and Eddie make a purge their stash. Dr. Prince and Akalitus bond.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E08 - Managed Care
7.plot: Dr. Prince enlists Jackie's help with a patient. Thor reveals a secret.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E09 - Serviam in Caritate
7.plot: Zoey finally confronts Jackie. Dr. Prince attracts a mob to All Saints.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E10 - Jackie and the Wolf
7.plot: An unexpected knock at the door puts Jackie and Eddie in jeopardy.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E11 - Vigilante Jones
7.plot: Jackie is forced to perform a procedure on her own. Zoey learns a secret.

7.title: FR - Nurse Jackie - S07E12 - I Say a Little Prayer
7.plot: Jackie gets offered a job - and wants Zoey to come with her. Series finale.

meta.plot: Every day is a matter of life and death in a hectic New York City hospital, but for Nurse Jackie that's the easiest part. Between chronic back pain that won't quit, and a personal life on the constant edge of collapse, it's going to take a white lie here, a bent rule there, and a handful of secret strategies to relieve the pain, and stay one step ahead of total disaster.

The Super Hero Squad Show is an American cartoon series by Marvel Animation. It is based on the Marvel Super Hero Squad action figure line from Hasbro, which portray the Avengers, the X-Men, and various other characters of the Marvel Universe in a cartoonish super-deformed-style. It is also a self-aware parody of the Marvel characters, with influences taken from on the comedic Mini Marvels series of parody comic books, in that the heroes tend to find themselves in comedic situations, and have cartoonish bents in comparison to their usually serious personalities, and is an overall comedic take on the Avengers. The series' animation was produced by Film Roman and Marvel Animation.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E02 - To Err is Superhuman!
1.plot: While in battle with Abomination and the Wrecking Crew, new Squaddie Reptil loses an Infinity Fractal. With both sides scrambling to retrieve it, Reptil, with Wolverine's help, learns to face his fears and what it means to be a hero. Meanwhile, Hulk inadvertently joins a mariachi band.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E03 - This Silver, This Surfer!
1.plot: Silver Surfer is having a difficult time trying to fit in on Earth and chooses to leave the squad. Things get complicated when Dr. Doom kidnaps him.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E04 - Hulk Talk Smack!
1.plot: During a chaotic battle with Klaw & Screaming Mimi, a fractal's cosmic power turns the Hulk into the Gray Hulk.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E05 - Enter: Dormammu!
1.plot: With supernatural wackiness plaguing the city, the Super Hero Squad enlists the help of the Sorcerer Supreme of the Earth dimension, Doctor Strange. However, the good doctor seems to be "off his rocker," babbling incoherently and summoning the Dread Dormammu to Super Hero City.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E06 - A Brat Walks Among Us!
1.plot: When the city is attacked, the squad investigates, only to find that a little girl named Brinny Bratten, who had a fractal stuck in her tiara, that gives her a large and terrifying power over reality. The Heroes For Hire are helping the Squad find her father, while Doom plans to use the chaos to his advantage.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E07 - Oh Brother!
1.plot: Loki teams up with Doctor Doom in a plot to take over Asgard. Meanwhile, the latest Infinity Fractal causes Thor to lose his memory and it's up to Iron Man and Hulk to help him remember who he is.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E08 - From the Atom...It Rises!
1.plot: A new villain named Scorpio shows up in superhero city. Nicky Fury disguises himself as a villain to infiltrate Doom's Headquarters to stop Dr. Doom from using a fractal to control a black hole.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E09 - Night in the Sanctorum!
1.plot: When Falcon is presumed the cause of crashing The Helicarrier, The Squad is forced to relocate. Meanwhile, Enchantress and M.O.D.O.K. plan to attack Superhero City while the squad is tired from moving from place to place.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E10 - This Forest Green!
1.plot: When MODOK and Abomination botched up another fractal retrieval mission, Doctor Doom pairs them up with Egghead in infiltrate the Helicarrier in micro-size. When Ant-Man is called in to help, it is a micro-sized, all-out battle for the fractal.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E11 - O Captain, My Captain!
1.plot: When he is tired of all he can take with the Super Hero Squad, Wolverine joins up with the internation All-Captains Squad (consisting of Captain America, Captain Australia, Captain Brazil, Captain Britain, and Captain Lichtenstein) as Captain Canada where he helps them fight Plantman in the Amazon. Meanwhile, the rest of the Super Hero Squad have an embarrassing encounter at Ringmaster's circus when Doctor Doom sent Abomination and MODOK to recruit Ringmaster.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E11 - O Captain, My Captain!
1.plot: When he is tired of all he can take with the Super Hero Squad, Wolverine joins up with the internation All-Captains Squad (consisting of Captain America, Captain Australia, Captain Brazil, Captain Britain, and Captain Lichtenstein) as Captain Canada where he helps them fight Plantman in the Amazon. Meanwhile, the rest of the Super Hero Squad have an embarrassing encounter at Ringmaster's circus when Doctor Doom sent Abomination and MODOK to recruit Ringmaster.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E12 - If This Be My Thanos!
1.plot: When the Skrulls start invading the city, the Super Hero Squad must team up with the Fantastic Four to stop them. Meanwhile, Thanos forms an alliance with Dr. Doom so he can steal an alien artifact from the Baxter Building.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E13 - Deadly is the Black Widow's Bite!
1.plot: After helping the Super Hero Squad in a battle against Screaming Mimi, Abomination and M.O.D.O.K., Black Widow joins the team. However, unknown to them, she is actually Mystique in disguise sent by Dr. Doom to steal the Infinity Fractals from the Vault.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E14 - Tremble at the Might of M.O.D.O.K.!
1.plot: When M.O.D.O.K. gains the power of an Infinity Fractal, he robs Dr. Doom of his powers and takes over as leader. Loki learns of this and decides to ally himself with M.O.D.O.K., forcing Dr. Doom to join forces with the Super Hero Squad in order to defeat M.O.D.O.K. and reclaim his rightful place as leader.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E15 - Mental Organism Designed Only for Kisses!
1.plot: Dr. Doom is fed up with the Super Hero Squad constantly foiling his plans, so Enchantress decides to help by casting a love spell on Thor to make him fall in love with her. However, the love spell accidentally hits Ms. Marvel instead, causing her to fall in love with M.O.D.O.K. Meanwhile, Skurge intends to defeat Thor himself so Enchantress will love him.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E16 - Invader from the Dark Dimension!
1.plot: When Baron Mordo possesses Iron Man turning him into the Iron Menace and escapes from the Dark Dimension, he plans to take over Super Hero City and Villainville. When Wolverine, Falcon, and Redwing end up under Baron Mordo/Iron Man's control, Hulk, Silver Surfer, and Thor must team up with Doctor Strange and Valkyrie to form a team of Defenders and stop Baron Mordo's evil plot. Doctor Doom and MODOK reluctantly help them when Iron Menace takes control of Abomination.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E17 - Tales of Suspense!
1.plot: War Machine teams up with Iron Man when Doctor Doom, Crimson Dynamo, and Melter band together in a plot to eliminate Iron Man. Meanwhile, Wolverine and Reptil face off against Abomination and M.O.D.O.K. in a game of golf.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E18 - Stranger from a Savage Land!
1.plot: When a smilodon is brought to Super Hero City from the Savage Land, a mysterious jungle lord named Ka-Zar shows up stating that the smilodon is actually his companion Zabu. When the Super Hero Squad encounter Ka-Zar, they learn of his mission and help him rescue Zabu. Meanwhile, Doctor Doom sees the Star Quartz (which will bind and merge any metal in the presence of Vibranium) around Zabu's neck and sends Toad, Thunderball, Sabretooth, and Batroc the Leaper to steal Zabu in a plot to reforge the Infinity Sword.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E19 - Mysterious Mayhem at Mutant High!
1.plot: Captain America sends Wolverine back to Xavier Academy to get his diploma and finish his remaining credits. Reptil tags along to see what Xavier Academy is like. To make matters worse, Ringmaster shows up and hypnotizes the entire X-Men team.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E20 - Election of Evil!
1.plot: The Mayor’s re-election bid goes awry when Egghead wins by a landslide (thanks to a little mass mind-control). But his reign at city hall makes life in Super Hero City a bureaucratic nightmare for heroes and villains alike. Wolverine and the Mayor are up against every hero and villain in a desperate attempt to free everyone from Egghead’s control and stop the villains’ planned invasion.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E21 - Hexed, Vexed, and Perplexed!
1.plot: Magneto is in town and he tricks his children Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch into helping in a sinister plot to steal the Infinity Fractals at the Vault for Doctor Doom. During the first fight, Falcon develops a crush on Scarlet Witch after she heals Redwing.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E22 - The Ice Melt Cometh!
1.plot: Doctor Doom sends his "Team Toxic" (consisting of Pyro, Trapster, and Zzzaz) out in a Fractal-retrieving activity at the north pole only to run afoul of Iron Man, Thor, and Wolverine. While Flatman and Reptil lecture about the polar ice caps, the world starts flooding after Trapster sets off their super-spinner machine to self-destruct. Now Iron Man must convince Iceman to help save the day.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E23 - Wrath of the Red Skull!
1.plot: It's Captain America's birthday and all he wants to do is celebrate it with his fellow Super Hero Squad members and Nick Fury. In order to show his minions what real villainy is like, Doctor Doom thaws out the WWII villain Red Skull. Captain America isn't pleased to find his old enemy up to his old tricks while Doctor Doom isn't thrilled about Red Skull's enormous ego.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E24 - Mother of Doom!
1.plot: Dr. Doom conquers Chthon's mystical dimension to free his mother Coco Von Doom. Though Doom ends up with Chthon's evil powers, he also finds himself dealing with his mother's monstrous nagging.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E25 - Last Exit Before Doomsday!
1.plot: Silver Surfer's past as Galactus' herald is revealed as he encounters another herald, Stardust. But Doctor Doom has plans of his own for Stardust and her big boss.

1.title: FR - The Super Hero Squad Show - S01E26 - This Al Dente Earth!
1.plot: Galactus arrives in Super Hero City to devour the Earth! The fate of the planet hangs in the balance, but all of the city's heroes are powerless before Galactus; omnipotence.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E01 - Cellular Bear
1.plot: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E02 - Jurassic Bear
1.plot: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his mummies. How can Grizzy and the lemmings armed with the T rex?

1.plot: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E04 - Bear Under Control

The lemmings try in vain to break the refrigerator until they see the bear sleep and open the refrigerator. Just as he did, he woke up surprisingly.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E05 - Popcorn Party
1.plot: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E06 - Dancing with the Bears
1.plot: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please his lovely she-bear. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E07 - Domestic Robots
1.plot: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E08 - Mass Control
1.plot: Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls functions in the cabin. One button creates light an other surveys the house. Will Grizzy be able to rid himself to the lemmings without leaving the couch?

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E09 - Lemming Tonic
1.plot: A tired Grizzly goes to fetch a pillow but the Lemmings have different plans for the couch.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E10 - Bear Itch

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E11 - Thirst Quencher
1.plot: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E12 - Spider Lemmings
1.plot: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky threads are perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insec

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E14 - High Voltage Bear Attack
1.plot: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their stereo into the river, he sparks a general power outage and is unable to watch his favourite shows.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E15 - Bear Luck
1.plot: This is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear, he is ousted from the cabin by the Lemmings. But his luck is about to change.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E16 - Bear Scents
1.plot: When he realises that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E17 - Bear's Best Friend
1.plot: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E18 - Super Grizzy Bros
1.plot: Grizzy starts playing video game on the console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his kart racing game. The Lemmings brought another joystick and starts playing with Grizzy. Both of them think they will win.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E19 - Polar Bear
1.plot: Nutty Hill is suffering from a stifling heat wave. Searching in vain for a bit of cool air, Grizzy suddenly has a brilliant idea. He'll get into the fridge, where the temperature will be more bearable.

1.plot: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the Tv, he discovers that the pantry is empty!

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E21 - Role Change
1.plot: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E22 - Lemming Interference
1.plot: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favourite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E23 - Magnetic Bear
1.plot: Grizzy sees objects moving all by themselves when the Lemmings play around with a powerful magnet.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E24 - Bear Charm
1.plot: Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, the Lemmings try to recover the frog.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E26 - Mind in a Whirl
1.plot: After being hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy's in love with thinks she's a Lemming.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E27 - A Sizeable Problem

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E28 - Teleportation's the Way to Go!

1.plot: The Lemmings throw a Birthday party when Happy Birthday rings out it wakes Grizzy who is sleeping after a hearty meal. Grizzy must stop the dim but for the lemmings. the party must go on.

1.plot: A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzy's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzy sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E33 - Lemming Airlines
1.plot: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a flow of incongruous objects.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E34 - Relax Bear
1.plot: Grizzy discovers that the ranger has purchased a brand new multi-function Stressless recliner.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E35 - Treasure Bear
1.plot: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E36 - Bear Countdown
1.plot: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings.

1.plot: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E38 - The Sound of a Lemming
1.plot: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E39 - Bear in the Wind
1.plot: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan set at maximum.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E40 - Construction Bear
1.plot: The Lemmings have fun tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy finds that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the construction.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E41 - Kung Fu Lemmings
1.plot: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two.

1.plot: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the Lemmings who have chosen this day to blast music.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E44 - Bling Bling Bear
1.plot: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear.

1.plot: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come.

1.title: FR - Grizzy et les Lemmings - S01E46 - Voodoo Blanket
1.plot: The Lemmings prepare a dream afternoon snack with the last jar of chocolate spread in the cupboard. Tough luck, Grizzy is coming!

1.plot: As usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter!

1.plot: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a stupid bouncing ball.

1.plot: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano at any cost. But when he notices that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise," he decides to learn the piece.

1.plot: A machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket the Lemmings dream of and there is also a flowers which made like a necklace the Grizzy dream of for she-bear.

1.plot: Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables him to learn anything within seconds, meaning that he can become the perfect bear. Lemmings also wants this gadget from Grizzy.
