Meanwhile, Urashiki breaks through Gaara’s Sealing Jutsu and begins to move once again.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E124 - Decision Time
1.plot: Boruto and Shinki continue on toward the Hidden Leaf Village to fulfill the mission entrusted to them. But Urashiki suddenly appears. Working together, Boruto and Shinki manage to slip away from Urashiki, but escaping him completely proves to be difficult.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E126 - Shukaku's Trick
1.plot: Boruto and Shinki bring Shukaku to Hidden Leaf Village. Upon arriving at the Uzumaki home, Himawari is completely taken with him, but Shukaku finds the entire situation irritating. When told about the day Naruto became the Seventh Hokage—and how Himawari hurt Naruto and Kurama—Shukaku comes up with an idea.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E127 - Make-Out Tactics
1.plot: Boruto becomes fascinated by Jiraiya, Naruto's former mentor. Inspired to train, he goes to Sasuke's house, where Sarada mentions Jiraiya's novel. Convinced that reading the novel is the fastest way to learn about Jiraiya, the search for Make-Out Tactics begins!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E128 - Urashiki's Target
1.plot: Boruto is forbidden to participate in the counterattack on Urashiki because he was previously targeted by the Otsutsuki. Frustrated by this decision, Boruto argues with Naruto when a report comes in that Urashiki has been located.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E129 - The Village Hidden in the Leaves
1.plot: While chasing down Urashiki, Boruto and Sasuke get hit with a strange Otsutsuki weapon. They find themselves in the Hidden Leaf, but years before Boruto was born. Although there's no sign of Urashiki, Sasuke thinks they should proceed carefully. Suddenly, a very young Naruto appears with Jiraiya and the two start questioning the "outsiders."

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E130 - Genin, Assemble!
1.plot: Boruto and Sasuke end up staying in the Hidden Leaf under the watchful eyes of Naruto and Jiraiya. At first, Boruto feels uncomfortable being with Naruto, but gradually warms up to him. Meanwhile, a group of genin—Sakura, Hinata, and Neji—are summoned for duty along with their chunin leader, Shikamaru. Boruto and Naruto head to the designated meeting place and find something unexpected.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E131 - The Power of the Nine Tails
1.plot: Urashiki appears to steal the chakra of Nine Tails from Naruto, but his attempt is unsuccessful. In order to save Naruto, Boruto, Sasuke and Jiraiya pursue Urashiki. Jiraiya then notices that the malevolent Nine Tails Chakra has started filling the air.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E132 - Jiraiya's Assignment
1.plot: At Jiraiya’s suggestion, Boruto and Naruto train to synchronize their chakra, but this turns out to be more difficult than expected. Boruto then runs into Neji and decides to talk to him. Sasuke, upon seeing a discouraged Naruto, is unable to ignore him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E133 - A Village Without Sasuke
1.plot: Boruto and Naruto resume their training. Meanwhile, Sasuke is at a loss for words when Jiraiya expresses doubt about his identity. However, Jiraiya says that he will not pry if they join forces to come up with a strategy to defeat Urashiki.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E134 - The Power to See the Future
1.plot: Another intense battle begins for Boruto, Sasuke and Jiraiya as they try to defend Naruto from Urashiki. Sasuke protects Naruto, allowing Boruto and Jiraiya to barely escape with him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E135 - The Last Battle: Urashiki
1.plot: Boruto's quick thinking exposes Urashiki's trick that enables him to see into the future and they manage to inflict some damage. But before they can breathe a sigh of relief, Urashiki emerges again with an even stronger move, and they're back in the same predicament!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E136 - Crossing Time!
1.plot: The battle against Urashiki is over, and it's time for Boruto and Sasuke to return to the place where they rightfully belong. Boruto is wistful about leaving Jiraiya and Naruto. Suddenly, Jiraiya makes a request to Sasuke.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E137 - The Samurai Exchange Student
1.plot: Sumire's wish comes true and she joins the Scientific Ninja Tools Team, leaving only Wasabi and Namida on Team 15. A new member, Tsubaki Kurogane, a young girl who hails from the Land of Iron, joins them.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E138 - Hiashi's Birthday
1.plot: Boruto's grandfather Hiashi's birthday is approaching and there's going to be a small family celebration. Boruto is chosen to select a birthday present, but he doesn't know what will please his grandfather, so he visits the Hyuga household and sneakily gathers information.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E139 - The Terror! Enko Onikuma!
1.plot: Enko Onikuma—one of Boruto's former classmates and a member of Team 40— was possessed by a Summoning Beast as a child. Now, she can manifest its enormous power. But lately, she hasn't been able to control her power, hindering her work on missions. Meanwhile, Ibiki Morino approaches Enko and tells her that she'll be working under him going forward.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E140 - The Mind Jutsu That Lost to Potato Chips
1.plot: Inojin approaches his parents about mastering the Mind Transfer Jutsu. Cho-Cho agrees to assist and everything is set for training to begin. With his father Sai observing, Inojin starts training with Ino. But due to his lack of confidence, Inojin's unable to execute the jutsu, which ends up irritating his mother.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E141 - The Shinobi Prison: Hozuki Castle
1.plot: Hozuki Castle is a prison run by the Hidden Grass, well known for being notoriously difficult to escape from. Boruto and Mitsuki are sent there to protect Kokuri, a former member of a brutal band of robbers known as the Mujina Gang who's now targeted by assassins after betraying and deserting the gang.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E142 - A Test of Willpower
1.plot: Boruto and his team try to get Kokuri assigned to the same cell, but the warden, Benga, shuts the idea down. Looking for a weakness in Benga, they approach Doragu, the leader among the prisoners, for information they can exploit. Doragu is willing to give them information, but in exchange Boruto and the team must undergo a test of perseverance.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E143 - The Criminal Targeting Kokuri
1.plot: It is discovered that a wooden tag used to prevent unauthorized entry into the medical unit has been stolen, and the prison guards begin a search for the culprit. Until the offender is found, all prisoners are locked in their cells. Once the culprit is found, each of their cellmates will be forced into solitary confinement. If this happens and the team becomes separated from Kokuri, their mission could be jeopardized.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E145 - Breaking Out of Hozuki Castle
1.plot: Boruto and Mitsuki worry that their mission is in jeopardy, since Kokuri is scheduled to be transferred to Hozuki Castle II. They decide to escape with Kokuri before he's moved. As they discuss their strategy with Sarada, their cellmate Kedama overhears them

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E146 - Executing The Prison Break
1.plot: The clock ticks down to the rendezvous time for the escape, but there's no word from Sarada. If they miss this chance, everything will be ruined. Boruto puts his faith in Sarada and proceeds as planned with Mitsuki and Kokuri. Meanwhile, Sarada's lost consciousness from falling to the underground level of Hozuki Castle.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E148 - A New Mission!!
1.plot: Boruto has a dream about the day he defeated Momoshiki Otsutsuki. It ends up bothering him so much that he can't focus on his mission. He then meets Tento, the son of Ikkyu Madoka—the Feudal Lord of the Land of Fire—who’s in the Hidden Leaf for a meeting with the Hokage.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E149 - Friends!!
1.plot: Boruto's new mission is to guard Tento, who is obsessed with ninja and collecting X Cards. He begs Boruto to teach him ninja skills, and Boruto thinks this will be a good opportunity to knock some sense into Tento. Meanwhile, the Mujina Gang, which had been laying low after Team 7’s infiltration mission at Hozuki Castle, rears its ugly head.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E150 - The Value of a Hidden Ace
1.plot: After completing his mission to guard Tento, Boruto is assigned a new B-rank mission with Sarada and Mitsuki. Boruto is excited to start but he finds the rare X Card that he had wanted in his pocket. Realizing that this was from Tento, he goes to their hotel and learns that Tento's life is in danger.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E151 - Boruto and Tento
1.plot: Boruto rushes to save Tento, but Shojoji the leader of the Mujina Gang blocks his way. Boruto dodges to protect Tento, but Shojoji and his Corpse Clone Jutsu prove to be too powerful. In the midst of all this, the mark on Boruto's palm reacts and paralyzes him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E152 - Developing One's Medical Ninjutsu
1.plot: A training class on Medical Ninjutsu is to be held, and each team must send a representative. Sarada is chosen for Team 7. Despite Sakura being a Medical Ninjutsu specialist, Sarada doesn't have a knack for it and being a participant fills her with anxiety.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E153 - Harmony in Gold
1.plot: Tsubaki, Sumire’s replacement on Team 15, is proud of her samurai upbringing and is highly skilled, but her team’s overall mission performance is lackluster. Tsubaki devises a plan to hone her team’s skills, where they fight for who performs best on missions.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E154 - Himawari's Ninja Trial Session!!
1.plot: Himawari attends the Ninja Academy's trial session where participants get a taste of ninja training. Himawari’s already decided to become a ninja, which annoys Norimaki and Edo, who criticize her for being there just for fun. Things become uncomfortable when they're assigned to the same team.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E155 - Mitsuki's Rainy Day
1.plot: One rainy night, guided by Mikazuki the cat, Mitsuki rescues an injured man. Mysteriously, Mikazuki seems to take a liking to the man who says he’s come to visit his sister who works in the Leaf Village. Soon after, Team 7 is assigned to back up the Leaf Police Force on a security mission. Their client is a president of a company who is being targeted by a serial killer known as "The Rainy Day Killer.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E156 - I Can't Stay in My Slim Form
1.plot: Cho-Cho and Choji go to the sweet shop after their training session, only to be disappointed that they are unusually out of azuki bean sweets. After hearing thieves have been raiding the deliveries, Cho-Cho plans to team up with Anko Mitarashi, her friend in desserts and beloved Ninja Academy instructor, to protect the azuki beans that she loves, and capture the bandits!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E157 - Kara's Footprints
1.plot: Using intel obtained from Shojoji the leader of the Mujina Gang, Sai and Sasuke journey to the Hidden Rain Village to find a location thought to be the hideout of an organization known as "Kara, the Husk.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E158 - The Man Who Disappeared
1.plot: Boruto and Team 7 are tasked with a mission to find a missing researcher of a medical equipment company in a distant nation. Mugino, a jonin who has a keen sense of location, comes on board to guide and assist Team 7. Without wasting any time, Boruto and the team start their mission with Mugino.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E159 - The Hashirama Cell
1.plot: Boruto and the team finally find the missing researcher. Despite his resistance, the team is determined to take him back safely to their client.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E160 - To the Land of Silence
1.plot: Leaving Mitsuki in the care of Yubina, a doctor and friend of Mugino, Boruto and the others go to a black market in the Land of Silence, a dangerous and lawless gathering place for disgraced ninja. Team 7 make it to a shop located in the most dangerous district whose owner knows all the latest news. After a scuffle with the bodyguards, the team finally gets ready to ask the shopkeeper for information.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E161 - The Castle of Nightmares
1.plot: The Hashirama Cell was extracted from the body of the First Hokage Senju Hashirama, and depending on how it is handled, its power to stimulate life energy to explosive proportions makes it extremely dangerous. Boruto and the others learn that the cell is in the hands of a wealthy individual who lives in Fushuu Castle, and plan on retrieving it. But there are others who are after it as well.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E162 - Escaping the Tightening Net
1.plot: Boruto and the others are involved in a robbery incident at Fushuu Castle, and on top of being branded criminals, they are being pursued by a gang from the Land of Silence. Although they're determined to capture the true culprits, the gang keeps attacking and hampering their efforts!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E163 - The Pursuers
1.plot: Team 7 and Mugino manage to evade the gang and continue their pursuit of the culprits. But on the way they encounter a squad of skilled ninja and the situation turns explosive. Amidst the tension they learn intel about the culprits, so the team set out in pursuit, but their way is blocked by Deepa.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E164 - The Forbidden Jutsu of Death
1.plot: Boruto and the team finally catch up to the real thieves, two ninja brothers from the Land of Kasumi. Yuga uses a Forbidden Jutsu to summon a monster, and seals it and the team inside a strong barrier. Naruto insists on defeating it and getting out of the barrier. But Mugino argues that unnecessary fighting should be avoided since they don't know how to counter this special jutsu.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E165 - The Quadruplets' Duty
1.plot: Boruto and the others manage to escape Yuuga's barrier, but this time his younger brother Hiruga gets in their way. Like Yuuga, Hiruga will resort to any method to fulfill his mission and uses his jutsu to seal away Boruto and the others. As Boruto tries to break the jutsu, he’s baffled by their rabid fighting style and their willingness to risk their lives.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E166 - Death Match
1.plot: Boruto and the team are determined to reach Asaka, the eldest brother of the Land of Silence Ninja, before Deepa does. They catch up to him, but Deepa arrives soon after and attacks ruthlessly. They try to counter, but nothing seems to work. In the midst of their panic, Victor appears!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E167 - Their Decision
1.plot: Boruto and Sarada convalesce at the Leaf Hospital while Mitsuki returns to Orochimaru's for treatment. For Boruto and Sarada, their inability to fight back against Deepa turns from frustration to resolve. Meanwhile, Konohamaru gives the Hokage his report regarding the incident, and in order to investigate the connection with the Kara more thoroughly, he asks that he be allowed to conduct surveillance on Victor's company.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E168 - Training Begins!
1.plot: Boruto and Sarada begin intensive training after experiencing defeat. Boruto wants to make his Rasengan even stronger and seeks out Kakashi. Sarada is mentored by her father, Sasuke, in the use of her Sharingan. Meanwhile, Konohamaru and Mugino have been authorized to visit Victor's company in order to investigate his motives.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E169 - A Joint Mission With the Sand
1.plot: Shikadai, Inojin, and Cho-Cho's Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Shinki, Yodo, and Araya from the Hidden Sand. The mission is to find and retrieve an Otsutsuki Puppet that Shikadai had once fought. Team 10 arrives in the Land of Wind and decide to stop at a certain shop. On their way, a man passes them who piques Shikadai's interest. Upon arriving, a chilling scene confronts the trio.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E170 - A New Rasengan
1.plot: Shikadai comes to see Boruto in the midst of training and witnesses his friend's determination to break through his slump. Shikadai, who also experienced Deepa's frightening power, tells Boruto that a rematch with Deepa would be reckless. Boruto explains his real reason for wanting to become stronger, and asks for Shikadai’s help. Meanwhile, Sarada trains with Sasuke to hone her Sharingan, but Sakura worries about her well-being.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E171 - The Results of Training
1.plot: Under Kakashi's watchful eye, Boruto succeeds in powering up his own style of Rasengan. And he demonstrates his progress in a battle against an opponent of Kakashi’s choosing. Meanwhile, Sasuke and Sakura switch places to train their daughter. With firm resolve, Boruto and Sarada continue their training and begin to see the results of their hard work.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E172 - A Signature of Fear
1.plot: Iwabe, Denki and Metal pay a visit to Boruto after he lands in the hospital from overtraining. There, they meet Nattou Nishiki, a young boy who is also a patient. Rambunctious and brash, Nattou easily manipulates the three into getting him an autograph from a certain ninja feared by everyone!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E173 - The Secret Behind the Underground Room
1.plot: Konohamaru and Mugino continue keeping their eye on Victor's company. They receive intel that the Feudal Lord of the Land of Valleys will be touring the company, giving them the opportunity to check the inner reaches of the secretive facility. Meanwhile, Boruto and Sarada complete their training and visit the woman who requested their previous mission.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E174 - The Revival of the Divine Tree
1.plot: Boruto and Sarada rush to Victor's research lab where they find a horrifying plant stealing the chakra of the people near it. As they work with Konohamaru to try to bring it under control, Deepa appears!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E175 - Beyond the Limits!
1.plot: Separated from Boruto and Sarada, Konohamaru battles Victor. But someone unexpected shows up to fight alongside him. Meanwhile, Boruto and Sarada are trying to defeat Deepa to even the score, but he still proves to be a formidable opponent despite all of their training.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E176 - Blockade the A-Un Gate!
1.plot: Konohamaru and his teammates report their findings that the Kara receives outside assistance from people called Outers, and that these Outers may have covertly infiltrated the Five Great Shinobi Nations. Though Naruto feels that, as Hokage, he is responsible for protecting the village, he is unable to decide on a course of action.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E177 - The Iron Wall's Sensing System
1.plot: The Yamanaka Clan, who have been tracking the village’s ingoing and outgoing traffic with their advanced sensory abilities, spearheads a plan to create a new sensory system and an operational test is conducted.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E178 - Our Fathers' Example
1.plot: A memorial service is being held in remembrance of the many fallen from the Fourth Great Ninja War. Shikamaru and Ino reminisce about their fathers who died carrying out their duties until the very end in the hopes of a better future. Meanwhile, Ao, an aide to the Fifth Mizukage Mei, pays a visit to the Village Hidden in Leaves.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E179 - Victor's Scheme
1.plot: The mysterious organization known as the Kara is about to take one of their plans to the next stage that involves a crucial item called a “Vessel.” However, having his own ambitions, Victor secretly panics as he tries to keep his true objectives hidden from Jigen, leader of the Kara, and the other core members

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E180 - The Assassin, Mugino
1.plot: Boruto, Sarada and Mitsuki are assigned to carry out Team 7’s missions by themselves until Konohamaru returns from an unexpected assignment. Boruto runs into Mugino in town and ends up going to his home at Mugino’s invitation.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E181 - The Vessel
1.plot: Son of Naruto Uzumaki, Boruto, follows his father's footsteps along with his friends to become great ninja. Throughout all their adventures, Boruto is determined to make his mark in the ninja world and live outside of his father's shadow.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E182 - Ao
1.plot: After the Chunin Exams, Katasuke has returned to work at the invitation of the Hokage. Upon seeing him, Boruto becomes annoyed thinking about what happened during the exam. Team 7 is given a mission to escort Katasuke and transport a Scientific Ninja Tool. Stuck on a mission he doesn’t like, Boruto runs into Ao while aboard the Thunder Train headed to their destination.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E183 - The Hand
1.plot: Team 7 has arrived at a high-tech research center along with Katasuke. There, they end up running into some familiar faces. The mission has ended without incident, and Boruto is ready to head home. However, there’s more they must do. Boruto and his friends end up cooperating in a test-run of a Scientific Ninja Tool that is under development. Boruto is unhappy at first, but as the test run continues his feelings start to change. As that happens, Team 7 is given a new urgent assignment from the Hokage.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E184 - Puppets
1.plot: After finding out that Konohamaru and Mugino have gone missing, Team 7 is ordered to go to their last known location and investigate what happened. Team 7 and Katasuke arrive at the airship wreckage, but are attacked by strange puppets.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E185 - Tools
1.plot: Team 7 learns that Ao is now an enemy that works for Kara. After Mugino's plan allows them to escape, they begin to strategize on how to handle the situation. Meanwhile, the members of Kara learn that there may be a traitor among them.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E186 - How You Use It
1.plot: The showdown between Team 7 and Ao begins. Team 7 works together to bring Ao down with various attacks and jutsu, but he proves to be a difficult adversary due to his use of scientific ninja tools.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E187 - Karma
1.plot: After Ao's defeat, Koji Kashin appears before Team 7 and attempts to ensnare them in a sealing jutsu and eliminate them. Konohamaru breaks free and takes him on, but during the battle, the mark on Boruto's hand activates.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E188 - The Awakening
1.plot: Koji Kashin retreats from battle after seeing that Boruto has a "Karma" mark on his hand. Shortly after, Team 7 discovers a battle site where a boy lies unconscious. Much to everyone's shock, the boy possesses the same mark as Boruto.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E189 - Resonance
1.plot: Boruto and the others learn that the boy named Kawaki is the target that Kara has been seeking. They watch on as a battle rages between Kawaki and the Kara Outer, Garo, and are shocked by the young man's capabilities.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E190 - Escape
1.plot: Boruto and the others return to the technology lab to contain and watch over Kawaki while Konohamaru returns to the Leaf Village to report the events of the mission to Naruto.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E191 - Stray Dog
1.plot: Wounded and hungry, Kawaki escapes from the tech lab and makes his way to a nearby town to find food. Sumire tracks him down, believing she can help him. Meanwhile, Naruto begins making his way to the area to meet with Kawaki himself.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E192 - The Past
1.plot: Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood. As a child, Kawaki endured an abusive father, until one day a man appeared before him— none other than Jigen, the leader of Kara.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E193 - Coexistence
1.plot: The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but he still refuses to open up to anybody. The atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki, who fought each other before, turns threatening.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E195 - A Vase
1.plot: Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada. Unaccustomed to peaceful everyday life, he snaps at Sarada’s attempts to talk to him, and almost attacks a child for bumping into him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E195 - A Vase
1.plot: Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada. Unaccustomed to peaceful everyday life, he snaps at Sarada’s attempts to talk to him, and almost attacks a child for bumping into him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E196 - A Binding Force
1.plot: Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles. Upon seeing this, Kawaki tells Boruto to use the power of his Karma. Meanwhile, Kawaki becomes interested in the Shadow Clone Jutsu that Naruto and Boruto like to use.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E197 - Delta
1.plot: In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions. As Naruto and Himawari watch, they activate their Karmas and confront one another. Meanwhile, Delta joins up with Koji Kashin, who’s still pursuing Kawaki. Somehow, Koji is able to sneak into the village without triggering the Hidden Leaf’s sensory system. Delta is left with no choice but to wait for his return. But when he doesn’t come back, she runs out of patience.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E198 - Monsters
1.plot: Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. Naruto confronts her to protect Boruto, Himawari and Kawaki. She attacks Naruto with Scientific Ninja Tools that have been implanted into her heavily modified body. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E199 - Overload
1.plot: Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan. He then turns up the power of his jutsu and propels it towards Delta. Unfortunately, Delta has been fitted with Scientific Ninja Tools and is able to absorb any jutsu, no matter how powerful… What will be the outcome of this battle?!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E200 - Becoming a Student
1.plot: Kawaki has lost an arm in the battle against Delta, so he is given the prosthetic arm made for Naruto. Though the prosthetic can't move without Naruto's chakra, Naruto shares some of his chakra with Kawaki. Kawaki is surprised by this gesture and remembers how Naruto said that chakra is the power to form bonds with one another. He asks Naruto to train him in Ninjutsu. Meanwhile, Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E201 - Empty Tears
1.plot: As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him. Kurama has been living with Naruto since he was sealed within him and tells Kawaki that Naruto used to be just like him. Upon hearing about Naruto's life, Kawaki aspires to become just like him. He reaffirms his decision to work with Boruto, who is also branded with a Karma, to defeat Jigen and the Kara.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E202 - The Cult
1.plot: Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan. Meanwhile, Boro, one of the leaders of the Kara, has been using his mysterious powers publicly to heal the sick. He tells the people who have gathered that he has a way for everyone to achieve happiness.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E203 - Surprise Attack!
1.plot: Kawaki's Karma starts to act up and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, appears before him! Not only are Naruto and Kawaki surprised, but so is Koji Kashin, who had been secretly keeping an eye on Kawaki. Jigen tries to take back Kawaki by force. Upon seeing this, Naruto battles Jigen to protect Kawaki! A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E204 - He's Bad News
1.plot: Naruto has been pulled into a different dimension by Jigen. There he encounters Sasuke, who tells him that Jigen is a dangerous person and that they must do whatever it takes to defeat him immediately. Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu. Meanwhile, Boruto gets a bad premonition when his Karma starts acting up, and so he quickly returns home with Mitsuki. Kawaki and Sarada are there, worried about Naruto's safety.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E205 - Proof
1.plot: Boruto, Kawaki and the others sense something has happened to Naruto. But before anyone can act, Shikamaru and his subordinates arrive and erect a barrier around the Uzumaki home to contain Kawaki, believing he can't be trusted.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E206 - The New Team Seven
1.plot: Boruto, Sarada, Mitsuki, and Kawaki arrive at the dimension that Naruto is trapped in, but Boro is there waiting for them. The four create a team with Sarada leading them to fight Boro, who uses a black mist to paralyze his enemies.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E207 - Regeneration
1.plot: The reformed Team 7 launches a series of attacks on Boro. But even when they land successful attacks, Boro instantly revives himself with his extraordinary regeneration powers.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E208 - Momoshiki's Manifestation
1.plot: Boro goes on a rampage and attempts to eliminate Boruto and the others. Boruto is beat down and falls unconscious. Then suddenly, his Karma activates and he becomes possessed by Momoshiki's spirit.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E209 - The Outcast
1.plot: Kawaki begins to worry that his presence is endangering everyone in the Leaf Village. Just as he makes the decision to leave, he notices Himawari acting strange.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E210 - Kara's Trail
1.plot: Konohamaru and Sai are given a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult in order to obtain information on Kara and its whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E211 - Tracking
1.plot: News has spread throughout the Leaf Village that a cloaked man has stolen data from the archives. Team 10 decides to launch their own investigation to find and catch the thief.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E212 - Amado's Defection
1.plot: Amado defects from Kara. Desiring to seek asylum in the Leaf Village, he takes Shikadai hostage. If granted asylum, Amado promises to provide the Leaf Village with every bit of knowledge that he has about Kara.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E213 - True Identity
1.plot: Amado reveals to Naruto and the others the knowledge that he possesses regarding Jigen, the Otsutsuki Clan, and Karma. Meanwhile, Koji Kashin confronts Jigen, and Amado's plan to eliminate him is revealed.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E214 - Predestined Fate
1.plot: Koji Kashin continues his battle with Jigen, whose body is revealed to have been taken over by Isshiki Otsutsuki. He continuously hits Jigen with a barrage of attacks in an attempt to drag Isshiki out of his body and destroy him.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E215 - Prepared
1.plot: Isshiki regains his true form and goes to the Leaf Village to recapture Kawaki. The Leaf shinobi prepare for his arrival. Boruto is willing to fight, but he becomes frightened at the possibility of losing control of his Karma again.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E216 - Sacrifice
1.plot: Boruto opens a portal and transports Isshiki and himself to another dimension. Naruto and Sasuke follow them, and the final battle against Isshiki begins.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E217 - Decision
1.plot: Naruto and Sasuke are greatly overwhelmed by Isshiki's abilities. As a last resort, Kurama offers Naruto a chakra mode called Baryon Mode, which grants him immense power. The intensity of this power, however, could end his life.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E218 - Partner
1.plot: Naruto and the others are exhausted from their battle with Isshiki. Suddenly, Boruto attacks Sasuke. Momoshiki has taken control of Boruto’s consciousness and stands before them as an enemy. Kawaki desperately calls out to Boruto to snap him out of it. Unfortunately, his words are unable to reach him. Sasuke tells Kawaki a way to bring back Boruto’s consciousness. In order to save Boruto, Kawaki attempts a risky plan using a jutsu he only recently learned. While Kawaki and Sasuke fight a desperate battle, Naruto finally runs out of strength. As his consciousness fades, he and Kurama quietly reminisce about their past.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E219 - Return
1.plot: Finished with their battle against Isshiki, Boruto and the others return to the village. Thanks to their work, the safety of the village has been maintained. Boruto is terrified by the fact that Momoshiki once again took over his consciousness during battle. Meanwhile, Amado provides some new information concerning Code, whose powers surpass Jigen. As that happens, something appears before Code, who has been keeping watch over the immature Ten-Tailed Beast in Kara’s possession!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E220 - Remaining Time
1.plot: Those with a Karma gradually lose control of their minds and bodies as they undergo Otsutsukification. Naruto convenes a Five Kage Summit to discuss what they should do about Boruto’s condition, as well as Cord, one of the leaders of Kara.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E221 - Chunin Test, Again!
1.plot: Naruto, proposes that the Chunin Exam be held to raise morale after Isshiki’s attack. Everyone is fired up for the exam, eager to show off the results of their training and experience they’ve gained from missions.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E222 - The Night Before the Decisive Battle!
1.plot: The final round of the Chunin Exam is announced. Many of Boruto’s classmates who didn’t advance to the final round of the last exam have made it this time. Also, the rules of the exam have changed: the use of Scientific Ninja Tools of your own creation is now allowed!

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E223 - Inojin VS Houki
1.plot:
The final exam has finally begun. The first match of the individual competition in the form of a real match is the VS Houki.　The twenty-fifth team of Houki and, unusually among their peers, has been involved in the mission of the "Anbu" until now. So, while we don't know what he's up to, Inojin uses his signature technique "Choju Giga" from the very beginning to hunt down Houki. However, as Houki was waiting for a chance, he suddenly lost sight of his opponent's location and the game was reversed. Who will win ......?

In this game, you'll have the chance to take the final exam, but you'll have to be careful not to get caught.

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E224 - The Legend of the Haunted Cat
1.plot: The final test, this time it's Iwabe vs Wasabi.　The two have a strong competitive spirit and usually clash with each other, but for some reason Iwabae is bewildered by Wasabi's unusual lack of energy. Wasabi, in fact, is feeling overwhelmed by the pressure of representing the hitherto unproven Izuno clan. Iwabeye is angry at Wasabi for setting her own limits on her ability and giving up. ......?　Who will be the victor in this match?

1.title: FR - Boruto: Naruto Next Generations - S01E225 - Showdown Between Best Friends
1.plot: The match between Sarada and Cho-Cho begins. Kawaki has been invited by Naruto to observe, as well as Shinki and others who have come from the Hidden Sand Village. Who will emerge victorious in a battle between best friends?!

meta.plot: The life of the shinobi is beginning to change. Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, has enrolled in the Ninja Academy to learn the ways of the ninja. Now, as a series of mysterious events unfolds, Boruto’s story is about to begin!

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E01 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP1: Departure
1.plot: A human, Sheriff Rao, Fiend Prince Beelzebub, and Thief, a demon, search for the Legendary Spring.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E02 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP2: The Royal Army's Secret
1.plot: The trio steals a Royal Army tank and winds up in a battle with a Royal Army airplane.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E03 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP3: A Man Called Legend
1.plot: As Rao's tragic past is revealed, the trio begins to battle General Are and his Royal Army Tanks.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E04 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP4: Beyond the Sandstorm
1.plot: When the Swimmers suddenly attack, Beelzebub gives chase and discovers something astonishing.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E05 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP5: The Terrifying Insect Men
1.plot: The trio arrive at the King's water source and the final battle with Supreme Commander Zeu begins.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E06 - The Story of the Fiend Prince EP6: The Fiend Beelzebub
1.plot: An enraged Beelzebub overwhelms the Insect Men as Rao infiltrates the Army's mega aircraft carrier.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E07 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP1: On to a New Adventure
1.plot: The river flows once again in Sand Land, bringing with it new encounters and a new adventure.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E08 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP2: Operation: Sneak into the Capital!
1.plot: Upon learning of King Jam's imminent execution, the trio and their new friend rush to stop it.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E09 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP3: Fiend Power
1.plot: King Jam's execution is imminent once again when Supreme Commander Bred and Muniel corner Beelzebub.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E10 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP4: Muniel's Urn
1.plot: A hint from Lango leads the four to Demon Village where King Lucifer and Muniel square off.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E11 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP5: Flying Fortress Garam
1.plot: The long-awaited invasion of Sand Land's capital can now begin as Muniel uses the Aquanium to reactivate the Flying Fortress Garam. Determined to infiltrate and stop the flying fortress, the four seek help wherever they can get it.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E12 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP6: The Final Battle!
1.plot: Beelzebub and Ann manage to get past Bred to stop Garam, only to come face-to-face with Muniel.

meta.plot: Sand Land is a mysterious world where demons and humans eke out an existence in a barren desert wasteland. In hopes of replenishing their water supply, Fiend Prince Beelzebub, a demon named Thief, and a human named Sheriff Rao team up and embark on a journey in search of the Legendary Spring.
Miyo's abusive family deems her worthless – but together with her powerful husband-to-be, her true self and hidden powers slowly begin to shine.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E01 - The Meeting
1.plot: Despised by her stepmother and sister, Miyo is treated like a servant in her own home. One day, her father calls her in to discuss her future.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E02 - About My Husband-to-Be
1.plot: Determined to be of use, Miyo wakes up early and prepares breakfast, but Kiyoka accuses her of trying to poison him and refuses to take a bite.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E03 - Our First Date
1.plot: While Kiyoka takes Miyo out to town, he quickly notices that she behaves very differently from other wealthy daughters he’s encountered.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E04 - The Gift
1.plot: To surprise Kiyoka with a handmade gift, Miyo goes into town to shop for some material. Meanwhile, Kiyoka pays Miyo's parents a visit.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E05 - Ripples
1.plot: Engulfed with jealousy, Kaya tries to thwart Miyo's engagement to Kiyoka. Miyo leaves the house and forgets to bring the good luck charm Kiyoka gave her.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E06 - Determination and Thunder
1.plot: Miyo wakes up to her sister and stepmother threatening her. Together with Koji, Kiyoka arrives at the Saimori home and demands to see his fiancée.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E07 - Glamorous Lady of Summer
1.plot: Kiyoka accompanies Miyo to the remains of the Saimori home at her request. Later, a stunning visitor comes by their home.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E08 - Nightmares and Ominous Shadows
1.plot: Hazuki and Miyo grow closer through their lessons. Worried, Kiyoka tries to get to the bottom of Miyo's relentless nightmares.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E10 - Summer Cherry Blossoms, and the Mistake
1.plot: Arata reveals his true identity and introduces Miyo to the grandfather she never knew. They claim they can cure her nightmares — on one condition.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E11 - My Mother's Legacy
1.plot: Yoshiro Usuba tells Miyo about how her mother came to marry her father — and why she made a decision that changed her only daughter's life forever.

1.title: FR - My Happy Marriage - S01E12 - Light in the Darkness
1.plot: Miyo's powers are everyone's last hope of waking Kiyoka from his unconscious state. But before she can rescue him, she must face the shadow of her past.

meta.plot: Les frères et soeurs Greyling se retrouvent dans leur maison familiale située dans le désert du Namaqualand, au Cap Nord, après que l'un d'entre eux a renoncé à un accord conclu il y a dix ans pour régler les dettes qu'ils avaient contractées lorsque leur père les avait abandonnés et avait disparu.

1.title: FR - Desert Rose - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The story begins on the day that Eben refuses to go fishing with his benefactor, Van As. Eben's rejection breaks the shackles of a decade long agreement between Van As and the Greyling family. But the debt will not disappear. Someone will have to pay. Van As searches for Freddy, beats up his daughter, Ishara, and steals her cat. Meanwhile, Jana and Piet set in motion a plan to "scare" Van As, but it goes awry and they end up kidnapping his wife, Suzanne, instead. Rosie realizes she needs to find Freddy in order to resolve the Van As situation. But she is distracted by a marriage proposal from Mack, and the revelation that her daughter, Lucy, has a major crush on her netball teacher. Rosie gets a lead on Freddy's whereabouts and leaves to go and find him. On the road to Port Nolloth Rosie dies in a car accident and her loss is the catalyst that forces the Greyling siblings to return to the family home and face their past.

1.title: FR - Desert Rose - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Lucy wakes the next morning to discover that Rosie has not come home. Captain Williams arrives at the farmhouse to break the news of the car accident. Gus prepares to resign from his job because of what Rosie has on him but he is let off the hook when news of Rosie's death filters through the school. Gus gives Lucy a lift home from school and she kisses him. Later, Patti is suspicious when she finds ice cream on her husband's collar. Ishara returns to the family home to find her siblings making plans after Rosie's loss. Jana partners with Thorne, a scam artist, to sell the farmhouse and escape. Meanwhile, Van As sends a thug called Bertus to force Freddy out of hiding. Bertus arrives at the house to kidnap Lucy but he is confronted by Ishara and a bloody Nama spear.

1.title: FR - Desert Rose - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The family bury Bertus in a quiver tree forest, hide his car and burn his belongings. Thorne invites them to breakfast so he can announce an offer on the house. Ishara and Eben contest this decision and Thorne insults Eben and refuses to pay for the meal. Lucy persuades Gus to cover the bill, and this opens up Patti's awareness of their "relationship." Ishara tries to find her father and discovers a link to a woman he was once with called Ella. This takes Ishara into the traditional Nama world to track her down. Van As sends Hugo to find out what happened to Bertus and he ends up in a violent showdown with Eben in his trailer.

1.title: FR - Desert Rose - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Eben's trailer burns to the ground. Ishara chases Van As away and accuses him of stealing her cat. Van As recalls Hugo from the Greyling situation but Hugo has unfinished business. Rosie's funeral brings the community together but everyone is shocked that Freddy hasn't pitched up. Heartbroken, Mack travels to Springbok to confront Freddy and eventually he finds him working as a busboy in a desert dive. Johnny and Ishara's budding relationship face a test because of her fear of driving and his need to connect with her. Hugo threatens Jana and Eben, so Lucy sabotages his truck with her pet Cape Cobra. Hugo is bitten and ends up crawling through the desert to his inevitable death. Hugo is saved by a traditional healer who amputates his little finger. Hugo swears revenge on the Greyling family.

meta.plot: Avec l'aide de son équipe, le magicien, humoriste et farceur professionnel Justin Willman met sur pied des canulars particulièrement élaborés pour aider des personnes à se venger.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Heads Will Roll
1.plot: Justin plays mind games with two sets of siblings and gets inside the head of an AI skeptic to prove that revenge is a dish best served cold.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Ride Or Die
1.plot: A woman pitches a rideshare nightmare to get back at her boyfriend for his distracted driving. A shy man uses a shocking prank for his marriage proposal.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Ghosting the Ghoster
1.plot: A woman recruits Justin to teach her mother a lesson in ghosting. The crew messes with grocery store patrons who don't put their shopping carts away.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Payback's a Stitch
1.plot: Years after falling for an invisibility trick inspired by Justin's viral stunt, a boy seeks payback. A husband also plots revenge against his wife.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Justin Serves Justice
1.plot: When a man jokes that he wants his husband to disappear, he doesn't expect to be taken literally. A clothes-stealing sister gets framed for shoplifting.

1.title: FR - Le Magic Prank Show avec Justin Willman [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Oversleeping the Apocalypse
1.plot: The team takes their schemes up a notch when a man convinces his prank-pulling brother that he's participated in a sleep study gone terribly wrong.

meta.plot: Dans un mystérieux pays primitif peuplé de dinosaures et d'autres créatures disparues, des personnes de toute l'histoire de l'humanité ont été ressuscitées. Lorsque la paléontologue australienne du XXIe siècle Helena Walker s'y réveille après une tragédie, elle doit apprendre à survivre et à trouver de nouveaux alliés, ou mourir à nouveau aux mains de chefs de guerre impitoyables, tout en essayant de découvrir la véritable nature de ce nouveau monde étrange.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E01 - Element 1
1.plot: Paleontologist Helena Walker awakens on an island full of strange beasts.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E02 - Element 2
1.plot: Helena's on the run from Nerva’s scouts, when she meets a new ally: Meiyin.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E03 - Element 3
1.plot: Helena makes allies in a treetop village, and travels to a Pteranodon den.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E04 - Element 4
1.plot: Helena and her friends devise a daring plan to liberate prisoners.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E05 - Element 5
1.plot: Nerva unleashes a punishing surprise-attack against John's village.

1.title: FR - ARK: The Animated Series - S01E06 - Element 6
1.plot: Helena, John and Henry risk everything to rescue Meiyin from Nerva.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E01 - Sauce for Prayers
1.plot: As the fight for independence teeters on the brink of defeat, Benjamin Franklin and his grandson plunge into a world of intrigue and deception.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E02 - Welcome, Mischief
1.plot: An arms operation is threatened by a ruthless opponent. The Paris police watch Franklin's every move. Temple makes a confession.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E03 - Pride and Gout
1.plot: Bad news arrives from America. Franklin finds himself ensnared in the traps of Versailles. Temple bows down before a star.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E04 - Small Revenge
1.plot: Franklin pays back an insult—and receives the favor of a king. A new lover catches his eye, and an old rival turns up to thwart him.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E05 - The Natural State of Man
1.plot: Tensions mount between Franklin and Adams. Madame Brillon asserts her power. Temple decides to fight his own war.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E06 - Beauty and Folly
1.plot: Franklin suspects traitors are everywhere. Vergennes makes a final offer. Jacques introduces Temple to the thrill of the hunt.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E07 - Begin by Creeping
1.plot: After victory at Yorktown, the Americans and the French plot against each other for the upper hand. Franklin is laid low at a crucial moment.

meta.plot: En décembre 1776, Benjamin Franklin est mondialement connu pour ses expériences sur l'électricité. Mais sa passion et son influence sont mises à rude épreuve lorsqu'il embarque pour une mission secrète en France tandis que le sort de l'indépendance des États-Unis est en jeu.

The story is set a hundred years after a war between the Empire of Snow (Ice Tribe) and the Fire Tribe, where the Fire Tribe was defeated. However, the war was fatal, leaving Prince Ka Suo and his younger half-brother Ying Kong Shi the only royal heirs and pure-blood ice illusionists left in the Ice Tribe. Conflict ensues after Ka Suo reluctantly ascends to the throne as his lover, Li Luo, and his brother go missing. Ka Suo also accidentally discovers an evil presence lurking in the Ice Tribe's holy shrine. He and his companions enter the mysterious shrine, and defeat head of the shrine, Lady Yuan Ji, only to find out that she has been plotting a conspiracy against him. Ka Suo also experiences hardships in trying to find his lover and brother, not knowing that his brother has lost all of his memories and has become the Fire Prince under his mother's command. A war between the two tribes commences once again, with the two brothers pitted against each other.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: At his coming-of-age ceremony, reluctant 130-year-old ice prince Ka Suo faces an undesirable future -- as well as a fiery interloper.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Trouble arises during a battle in the Snow Fog Forest, but young Shi has a trick up his sleeve. The Fire King enacts a treacherous plan.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Prince Shi embarks on a potential suicide mission to retrieve the Spirit Devouring Sword. A traitor reveals the Ice Clan's weakness to the Fire King.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While journeying to the Mortal Kingdom with Shi, Ka Suo has a vision of an apocalyptic future. The Fire King learns the secrets of the ice crystal.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: In search of the crystal leaf, Ka Suo and Li Luo trek to the realm of the Healer Tribe. Yun Da looks for Shi but instead finds a dazed man in a lake.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Reunited with the adult Shi, the gang quests further with a Healer prince in tow. But they soon meet a warrior woman who has a bone to pick with Shi.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: While Ka Suo has a run-in with the Tiger Monster, Li Luo and Luna battle a nasty demon themselves. But the crystal leaf lies with a more sinister foe.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Ka Suo and Li Luo arrive at the ethereal Dream City, where they are soon tasked with retrieving a lord from a mind-bending inner reality.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: As everyone’s dreams intersect, reality becomes nearly impossible to untangle. Li Luo discovers the truth about Xing Jui.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The Fire King formulates a sinister plot as Ka Suo and Li Luo struggle to escape the dream world. The Dream King’s motives may not be what they seem.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: The Fire Clan targets the Bear Clan while Ka Suo visits the Spirit Clan. Yun Fei feels the effects of the heart-burning fruit he was fed.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: While demonic music mesmerizes the mortals, Ka Suo and Li Luo struggle to find the antidote. Yan Da’s emotions get in the way of her duties.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: A desperate Yan Da makes a sacrifice in order to save Shi. Princess Lan Shang of the Mermaid Tribe gets a bitter taste of mortality.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Ka Suo races to reach the Predor Mermaid before the Fire Tribe does. But the Fire King has prepared a cruel ordeal for him: a prison of despair.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Ka Suo remains powerless and despondent as the Fire King assumes control of the Ice King’s body, forcing Shi to take matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: The Mermaid Saint agrees to help Shi kill the Fire King under one condition, which leads to tensions between Shi, Yan Da and Lan Shang.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Lian Ji frets over Shi’s involvement with Yan Da. Lan Shang goads Shuo Gang and the Fire King into a duel for her hand in marriage.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: While Lan Shang readies herself for a harrowing wedding day, Ka Suo’s soul journeys to a dark place to retrieve the dangerous Spirit Devouring Sword.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Ka Suo is horrified to learn he’s possessed by the sword spirit. Meanwhile, his love for Li Luo angers the Ice King.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: As Yan Da infiltrates the City of Bladed Snow to meet Shi, Lian Ji becomes more determined to ensure that he takes the throne.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: The decision of who will be the next Ice King proves difficult as deceit and conflicting prophecies complicate matters.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E22 - Episode 22
1.plot: While the fight for the throne continues to pit brother against brother, the Head Dreamer has a vision that might foretell the future.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E23 - Episode 23
1.plot: After Ka Suo is attacked by a strange black fog in the mortal realm, Li Luo is banished from the Ice Clan for failing to protect him.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E24 - Episode 24
1.plot: Li Luo prepares to leave for the northern border. Shi realizes he may have to choose between his brother and everyone else in his life.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E25 - Episode 25
1.plot: The Ice Tribe tries to expedite the naming of a new king when it seems they are under attack. Li Luo attempts to sniff out the Fire Tribe's spy.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E26 - Episode 26
1.plot: Various tribe leaders throw their support behind Ka Suo and Shi. Li Luo stumbles upon the banished She Yin, bringing her one step closer to her goal.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E27 - Episode 27
1.plot: The battle for the throne commences as Liao Jian challenges Pian Feng, and Lan Shang faces off against Chao Ya.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E28 - Episode 28
1.plot: The battle for the throne barrels toward its conclusion. Ka Suo learns of a disturbing prophecy that seems to dictate he must win.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E29 - Episode 29
1.plot: Ka Suo struggles to contrive an outcome of the match in which Shi isn't harmed. Li Luo discovers the secrets of She Yin's past.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E30 - Episode 31
1.plot: After the battle, Ka Suo and Shi must deal with two very different transformations. Xuan Ta and Xing Jiu look for the traitor among the Ice Tribe.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E31 - Episode 31
1.plot: Hoping to cure Ka Suo, Li Luo brings the Fallen Oracle to the Ice Tribe. The Fire King blackmails Shi into helping him conquer the three realms.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E32 - Episode 32
1.plot: Lian Ji's treacherous machinations lead to deadly consequences. Shi prepares for his new role as a leader.

1.title: FR - Ice Fantasy - S01E33 - Episode 33
1.plot: Shi concocts a plan after the Fire King overwhelms an Ice Tribe outpost with arrows. Li Luo begins to avoid a bewildered Ka Suo.

meta.plot: Jack, commandant de bord pilotant aussi mal sa vie personnelle que son avion, et Charlie sa co-pilote, reléguée d’une compagnie prestigieuse à Flywingz, sont obligés de collaborer. Pour ce faire, ils seront épaulés par une équipe de PNC étonnante : la naïve Nelly, Nabil, le stewart le plus imprévisible que le ciel ait connu, Tristan l'arriviste, et Armelle, militante de tous les combats. Une visite d'inspection qui tourne au fiasco, un enfant qui prend les commandes de l’avion ou une formation de sécurité qui part en vrille : notre équipe de bras cassés (presque) toujours soudée tentera tant bien que mal de gérer ces situations absurdes. Et tant pis si les méthodes adoptées ne respectent pas toujours les procédures de sécurité. Bon vol !
