4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E01 - Le Mardaric (Peyruis)
4.plot: On the spot, Helmut, an 85-year-old former paratrooper, manages a restaurant with his own methods: he goes behind everyone to criticize the slightest failure, criticizes his chef for not saving enough money, castigates his waitress for being too provocative when she wears a skirt, and interferes in the customers' conversations during service. As a result, the restaurant has a very bad reputation and the room is empty. However, this old man claims a family management of his restaurant and did not hesitate to give his chance to young people of the village to make his store work. Unfortunately, the benevolent grandfather has gradually turned into a terror for the staff. The arrival of Philippe will shake up Helmut's habits, especially since Ludovic, the young and talented chef, is on the verge of implosion. Another encounter that holds many surprises for Philippe Etchebest, our two-starred chef.

4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E02 - Chez maman (Amiens)
4.plot: He will meet Quentin, a young entrepreneur who has created an original concept of restaurant in the heart of the city: an establishment called "Chez Maman" in which the furniture is for sale in the form of a flea market. Philippe will also meet Jacques, a former legionnaire and chef with a fiery temperament. This 40-year-old Picard is a force of nature who works with well-established values: respect, loyalty, honesty and a code of honor. Between the two men, the torch burns; Quentin regularly interferes in the management of the kitchen, Jacques' preserve. Misunderstandings, outbursts and insults: the two men are close to coming to blows... and as a result, nothing works in the establishment. Philippe Etchebest will have a lot of work to do to bring the two men to their senses and will have to use his imagination to reconcile two people who hate each other. His objective will be, as always, to find the way back to the heart to allow each of them to blossom in their profession.

4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E03 - L'olivier (Montesquieu-Volvestre)
4.plot: Philippe Etchebest goes to Ariège to Fabio and Emilie's restaurant, parents of a little girl. A beautiful establishment with a garden that has trouble filling its room. It must be said that the manager has a bad temper... Of Italian origin, he likes to insult everyone in his restaurant, especially his girlfriend. It is not rare that the customers hear these disputes, which does not encourage anyone to return. Emilie is in charge of the service but has no professional training. She also has to take care of her daughter who lives with them in the restaurant. Today, the business but also the family life of this young couple are threatened. As always, Philippe will have his work cut out for him to tame Fabio's explosive personality and bring some sanity back into the management of this establishment.

4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E04 - La Villa Blanche (Chalèze)
4.plot: It is in Chalèze, not far from Besançon, that Gianni and Julie called upon Philippe Etchebest. This couple of managers is in the process of seeing their restaurant sink on the banks of the Doubs. Since the opening, 3 and a half years ago, they never agreed on what they wanted to do with this establishment. Gianni, of Italian origin, wants to make pizzas; Julie, his companion, would like to make gastronomy. By arguing too much about the identity of their restaurant, Gianni and Julie are now arguing all the time... All the employees suffer from these arguments and the bad atmosphere reigns during the services, to the detriment of the customers' satisfaction! If Philippe doesn't intervene very quickly, this establishment will end up closing its doors...

4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E05 - Le Mas Peynier (Peynier)
4.plot: Patrick and Cathy, a couple of restaurateurs, called on him. The couple had worked in a high-altitude restaurant for years and wanted to be closer to their family. Unfortunately, the clientele in the mountains is not the same as in the south. And serving Savoyard fondues in the land of cicadas is not necessarily appreciated! As a result, the restaurant is often empty and the couple's life is shattered by working hard to get the business back on track. The arrival of Philippe is going to upset things, the couple is going to have to review their copy. But above all, by discussing with Lilian, Cathy and Patrick's son, Philippe will realize that the family is threatened, that it is imperative that the couple give themselves time to strengthen the family ties. Between a moving realization and saving a family in danger, Philippe will have his work cut out for him.

4.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S04E06 -

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E01 - Crêperie d'Antan (Nantes)
5.plot: Monique has acquired a small restaurant in one of the most commercial streets of Nantes. Her plan: to bequeath this establishment to Laure, her daughter. In the kitchen, there is Kevin, Laure's boyfriend. Unfortunately, this project turned out to be a failure: today, the room is empty while all the nearby pancake restaurants are full. The problem is that neither Monique, Laure, nor Kevin understand the origin of the disaster; they wait, in vain, for customers who don't come. Philippe Etchebest has one week to figure out what's wrong and try to give the restaurant a new lease on life. As soon as he arrives, he meets Kevin, the cook who has no experience in the business. But in the restaurant business, good will is not enough! And no luck, Philippe loves pancakes. The meeting is going to be tense and Philippe will have to use all his pedagogy to teach him the rudiments of the profession of cook... and avoid a nervous breakdown!

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E02 - Le Nautique (La Ciotat)
5.plot: Philippe Etchebest goes to La Ciotat to an establishment overlooking the sea that serves a lot of fish... frozen. On the spot, the manager has trouble trusting his chef: a young woman full of energy who has trouble getting respect. Philippe Etchebest will have to fight against the preconceived ideas to bring some sense to the restaurant. And above all, he will have to use all his authority to convince the manager to change his habits!

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E03 - Tourist Bar (Orbec)
5.plot: On the spot, Sylvie bought an establishment for her children. Her daughter Mathilde is in charge of the management. A young woman with experience, Mathilde did her apprenticeship in luxury hotels. The mother has also placed her son Guillaume in charge of the restaurant. Unfortunately, the brother and sister don't get along at all! Mathilde reproaches her brother for his lack of involvement and Guillaume reproaches his sister for her incessant criticisms: between them, the torch burns... and the establishment sinks. As soon as he arrives, Philippe Etchebest discovers a terrible kitchen, a backyard that looks like a real dump and a family history that is in a bad way... As always, he has to dot the i's and everyone will have to face their responsibilities. And once again, it won't be easy...

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E04 - O Clin d'œil (Vendargues)
5.plot: In the heart of a large shopping area, Nathalie and Jean-Pierre have invested all their savings in a large restaurant that can accommodate a hundred people. Unfortunately, no one comes to their place. Worse, in the face of these difficulties, Jean-Pierre, who is the boss's companion but who also takes care of the pizzas, puts his grain of salt in everyone's work. The atmosphere deteriorates and Nathalie can no longer fulfill her role as manager. The result is a talented chef who refuses to get involved... The starred chef Philippe Etchebest is not going to take the gloves off when it comes to raising the problems of one or the other. He will meet a young talented chef who will totally crack up when he arrives, a Nathalie on the verge of breaking up and a Jean-Pierre who hides his game well... Another complicated affair that needs to be cleared up urgently to save an establishment.

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E05 - La Taverne des Pirates (Neufchateau)
5.plot: On the spot, he will meet Marc, manager of a tavern that is heading straight for disaster. Marc is American, and more than 20 years ago he left his country to come and live in France and open his own restaurant. His menu includes pizzas, pasta, calf's head, oceanic dishes, pancakes... anything and everything. In the dining room and in the kitchen, there is consternation, a team mobilizes every day to go to work but everyone has given up: the kitchen is in an incredible state of dirtiness, the waitress is on the verge of a nervous breakdown, in short, everything is going from bad to worse under the outdated eye of Marc, who no longer knows how to handle it. Chef Philippe Etchebest has only one week to shake up the (bad) habits of the whole team and try to save this drifting establishment...

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E06 - Au Vieux Port (Irigny)
5.plot: Direction Irigny, in an establishment run by Ruben, a hardworking and demanding manager who tends to put his staff under pressure. Young, ambitious and perfectionist boss, he is everywhere and especially on everyone's back. So much so, that today the staff is about to quit. Philippe discovers a talented and devoted team that has lost all its motivation. As soon as he arrives on the scene, he will understand that the manager wants to control everything and will do everything to destabilize him so that he understands how much he needs the others to make his establishment work.

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E07 - La Belle Époque (Cabourg)
5.plot: Cabourg, in a large brasserie on the Normandy coast. On the spot, Monique and Jean-Louis are the managers of an establishment that is desperately running out of business. The couple, who are not in the business, found themselves at the head of a team of 10 people overnight. Unable to coordinate the work of the staff, Jean-Louis collapses a little more each day. The atmosphere in the restaurant is electric and the number of departures is increasing. Faced with this lack of stability, Gregory, the head chef, has taken the place of the boss and is reigning terror around him... Needless to say, the arrival of Philippe Etchebest will shake things up. How to push the manager to take his place as boss? How to calm down the chef's ardor? These are the difficult objectives that the chef will try to achieve.

5.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S05E08 -

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E01 - Le Joker (Marseille)
6.plot: In this establishment in the heart of the artists' district, the manager Rémy has a lot of trouble finding the identity of his restaurant. This former Air Force commando rifleman manages the restaurant with his own methods: he imposes excessive quantities on the customer's plate and insists on keeping a long menu that penalizes his chef, Pascal. Rémy doesn't listen to anyone, neither his staff, nor his mother Lilly who has invested all her savings to allow her son to realize his dream and open this establishment. Philippe Etchebest will have to fight against Rémy's preconceived ideas to bring some sense back to the restaurant. And above all, he will have to use all his authority to convince the manager to change his habits and to renew his relationship with his mother.

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E02 - Pizza Kelly (Cagnes sur Mer)
6.plot: Direction Cagnes-sur-Mer, in a pizzeria held by Cathy, a manager who cruelly lacks self-confidence and who tends to put her staff under pressure. For lack of means, Cathy cannot hire any more. For the past year, her parents, Claude and Graziella, have been working in the dining room and in the kitchen! As soon as he arrives on the scene, Philippe understands that Claude and Graziella are at their wits' end and that there is absolutely nothing professional about this establishment. The worst thing is Cathy's stock management, because the expired products go straight to the customer's plate. The arrival of Philippe will shake up the manager's habits and she will have to question everything!

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E03 - O Cantinho (Pfastatt)
6.plot: Direction PFASTATT, in an Italian-Portuguese restaurant run by Monica, a manager with a strong character who runs her business with an iron hand. Six years ago, she sacrificed everything to open her restaurant, but today, nothing goes right and her life savings are going up in smoke... For the boss, the problem comes from her employees who lack professionalism, don't respect her and don't follow her directives... A situation she can't stand anymore! But for the employees, the problem is the boss! Her tantrums and screams stress everyone, including the customers... As a result, the atmosphere in the restaurant is electric... The worst part of it all is that it's a family conflict. Paolo, the chef, is Monica's older brother and he is finding it increasingly difficult to cope with the situation. The arrival of Philippe will shake up the family's habits and they will have to question everything!

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E04 - Au coin du feu (Vandœuvre-lès-Nancy)
6.plot: On the spot, Jean-Michel, a boss desperate by the failure of his establishment, and Fréderic, a chef with a strong character who no longer has the taste for a job well done! Eight years ago, when they started the business, it was quite successful, but for the past three years, the two men have been going in circles during the services and are unable to question themselves. Philippe Etchebest will have to fight against the boss's preconceived ideas, and above all use all his authority to convince the chef to change his bad habits. Philippe has known chefs who have given him a hard time, but Fréderic dethroned them all! Another encounter that holds many surprises for our two-starred chef.

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E05 - Le Jardin Italien (Martignas-sur-Jalle)
6.plot: On the spot, Christophe, 54 years old, has been managing his establishment since 1988 with his own methods: he doesn't trust anyone, needs to control everything and, during service, yells at his employees! As a result, no one wants to work with him anymore and he is forced to be an accountant, a chef and a dishwasher all at the same time. Fortunately, Audrey stays by his side and takes care of the service in the dining room, but she finds it more and more difficult to put up with her boss' moods. The arrival of Philippe will shake up Christophe's habits and he will completely change his attitude towards the chef. But Philippe Etchebest is not fooled and will use his ingenuity to make the boss's mask fall off and bring back some sanity to the restaurant.

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E06 - Le Cèdre Vert (Gardonne)
6.plot: It is in Gardonne, in Dordogne, that Philippe Etchebest was called to help Vincent and Marina. This couple from Brittany left everything 6 months ago and invested all their savings to buy the restaurant of their dreams! But since their arrival, their business is collapsing day after day. Faced with these difficulties, Vincent, the chef, has completely given up; and his partner Marina is completely lost and doesn't know what to do anymore. Not only is their relationship in peril, but they also have their backs to the wall: they risk losing everything and ending up on the street with their two children. Philippe Etchebest is their last hope, but the task will prove to be extremely difficult: in addition to Marina's inexperience in the dining room, the chef will come up against Vincent's lack of motivation: poorly kept buffet, cobwebs in the kitchen, expired products in the fridges... Philippe will have to try to give him back his taste for cooking!

6.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E07 -
FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S06E08 -

7.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S07E01 - Auberge de la Venise Verte (Arçais)
7.plot: It is in Arçais in the Marais Poitevin that Chantal and her family called upon Philippe Etchebest. Eight years ago, Chantal and her husband Alain took over an inn and invested all their savings in it. Alain, although retired, is in charge of the bar. Jimmy, their son, is in the kitchen, and Chantal manages the dining room. But, year after year, the business collapsed... For lack of customers, the owners are on the verge of closing down, and the family is on the verge of breaking up! Philippe soon realized that the real problem at this inn was the atmosphere... A stormy atmosphere, both in the kitchen and in the dining room, which was going to put him in a bad mood. The chef is going to give them an ultimatum: if Chantal and her family don't accept his help and refuse to open their eyes, he will be forced to abandon his mission and leave them alone to face their fate...

7.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S07E02 - Le Pontet (Quintenas)
7.plot: It is in Quintenas, in Ardèche, that Anthony called upon the chef Philippe Etchebest. A year and a half ago, Anthony took over the reins of a traditional cuisine restaurant on a whim, but, alone at the head of the establishment and at the stove, Anthony was drowning in problems. Self-taught and without any experience in business management, he even had to call upon his mother on a daily basis to support him. The latter does not hesitate to travel 200km to help her son! But in spite of this, since the opening, the debts are piling up and the restaurant keeps emptying itself of its customers. According to Anaïs, the waitress, this is due to the bad reputation of the boss, who is said to have a temper! The arrival of Chef Etchebest will shake up Anthony's habits who, very impressed, will completely change his attitude towards him!

7.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S07E03 - O Franco Thaï (Marseille)
7.plot: Called for help by Marie, the starred chef goes to Marseille, to Mélody's restaurant. The latter had opened her establishment five months earlier. And since the launch, nothing has gone as planned. Not having the means to pay employees, Mélody asked Marie, her partner, to take care of the service but also of the restaurant's accounts. The problem is that the young woman has no experience in the field. The couple of Marie and Melody is put at risk by the situation. Philippe Etchebest tries to save the situation. But as soon as he arrives, he notices mistakes in the kitchen and a very rough service. And the chef, with her strong temperament, will give him a hard time.

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E01 - Vite fée bien fée (Marseille)
8.plot: Philippe Etchebest was called to Marseille to help Sandrine, manager of a local restaurant that she runs with her sister Aline and her daughter-in-law Sabrina. As soon as he arrived, the chef quickly wondered where he had set foot... The establishment looked more like a beauty salon than a restaurant! And once at the table, nothing got better: the dishes offered turned out to be bland and uninteresting, but above all, the atmosphere between the two sisters is so electric that the meal quickly turned into a vaudeville! A situation that could have amused the chef if the future of the restaurant was not at stake. Between Sandrine, the boss who has completely given up, and her sister Aline, whose character and very familiar attitude will not fail to irritate the chef, Philippe Etchebest will have to redouble his efforts to try to save this restaurant that is on the verge of exploding!

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E02 - Le Saint Nicola (Besançon)
8.plot: It is in Besançon, in the Doubs region, that Julien called on Chef Etchebest to help his father Tony, the owner of an Italian restaurant. In this rudderless establishment, communication is totally broken between Tony, the boss, Bastien, the apprentice cook, and Julien, who works in the dining room. Between a dubious kitchen, a cantankerous boss who smokes in his office in the middle of the service, and an approximate organization, laxity has clearly taken over the restaurant! And, faced with Tony's strong character, Julien and Bastien start to seriously give up: this business is on the verge of implosion! Philippe Etchebest will have to take up a major challenge: confronting a fiery business manager and demotivated employees, ready to jump ship. Tony, Julien and Bastien will have to react together or else the restaurant will definitely close its doors.

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E03 - Le Madrid (Canet-en-Roussillon)
8.plot: It was in Canet-en-Roussillon that Alex called on chef Philippe Etchebest to try to help him. After a flourishing career that led him to work for a time in New York at the UN, Alex realized his childhood dream 17 years ago by becoming the owner of a restaurant on the seashore. But for the last 4 years, it has been a downhill slide. With no customers, the restaurant's financial situation is catastrophic, to the point that Alex is now on the verge of eviction. He risks ending up on the street and, in his fall, he is not alone: he takes with him his young apprentice cook, Alexis. Alex and Alexis are sinking, but the chef would never have imagined to what extent. As soon as he arrives, Philippe Etchebest is literally shocked by the dilapidated state of the restaurant: broken windows, dust on the cutlery, a menu full of mold...

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E04 - La Table d’Enzo (Hyères)
8.plot: It is in Hyères, in the Var, that Vanessa called upon Chef Etchebest. 20 months ago, Vanessa and her husband Stéphane decided to take over a restaurant, but since the opening, it is every day the same nightmare: the restaurant remains desperately empty... For lack of customers, the financial situation of the couple becomes very critical, especially since Vanessa invested all her savings in this business. Their daily life is thus extremely heavy and big tensions appeared in the couple. But between Stéphane's lack of organization in the kitchen, even though he has more than 20 years of experience, and Vanessa's lack of communication, who does not see her own mistakes, Philippe Etchebest has his work cut out for him! Faced with Stéphane's behavior, who refuses to assume the problems of his establishment, the chef will even wonder if, for once, he will not give up the idea of helping them...

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E05 - Brasserie de Lyon (Marseille)
8.plot: It was in Marseille that Siham called on chef Philippe Etchebest to help her. Six months ago, Siham fought and invested all her savings to make her dream come true: setting up a restaurant with her sister Sanna and her cousin Leila in the kitchen. But she thought she was living a great family adventure, but her dream has turned into a nightmare. The customers have deserted the establishment and the turnover is collapsing... It must be said that in this restaurant, nothing works: the menu offers Provencal cuisine, passing by burgers and Moroccan specialties. The dishes served are insipid, but above all, the atmosphere is electric! The relationship between the two sisters is complicated and tensions are omnipresent. A new challenge for the chef because if the restaurant doesn't recover very quickly, Siham risks losing everything: her dream and her family.

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E06 - Le Grill (Tarbes)
8.plot: It is in Tarbes that Philippe Etchebest will try to save a new restaurant. 25 years ago, Christian took over an establishment with his wife Joëlle and his nephew Christophe. After years of hard work and sacrifices, today the business is failing and nothing is going right anymore. Christian has worked day and night to the point of exhaustion and has never taken a vacation. The years go by and the customers don't come anymore, to the point that the financial situation of the restaurant is catastrophic: for the last 5 months, Christian can no longer pay his nephew; he is demoralized and is afraid of ending up on the street. It's a new challenge for the chef who will have to try to save a restaurant held by the same person for 25 years! And so many bad habits and mistakes that Christian has never wanted to admit. One thing is sure: if Christian continues to deny it, the chef will not be able to save his restaurant.

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E07 - L'Auberge du canal (Écuisses, Saône et Loire)
8.plot: It's in Écuisses, in Burgundy, that Élodie and Allan called on chef Philippe Etchebest to try to save their establishment. Parents of 5 children, they took over a village restaurant 4 years ago to give themselves a new life. While everything was going well for the first two years, an unfortunate event turned everything upside down and the couple's financial situation became catastrophic. Today, the whole family is in danger. As soon as he arrives, Philippe Etchebest realizes how badly the couple is doing: the restaurant is in a deplorable state and the dishes cooked by Allan are not very tasty... The situation is so terrible that the chef doubts his ability to help them avoid closing their restaurant. One thing is sure, this issue of "Nightmare in the kitchen" will be more than intense for Philippe Etchebest who will have to face a huge challenge... And despite all their mistakes, this couple will literally upset the chef.

8.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E08 -
FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S08E09 -

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E01 - Lou Pebren d'aï (Cavalaire)
9.plot: It is in Cavalaire, in the Var, that Pascale and Patrick, who have been together for 32 years, have called upon Chef Philippe Etchebest! Owners of a seaside restaurant that used to run smoothly, for the past few years the couple has seen its financial health deteriorate: Today, the situation is alarming, the bills are piling up and the bailiffs are knocking at the door. However, with Pascale's smiling welcome and Patrick's solid training as a cook, they had everything to succeed! But behind this idyllic image, the chef will quickly discover another reality: dishes with a very dated look, cooking problems, failed desserts, Philippe Etchebest will quickly be disappointed. And the chef will not be at the end of his surprises, he will quickly discover that within the couple, there is no more communication, in their life as at work.

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E02 - Au Lion des Flandres (Lesquin)
9.plot: It is in Lesquin, in the Hauts-de-France region, that Marie-Claude, 62 years old, called upon Chef Philippe Etchebest to try to help her save her restaurant. For 36 years, her husband Pascal has owned a restaurant that, after years of success, is now on the verge of bankruptcy. As soon as he arrived, the chef quickly understood that this mission was going to be complicated: between Marie-Claude's strong character and Pascal's total lack of organization in the kitchen, the restaurant couple is going to give him a hard time. Marie-Claude and Pascal are going to show the chef a colorful face, with their temper tantrums, bad faith, flying fries in the kitchen and smoking cigarettes in the dining room! And to make matters worse, relations between them are becoming increasingly tense! However, if they don't manage to straighten things out very quickly, it will not only be the end of their relationship but also of their restaurant...

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E03 - Coyote Café (devenu Le Liseré) (Dunkerque)
9.plot: Chef Philippe Etchebest was called to Dunkirk to help Melanie, a young mother of 26 years old, who took over a local institution 8 months ago: a Mexican restaurant! For fear of scaring away the regulars, Melanie has not made any changes to the establishment. She even kept the chef, Élodie, a 37-year-old cook with a strong character, who has been working there for 14 years. But since she took over the restaurant, nothing is going right. The establishment, which was working very well a few months ago, has seen its turnover drop by 50%: today, the situation is catastrophic to the point that Melanie is struggling to pay her bills. Faced with these difficulties, the atmosphere is particularly tense between Melanie and Elodie. The two women are on the verge of an explosion! They are going to push Chef Etchebest to the limit and give him a hard time...

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E04 - L'Isle aux pizzas (Saint-Astier)
9.plot: It was in Saint-Astier, in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, that Marielle asked chef Philippe Etchebest to intervene to save the restaurant of her partner, Patrick. A chef for 28 years, Patrick has had many successful businesses and so the chef expected to make a decent meal. But sometimes appearances are deceiving, and in Saint-Astier, he was quickly disillusioned when he discovered that this experienced chef had totally lost the desire to cook: in his establishment, he was now content to open cans of food... To make matters worse, the restaurant was disorganized and in total chaos! The result: relations between Marielle and Patrick are more than strained... Philippe Etchebest is going to have to take up a new challenge: trying to make Patrick open his eyes, whose strong character is going to give him a lot of trouble!

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E05 - La Table de Rouges Masures (Roumazières-Loubert)
9.plot: Philippe Etchebest was called to Roumazières-Loubert, in Nouvelle-Aquitaine, to help Isabelle and Christian. Owners of a roadside restaurant for a few months, the couple's sales have collapsed and bankruptcy threatens. But for the first time in Cauchemar en Cuisine, Chef Etchebest will find himself completely destabilized by this establishment: impeccable service, more than correct cooking, owners who listen to their employees... He will be confronted with a real enigma: why is this restaurant, where everything seems to be going well, not working? The Chef will have to conduct a real investigation, even going so far as to observe a service on hidden camera, so that the truth will finally come out! How will he react when he discovers the truth? Will he accept to help this couple who hid the truth from him?

9.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S09E06 - La Perle noire (Montpellier)
9.plot: It is in Montpellier, in the Hérault region, that Fatiha and Adel asked Philippe Etchebest to help them save their restaurant. Owners of a large establishment, well located in the heart of a business incubator, they are now on the verge of bankruptcy but do not know why. However, it didn't take long for the chef to see the problems flash before his eyes: stale whipped cream, poor organization, communication problems... nothing is going right in this restaurant. Adel is not in the business and, given the state of his kitchen, he can't hide it even if his strong character prevents him from admitting it! And to make matters worse, Fatiha also has big gaps in her knowledge. And despite their 44 years together, the relationship between Fatiha and Adel is extremely tense... Philippe Etchebest will have to face a new challenge that is much more complicated than it seems!

10.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S10E01 - La Durancette (Sénas)
10.plot: Philippe Etchebest has come to try to unblock the situation of the restaurant of three sisters, in Sénas in the Bouches-du-Rhône. Mélanie and Mylène, two 28-year-old twins, have called on him to save the restaurant they run with their older sister Séverine. As soon as he arrived, the chef discovered the icy atmosphere that reigned in this establishment deserted by customers, although it was full of assets: a good location in the center of the village and surrounded by many shops. The chef finds himself in the middle of a family conflict... But Philippe Etchebest remains determined to help them and save their restaurant...

10.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S10E02 - Brasserie Foch (Antibes)
10.plot: Childhood friends, Thomas and Romain run a brasserie in downtown Antibes, in the Alpes-Maritimes. Despite an ideal location, their establishment is drowning in debt and could close within a few months. The two managers have both worked in the world of high gastronomy, Romain having even been the chef of a starred restaurant for several years. The chef Philippe Etchebest is therefore faced with a real challenge: to find out why their business is going so badly despite their rich experience.

10.title: FR - Cauchemar En Cuisine Avec Philippe Etchebest - S10E03 - Le Crazy Frog (Saint-Estèphe)
10.plot: Philippe Etchebest arrived in Saint-Estèphe, in the Dordogne, at the home of Thierry and Amanda, a French-English couple who opened a pub a little less than a year ago. Contrary to his habit, when he arrived, the chef was pleasantly surprised by the "so british" decoration and Amanda's English charm... Unfortunately, he was quickly disappointed! Frozen products, badly cooked duck breasts, industrial desserts: the Chef discovered a cook who, despite his 40 years of experience, is the king of freezing! And, to make matters worse, problems are piling up in this restaurant: in addition to the kitchen that leaves something to be desired, the organization in the dining room is surreal and Amanda and Thierry are completely overwhelmed. If they continue like this, their restaurant will go straight into the wall and they risk losing everything...

1.title: FR - Bad Sport : la triche organisée - S01E02 - Need for Weed

1.title: FR - Bad Sport : la triche organisée - S01E03 - Footballgate
1.plot: Investigators detail shocking allegations that former Juventus director Luciano Moggi influenced referees in a scandal that rocked Italian football.

1.title: FR - Bad Sport : la triche organisée - S01E04 - Gold War
1.plot: Controversy erupts at the 2002 Winter Olympics when a figure skating judge is allegedly pressured to rank Russia over Canada in the pairs competition.

1.title: FR - Bad Sport : la triche organisée - S01E05 - Horse Hitman
1.plot: Tommy Burns looks back with regret at his disturbing days of killing show horses as part of an insurance fraud scheme concocted by wealthy owners.

1.title: FR - Bad Sport : la triche organisée - S01E06 - Fallen Idol
1.plot: Hansie Cronje captivates South Africa as the nation's charismatic cricket captain, but allegations of match fixing besmirch his sterling reputation.

meta.plot: Crime et sports se percutent dans cette série documentaire qui passe en revue des polémiques et des scandales avec l'appui de témoignages de personnes qui les ont vécus.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E01 - Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe
1.plot: A kitten named Precious is floating out to sea, and the PAW Patrol must rescue her, but that's not all. The PAW Patrol must also act fast to find her owner before the mischievous kitten gets into big trouble.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E03 - Pup Pup Boogie
1.plot: A train car falls off the tracks and also breaks some rails. A train is coming later with important packages in it, with the all new Pup Pup Boogie 2.0 dance game. The PAW Patrol tries to fix the tracks, but how will they fix the tracks when Rubble sprains his paw and can't work? Can Chase save the day?

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E05 - Pups Save the Sea Turtles
1.plot: Baby sea turtles were hatching at the other side of the road near the beach. They can't get to the beach without crossing the street, there are cars, skateboarders, scooters and all the hungry naughty seagulls around, not to mention Alex's rambunctious antics.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E07 - Pups Save the Circus
1.plot: Ellie, the baby elephant from the Circus train, has escaped and is loose in Adventure Bay!

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E09 - Pup Pup Goose
1.plot: When a flock of migrating geese stops in Adventure Bay, Marshall bonds with Fuzzy, the gosling of the flock.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E11 - Pups Pit Crew
1.plot: The pups help a young boy named Alex fix his broken tricycle and teach him a valuable lesson of taking new things slow.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E13 - Pups Save the Bunnies
1.plot: A bunch of adorable bunnies have come to Farmer Yumi's carrot patch. The PAW Patrol must catch them all and relocate them to a perfect new home.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E15 - Pups Save the Bay
1.plot: There's an oil spill in the bay, and a Baby Whale swam into the oil. The PAW Patrol must clean up the Baby Whale and the oil spill before more animals living in Adventure Bay are harmed by it.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E17 - Pups Get a Rubble
1.plot: This episode is a flashback story of how Rubble joined the PAW Patrol. Rubble must help Jake when he gets trapped in an Avalanche.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E19 - Pups Save the Treats
1.plot: On a snow and icy day, Mr. Porter's van ends up sliding on ice. If the ice cracks, it will fall into the bottom of the bay, and inside of the truck has all the pups' treats and food in it!

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E21 - Pups Save a Hoedown
1.plot: The PAW Patrol are having a great time at the Adventure Bay Hoedown, but trouble starts to brew when Farmer Al's cows get spooked out and are on the loose in Adventure Bay.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E23 - Pups and the Ghost Pirate
1.plot: A Halloween party turns into a spooky time when there's a ghostly figure roaming around on a ship. Can the PAW Patrol solve the paranormal mystery and save the Halloween party?

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E24 - Pups Save a School Day
1.plot: It's Alex's first day of school, but he has lost his backpack! So the PAW Patrol agrees to help him find it.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E26 - Pups Save a Pool Day
1.plot: It's a hot day and the pups head for the water park, but the pool is empty! The water tower that pumps water into the pool is tilted and has a bent pipe.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E28 - Pups Make a Splash
1.plot: Cap'n Turbot got The Flounder stuck on some rocks. If the PAW Patrol doesn't save him, The Flounder will sink to the bottom of the bay!

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E30 - Pups Save Christmas
1.plot: Santa's sleigh crashes and breaks in a snow storm on Christmas Eve, and all the presents are strewn across Adventure Bay. It's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the sled, collect the reindeer, find the gifts, find the magic star, and most importantly, save Christmas for Adventure Bay.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E31 - Pups On Ice
1.plot: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E33 - Pups Save a Super Pup
FR - PAW Patrol - S01E35 - Pups Go All Monkey
1.plot: An escaped baby monkey named Mandy leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay, when she steals Mr. Porter van full of bananas.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E37 - Pups Save a Bat
1.plot: A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell and Mayor Goodway can't ring it. Ryder and the Pups attempt to rescue the bat quietly so it doesn't wake up, but it does and causes trouble around town. It's up to Ryder and the Pups to get the Bat and return her to her Bat cave.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E39 - Pups Save the Easter Egg Hunt
1.plot: It’s Adventure Bay’s annual Easter Egg Hunt and the pups are helping Mayor Goodway with the egg decorating. The hunt for a very special egg leads Ryder and the PAW Patrol on an exciting adventure.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E40 - Pups and the Lighthouse Boogie
1.plot: Cap'n Turbot has accidentally locked himself inside the lighthouse, so it is up to the pups to rescue a rowboat drifting out to sea.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E42 - Pups Great Race
1.plot: It's Adventure Bay Race Day and the pups are about to race each other all across the town to see who is the fastest pup. One other competitor unexpectedly shows up though, Alex in his super trike!

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E44 - Pups and the Beanstalk
1.plot: Rubble has a wondrous dream, similar to Jack and the Beanstalk, where Marshall grows a giant beanstalk and Alex is a giant. However, when giant Alex starts to cause havoc, Ryder and the PAW Patrol must keep him occupied.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E46 - Pups Save the Camping Trip
1.plot: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E01 - Pups Save the Space Alien
2.plot: An alien lands on Earth at Farmer Yumi's place, and the gang try to repair his spaceship so he can return home.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E02 - Pups Save a Flying Frog
2.plot: Marshall gets a pet frog, and it jumps into a helicopter prior to a big frog-jumping competition.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E03 - Pups and the Pirate Treasure
2.plot: Cap'n Turbot accidentally stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout. When the PAW Patrol rescues him, they find an incomplete treasure map. The adventure is on as the pups follow clues to find the missing map pieces, and eventually to an amazing sunken pirate treasure!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E04 - Pups Save the Penguins
2.plot: The pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E05 - Pups Save a Dolphin Pup
2.plot: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E06 - Pups Save Jake
2.plot: The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E07 - Pups Save the Parade
2.plot: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E08 - Pups Save the Diving Bell
2.plot: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E09 - Pups Save the Beavers
2.plot: When a storm washes away Chompy the Beaver's dam, he starts chomping wood all over town.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E10 - Pups Save a Ghost
2.plot: A mysterious Ghost is causing havoc around the Lookout at night. The Pups and Chase in his new SPY GEAR set up a stakeout to bust it.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E11 - Pups Save a Show
2.plot: The Pups are going to put on a Medieval play in town square, but Cap'n Turbot's castle stage prop ends up collapsing and trapping him!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E13 - Pups Save a Wedding
2.plot: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi are getting married! Farmer Yumi's barn is being decorated for the big day and all the pups are helping, but a big storm blows in and takes down a wall of the barn!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E14 - The New Pup
2.plot: An Arctic storm picks up, but Jake finds help from a brave mountain ranger pup named Everest!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E15 - Pups Jungle Trouble
2.plot: The PAW Patrol heads to the Jungle in the PAW Patroller to meet Ryder's 10 year old pen-pal, Carlos.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E16 - Pups Save a Herd
2.plot: Chase is taking part in a herding competition and starts to herd people around town as practice which causes more trouble than good.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E17 - Pups and the Big Freeze
2.plot: A wintertime storm causes trouble all over Adventure Bay.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E18 - Pups Save a Basketball Game
2.plot: Marshall is nervous about playing in the PAW Patrol basketball team. Chase lets Marshall sit out, but when Zuma and Rocky get injured, Marshall is forced to take over.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E19 - Pups Save a Talent Show
2.plot: It's Adventure Bay Talent Show Day! Mayor Goodway is excited but afraid there won't be enough acts! Ryder's super talented pups can definitely help out.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E20 - Pups Save the Corn Roast
2.plot: Ryder and the Pups help Farmer Al prepare his annual Corn Roast, complete with a Corn Field Maze! Bettina accidentally tips over some hot BBQ coals onto the piles of corn that begin to pop, pop, POP into piles of POPCORN!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E21 - Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone
2.plot: Ryder and the Pups head out for a day of Parachute training, but Marshall decides to stay back because of his fear of heights.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E22 - Pups Save the Deer
2.plot: Cap'n Turbot goes out ice fishing and finds a family of Deer stuck on the slippery ice! They must have tried to get across the frozen Bay for food! Ryder and the PAW Patrol to the rescue!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E23 - Pups Save a Friend
2.plot: Feeling like his clumsy ways are constantly messing up his friends' fun, Marshall decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off into the woods. Once the pups notice Marshall is gone, they jump to action to find him and bring him back to the Lookout.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E24 - Pups Save a Stowaway
2.plot: The PAW Patrol is on another road trip--this time to the icy tundra to help Jake count penguins.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E25 - Pups Save the Parrot
2.plot: Ryder and the PAW Patrol head to the Jungle in the PAW PATROLLER to help their good friend CARLOS find his lost Parrot, Matea!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E27 - Pups' Adventures in Babysitting
2.plot: Mayor Goodway has her hands full with her twin niece and nephew Julia and Julius. She calls on the PAW Patrol to rescue them from a tree, and then twin sit for the day!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E28 - Pups Save the Fireworks
2.plot: Mayor Goodway receives a package of piglets instead of the fireworks she was expecting. It turns out that the mailman has been making sloppy deliveries as he keeps delivering each package to the wrong address.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E29 - Pups Save an Elephant Family
2.plot: The Pups are on a PAW Patroller road trip to the Savana where they meet up with Photo Safari fans Cap'n Turbot and his cousin François Turbot. In the middle of the night the campers are awakened by an intruder who turns out to be a lost baby elephant - Gilda.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E30 - Pups and the Mischievous Kittens
2.plot: Adventure Bay has been picked as a Finalist in the Tidiest Town Contest and looks like they're going to win! That is until Mayor Humdinger unleashes his Kitten Catastrophe Crew and those naughty kittens mess up everything in sight.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E31 - Pups Save a Mer-Pup

3.plot: Trapped in an isolated mansion during a storm, Charlie and Rex must uncover a wannabe-killer after the hostess is drugged, while Sarah fights to keep her alive.

3.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S03E14 - The Secret Life of Levi
3.plot: Jesse's friend vanishes; Charlie and Rex discover the man was living two separate lives.

3.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S03E15 - Seeing Is Deceiving
3.plot: A magician dies during a practice-run of her latest routine; Charlie and Rex must look beyond the smoke and mirrors to uncover the truth.

3.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S03E16 - The Art of the Steal
3.plot: Charlie and Rex witness an armed robbery during a trip to the bank; they discover a connection to a string of ingenious unsolved heists.

4.plot: When two hikers are discovered murdered near a remote coastal trail, the team is on the hunt for a fugitive duo wanted in a series of grisly campsite murders.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E02 - Oops I Bit It Again
4.plot: When a troubled popstar is suspected of killing her fiancé, the team's investigation uncovers the distorted loyalties formed when personal ties meet the trappings of fame.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E03 - Rex Marks the Spot
4.plot: After a journalist is killed searching for buried pirate treasure, Charlie and Rex dig deep into the competitive world of treasure-hunters to unearth the killer.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E04 - Leader of the Pack
4.plot: While Sarah embarks on a wilderness adventure, Charlie and Rex investigate the murder of a college professor.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E05 - Rex to Riches
4.plot: A stock market guru's fortune is stolen, setting Charlie and Rex on the trail of a very surprising thief.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E06 - Dead Man's Bridge
4.plot: After a truck transporting liquid explosive is hijacked by criminals, Charlie and Rex find themselves in a race against time to prevent the case from blowing sky high.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E07 - A Stab in the Dark Web
4.plot: As Major Crimes investigates a dark web marketplace, Charlie and Rex protect a witness in their home.

4.plot: After an elite hockey prospect is found dead, Charlie and Jesse disagree over the prime suspect in the case.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E09 - Impawster Syndrome
4.plot: The Major Crimes team is forced to turn against Jesse when he becomes the prime suspect in a bank robbery.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E10 - Blood & Diamonds
4.plot: After a raw diamond is found at the crime scene of a murder, Major Crimes sets up a stakeout to take down the suspected gem smugglers. An undisclosed team connection threatens to derail the investigation.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E11 - Capital Punishment
4.plot: Charlie and Rex receive an award for heroism while Major Crimes investigates an extremist threat.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E12 - No Man Is an island
4.plot: Charlie, Rex and Sarah travel to an isolated island community caught up in a resettlement dispute. Donovan tries to stop a British police officer from derailing the investigation.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E13 - Roses of Signal Hill
4.plot: Rex's starring role in a television commercial is interrupted by the murder of one of the agency's ad executives.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E14 - Roll the Bones
4.plot: After the owner of a construction company is found dead, Charlie and Rex track the killer to an underground casino. Major Crimes goes undercover to solve the case.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E15 - Nightmare on Water St.
4.plot: While St. John's celebrates Mardi Gras, Charlie and Rex investigate a targeted killing spree.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E16 - Dog Days Are Over
4.plot: When Officer Maya Power and her K9 partner Rebel are violently attacked responding to a call about a warehouse break-in, Major Crimes is at the ready.

5.plot: When Charlie's estranged brother is accused of the death of his recent boxing opponent, Charlie and the team wrestle with the possibility of his guilt.

5.plot: When Rex is accused of attacking a decorated former police officer, Charlie enlists the help of an unorthodox ally to uncover the truth in the hopes of restoring Rex's position on the team.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E06 - Den of Snakes
5.plot: When the co-owner of a successful board game company is found dead of a snake bite, the team has to not only catch the hugger but also the deadly venomous snake still on the loose.

5.plot: After two killers escape from St. John s Women s Penitentiary, the team is stymied in their attempts to capture the duo when their antics turn them into modern-day folk heroes.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E08 - Bury the Lead
5.plot: When Supt. Donovan's journalism student daughter investigates the story behind a murder on her university campus, the team races to find the killer before someone else becomes the next victim.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E09 - Rexpert Witness
5.plot: When an important trial is jeopardized after Sarah s testimony is challenged by a former rival in court, it s up to Charlie, Rex, and the rest of the Major Crimes team to uncover new evidence to save the case before time runs out.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E10 - One Wild Night
5.plot: When the maid-of-honor winds up dead after a bachelorette party, it s up to Charlie and Rex to untangle the events of the night.

5.plot: When Rex finds a body with signs of foul play during Charlie and Sarah's romantic weekend getaway, they discover the idyllic community they're staying in may be more hostile than it looks.

5.plot: After a popular physiotherapist is murdered, the team must investigate the victims of his alleged sexual assaults in order to track down the killer before they strike again.

5.plot: When Charlie's beloved Aunt Miranda and her friends are caught investigating an investment fraud scheme, it's up to Charlie and Rex to get to the source of the fraud.

5.plot: When a famous starlet is killed onstage during a preview performance of abeloved Newfoundland play, Rex takes on a starring role while Charlie goesbehind the scenes.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E16 - Due North
5.plot: Rex seeks help from Detective Sidney Scott to save his stranded and injured friends.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E17 - Lost and Found
5.plot: Charlie gets a break in a long-unsolved kidnapping case that has haunted him, but runs into trouble when the abductee refuses his help.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E18 - Jail Break
5.plot: An imprisoned killer forces the station into lockdown by taking a hostage and attempting escape.

5.plot: Charlie and Rex sniff out the suspects when the Chief Superintendent of the St. John's Police Department dies at a popular restaurant and all signs point to poison.

5.plot: Charlie and Rex try to take down a car theft ring after one of the team is seriously injured trying to stop a theft in progress.

meta.plot: Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E01 - We Open Her Chakras Episode 1
1.plot: Charlie, a discreet cop who was stationed at the complaints office, interfered with the investigation by his colleague Chris to find Anna, a six-year-old girl. Headed by Samy, the new trainee, she will discover exceptional investigator skills, inherited from her great-grandfather: Sherlock Holmes.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E02 - SearchK-Lista Episode 2
1.plot: Charlie is the only one to take seriously the disappearance of K-Lista, an influence. Samy and she immerse themselves in the world of social media to understand what could have happened to her: easy money, jealousy, secret relationships, many could have wanted her to harm. Unless all of this is just a staging, meant to make the buzz?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E03 - Off Course Episode 3
1.plot: Nicolas, a friend of Charlie's youth, calls him for help when he has just had a tragic car accident for Anthony, his brother-in-law, who was in the passenger seat. But then, real accident or sabotage? Immersed in the world of vintage cars, will Charlie have enough back to find out who could have done attack on his friend?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E04 - Baker Street Episode 4
1.plot: Her personal history led her to London and Charlie was determined to meet her half-sister. Samy, of course, accompanies him on his journey. On the way to visiting Sherlock Holmes' house, they meet Tracy, a young psychotic girl, who begs them to help her: her sister's ghost would have come to warn her that she was in great danger. Will they be able to prevent Tracy from suffering the same tragic fate as her dead sister a few years ago?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E05 - 20 Degrees Episode 5
1.plot: Jiyoung, a talented young icerman, is found dead, frozen, in the supergelator of the factory where she worked. If her professional requirement had not brought her only friends and might lead her to revenge, Charlie will discover that the young woman voluntarily returned to the freezer... but why?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E06 - The Last Problem Episode 6
1.plot: George, Charlie's grandfather, is in a coma after an attempted murder. The police station mobilized to find the culprit, while Charlie was excluded from the investigation. But Charlie is determined to shed light on the case, in the back of the brigade, always with Samy's help. But she soon discovers that all incriminates her...

meta.plot: Shy cop Charlie, descendant of Sherlock Holmes, lives with grandfather until a car accident changes her. Her newfound energy and brilliance as a cop lets her embrace life and solve crimes with Watson-like partner Samy.
Inspired by real events, this fictional dramatization shows Griselda Blanco's journey from Medellín to becoming "the Godmother" of Miami's drug empire.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E01 - Lady Comes to Town
1.plot: Griselda flees Medellín for Miami to make a fresh start. With her sons and a hidden cache in tow, she seizes a chance to establish her own business.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E02 - Rich White People
1.plot: Griselda welcomes some well-supplied Medellín associates to Miami, but an enemy isn't far behind. A night out fuels a bold plan to tap into a new market.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E03 - Mutiny
1.plot: After Griselda receives a tempting offer from a big-time supplier, she tries to win over a business rival and earn the trust of the local dealers.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E04 - Middle Management
1.plot: Griselda hides out in a secure compound and prepares to make her move against the Ochoas. June joins an elite tactical unit targeting drug traffickers.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E05 - Paradise Lost
1.plot: Griselda suspects there's an informant in her ranks as June and CENTAC gain ground. A lavish, coke-fueled birthday party descends into chaos.

1.title: FR - Griselda - S01E06 - Adios, Miami
1.plot: Feeling pressure from all sides, Griselda gets out of Miami. But with her options dwindling and enemies closing in, can she outrun fate?

meta.plot: Narrée en VO par Cate Blanchett, cette magnifique série sur la nature explore l'intelligence, l'ingéniosité et le caractère interconnecté de la vie sur notre planète.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Nature's Amazing Network
1.plot: Rhinos in Nepal, reindeer in the Arctic and agoutis in the Amazon — every creature, big and small, is connected to nature's vast network of life.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Rhythm of Life
1.plot: Timing is crucial. From the setting of the sun to the passing of the seasons and the phases of the moon, nature works best when it's in sync with life.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Breaking Point
1.plot: The impact of climate change is now impossible to ignore. As the natural world is thrown off balance, the call for action is more urgent than ever.

1.title: FR - Notre monde vivant [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Road to Recovery
1.plot: While bushfires and poaching leave devastation in their wake, the reintroduction of a predator breathes new life into wetlands overrun by rodents.

meta.plot: Dans un monde en proie à des d’effroyables monstres géants connus sous le nom de kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspire à rejoindre un jour les Forces de Défense pour combattre ces terribles créatures. C’était un rêve qu’il avait avec son amie d’enfance, Mina Ashiro, mais leurs chemins ont pris des directions différentes. Aujourd’hui, Kafka nettoie les rues de leurs encombrants cadavres quand il croise la route de Reno Ichikawa. La détermination de Reno à rejoindre les Forces de Défense pousse Kafka à rejoindre Mina afin de protéger l’humanité.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E01 - The Man Who Became a Kaiju
1.plot: Kafka Hibino has almost abandoned his dream of joining the anti-Kaiju "Defense Force." He now works in Kaiju clean-up, disposing of the bodies of slain Kaiju and thinking back with regret to the days he spent with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, captain of Defense Force's Third Division.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E02 - The Kaiju Who Defeats Kaiju
1.plot: After turning into a Kaiju, Kafka is forced to flee. His escape is interrupted, however, by the arrival of another Kaiju...

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E03 - Revenge Match
1.plot: Kafka arrives for one last shot at the Defense Force entry exam... but can he pass while keeping his Kaiju powers a secret?

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E04 - Fortitude 9.8
1.plot: An unexpected incident during the exam forces Kafka to use his powers at the risk of revealing his secret.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E05 - Joining Up!
1.plot: Kafka is now a member of the Defense Force, if not a full-fledged one. But Hoshina tells him he has three months to prove himself before he's fired...

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E06 - Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak
1.plot: It's time for Kafka's first mission, and he witnesses the true power of the Defense Force when a Kaiju strikes a nearby city.

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E07 - Kaiju No. 9
1.plot: Reno and Iharu encounter a powerful humanoid Kaiju that quickly overwhelms them. Can help arrive in time?

1.title: FR - Kaiju No. 8 - S01E08 - Welcome to the Defense Force
1.plot: After transforming into a Kaiju to rescue Reno and Iharu, Kafka is found by Hoshina, who immediately attacks him.

1.plot: Tachikawa base comes under attack from the air, as a powerful Kaiju has its sights set on the Defense Force.

1.plot: When the Defense Force is in danger, Kafka is forced to choose between keeping his secret and saving his comrades.

1.plot: Kaiju No. 8 is captured, and Kafka is at the mercy of the Defense Force's most important leaders.

meta.plot: Alors qu'un astéroïde se dirige inexorablement vers la Terre, une enseignante déterminée ne recule devant rien pour assurer la sécurité de ses anciens élèves.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E01 - Football, Bloody Hell!
1.plot: Traumatized by a tragedy that keeps haunting her, Jin Se-kyung vows to keep her loved ones safe and plots revenge against the perpetrators.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E02 - Love Is Back
1.plot: Suspecting Se-kyung's role in the latest murder, Kang In-a gives her a warning. But as Se-kyung plans her next move, a surprising visitor greets her.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E03 - I Have Butterflies...
1.plot: Ha Yun-sang's friends celebrate his sudden return, despite the mystery surrounding it. Meanwhile, Se-kyung realizes she's being watched.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E04 - Felix Culpa
1.plot: Se-kyung confides in In-a about the ominous threats she's been receiving. The two later embark on a dangerous mission to confront the criminal.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E05 - The Girl with a Cat
1.plot: Despite her recent win, Se-kyung still worries that the threat isn't over. Yun-sang receives an enigmatic proposal involving important missing figures.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E06 - Much Ado About Nothing
1.plot: Disorder during the joint memorial Mass leads to chaos at the church, increasing criticism and scrutiny into the whereabouts of Father Baek.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E07 - Arirang; Gone, but Not Forgotten
1.plot: Se-kyung discovers more about a mysterious training center, and pleads with In-a to investigate it. They soon find darker secrets lie within the building.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E08 - Dum Spiro Spero
1.plot: In the aftermath of the raid, the group encounters pushback from authorities — but they uncover more disturbing details about Father Baek's activities.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E09 - Silver Lining
1.plot: Se-kyung and Yun-sang finally confront Father Baek, who in turn leaves them with a choice, forcing Se-kyung to ask Yun-sang an impossible question.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E10 - Exodus, Eclipsed
1.plot: On the day of the evacuation, Se-kyung and her friends coordinate a plot to get the children to safety. But pandemonium ensues as the plane approaches.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E11 - Last Christmas
1.plot: Accepting the fate of the asteroid, everyone tries to carry on with their lives. But the harsh and grim realities of their last days set in.

1.title: FR - Goodbye Earth - S01E12 - Goodbye Earth
1.plot: With less than 20 days left, survivors solemnly brace for the asteroid. However, Se-kyung remains steadfast in her mission to protect the children.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E01 - The Day I Became a Shinigami
1.plot: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E02 - A Shinigami's Work
1.plot: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E03 - The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
1.plot: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E04 - Cursed Parakeet
1.plot: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E05 - Beat the Invisible Enemy!
1.plot: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E06 - Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
1.plot: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E07 - Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E08 - June 17, Memories in the Rain
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E09 - Unbeatable Enemy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E10 - Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
1.plot: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E11 - The Legendary Quincy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E12 - A Gentle Right Arm
1.plot: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E13 - Flower and Hollow
1.plot: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E14 - Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E15 - Kon's Great Plan
1.plot: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E16 - The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
1.plot: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E17 - Ichigo Dies!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E18 - Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E19 - Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
1.plot: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E20 - Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
1.plot: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E01 - The Blood Warfare
2.plot: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E02 - Foundation Stones
2.plot: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E03 - March of the Starcross
2.plot: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E04 - Kill the Shadow
2.plot: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E05 - Wrath as a Lightning
2.plot: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E06 - The Fire
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E07 - Born in the Dark
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E08 - The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
2.plot: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E09 - The Drop
2.plot: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E10 - The Battle
2.plot: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E11 - Everything but the Rain
2.plot: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E12 - Everything but the Rain: June Truth
2.plot: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E13 - The Blade Is Me
2.plot: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E14 - The Last 9 Days
2.plot: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims that Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E15 - Peace From Shadows
2.plot: As the Seireitei is completely replaced by the Wandenreich, the Gotei 13 are confronted by the Sternritter.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E16 - The Fundamental Virulence
2.plot: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo to search for a way to reclaim everyone’s stolen Bankai. Urahara claims that he was able to come up with a solution based on the data gained from his earlier battle with Quilge.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E17 - Heart of Wolf
2.plot: The tides of battle seemed to have turned after the captains reclaimed their stolen Bankai. However, the Stern Ritters release their Quincy Voll Stern Dich to drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E18 - Rages at Ringside
2.plot: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine, who has already defeated Shuhei Hisagi, Ikkaku Madarame, and Yumichika Ayasegawa. However, Kensei is taken aback by how weak his opponent is.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E19 - The White Haze
2.plot: A fearless Rukia swings her Sodenoshirayuki in battle as she takes on Äs Nödt.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E20 - I Am the Edge
2.plot: Isane and Yachiru are treating the wounded Kensei and Rojuro when they are attacked by Gwenael, a Quincy who not only possesses the ability to disappear physically but can also erase his existence from the memory of his opponents.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E21 - The Headless Star
2.plot: Kenpachi defeats Gremmy, but his moment of victory is cut short when he is suddenly struck by Candice’s thunderbolt attack. Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto also join Candice to take down Kenpachi, who is considered to be a Special Threat.
