meta.plot: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Now at an NGO in Penamstan, Claire discovers signs reminiscent of Raccoon City. Leon makes his way to the White House, unaware that it's under attack.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Leon, along with agents Jason and Shen May, embarks on a covert mission to infiltrate a research facility in Shanghai aboard a nuclear submarine.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Claire discovers a grim scene at the home of one of the last surviving members of the Mad Dogs Unit. Shen May warns Leon about an ominous conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Secretary Wilson threatens Claire's life, demanding that she drop her investigation. Leon and Shen May rush to the vast subterranean bioweapons lab.

meta.plot: Years after the horrors of Raccoon City, Leon and Claire find themselves consumed by a dark conspiracy when a viral attack ravages the White House.

1.title: FR - La Recrue - S01E01 -
FR - La Recrue - S01E02 -
FR - Wild Cards - S01E01 - The Infinity Thief
1.plot: To regain his detective status, Cole Ellis, a demoted by-the-book cop, is assigned to work with Max Mitchell, a spirited con artist whose charismatic street smarts could help catch an elusive thief.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E02 - Show Me the Murder
1.plot: A community outreach lecture on porch pirates turns into a murder investigation when Max and Ellis find an elite sports agent dead in his condo. Max’s dad George gives her advice – from his jail cell.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E03 - Howl to Get Away with Murder
1.plot: Things go from quaint to creepy when Max and Ellis look into the disappearance of a butcher in a small rural town. The duo gets a lesson in team building and Max quizzes Ellis on his personal life.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E04 - Strangers on a Wave
1.plot: When a surfer is mysteriously killed, Detectives Simmons and Yates are assigned the case. But it’s Ellis who grabs a board and goes undercover, taking a page out of Max’s book of disguise.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E05 - The Accountant of Monte Cristo
1.plot: When Ellis’s federal agent ex-girlfriend loses an accountant scheduled to testify against the mob, she enlists their help to find him before the accountant ends up sleeping with the fishes.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E06 - Dead of Night
1.plot: When the leads of THE most popular vampire show on TV become the target of a stalker, Max and Ellis enter the world of showbiz where the behind-the-scenes drama is even wilder than what’s on screen.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E07 - Con With the Wind
1.plot: George gets a 3-day pass from jail to spend with Max but the urge to pull one more con is real. Ellis helps a troubled youth charged with a B&E after he discovers it’s a teen his brother used to know.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E08 - Eternal Sunshine of the Therapized Mind
1.plot: When a celebrated therapist and best-selling author is murdered, a bickering Max and Ellis go undercover as a married couple at her wellness retreat and discover more than their chakras.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E09 - Inside (Con)Man
1.plot: Max visits the bank to access her safe deposit box but instead becomes a hostage in a dangerous robbery. Ellis defies Chief Li's orders to wait for the Tactical Response Team, knowing Max is inside.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E10 - Romancing the Egg
1.plot: Ellis is drawn into a case involving Max, her ex, and a world-famous Imperial egg, where a cat-and-mouse heist tests their friendship, their partnership, and their trust in each other.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E01 - Con in 60 Seconds
2.plot: Begrudgingly, Ellis comes to terms with Max's betrayal knowing she risked it all to share info about his brother's killer; now assigned to a new case, they dive into a high-speed street racing ring.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E02 - Once a Con a Time in the West
2.plot: Max and Ellis saddle up for a wild west adventure as they track down the attempted murderer of a ranch family's stud horse and uncover a dark family secret.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E03 - The Lorne Identity
2.plot: A paranoid biomedical engineer with a case of amnesia comes to Ellis for help leading the team down a trail of conspiracies, corruption and secret codes.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E04 - Dial 'A' for Alibi
2.plot: Stuck at home with a sprained ankle and a pair of binoculars, Max is convinced she has witnessed a murder while snooping on the condo across the street.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E05 - Catch Me if You Con
2.plot: Max's childhood bestie visits, pulling her into her old con ways. While Ellis investigates the murder of a former tennis pro, the BFFs go undercover to find the killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E06 - Seance and Sensibility
2.plot: Max and Ellis investigate a mysterious murder among an eccentric family where everyone is a suspect with riches on the line. Max adopts a psychic persona and holds a séance to summon the true killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E07 - The Big Bang Theory
2.plot: When Chief Li and Max are trapped in a hostage situation, Ellis tries to save them without letting his emotions cloud his judgement.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E08 - Death By Design
2.plot: When the head of a popular streetwear clothing brand is found dead, Max and Ellis find themselves investigating a murder within the world of haute couture, fashion models, and overworked assistants.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E09 - Barking Bad
2.plot: A murdered dog show judge leads Max and Ellis to a traveling dog competition to sniff out the killer. Ellis and his cat Marc move in temporarily with Max and Ricky while Ellis' boat is under repair.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E10 - Our Lip (Fillers) Are Sealed
2.plot: Max and Ellis go undercover, joining the cast and crew of a reality show to find out who murdered its star. In a world of scandal, deceit and lip-filler parties, every cast member is under suspicion.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E11 - Bride and Doom
2.plot: Max and Ellis are pulled into the undercover world of espionage and counterintelligence when a bride becomes the target of an unusual murder attempt on her wedding day.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E12 - Clouds In My Eyes
2.plot: Ellis gets new information that leads him to a jazz club and possibly the person responsible for Daniel's death. Max poses as a singer at the club to gather intel. George goes before the parole board.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E13 - Sunrise Sunset
2.plot: Ellis makes a shocking discovery about the criminal kingpin responsible for Daniel's death, and who is protecting him. Max, George and Ricky try to solve the cryptic clues hidden in Ashford's office.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E01 - September 21
1.plot: Rosario and Alfonso report their adopted daughter, Asunta, as missing. But what police assume is a kidnapping quickly spirals into something sinister.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E02 - September 24
1.plot: The investigation discloses unexpected details about Rosario's love life. A new testimony goes over Asunta's last months and points to alarming signs.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E03 - September 26
1.plot: As questions and evidence mount, public opinion turns against Rosario and Alfonso, whose relationship proves to be more turbulent than it looked.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E04 - September 28
1.plot: The defense attorney switches gears and reveals that Asunta had been targeted in the past. However, the new evidence seems off to Judge Malvar.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E05 - 24 Hours
1.plot: Detectives piece together theories about Asunta's death, her complicated relationship with her parents and Rosario and Alfonso's co-dependency.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E06 - The Trial
1.plot: Pressure builds on both sides as evidence and key testimonies are scrutinized in court. A new set of eyes on the case could sway the verdict.

meta.plot: Après avoir signalé la disparition de leur fille Asunta, âgée de 12 ans, des parents se retrouvent rapidement visés par l'enquête.

1.title: FR - The Veil [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Camp
1.plot: Imogen visits a refugee camp in the remote mountains on the Turkish and Syrian border. Amongst the chaos, she seeks out Adilah, who has been separated and detained from the rest of the refugees.

1.title: FR - The Veil [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Crossing the Bridge
1.plot: Imogen and Adilah continue on their journey to Paris and face a threat in Istanbul. Meanwhile, the pressure mounts on the CIA and DGSE to determine the true identity of the "Djinn al Raqqa."

1.title: FR - The Veil [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - The Asset
1.plot: Imogen reunites Adilah with her daughter in Paris as truth and lies become further blurred.

1.title: FR - The Veil [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Declassified
1.plot: Amidst the increased threat on her daughter's life, Adilah reveals a secret to Imogen. Max must deal with the consequences of Emir's arrival in Paris.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E01 - Welcome to Chateau Rosabelle
1.plot: For months, Lisa Vanderpump has meticulously curated her latest business venture: a chateau in the South of France. But when the first guests check in for a luxury experience, will the new staff be able to provide the service that meets Lisa’s standards?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E02 - No Room for Error
1.plot: Upon learning of a huge argument in front of the guests, Lisa sets her staff straight. With the marquee event less than 24 hours away, can the staff put aside their differences and come together to help the Guest of Honor pull off a secret proposal?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E03 - From One Queen to Another
1.plot: The Chateau welcomes a close circle of friends who are celebrating a ‘Rebirth’ party. Eric attempts to navigate managing duties while receiving pushback from Stephen and Lisa. Two ladies in the staff develop romantic feelings for the same co-worker.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E04 - A Naughty Night in Versailles

meta.plot: Men in Black: The Series, also known as MIB: The Series and Men in Black: The Animated Series, is an American animated television series that originally aired on The WB's Kids' WB programming block from October 11, 1997 to June 30, 2001. The show features characters from 1997's science fiction film Men in Black, which was based on the comic book series The Men in Black by Lowell Cunningham, originally published by Aircel Comics.

1.plot: While trying to get Skraaldians out of New York sewers, Jay uses his Noisy Cricket on one and kills it. Problem is, all Skraaldians are psychically linked and know what Jay did. And every last one will go after him to settle the score.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E02 - The Buzzard Syndrome
1.plot: Jay and Kay investigate a crashed alien ship in the woods when they encounter Treblor, an alien cop from the Zombarian Retrieval Department. Treblor says the owner of the crashed ship is a fugitive named Z-Ron. While Jay goes out ahead to get Z-Ron, Kay learns Treblor isn't who he says he is.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E03 - The Irritable Bow-Wow Syndrome
1.plot: A Charnok has to come to Earth and ransacked Jeebs' pawn shop as well as hunting reliable MIB informant, Frank the Pug. After some investigating, Jay and Kay learn the Charnok was trying to buy a Void Density Core from Jeebs, who didn't want to sell it. Frank made off with it during the fight and accidentally swallowed it. Now the MIB have to get the VDC out of him before it detonates and sucks the city into a miniature black hole.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E04 - The Alpha Syndrome
1.plot: Investigating the theft of a Sintillian heart, Kay learns the culprit is Alpha, his former mentor and the man who left him for dead years ago. But Jay and Kay discover Alpha now has multiple body parts grafted onto his body, becoming even more dangerous.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E05 - The Undercover Syndrome
1.plot: Jay goes undercover as a Tarkan bodyguard at an alien conference to protect Dirndl, Trade Minister of Tarka, from an alien assassin.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E06 - The Neuralyzer Syndrome
1.plot: While trying to stop alien thieves known as Chop Shoppers, Jay's accidental use of the Neuralizer erases Kay's memories and makes him think he is sixteen.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E07 - The Symbiote Syndrome
1.plot: When Kay is infected with Millicrons, Jay takes his place on an assignment to transport a symbiote named Troy to New York City. He has to do it within twenty hours or be permanently absorbed by Troy. But Buzzard returns and is looking to capture the symbiote for his mysterious boss.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E08 - The Inanimate Syndrome
1.plot: An Inanimate, a shapeshifter capable of disgusing itself as inanimate objects, escapes from prison to Earth. But the MIB get some help from Eileen, an intergalactic cop that stirs up some old feelings for Kay.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E09 - The Psychic Link Syndrome
1.plot: An insane Alcidian named Forbus is hunting humans, draining them of their bodily fluids. But during the pursuit, Forbus forms a psychic link with Kay, making him feel whatever he feels.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E10 - The Head Trip Syndrome
1.plot: Jay mistakes a Cerebro-Accelerator for a pair of head phones, making him the smartest man on Earth. However, this will also cause his brain to explode in twenty-two hours. But his advanced brain is MIB's only hope when someone uses time travel to erase the five founders of MIB from existence.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E11 - The Elle of My Dreams Syndrome
1.plot: Alien dream eaters known as the Vermax attack the crew of a returning NASA space shuttle. When Jay, Kay and Elle arrive at the landing sight, a Vermax attaches itself to Jay and sends him into a deep sleep. Elle enters Jay's dreams to get him to wake up and remove the Vermax.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E12 - The I Married an Alien Syndrome
1.plot: The Blastula are increasing the temperature on Earth in their plot to colonize the planet.

1.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S01E13 - The Take No Prisoners Syndrome
1.plot: Dr. Lupo and other inmates of MIB's prison ward manage to break out and incapacitate most of MIB. Only Jay and the worms can save the day.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E01 - The Little Big Man Syndrome
2.plot: The Fmeks are stealing human suits from their enemies, the Arquillians. Jay gets shrunk down to their tiny size to find out what the Fmeks are up to.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E02 - The Quick Clone Syndrome
2.plot: Jay gets Elle to make him a set of quick clones so he can catch up on some much needed sleep. But while Jay snoozes, Alpha resurfaces and uses one of the quick clones to capture Zed.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E03 - The Heads You Lose Syndrome
2.plot: Alpha is back and his alien attachments are falling apart. At first, he forces Jeebs to locate new alien body parts for him. But when Alpha discovers Troy the symbiote is at MIB, his plans change.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E04 - The Dog Eat Dog Syndrome
2.plot: Drekk, an old friend of Frank the Pug, is running loose on Earth. And Frank faces getting boiled alive if he helps Jay and Kay apprehend him.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E05 - The Big Bad Bug Syndrome
2.plot: The Queen Bug puts out a bounty on the MIB agent that took out dearly departed Edgar. Now Elle is running from some nasty bugs looking to collect the reward.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E06 - The Jack O'Lantern Syndrome
2.plot: It's Halloween night and trick-or-treating with the worms gets dangerous when Jay comes across an alien that kidnaps children.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E07 - The Sonic Boom Syndrome
2.plot: A sonic powered alien named Aldoosi escapes from Eileen and her new partner, Eidi. To track this fugitive down, Kay works with Eileen and Jay works with Eidi.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E08 - The Bad Seed Syndrome
2.plot: Parasites spread by alien seeds take over MIB and threaten the world. As the remaining agents try to stop it, Jay can't keep his mouth shut since he's accidentally been given a truth serum.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E09 - The Fmall, Fmall World Syndrome
2.plot: Preparing to conquer Earth, the Fmeks break into MIB to get their tiny hands on a growth forumla. They mistake one of the worms to be able to make the formula and capture him.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E10 - The Black Christmas Syndrome
2.plot: It's up to MIB to save Christmas when Drekk kidnaps Santa Claus.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E11 - The Supermen in Black Syndrome
2.plot: The Tomassitron Matter Amplifier grants Jay, Kay and Elle super powers as well as three alien criminals, leading to a super showdown.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E12 - The Star System Syndrome
2.plot: Jay and Kay head to Hollywood to investigate the disappearances of alien actors.

2.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S02E13 - The Blackguard Syndrome
2.plot: Alpha and Dak, Jeeb's brother, take over MIB's Blackguard satellite. Jay and Kay blast into space to stop them before they destroy MIB with it.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E01 - The Worm-Guy Guy Syndrome
3.plot: Two Kalifadik law enforcement officials begin punishing the guilty on Earth, using teleportation guns to send them to an alien prison. As MIB tries to stop them, Jay and one of the worms pass through each in mid-teleportation and slowly turn into each other.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E02 - The Cold Sweat Syndrome
3.plot: Merged together, Alpha and Dak find themselves in Antartica where a powerful alien spaceship lies buried.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E03 - The Puppy Love Syndrome
3.plot: Frank the Pug meets an alien named Veronica and falls in love. But what he doesn't know is that Veronica works for Javkor, who is out to steal MIB's most powerful weapons.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E04 - The Lost Continent Syndrome
3.plot: Jay and Kay have to stop alien terrorist Quintoon's plans to raise the legendary Atlantis continent.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E05 - The Way Out West Syndrome
3.plot: When MIB fails to stop a Metaphite that threatens Phoenix, Jay and Kay have to travel back in time to the wild west to find the Metaphite's then vulnerable cocoon.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E06 - The Mine, Mine, Mine Syndrome
3.plot: The Bug Queen herself has come to Earth and is hiding in hotel, waiting for her eggs to be able to take over. Making things worse for MIB is the presence of the Emperor Worm, who happens to be staying in the exact same hotel as the Bugs.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E07 - The Bye-Bye Worm Syndrome
3.plot: When Zed orders the worms to be sent back to their home after another mishap, Jay does whatever he can to prove their innocence.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E08 - The Lights Out Syndrome
3.plot: Kay is blinded by a Darkon ray and will need Jay's help to stop the Darkons from creating a permanent eclipse.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E09 - The Out To Pasture Syndrome
3.plot: Zed surprises everyone when he decides it's time to retire. Jay gets partnered with Elle since Kay is chosen to be the new head of MIB. As Zed is neuralized and embarks on a life of fishing in Long Island, Alpha returns more powerful than ever.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E10 - The Sardines & Ice Cream Syndrome
3.plot: Jay accidentally swallows an alien egg and becomes pregnant. Meanwhile, the Fmeks are shrinking everything in sight.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E11 - The I Want My Mummy Syndrome
3.plot: Jay and Kay have to contend with a recently awakened Hyperian, which is dressed like an ancient Egyptian Mummy.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E12 - The Baby Kay Syndrome
3.plot: The Stellairian leader comes to Earth for peace talks and Jay and Kay have to watch over his daughter, Kima. When she is kidnapped by Frostifarians, her age regressing hypo-spray breaks loose. Now as Kima grows older, Kay begins turning into a baby.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E13 - The Bad Doggie Syndrome
3.plot: Jay and Kay are moving fast to stop the take over of Earth by the Tunstons, whose king is hiding out in Frank the Pug's body.

3.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S03E14 - The “J” is for James Syndrome
3.plot: Jay's destructive joyride in the LTD causes him to be thrown out of MIB. Now, Jay is neuralized and back in the NYPD just as the Bugs arrive.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E01 - The Musical Chairs Syndrome
4.plot: Changes abound at MIB as Dr. Zeeltor takes over in the lab for Elle, who has become a field agent and gotten partnered with an alien named Agent X. As these new changes set in, MIB has to stop New York from being devoured by a Barooga.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E02 - The Spectacle Syndrome
4.plot: Jay and Kay have to rescue the worms from an alien world similar to Ancient Rome.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E03 - The Back to School Syndrome
4.plot: Jay poses as a high school student to protect an alien prince from alien terrorists.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E04 - The Opening Gambit Syndrome
4.plot: Thirty years ago, an Ixion named Vangus came to Earth and was stopped by an MIB agent. Now when Vangus returns, MIB seeks answers from the agent that stopped him: Alpha.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E05 - The Future's So Bright Syndrome
4.plot: During pursuit of a large criminal Worm, Jay gets sent to the future and finds that the Worms rule all of Earth.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E06 - The Loose Ball Foul Syndrome
4.plot: The Fmeks are back and trying to take over a tiny planet that resembles a baseball. To make matters worse, Kay is on the tiny planet and things are getting very hot.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E07 - The Hots for Jay Syndrome
4.plot: After eating some alien food, Jay gains the ability to throw fire. But this new power will have serious consequences if he keeps using it.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E08 - The Circus Parade Syndrome
4.plot: A member of a witness protection program for aliens is on the run from an intergalatic gang called The Association when they discover he's on Earth.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E09 - The Virtual Crossfire Syndrome
4.plot: Jay gets a low score on MIB's new virtual reality training test and the embarassment eventually forces him to try again. But this time the game goes haywire and the dangers Jay faces become deadly.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E10 - The Breaking News Syndrome
4.plot: An alien tv crew comes to Earth to film MIB agents on the job just as Drekk returns to cause trouble.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E11 - The Zero to Superhero Syndrome
4.plot: A super hero caling himself Cosmosis emerges to defend the city from evil, but he's really an alien looking to put his powers to good use. However, MIB feels his new profession could attract trouble for Earth, so they try to lure him out using Jay as bait.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E12 - The Endgame Syndrome, Part 1
4.plot: Alpha, Vangus and the Ixions return to Earth, working together to threaten all life on the planet. With invasion imminent, Zed decides to reveal MIB's existence to the world.

4.title: FR - Men in Black: The Series - S04E13 - The Endgame Syndrome, Part 2
4.plot: With MIB having success in coordinating resistance against the invasion, the Ixions plan to unleash a weapon that will kill everyone on Earth. Jay and Kay will fight Alpha in the final battle for humanity.

meta.plot:
L’histoire se déroule dans un futur relativement proche sur une terre ravagée par la guerre nucléaire qui a eu pour conséquence l’évaporation de la plupart des océans et la destruction d’une grande partie de la végétation. Dans cet univers post-apocalyptique, les survivants sont soit d’humbles villageois essayant de survivre, soit des bandits vicieux regroupés en gangs qui s’adonnent aux pillages et à la persécution de ces villageois.

Cependant, un artiste martial nommé Kenshiro (Ken), un homme reconnaissable aux sept cicatrices qu’il porte sur le torse, est choisi pour devenir le successeur du légendaire art assassin le Hokuto Shinken (北斗神拳, l’art divin de l’Étoile du nord). Au début de l’aventure, Kenshiro ne cherche pas réellement à aider les villageois, mais au fur et à mesure que son étoile le guide, il se révèle comme étant le sauveur tant attendu par une population au bord du désespoir.

Accompagné dans son périple par deux jeunes enfants nommés Bart et Lynn, Ken affrontera un grand nombre de gangs, allant même jusqu'à affronter ses frères adoptifs, eux aussi disciples de l’art du Hokuto Shinken. Ken se mesurera aussi à certains maitres de l’école Nanto Seiken (南斗聖拳, Le poing sacré de l’étoile du Sud).

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E01 - God or Devil!? The Mightiest Man Appears in Hell.
1.plot: After a long time wandering in the desert, Ken is taken prisoner while wandering into a village looking for water. There, he shares a cell with a young thief named Bato (Bart), and befriends his cell guard, an orphaned girl named Rin (Lynn). Shortly afterwards, a biker gang attacks the village and their leader Zeed takes Rin hostage. Ken breaks out of his cell and defeats Zeed, rescuing Rin. Ken leaves the village with Bato following him, while Rin stays behind.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E02 - The Deadly Fist of Lingering Regret! The Future is Sighted in the Barren Desert!
1.plot: Ken rescues an old man named Smith from Spade, a member of the Four Jacks working for the King organization. The old man seeks to deliver a bag of rice seeds to his village, hoping to harvest them for the future. Ken and Bato take Smith to his village, unaware that Spade and his men are following them. Spade, who lost his eye during his initial encounter with Ken, attacks the village and kills Smith in retaliation. Unable to rescue Smith, an angry Ken kills Spade with a technique that makes their victim feel remorse before dying. After the battle, Ken plants Smith's seed over his grave.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E03 - In the City Without Light, a Lone Fist Burns! The Furious Death by the Five Exploding Fingers.
1.plot: Bato spots Rin in a truck full of captured villagers being taken to the village of Dorado, which is occupied by the King gang. On their way there, Ken encounters two of remaining Jacks, Diamond and Club, who are torturing the villagers of Dorado. With Bato's help, Ken is reunited with Rin.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E04 - Attack the Bloody Cross! The Secret Technique, Death by Soft Strikes.
1.plot: Ken learns that the prisoners that were transported with Rin were taken to a prison camp in a nearby valley. Ken manages to break the imprisoned villagers free, but during their escape they're all slaughtered in an ambush led by Mr. Heart, the last of the Four Jacks. While Heart's excess flesh proves resistant to his attacks, Ken eventually uses a techniques which penetrates through his body. From his battle with Heart, Ken learns an important clue which reveals to him the identity of King.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E05 - Can the Flames of Love Burn in Hell? You Are Already Dead!!
1.plot: Having learned that King is none other than his old friend turned nemesis Shin, Ken remembers how a year ago Shin defeated him in combat, engraved the seven scars on his chest, and kidnapped his fiancee Yuria (Julia). Ken arrives at a local castle where Shin was staying, but only finds Shin's right-hand man Joker, who reveals that Shin and his gang has already left the castle, taking Yuria with him. Joker escapes and sets the castle ablaze with Ken inside, but Ken manages to escape, swearing to find Shin.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E06 - The Devil's Hit list. Find the Man With the 7 Scars!
1.plot: Ken and his friends arrive at an oasis under the surveillance of God's Army, a fanatical military group composed of former special forces members. Ken becomes a target for this group after Ken kills one of the security officers in battle.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E07 - Villains! - Shall We Have a Countdown to Death?
1.plot: The members of God's Army conduct a full-scale search of the oasis for Kenshiro. When the search team begins to execute random villagers to lure him, Ken allows himself to be captured in order to infiltrate their training facility. There, he faces against the army's drill instructor, the Mad Sarge.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E08 - Strike the Hidden Power Point! There’s No Requiem for the Wicked.
1.plot: Ken penetrates the headquarters of God's Army and confronts their leader, the Colonel, a deluded follower of Shin who has mastered the art of Nanto Muonken.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E09 - Villains! - Say Your Prayers Before You Die!
1.plot: Ken and his friends visit a village where young men and women are offered as slaves to Madam Patra, a local sorceress who controls the village's water supply.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E10 - Inverse Raging Fire Punch! There Are Too Many Who Must Die!
1.plot: Ken ventures into Patra's lair at Dragon God Mountain to save the young villagers. There he faces Patra's partner Dragon, a firebreather who attempts to coerce Ken to his side.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E11 - Villains!! Listen to the Blues of Hell!!
1.plot: Ken and his companions meet Taki, an old friend of Bato. Taki takes them to his home village where Auntie Toyo, an elderly woman who takes care of orphaned and abandoned children, is trying to dig a well. Unaware to him, the Warriors biker gang led by Jackal have followed Ken, seeking to claim Toyo's village as their new hideout.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E12 - I Am the God of Death! I'll Chase You to the Ends of Hell!
1.plot: After Toyo is killed by Jackal, Ken leaves Bato and Rin to watch over Toyo's orphans while he chases after Jackal's gang. While searching for clues to Jackal's destination, Ken encounters Fox, Jackal's right-hand man.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E13 - Arhat Deva Fist! Once Released There's No Stopping It!!
1.plot: Ken chases Jackal to the ruins of Villainy Prison, a place that used to imprison the most vicious of criminals. Hoping to defeat Ken, Jackal releases Devil's Rebirth, a giant demon-like killer who has mastered the forbidden art of the Arhat Deva Fist.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E14 - A Miserable Era! The Good Die So Young!!
1.plot: Ken and his friends visit a village where their local doctor, a man named Duran, offers his hospitality. However, Duran's former partner-in-crime, Dante, is hired by Shin to hunt down Ken. Dante takes the opportunity of the situation to blackmail Duran to do his bidding.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E15 - Count to Three! You're the One Who'll Die!
1.plot: Ken and his friend must save a haunted village from Zaria, a witchdoctor who uses a strange hypnosis technique that turns villagers into mind-controlled slaves.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E16 - Sing For Me, Villains! The Counting Rhymes of Hell!
1.plot: Ken is caught at the middle of a gang war between the Scorpions and the Snakes, each seeking to recruit Ken to their side.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E17 - Battle Makes a Man! The Gates of Confrontation Have Finally Opened
1.plot: Shin gathers his entire army for a meeting as he officially declares war against Kenshiro. Barcom, the General of King's army, tells his men how Ken defeated some of Shin's best fighters. Meanwhile, Yuria recounts to Saki how she came to be Shin's captive and his rise to power.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E18 - Life or Death?! Beyond the Wasteland Lies the First Circle of Hell!
1.plot: One of King's subordinate gangs attacks a village Ken is visiting, while Yuria attempts to escape from Southern Cross with the help of her young maid Saki.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E19 - Villains! Ready Your One-Way Tickets to Death
1.plot: Ken is forced to return to Jeena village when Garekki of the Gold Wolf gang attempts to invade it, while Saki's elder brother, Temjina, escapes from Southern Cross, seeking to tell Ken of Yuria's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E20 - Nightmarish Full-Scale War! My Fists Pack One Million Volts!
1.plot: With Ken having learned the location of the city of Southern Cross from Temjina's dying words, Shin deploys a giant gunship as his last resource.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E21 - The Evil Palace in Flames! Just One More Step to Reach You, Shin!
1.plot: With Ken presumed dead, General Barcom leads a mutiny against Shin, seeking to take over the King gang for himself. Elsewhere, Joker searches the wreckage of the gunship for Ken's body, unconvinced that he is actually dead.

1.title: FR - Ken le survivant - S01E22 - Conclusion of Part One: Yuria, Forever... and Shin!
1.plot: With Southern Cross left in ruins following Barcom's revolt, Shin is left by himself in his own palace, protected by the few followers he still has left. Ken confronts Shin for the first time in a year and defeats him, only to learn that Yuria has already killed herself.

FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E01 - The Boy in the Iceberg
1.plot: Two teenage siblings (Sokka and Katara) living in the South Pole discover a very strange boy (Aang), along with his pet flying bison Appa, in an iceberg. But can they trust him when he accidentally draws the war to their village's doorstep?

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E02 - The Avatar Returns
1.plot: Katara and Sokka discover that Aang is the long-lost Avatar and must rescue him when a Firebending prince named Zuko kidnaps him.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E03 - The Southern Air Temple
1.plot: Aang is excited about going home for the first time in one hundred years, but he is shocked to find out that the temple is deserted. Aang tells Sokka and Katara about his childhood as they explore the temple, but they soon discover something that Aang never expected. Meanwhile, Zuko must make repairs to his ship and the only way he can do it is to dock his ship at his rival's naval base.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E04 - The Warriors of Kyoshi
1.plot: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors. When Aang reveals that he is the avatar, news quickly spreads out, eventually reaching Zuko, who then goes to Kyoshi Island to capture him.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E05 - The King of Omashu
1.plot: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a king.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E06 - Imprisoned
1.plot: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E07 - The Spirit World: Winter Solstice (1)
1.plot: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E08 - Avatar Roku: Winter Solstice (2)
1.plot: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E09 - The Waterbending Scroll
1.plot: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E10 - Jet
1.plot: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.  However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E11 - The Great Divide
1.plot: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E12 - The Storm
1.plot: Aang, Katara and Sokka have run out of money.  Katara suggests Sokka get a job, and coincidentally, they meet a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. But when the fisherman recognizes Aang as the Avatar, he blames Aang's absence for all of the troubles of the last 100 years, and Aang runs away on his glider. Katara follows on Appa, and when she finds him, Aang begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, Zuko and Lieutenant Jee get into a fight, but Iroh breaks it up. Soon thereafter, the Lieutenant and the rest of the crew gain a newfound respect for their leader after learning of his past.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E13 - The Blue Spirit
1.plot: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E14 - The Fortuneteller
1.plot: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E15 - Bato of the Water Tribe
1.plot: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E16 - The Deserter
1.plot: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang decides to use this time to attempt to learn firebending. The firebending master, however, seems reluctant to teach Aang.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E17 - The Northern Air Temple
1.plot: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves. What they find is a bunch of people who are not airbenders, but have mastered the art of gliding; though this upsets Aang because they have been defacing the temple. However, there was one part of the temple where nobody has been able to enter, and what Aang and his friends discover inside spells oncoming conflict.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E18 - The Waterbending Master
1.plot: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E19 - The Siege of the North (1)
1.plot: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E20 - The Siege of the North (2)
1.plot: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E01 - The Avatar State
2.plot: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh, having survived the failed attack on the North Water Tribe, have a surprise visit from Zuko's sister with seemingly good news.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E02 - The Cave of Two Lovers
2.plot: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers". But when the group becomes trapped in the cave, it's up to Aang and Katara to save the group by trusting in love, possibly questioning their relationship. Meanwhile, Iroh gets a lethal rash so Zuko and Iroh head to a small Earth Kingdom town for help, hoping their real identities will not be discovered.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E03 - Return to Omashu
2.plot: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find King Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E04 - The Swamp
2.plot: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E05 - Avatar Day
2.plot: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E06 - The Blind Bandit
2.plot: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful Earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of Earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E07 - Zuko Alone
2.plot: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town were he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E08 - The Chase
2.plot: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E09 - Bitter Work
2.plot: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E10 - The Library
2.plot: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes. When Wan Shi Tong discovers Sokka wasn't being truthful with him, he begins to sink the library, bringing the kids down with it.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E11 - The Desert
2.plot: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E12 - The Serpent's Pass
2.plot: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E13 - The Drill
2.plot: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E14 - City of Walls and Secrets
2.plot: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E15 - The Tales of Ba Sing Se
2.plot: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E16 - Appa's Lost Days
2.plot: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E17 - Lake Laogai
2.plot: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E18 - The Earth King
2.plot: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E19 - The Guru
2.plot: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father. Meanwhile, Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies in the Earth Kingdom, including Zuko and Iroh.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E20 - The Crossroads of Destiny
2.plot: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister plan. Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source. Aang's destiny hangs in the balance—and so does Zuko's, as Iroh tells him it's time to make a choice.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E01 - The Awakening
3.plot: Aang awakens to find himself aboard a captured Fire Nation ship with a full head of hair and sustaining serious injuries from the previous battle for Ba Sing Se. At his side are Katara, Sokka, and their father Hakoda who recount the events that led the four to the ship and contemplate their next move. Aang struggles to fight his own desire to face the Fire Lord before he is ready. Meanwhile, Zuko deals with his own issues as he makes his long-awaited journey home, with the fear of his father's rejection hanging over his head.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E02 - The Headband
3.plot: To better blend in as Fire Nation citizens, Aang enrolls in a Fire Nation school, giving himself an opportunity to learn more about the Nation and to enjoy life as a normal kid for the first time since he discovered he was the Avatar. Meanwhile Zuko, growing more and more paranoid about the Avatar's false demise, brings himself to confront the imprisoned Iroh.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E03 - The Painted Lady
3.plot: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E04 - Sokka's Master
3.plot: Feeling as though he isn't contributing enough to the group, Sokka seeks out an elusive swordsmaster from whom he can learn the ways of the blade.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E05 - The Beach
3.plot: Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee take a vacation to Ember Island. In the process, they come to learn more about themselves and each other as well as their desires for the future. Elsewhere, Aang and the others face off against a new adversary.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E06 - The Avatar and the Firelord
3.plot: The tale of Avatar Roku and Fire Lord Sozin is revealed to Aang and Zuko by different sources.  Both learn about themselves and are shown the origins of the war.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E07 - The Runaway
3.plot: When Katara expresses her disapproval of Toph's new way to make quick cash, the group finds her too motherly and tension grows between Katara and Toph. When Katara finally decides to participate in this scam to disprove Toph's accusations, they are left vulnerable and are forced to face the dire consequences.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E08 - The Puppetmaster
3.plot: The gang investigates the bizarre disappearances taking place within an eerie town.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E09 - Nightmares and Daydreams
3.plot: Four days prior the invasion, Aang becomes nervous over his soon-to-come confrontation with the Fire Lord. His anxiety gets the better of him as he begins to suffer from outrageous nightmares and hallucinations. Meanwhile, Zuko becomes upset to learn that he was not informed about a war meeting.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E10 - The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
3.plot: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E11 - The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
3.plot: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E12 - The Western Air Temple
3.plot: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E13 - The Firebending Masters
3.plot: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E14 - The Boiling Rock (1)
3.plot: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E15 - The Boiling Rock (2)
3.plot: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E16 - The Southern Raiders
3.plot: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E17 - The Ember Island Players
3.plot: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E18 - Sozin's Comet: The Phoenix King (1)
3.plot: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning. Zuko leads the rest of the group to the Earth Kingdom to meet a tracker whom they hope can find Aang. The Fire Lord crowns himself Phoenix King and Aang awakens on the island not knowing where he is.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E19 - Sozin's Comet: The Old Masters (2)
3.plot: While on the island, Aang seeks guidance from his past lives, but is not pleased with what he is told. The island, in fact, turns out to be a lion turtle from which Aang is given the guidance he had been seeking. After the tracker is unable to track Aang, the rest of the group decide they must find Iroh. Meanwhile, while tracking down Iroh, the group meets up with The Order of the White Lotus, a group that transcends the division of the four nations.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E20 - Sozin's Comet: Into the Inferno (3)
3.plot: Sokka, Suki, and Toph try to stop the Fire Nation's air fleet. Meanwhile, Zuko and Azula duel in an Agni Kai and Aang confronts the Fire Lord. On the verge of losing, Aang gets hit in the back of his scar which sends him into the Avatar State.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E21 - Sozin's Comet: Avatar Aang (4)
3.plot: Aang defeats the Fire Lord by bending the elements within the Fire Lord and removing his firebending abilities. After Zuko is taken down protecting Katara from Azula, Katara joins the fight and manages to restrain Azula. Afterwards, Zuko is crowned Fire Lord and promises a better future for the world, while Aang takes his place as the next Avatar. Katara finally shows her love for Aang as they kiss under the setting sun.

meta.plot: Ang est un jeune Maître de l'Air, mais c'est surtout l'Avatar, un être unique qui maîtrise tous les éléments - Feu, Air, Eau et Terre. Lors d'un terrible orage, il sombre dans la mer et hiberne grâce à ses pouvoirs d'Avatar, pour se réveiller un siècle plus tard dans un monde tyrannisé par la puissante Nation du Feu et où il est le dernier représentant de son peuple. Aidé de ses deux amis de la Tribu de l'Eau, Ang va devoir réveiller l'Avatar en lui, apprendre à contrôler tous les éléments et se battre contre la menace que les Maîtres du Feu font peser sur le monde.

FR - Vermin - S01E02 - Laundrette Housing Projects
FR - Vermin - S01E03 - The Flashback
FR - Vermin - S01E04 - Spider-Spider
