FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E01 - The Cat and the Claw (1)
1.plot: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E02 - On Leather Wings
1.plot: When a vicious bat creature known as Man-Bat, starts terrorizing Gotham City, everyone mistakenly thinks that Batman is the culprit. Batman must find out who the mysterious Man-Bat is and clear his own name.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E03 - Heart of Ice
1.plot: Brilliant cryogenics expert Dr. Victor Fries is transformed into Mr. Freeze, a vengeful creature who can only survive in subzero temperatures.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E04 - Feat of Clay (1)
1.plot: A popular actor renowned for his ability to play any part has a terrible secret--he's addicted to a strange chemical formula that enables him to alter his facial features without makeup.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E05 - Feat of Clay (2)
1.plot: Clayface learns that the man responsible for his disfigurement is to appear on TV, promoting a skin conditioner containing the same chemical that deformed him.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E06 - It's Never Too Late
1.plot: An aging Mob boss learns his drug dealings have contributed to his son's drug addiction.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E07 - Joker's Favor
1.plot: When a timid accountant accidentally runs afoul of the Joker, he promises the Joker anything if the villain will only let him go.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E08 - The Cat and the Claw (2)
1.plot: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E09 - Pretty Poison
1.plot: When District Attorney Harvey Dent is poisoned after a dinner date, Batman makes the horrifying discovery that his date was Poison Ivy, a plant-obsessed villainess.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E10 - Nothing to Fear
1.plot: A horrifying villain named Scarecrow spreads fear gas and wreaks havoc at Gotham State University.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E11 - Be a Clown
1.plot: The Joker infiltrates the birthday party of Mayor Hill's son in order to plant a bomb.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E12 - Appointment in Crime Alley
1.plot: Batman's friend, Dr. Leslie Thompkins, is taken prisoner by a ruthless land developer after she uncovers his devious plans.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E13 - P.O.V.
1.plot: Bullock's account of a botched sting operation is so at odds with the other officers' testimony that the police investigator suspends everyone involved.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E14 - The Clock King
1.plot: When a maniacally punctilious man faces financial ruin because of attorney Hamilton Hill, he transforms into the devious Clock King and swears revenge on Hill, now the mayor of Gotham.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E15 - The Last Laugh
1.plot: The Joker employs a lethal mind-altering laughing gas to transform the citizens of Gotham into total fools.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E16 - Eternal Youth
1.plot: Alfred and his friend, Maggie Paige, visit a health spa that is actually run by the nefarious Poison Ivy.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E17 - Two-Face (1)
1.plot: District Attorney Harvey Dent hides a deep dark secret--he has a second personality, Big Bad Harv, a tough gangster.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E18 - Two-Face (2)
1.plot: Two-Face, the former Harvey Dent, begins an aggressive campaign against his hated rival, Rupert Thorne.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E19 - Fear of Victory
1.plot: The Scarecrow uses a fear chemical triggered by adrenaline on Gotham's greatest athletes, then bets against them to reap the winnings.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E20 - I've Got Batman in My Basement
1.plot: After the Penguin sprays Batman with nerve gas, a 12-year-old boy rescues the unconscious hero and hides him in his basement.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E21 - Vendetta
1.plot: Batman suspects that an imprisoned Detective Bullock may be innocent after he is arrested for murder. The real murderer turns out to be Killer Croc, who framed Bullock to get revenge.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E22 - Prophecy of Doom
1.plot: Bruce begins to worry when all of his wealthy friends join the same Brotherhood group run by Nostromos, a so-called psychic.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E23 - The Forgotten
1.plot: When men begin disappearing at a bowery, Bruce Wayne decides to go undercover as a worker. He loses his memory after he is attacked, kidnapped and forced to work in a mining camp.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E24 - Mad as a Hatter
1.plot: The Mad Hatter puts the city of Gotham under his control in an attempt to impress a woman, Alice, with whom he is in love.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E25 - The Cape and Cowl Conspiracy
1.plot: Batman investigates a theft of bearer bonds intended for the starving people of a poor country.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E26 - Perchance to Dream
1.plot: Bruce Wayne wakes up to find that his parents are not dead, he is not Batman, and he's engaged to Selina Kyle!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E28 - Night of the Ninja
1.plot: When Wayne Enterprises is robbed by a mysterious figure known as the Ninja, Batman and Robin discover that the Ninja is an old nemesis of Bruce Wayne.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E29 - The Strange Secret of Bruce Wayne
1.plot: Dr. Hugo Strange's invention, a machine that reads people's thoughts, leads him to discover that Bruce is Batman.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E30 - Tyger, Tyger
1.plot: When a genetic engineer produces a man-cat hybrid, he kidnaps Selina Kyle to provide his creation with a mate.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E31 - Dreams in Darkness
1.plot: Batman must thwart the Scarecrow's plan to poison Gotham's water supply with a chemical that induces hallucinations.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E32 - Beware the Gray Ghost
1.plot: Batman connects recent bombings in Gotham to an episode of an old television series featuring his favorite boyhood hero, the 'Gray Ghost.'

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E33 - Cat Scratch Fever
1.plot: Selina Kyle uncovers a plot to infect stray animals with a deadly disease that will be transmitted to the human population.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E34 - I Am the Night
1.plot: On the anniversary of the death of Bruce's parents, Batman expresses doubts about whether or not he should continue his one-man war against crime.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E35 - Almost Got 'Im
1.plot: While hiding from the police, Batman's deadliest enemies exchange stories about their mutual nemesis--Batman.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E36 - Moon of the Wolf
1.plot: Professor Milo tries to use an old friend of Bruce Wayne's, Anthony Romulus, to destroy him after Milo injects Romulus with a serum that changes him into a wolf.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E37 - Terror in the Sky
1.plot: When a man-sized bat ransacks Gotham harbor, Batman suspects that Dr. Kirk Langstrom is drinking his Man-Bat formula again.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E38 - Christmas with the Joker
1.plot: The Joker kidnaps three prominent citizens during Christmas and challenges Batman to find him before midnight.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E39 - Heart of Steel (1)
1.plot: Karl Rossum, owner of Cyberton Labs has been replacing important authority figures with robot look-alikes. Batman invites a young woman to dinner, not knowing that she is a robot as well.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E40 - Heart of Steel (2)
1.plot: Batman escapes from being attacked by his own Batcomputer, which was sabatoged by HARDAC. He now seeks to get back Gordon, Hill and Bullock, who have all been replaced with robots.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E41 - If You're So Smart, Why Aren't You Rich?
1.plot: When Edward Nygma's greedy boss unjustly fires genius him, Nygma seeks revenge in a new guise--as the Riddler!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E42 - Joker's Wild
1.plot: When a billionaire builds a casino called the Joker's Wild, the Joker breaks out of Arkham Asylum to destroy it.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E43 - His Silicon Soul
1.plot: A confused robot that believes he is Batman causes problems for the real Dark Knight.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E44 - Off Balance
1.plot: Batman investigates a notorious global crime cartel, The Society of Shadows, which has begun to operate in Gotham City.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E45 - What Is Reality?
1.plot: To prove that he has a superior mind, the Riddler lures Batman into a contest inside a virtual reality computer game.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E46 - The Laughing Fish
1.plot: The Joker becomes enraged when the Gotham copyright office rejects his demand for a copyright for his grinning Joker fish.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E47 - Harley and Ivy
1.plot: Harley Quinn has broken off with the Joker and teams up with Poison Ivy. Together they wreck havoc on Gotham and now Joker wants a piece of the action.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E48 - The Mechanic
1.plot: While engaged in a high-speed chase, the Penguin's gang escapes and the Batmobile is virtually demolished.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E49 - The Man Who Killed Batman
1.plot: Sidney Debris, a small-time mobster, earns the hatred of all of Batman's enemies when he claims to have accidentally killed Batman during a brawl.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E50 - Zatanna
1.plot: When glamorous female magician Zatanna is framed for a robbery during her act, Batman comes to her defense.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E51 - Robin's Reckoning (1)
1.plot: After learning the name of an extortion ringleader, Batman mysteriously refuses to let Robin continue the investigation with him.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E52 - Birds of a Feather
1.plot: Veronica Vreeland, a socialite desperate to create a novel party, makes the mistake of inviting the Penguin as her guest of honor.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E53 - Robin's Reckoning (2)
1.plot: Despite Batman's orders not to, Robin pursues Tony Zucco, the criminal who was responsible for the death of Robin's parents.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E54 - Blind as a Bat
1.plot: Bruce Wayne is temporarily blinded when the Penguin steals a new police helicopter with weaponry developed by WayneTech.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E55 - Day of the Samurai
1.plot: Bruce Wayne and Alfred travel to Japan to help Bruce's old martial arts teacher, Sensei Yoru.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E56 - See No Evil
1.plot: After a fortune disappears from a gem exposition, Batman investigates. He discovers that the crime may have been committed by an invisible man, an ex-con named Lloyd Ventris.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E57 - The Demon's Quest (1)
1.plot: When Robin is mysteriously abducted, Batman's search leads him to meet Ra's Al Ghul, leader of The Society of Shadows, whose daughter, Talia, has also been kidnapped.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E58 - The Demon's Quest (2)
1.plot: Batman discovers Ra's Al Ghul's plan to flood Earth with chemicals and return it to a lush, green planet--which will destroy all life that now exists!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E59 - Read My Lips
1.plot: Batman investigates a series of baffling crimes and discovers that the crime czar is a wooden dummy, manipulated by a mild-mannered man called the Ventriloquist.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E60 - Fire from Olympus
1.plot: Believing he's the reincarnation of Zeus, a mad shipping magnate mounts a stolen electron cannon atop his penthouse to shoot 'lightning bolts' at the 'wicked mortals' below.

meta.plot: Vowing to avenge the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne devotes his life to wiping out crime in Gotham City as the masked vigilante "Batman".

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Maxine is ready to start a new life in Palm Beach. While trying to join an elite club, she discovers several secrets—while hiding her own.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E02 - Maxine Saves a Cat
1.plot: To gain membership sponsors, Maxine must make an impressive splash at a charity auction—but bad checks and a suspicious bartender hound her.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E03 - Maxine's Like a Dellacorte
1.plot: When Maxine's auction antics land her in the Shiny Sheet, the ladies of Palm Beach become interested in knowing more about her.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E04 - Maxine Rolls the Dice
1.plot: With Norma's estate going to charity, Maxine's last shot at the Dellacorte fortune is a conservatorship that puts her at legal odds with Robert.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E05 - Maxine Shakes the Tree
1.plot: Maxine tries to unearth information that could upend her marriage. Linda and the Women's Circle grapple with threats to Palm Beach social order.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E06 - Maxine Takes a Step
1.plot: With both the Beach Ball and a real estate deal set to take off, Maxine and Douglas need to secure the favor of a visiting prince.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E07 - Maxine Bags a Prince
1.plot: Douglas faces a looming threat. Robert navigates his increasingly serious relationship with the prince. Linda and Evelyn receive shocking news.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E08 - Maxine Saves the Whale
1.plot: A beached whale appears on the Beach Ball site, throwing the event into doubt with days to spare. Linda and Evelyn adjust to their new normals.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E09 - Maxine Makes a Splash
1.plot: Evelyn must hide at Eddie's place. Doug makes a pitch for the Dellacorte. Maxine and Robert make shocking discoveries.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E10 - Maxine Throws a Party
1.plot: Tensions boil over at the Beach Ball.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E01 - Maxine Drinks Martinis Now
2.plot: In the aftermath of the Beach Ball fiasco, Maxine navigates her new reality and contends with Douglas' betrayal.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E02 - Maxine Serves a Swerve
2.plot: As Linda's case makes it to national television, Maxine botches her own plan and must help her friend before the (wo)manhunt begins.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E03 - Maxine's Like a Dellacorte
2.plot: When Maxine's auction antics land her in the Shiny Sheet, the ladies of Palm Beach become interested in knowing more about her.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E04 - Maxine Unwrecks a Home

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E05 - Maxine Is Ready to Single Mingle

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E06 - Maxine Finds Herself

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E07 - Maxine Plays Dead

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E08 - Maxine Hits the Slopes
2.plot: Palm Beach society arrives in Switzerland with sights set on the Dellacorte generation-skipping trust.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E09 - Maxine Hears a Confession
2.plot: Amid a raging snowstorm in the Alps, Norma orchestrates plans to secure the fortune for herself and Robert. Maxine races to expose her.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E10 - Maxine Does Something Good

meta.plot: En 1969, une femme ambitieuse aspire à franchir la frontière entre les modestes et les nantis pour se faire une place à la table la plus huppée, la plus sélect, et la plus impitoyable des Etats-Unis : la haute société de Palm Beach.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E01 - The small world of Tom Sawyer
1.plot: Tom Sawyer doesn't like school much. Escaping from the schoolhouse, he's off to the woods to catch a wild pig with his friend Huck. Their attempts to sell the pig at the harbor end with a wild disturbance on the steamboat.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E02 - Hand games, evil games
1.plot: Tom is dismayed when Aunt Polly tells him he must spend his Saturday whitewashing the fence. Too long to paint in one day, Tom convinces his friends of the joys of the job, and soon has all the help he needs.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E03 - A great love
1.plot: Tom goes to the harbor to meet his cousin Mary, and sees Becky Thacher for the first time. Her family moves into St. Petersburg, and Tom falls in love.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E04 - The magic spell
1.plot: Tom tries to arouse Becky's interest at Sunday School, but is ignored. That night Old Sam shows him a special charm to make wishes come true.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E05 - Becky
1.plot: Tom arrives at school late and finds that Becky is in his class. He finally manages to become friends with her, and promises to visit - forgetting another promise he has made to Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E06 - Huck's house
1.plot: Huck is offended that Tom forgot his promise. The next few days Tom works with Huck, telling Becky he is busy helping his sick aunt. Becky discovers his lie but her anger is replaced with surprise when she sees Huck's newly built tree house.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E07 - Competition
1.plot: Tom just can't get along with his new classmate Alfred, and challenges him to a fighting match. On the way home, the boat they are aboard sinks and Tom rescues Alfred, who can't swim at all - winning Becky's praise.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E08 - Panic at board
1.plot: A large steamship comes to St Petersburg. Tom and Huck steal aboard for a trip. Next day, Tom boasts about their adventure, fascinating his classmates.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E09 - The children of aunt Polly
1.plot: Aunt Polly falls sick and is struck with an idea. She calls Tom to her bedside, pretending to be dying. Aunt Polly tells Tom she cannot go to heaven unless he promises to be a good boy but Tom refuses to promise, because he doesn't want his aunt to die.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E10 - The treasure
1.plot: The villagers do not like drunken Muff and Indian Joe. Tom and Huck rescue Muff and he, in return, tells them about a treasure buried near St Petersburg. The boys decide they will find the treasure, and Indian Joe joins Muff in his search.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E11 - Pirates
1.plot: Mr. Dobbins, the schoolteacher, doesn't trust Tom, but all Tom's classmates like him. Younger brother Sid saves Tom from punishment at school. Later, Tom and Huck decide to conduct their treasure hunt at night, to avoid Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E12 - The professor
1.plot: Tom gives Becky an engagement kiss. But with a slip of the tongue, he tells her that he had once been engaged to Amy. Becky is furious, and Tom becomes so discouraged he ends his treasure hunt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E13 - I want to be a pirate
1.plot: After Becky ignores Tom for five days, he decides to run away from home to be a pirate. During the night he sails to Jackson Island on a raft, along with Huck and Ben.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E14 - Pirates don't go to school
1.plot: Tom, Huck and Ben enjoy their adventure on the island while everyone in the village worries about their disappearance. A rainstorm washes away their raft, and it is found by a villager broken to pieces.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E15 - Ah! the adventure...
1.plot: The villagers believe the boys have drowned in the river. Though they play all day on the island, Ben misses his home. Tom returns secretly for news of the village and sees Aunt Polly praying for his safety.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E16 - The pirates crush black
1.plot: Ben and Huck miss the village, so Tom proposes that they return on the very day of their funeral. No other village children, Tom decides, have ever become the center of so much attention.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E17 - Good old days
1.plot: After the funeral Tom is a hero at school, and everyone wants to hear his story. Charlie inks Tom's schoolbook out of jealousy, and Tom is punished. Becky saw what happened and feels guilty that she did not tell the truth.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E18 - Reconciliation
1.plot: Becky accidentally tears a page of Mr. Dobbins' precious book on medical science, and Tom takes the blame. Becky makes up with him.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E19 - The frog contest
1.plot: Frog leaping matches are popular with the school students, and Tom trains his frog to be a great leaper. Charlie doesn't want to hand over his championship, so he stuffs Tom's frog with pebbles.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E20 - The secrecy of mr. Dobbins
1.plot: Tom and Huck discover that Mr. Dobbins wears a wig. On the last day of school, when the teacher whips every student, even girls, for sleeping during class, Tom hits on a capital idea for revenge.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E21 - The holidays begin
1.plot: Sid comes down with the mumps just as summer vacation starts. Tom doesn't want to get sick and spoil his holiday. Just then two men come to town with Water of Life, guaranteed to cure every disease.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E22 - The charlatan
1.plot: Tom distributes handbills in return for the medicine. It sells like hotcakes, then the two men disappear. The medicine turns out to be a sham. Tom doesn't get the mumps, but he makes many trips to the outhouse.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E23 - Fishing party
1.plot: Tom goes fishing with Huck and Becky. They catch a big one, but only after Becky jumps in to lend a hand.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E24 - Huck carries a tie
1.plot: Becky's great aunt has no children of her own, and decides to adopt Huck. Tom makes him take a bath, dresses him up, and takes him to Becky's house. Huck doesn't like anything that binds, including a tie, and declines the offer.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E25 - A stubborn boy
1.plot: Alfred hones his swimming skills in order to show up Tom. At his birthday party he challenges Tom to a swimming race and wins. Tom then challenges Alfred to a contest to see who can stay under the water the longest.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E26 - Lisette
1.plot: The village children are bored; nothing exciting ever happens there. Then a theatrical troupe arrives and announces a play for the children. Among them is a young actress Lissette, and Huck falls in love.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E27 - The rising of the curtain
1.plot: Tom promises to take Huck to the play. To earn the money he works for his aunt, moving furniture to a friend's ranch quite a distance away. When a wheel comes off the cart, Tom is almost defeated - but manages to run home just in time for the play.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E28 - Helping Lisette
1.plot: Lizette is treated severely in the tragedy. Huck, unaware that it's a drama, jumps onto the stage to save her. Tom stirs up the other children to help Huck and Lizette, and the play becomes a fiasco. Lizette rather likes Huck, and promises to visit.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E29 - Goodbye Lisette
1.plot: Huck prepares a delicious meal for Lizette's next visit. Suddenly two of the troupers desert, and the group must leave, unable to continue the show. Lizette tells Tom she will be back someday to see Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E30 - Huck's father
1.plot: Tom discovers a dead body up the river - it appears to be Huck's father! After the funeral, Huck's father appears alive; come to take his son. Huck doesn't want to go, and hides.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E31 - The candlestick
1.plot: On the anniversary of Huck's mother's death, he wants to light a candle in her memory. Though he knows Aunt Polly won't allow it, Tom promises to bring Huck her silver candlestick. Then, with the help of Mary and Sid, he tricks his Aunt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E32 - Gold, gold!
1.plot: When Tom and Huck find a small gold lump in the river, the news spreads quickly and all the villagers rush to the river to search for gold. Even Aunt Polly tries to join them, but Mary calls a halt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E33 - The escape to freedom
1.plot: Morris, Jim's friend, runs away from his master. He wants to go north where slaves can be free. Tom makes a raft and helps him leave the village.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E34 - The man who came from the cold
1.plot: Mary begins working for Dr. Mitchell, training to be a nurse. A balloon descends in the village, and the people panic, thinking it is a monster. Tom, who knows what it is, lends a hand to Arthur the pilot.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E35 - Tom wants to fly in the sky
1.plot: Arthur meets Mary at Dr. Mitchell's office, and she invites him to dinner. Tom is fascinated by his stories of balloon flight and is determined to have a ride.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E36 - To fly or not to fly?
1.plot: Arthur and Mary fall in love. He decides to fly the balloon with the children's help before the army comes to recover it. But the sheriff suspects he is a devil and intervenes. The children are disappointed, but Tom won't give up his dream of flight.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E37 - Goodbye, Arthur!
1.plot: Tom attempts an early morning balloon flight with Huck. Arthur jumps on just as the balloon takes off, and they enjoy the view from the sky. Soon the army arrives and Arthur leaves the village, with a promise to return to Mary.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E38 - The drama
1.plot: On their way to a haunted house in the middle of the night, Tom and Huck witness a murder. Indian Joe kills Dr. Robinson, then lays the blame on Muff Potter. Tom and Huck exchange a promise to keep their secret, because they fear Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E39 - A question of confidence
1.plot: Muff is arrested for the murder, just as Indian Joe planned. Tom and Huck sympathize with Muff and send in food and cigarettes, but keep their silence. Tom is plagued by nightmares.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E40 - The lawsuit
1.plot: Tom and Huck suffer from their guilty consciences and decide to tell the truth. Indian Joe comes to the trial with confidence, but his plan is foiled by Tom's testimony. Joe takes flight and Muff is declared not guilty. Tom is again the children's hero.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E41 - The undesirable
1.plot: The sheriff calls in a detective from St. Louis to find Indian Joe, but to everyone's disappointment he is unsuccessful. He is sure, however, that Joe will seek revenge. The detective follows Tom continually, hoping eventually to arrest Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E42 - A happy journey
1.plot: Aunt Polly asks Tom to visit Aunt Sally in Arkansas and deliver important papers. Glad to go as Becky is also traveling to St. Louis, and the trip will keep him away from Indian Joe. To the surprise of Tom and Becky, Huck steals aboard the steamship.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E43 - The white horse
1.plot: Tom and Huck reach Aunt Sally's ranch safely and hand over the papers. Tom introduces Huck as his brother Sid. While out riding, they spy a white horse.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E44 - The capture
1.plot: Tom and Huck have a grand time on the ranch. When the ranch hands decide to catch the white horse named Lightning, the boys go along. The horse is finally captured, but Tom feels they have injured Lightning's pride.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E45 - Freedom
1.plot: Bennie discovers that Huck is not Tom's brother, but offers to keep their secret in return for help. The ranchers try to tame Lightning, but the Indians say they should release the horse. Out of love for Lightning, Bennie releases it with Tom and Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E46 - The haunted house
1.plot: Tom sneaks out to go to the haunted house with Huck. There they learn that Indian Joe has come back to the village in disguise. By chance, Joe and his friend find a box of gold coins. Tom informs the sheriff, but is not believed.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E47 - The sighs cave
1.plot: All the children go on a picnic except Sid, who has a cold, and Huck. Tom and Becky get lost while exploring a cave. Trying to find the way out, Tom sees Indian Joe coming in. Huck discovers Joe's friend, killed.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E48 - End of Joe the Indian
1.plot: A search party forms to find Tom and Becky. Indian Joe comes upon Tom and scares him, but does no harm. Pursued by the sheriff, Joe falls into a gorge and meets his end. Tom, to his surprise, feels sorry for Joe. Later, Tom and Huck find gold coins.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E49 - All is well
1.plot: The judge divides the gold between Tom and Huck. Mrs. Douglas is chosen as Huck's guardian, and he begins a new life under strict discipline. A new school year begins, and Huck attends with Tom. On day one, the two are in trouble with the new teacher.

meta.plot: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer is a Japanese anime series, directed by Hiroshi Saitô which was aired in 1980. It is based on the well-known and popular novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain. The series was broadcast on the World Masterpiece Theater, an animation staple on Fuji TV that showcased each year an animated version of a different classical book or story of Western literature, and was originally titled "Tom Sawyer no Bōken". It was the second installment of the series, after 1977's Rascal the Raccoon, to feature the work of an American author. This series was also dubbed to English by Saban International and aired on HBO circa 1988 under the title "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer." It aired during the 7:30AM time slot and alternated with the later WMT version of "Little Women." Celebrity Home Entertainment released videos in the United States under the title "All New Adventures of Tom Sawyer". As of January 2011, the anime is airing in the United States on the NHK's cable channel TV Japan.

Amidst the thaw of glasnost, the Kremlin discovers that two Soviet agents, sent to England under deep cover in 1965, have been "lost." A beautiful and ambitious Russian agent, sent to London to track them down, becomes embroiled in a tangle of CIA, KGB and MI-5 plots and counter-plots as the two lost agents, now utterly assimilated, try to avoid detection.

1.title: FR - Sleepers - S01E01 - The Awakening
1.plot: In 1990, the Russians discover a secret room in the Kremlin that is a meticulous re-creation of London life in the 1960s.  After savvy KGB agent Nina Grishina figures out that the room was used to train two agents who haven't been heard from since 1966, she sets off for England to lead the hunt.

1.title: FR - Sleepers - S01E02 - The Net Tightens
1.plot: Nina's arrival in London arouses the interest of the CIA, which only intensifies after the sports-obsessed London KGB chief is observed handing over a suspicious film.  After their reunion, Jeremy and Albert return to their UK lives, but Albert panics when he sense his family is in danger.

1.title: FR - Sleepers - S01E03 - On the Run
1.plot: Together again, the sleepers take to the road in Jeremy's red Ferraris to elude the KBG stakeout.  Albert's effort to reassure Sandra backfires, and she has to admit her jaded mother may be right.  MI5 gets in deep, tripping over the CIA, while Nina outwits them all.

1.title: FR - Sleepers - S01E04 - Welcome Home
1.plot: The jig is up and the sleepers are going in.  Nina begins to regret her success when she learns the truth.  Meanwhile, Comrade Zorin is out of the mental hospital and back in command of the mission.

1.title: FR - Sleepers - S01E05 -

FR - A Man in Full - S01E01 - Saddlebags
1.plot: On the heels of a lavish birthday blowout, Charlie suddenly finds his business empire in jeopardy as those around him contend with crises of their own.

1.title: FR - A Man in Full - S01E02 - The Big Squash
1.plot: Charlie races to entice a potential investor. Roger devotes his attention to his first criminal case. Raymond tries to flip a setback into a settlement.

1.title: FR - A Man in Full - S01E03 - The Takedown
1.plot: A shocking spectacle breeds tensions at Turpmtine. Roger's aspirations to help Conrad take a hit. At a charity gala, old acquaintances reconnect.

1.title: FR - A Man in Full - S01E04 - Tick Tick
1.plot: Conrad adjusts to his new reality. Raymond takes a huge gamble. Charlie finds strength after surgery only to be reminded of his ongoing financial woes.

1.title: FR - A Man in Full - S01E05 - Push Comes to Shove
1.plot: With his options dwindling, Charlie considers taking a dubious deal. Conrad's bail hangs in the balance. Raymond's manipulative game loses momentum.

1.title: FR - A Man in Full - S01E06 - Judgment Day
1.plot: Roger demands justice at Conrad's trial. Raymond exploits his enemy's weakness. After a stunning press conference, Charlie fights to protect his own.

meta.plot: Facing relentless foes and sudden bankruptcy, an Atlanta real estate tycoon must claw his way back to the top when his empire begins to crumble.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E01 - Unicorn Academy
1.plot: At Unicorn Academy, regular teen Sophia has a lot to learn about fantastical creatures, but a dark force threatens to return and destroy unicorn magic!

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E02 - The Hidden Temple
1.plot: While riding the Skyberry Trail, Wildstar gets spooked by grim magic, sending the group racing to a long-forgotten temple full of mysteries — and danger.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E03 - The Race
1.plot: Miss Primrose accelerates the students' training by sending them to an advanced obstacle course. But will competition get in the way?

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E04 - The Book of Grim
1.plot: To learn more about grim magic, Sophia, Ava and Layla sneak into the library after hours to borrow a restricted book that proves to be too powerful.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E05 - Under Starglow Lake
1.plot: When grim magic contaminates the academy's water supply, the unicorns risk losing their power unless Sophia can save Starglow Lake with an unlikely ally.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E06 - The Vision Pool
1.plot: Eager to decode the message from the Whispering Willows, Sophia skips party planning to visit the Vision Pool — right after promising Ava she wouldn't.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E07 - The Broken Gem
1.plot: The Sapphires try everything to get Sophia and Ava to stop fighting, but they've got bigger problems: Two dastardly henchmen are after the grimstone.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E08 - Ravenzella's Revenge
1.plot: As the academy teachers gear up to battle a powerful foe, they forbid their students from leaving the dorms. But one rider doesn't follow the rules.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E09 - Mended Hearts
1.plot: Without the help of their teachers, the students must work together to take on the evil Ravenzella all by themselves. Unicorn Academy depends on it!

meta.plot: When a dark force threatens to destroy Unicorn Island, a brave teen and her five schoolmates must rise up to protect their beloved magical academy.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E01 - Laser Baby's Day Out
1.plot: Laser eyes plus a cute baby equals an evisceration machine that will melt your heart. Before burning it out of your chest. With her laser eyes.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E02 - An Animated Short Where Pissed-Off Supes Kill Their Parents
1.plot: The title says it all and kinda gives away the ending. Let’s just say it’s cathartic and messy.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E03 - I’m Your Pusher
1.plot: Ripped from the pages of the original THE BOYS comics - Billy Butcher, with Terror in tow, terrorizes a narcotics supplier into spiking a certain supe’s fix.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E04 - Boyd in 3D
1.plot: Social media is a dysmorphic lens that warps how we view ourselves and others and numbs us to what’s truly important in life. This is about that.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E05 - BFFS
1.plot: Inject Compound V and get superpowers. Drink compound V and uh… this happens.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E06 - Nubian vs Nubian
1.plot: Divorce is complicated. Divorce with a kid, even more so. Superheroes getting divorced with a kid who’s determined for that NOT to happen? There will be blood…

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E07 - John and Sun-Hee
1.plot: Put on your crying face for this one as an elderly man risks everything to cure his wife’s inoperable cancer.

1.title: FR - The Boys Presents: Diabolical - S01E08 - One Plus One Equals Two
1.plot: Even a great American hero like Homelander had to start somewhere…

meta.plot: From some of the most unhinged and maniacal minds in Hollywood today comes this animated anthology series, a collection of irreverent and emotionally shocking animated short films. Each episode plunges elbow-deep into unseen crevices of The Boys Universe.

A timid young boy who loves all sorts of games, one day solves an ancient puzzle known as the Millennium Puzzle, causing his body to play host to a mysterious spirit with the personality of a gambler.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E01 - The Furious Battle - A Shadow Game
1.plot: A boy named Yugi Mutou solves the Millennium Puzzle which turns in into the "King of Games".

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E02 - The Devil Gamer - The Trap of Hell
1.plot: A criminal escapes from jail and takes Anzu as a prisoner. Yugi shows his other self by using the Millennium Puzzle as he challenges the criminal to a Shadow Game in order to get Anzu back.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E03 - Clash! The Strongest Monster
1.plot: Seto Kaiba is a new student in Yugi's class and he is also a Duel Monsters (a card game) expert. After he steals the Blue-Eyes White Dragon from Yugi's grandfather, Yugi challenges him to a duel where the cards are real. The game remains a tie and Yugi gets his grandpa's card back.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E04 - Theft! The Super Legendary Rare Watch
1.plot: Honda buys a watch for Miho and he gets lucky because he gets the last one. When a guy that collects watches sees that there aren't anymore, he steals the watch from Miho only to be stopped by Dark Yugi right in time. Yugi challenges him to a Shadow Game for the watch as the watch collector loses and Yugi returns the watch to Miho.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E05 - Now Revealed!! Yugi's Secret
1.plot: A man from ancient Egyptian comes at the museum where he sees Yugi with the Millennium Puzzle. He travels in Yugi's mind to see if the puzzle really belongs to Yugi. In there, Dark Yugi challenges him to a game where the man from Egypt must find the real door which has the Millennium Puzzle in it. In the end, the man from Egypt loses and he tells Dark Yugi that he really is the owner of the Millennium Puzzle.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E06 - Desperate Situation!! The Hot Friendship Showdown
1.plot: Shadi, the man from Egypt, challenges Yugi to a Shadow Game, with Anzu's life as the prize.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E07 - The Underhanded Digital Pet Rebellion
1.plot: The popularity of Digital Pets leads to a contest, and Honda trains Miho's pet, so they can take the paid trip. Meanwhile, Yugi is worried for his friend Haiyama, who seems to be pressured into some shady business by the bullying Kujirada. But all is not what it seems...

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E08 - The Four Game Masters Finally Move Out
1.plot: Yugi is kidnapped by Kaiba, and forced to duel the first of his four Game Masters, Count Ridley Sheldon. Can Dark Yugi defeat his doll monsters?

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E09 - Explosion - The Ultimate Secret Yo-Yo Technique
1.plot: The gang is concerned and confused when they see Jonouchi with a gang wielding yo-yos as weapons. Has he turned his back on his friends?

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E10 - The Pressing Beautiful Teacher - The Secret Mask
1.plot: Anzu clashes with the beautiful but sadistically strict Ms. Chrono, and organizes a petition to change the school rules. But Chrono's underhanded counterattack ruins the petition--until Dark Yugi steps in.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E11 - The Rumored Capmon - It's a New Arrival
1.plot: Yugi's friend Warashibe is obsessed with Capsule Monsters, and Miho. When she spurns his advances, Warashibe decides to eliminate her friends--his competition for her affection.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E12 - The Extremely Lucky Enemy - The Invincible Legend
1.plot: Game show champion Ryuichi Fuha (Kaiba's second Game Master) moves to the gang's high school. Although he seems friendly, Ryuichi's tactics for arousing Dark Yugi soon turn dangerous...

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E13 - Target the Schoolgirls - The Fangs of Great Prophecies
1.plot: Fraudulent psychic Kokurano has his eyes on Anzu. Though Anzu doesen't believe his predictions at first, her desire to see her mysterious savior (Dark Yugi) leads her right into Kokurano's grasp.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E14 - In a Bomb Game - The Worst Date
1.plot: When she realizes that Yugi is her mysterious crush, Anzu invites him on a date to an amusement park, intending to put herself in danger to see Dark Yugi. But she finds herself in real danger when a mad bomber challenges Dark Yugi to a twisted game of balloons and explosions.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E15 - An Eerie Woman!! Unable to Transform
1.plot: A new girl named Risa Kageyama wants to become Yugi's girlfriend (much to Anzu's anger). But Risa is actually intent on obtaining Yugi's rare Violet Hectate card.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E16 - Turnabout by a Hair's Breadth - The White-Robed Crisis
1.plot: Jonouchi has a crush on Miyuki, the nurse taking care of his sister Shizuka. But when a corrupt doctor fires her, Jonouchi can't expose him, or Shizuka will be kicked out of the hospital.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E17 - A Last Minute Match - The Model that Invites
1.plot: Kaiba's third Game Master, famous model Aileen Rao, challenges Dark Yugi to a game of Rijinhai. Irene prides herself on taking away the most important things from the ones she defeats--if Yugi loses, he loses Anzu...

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E18 - In a Forbidden Game - Don't Make a Move
1.plot: Yugi befriends bullied youth Imori, and the two discover the forbidden game Dragon Block. The evil game overcomes Imori and he challenges Dark Yugi to a game with his soul itself on the line.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E19 - The Great Melee!! A Popularity Contest
1.plot: With Honda's support, Miho enters a popularity contest against arrogant school beauty Kaoruko Himekoji. Soon Kaoruko resorts to cheating, but when she hurts Miho, she incurs the wrath of Dark Yugi. (Bakura makes a cameo in this episode)

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E20 - It Came Out!! The Strongest and Final Trump Card
1.plot: Kaiba's butler Daimon, an old man kept alive through machinery, duels Dark Yugi as the final Game Master. In the process, he reveals how Kaiba used to be, and implores Yugi to restore his kindness.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E21 - Complete!! The Ultimate Game Land
1.plot: Kaiba kidnaps Yugi's grandpa and dares him to come to Death-T, an amusement park full of death trap games. But Yugi is hesitant to put his friends in danger.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E22 - Tear - The Borderline Shooting
1.plot: The gang heads through Death-T, making their way through a laser tag game with actual lasers, and a game of wits with a giant killer robot.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E23 - The Capmon King! The Showdown for the Top!!
1.plot: With Honda seemingly dead, an enraged Dark Yugi battles Mokuba, Kaiba's little brother, in Capsule Monster Chess.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E24 - Now! The Time of Decision - The Miracle Friendship
1.plot: With his grandpa and friends at stake, Yugi duels Kaiba, and his three Blue-Eyes White Dragons, while Jonouchi and Miho battle Ryuchi and Aileen. With his friends' support, Yugi pulls off the unbeatable combo--Exodia.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E25 - A New Development - The Handsome Boy who Attacks
1.plot: Yugi and his friends meet Ryo Bakura, a gentle new student with an interest in role-playing games. Little do they know the danger that dwells within him...

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E26 - Rival Clash - The Greatest Crisis
1.plot: Yami Yugi aids the others, reduced to figurines, against Dark Bakura and his RPG's boss, Dark Master Zorc.

1.title: FR - Yu-Gi-Oh! - S01E27 - Friendship - From Legend to Myth
1.plot: Even when seemingly defeated, Zorc rises again and threatens to overwhelm the gang. It is up to Bakura to defeat his evil counterpart.
