1.plot: In a bid to sabotage the Lil' Dumpling Pageant, the Uncuddleables replace all of Baby Corp's super-cute top performers with the not-so-cute bottom 5%.

1.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S01E12 - The Great Medieval London Fire of 1135
1.plot: A surprising partnership could turn Baby Corp's entire business model upside-down — and change the way the world looks at baby love. Time to re-org!

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E01 - Untitled Templeton Project
2.plot: With no name, zero capital and countless rivals, the Templetons' scrappy startup takes on risky new client Cathy — the most-hated baby in town.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E02 - Puppy Love
2.plot: The team explores a promising side hustle: reforming naughty puppies. But their pack of potential new clients leads them to a hair-raising discovery.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E03 - Biscuits Rising
2.plot: A scheming British schoolboy baby who was secretly hired to ruin Teddy and Tina's lives lures the team into a trap that's crawling with mind games.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E04 - Moon Shot
2.plot: The team competes with their Baby Corp rivals in a cutthroat "space race" to see who can create the cutest — and kid-friendliest — fake moon landing.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E05 - Inner Children
2.plot: JJ's on the job when the town's adults accidentally sample special formula that gives them all "baby brains." Can she fix it before Tina finds out?

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E06 - Poompf!
2.plot: Crispin Biscuits cooks up a plan to frame the Untitled Templeton Project for a plush toy explosion. But Tina's going all in to clear the company name.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E07 - The Heat Is On
2.plot: It's hot — and babies are cranky. Can the Templetons find a way around the country club splash pad's strict "no babies" rule before the team melts down?

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E08 - One Tricked Pony
2.plot: Crispin Biscuits pulls a beastly power move: luring Precious the pony away from the Templetons. Now it's up to the team to convince her he's bad news.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E09 - Federal Slumber Party
2.plot: Uncle Benji's in town with two big surprises: a cute baby of his own and ambitions to become a federal agent, putting Boss Baby's real identity at risk.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E10 - Floaties
2.plot: Tina's relaxing stay at a baby resort goes off the rails when Crispin Biscuits has everyone convinced that she's not actually Tina... but someone else.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E11 - Breaking the Bank
2.plot: For his next trick, Crispin Biscuits plots to rob the underwater Baby Bank — but not if Boss Baby, Tina and Banker Baby Benny can sink his plans.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E12 - Hate That Baby!
2.plot: After Crispin Biscuits alters the economy to reward Baby Hate, the Boss Baby's forced to become the town's least lovable baby to save the startup.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E13 - North of the Border
2.plot: With Teddy hiding out in Canada, Tina tries to hold the company together. But Baby Love's tanking, thanks to adult baddies who've shrunk to baby size.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E14 - Intensive Purposes
2.plot: Dez and Aubrey go undercover to expose Russ Tisdale as a criminal kingpin. Elsewhere, Boss Baby and crew try to brainstorm their way out of captivity.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E15 - The Unshakeable Bear
2.plot: The team searches for the elusive Dr. The Beard with the feds — and a bear — in hot pursuit. Tabitha pulls an inside job. Tina takes a critical test.

2.title: FR - The Boss Baby: Back in the Crib - S02E16 - Ba-Ba Town
2.plot: Peek-a-boo! Familiar faces return to help the Templetons take down the Shrinkies and get the Boss Baby his old life back. But will their plan work?

meta.plot: Framed for a corporate crime, an adult Ted Templeton turns back into the Boss Baby to live undercover with his brother, Tim, posing as one of his kids.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E01 - Here's Ranma
1.plot: Soun Tendo gets quite a surprise when the son of his friend Genma Saotome that he's arranged for one of his daughters to marry turns out to be a girl...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E02 - School is No Place for Horsing Around
1.plot: Attending his first day at Furinkan High, Ranma encounters Akane's many would-be suitors.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E03 - A Sudden Storm of Love
1.plot: Not realizing that Ranma and 'the pigtailed girl' are the same, Kuno is furious that he let the "cretin" slip away. His attention soon shifts to the red-haired one though, when she bests him in combat.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E04 - Ranma and... Ranma? If It's Not One Thing, It's Another
1.plot: As Kuno continues his attempts to get a date with the 'pigtailed goddess', Ranma starts freaking out, while Nabiki smells money.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E05 - Love Me to the Bone! The Compound Fracture of Akane's Heart
1.plot: A solid beating from Akane brings Ranma to Dr. Tofu, who tries to help out the two teens' relationship, as well as Ranma's injuries.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E06 - Akane's Lost Love... These Things Happen, You Know
1.plot: Akane and Ranma are back at Dr. Tofu's when Kasumi shows up, causing Tofu to start acting like a loon out of love, something Akane doesn't handle well.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E07 - Enter Ryoga! The Eternal 'Lost Boy'
1.plot: After years of searching, Ryoga Hibiki finally finds the person who ruined his life - Ranma Saotome. Now, if only Ranma could remember what the heck he did to make Ryoga so mad...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E08 - School is a Battlefield! Ranma vs. Ryoga
1.plot: Ryoga finally manages to find Ranma again, and challenges him to a fight in the schoolyard. Unfortunately for Ranma, several outside parties have a vested interest in seeing him lose.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E09 - True Confessions! A Girl's Hair is Her Life!
1.plot: Akane's accidental haircut brings a temporary reprieve in Ranma and Ryoga's fighting. Stunned, she wanders off alone, thinking about the loss of the one thing that wasn't 'tomboyish' about her.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E10 - P-P-P-Chan! He's Good For Nothin'
1.plot: Not knowing that it's Ryoga, Akane adopts the little black pig as her pet, naming him P-Chan. This of course drives Ranma crazy, as he desperately wants to get Ryoga away from her, yet feels honorbound not to reveal the secret.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E11 - Ranma Meets Love Head-On! Enter the Delinquent Juvenile Gymnast!
1.plot: Intending to insure St. Hebereke School for Girls' victory in the upcoming match, Kodachi of puts the entire Furinkan Martial Arts Rythmic Gymnastics team out of commission. Akane is chosen as Furinkan's replacement, but not only does her gymnastics skills leave something to be desired, Kodachi decides to lessen Akane's odds with a little visit to the Tendo Dojo...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E12 - A Woman's Love is War! The Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics Challenge!
1.plot: Akane twists her ankle during practice, forcing Ranma to take her place in the match with Kodachi.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E13 - A Tear in a Girl-Delinquent's Eye? The End of the Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics Challenge!
1.plot: Ranma faces Kodachi in the ring, with the Black Rose's love on the line.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E14 - Pelvic Fortune-Telling? Ranma is the No. One Bride in Japan
1.plot: Dr. Tofu's mother comes to visit, determined to find her son a bride. Nabiki, Akane and Ranma all find themselves volunteering to help him get her of his back.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E15 - Enter Shampoo, the Gung-Ho Girl! I Put My Life in Your Hands
1.plot: Ranma gets a shock when an Amazon girl he encountered in China tracks him down, intending to kill his girl half.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E16 - Shampoo's Revenge! The Shiatsu Technique That Steals Heart and Soul
1.plot: Tired of the constant outbursts whenever she gets near Ranma, Shampoo decides to get Akane out of the way.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E17 - I Love You, Ranma! Please Don't Say Goodbye
1.plot: Ranma desperately attempts to recover Akane's lost memory. He even turns to Shampoo who promises to help... at a price.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E18 - I Am a Man! Ranma's Going Back to China!?
1.plot: Genma tries to dissuade Ranma from abandoning Akane to travel back to China and trying to find a cure at Jusenkyo.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E19 - Clash of the Delivery Girls! The Martial Arts Takeout Race
1.plot: Who would sell his only son for a bowl of rice, a fish and some pickles? Genma Saotome, that's who! And now, the wealthy resturant owner has come to collect, demanding Ranma marry his daughter unless Akane can beat her in the ancient art of Martial Arts Takeout Delivery...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E20 - You Really Do Hate Cats!
1.plot: When Ranma opens a package from Shampoo, his major weakness is revealed - he's terrified of cats, something Sasuke, Kuno's loyal ninja servant, intends to exploit to the fullest.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E21 - This Ol' Gal's the Leader of the Amazon Tribe!
1.plot: A strange old woman seeks out Ranma, testing his skills while calling him 'future son-in-law'.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E22 - Behold! The 'Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire' Technique
1.plot: Having been made hyper-sensitive to heat by Cologne, Ranma is trapped in his girl form until he promisees to marry Shampoo. Refusing to give up, Ranma takes a job at her diner, hoping for a chance to grab the 'Phoenix Pill' that's supposed to cure him.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E23 - Enter Mousse! The Fist of the White Swan
1.plot: Dr. Tofu is able to cure Ranma, but as Cologne is quick to ask - How long will it last? In any case, his mind soon gets other things to think about, as Mousse, a Chinese master of hidden weapons, arrives, challenging him for the right to Shampoo's hand.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E24 - Cool Runnings! The Race of the Snowmen
1.plot: Taking a break at a skiing resort, Ranma finds himself entering a Martial Arts ski race where the prize is a date with Shampoo - and the Phoenix Pill!

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E25 - The Abduction of P-Chan
1.plot: Figure skating champion Azusa Shiratori decides P-Chan is now her 'Charlotte', and challenges Akane and Ranma to a match against herself and her partner for the ownership of the pig. But can Ranma learn to skate in time?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E26 - Close Call! The Dance of Death... On Ice!
1.plot: The kiss makes Ranma go ballistic, charging at Mikado like a madman. Ranma barely wins, but Mikado is certain he'll get his revenge in the big Martial Arts Figure Skating match.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E27 - P-Chan Explodes! The Icy Fountain of Love!
1.plot: The match is on, but can Ranma and Akane survive the Golden Pair's deadly 'Couple Cleaver'? And what's Ryoga up to?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E28 - Ranma Trains on Mt. Terror
1.plot: Tired of getting beaten by Ranma, Ryoga takes up Cologne's offer to train him. They set off to the mountains, only to find Genma, Ranma and Akane already there, also training.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E29 - The Breaking Point!? Ryoga's Great Revenge
1.plot: Cologne is teaching Ryoga the fearsome Breaking Point technique, making him capable of shattering giant boulders with a single touch. With it, he's sure he can beat Ranma... If the training doesn't kill him first.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E30 - Danger at the Tendo Dojo!
1.plot: The Tendo Dojo receives a challenge from the Dojo Destroyer, and Soun charges Akane and Ranma with task of defending its honor. Ranma however, gets other things on his mind, when Shampoo promises to give him a cure for the curse if he'll only go on a date with her...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E31 - The Abduction of Akane!
1.plot: Mousse returns, trying to kidnap Akane, but ends up mistakenly grabbing her stuffed toy pig instead. Still, Akane wants her pig back, so Ranma goes along with the instructions to meet up with the kidnapper at the circus.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E32 - Ranma vs. Mousse! To Lose Is to Win
1.plot: Having managed to grab the right person this time, Mousse sets up a new show - girl turns into duck (courtesy of a little cursed water from the spring of drowned duck).

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E33 - Enter Happosai, the Lustful Lecher!
1.plot: Soun and Genma are terrified when their old teacher, master Happosai, shows up. The founder of the Anything Goes school of martial arts, his fighting skills are only surpassed by his lust for women's underwear...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E34 - Assault on the Girls' Locker Room
1.plot: Ranma is determined to infiltrate the Furinkan High girl's locker room when he gets a map from Ryoga that shows there's a old spring beneath it that can cure his curse. It proves harder than Ranma thought though, since the girls are on high alert due to the recent raids by Happosai.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E35 - Kuno's House of Gadgets! Guests Check in, But They Don't Check Out
1.plot: Ranma's found the first of the three magic urns needed to summon the spring. And where's the next one's hidden? Deep in the bowels of the Kuno estate, full of traps, tricks and hot and cold water...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E36 - Goodbye Girl-Type
1.plot: Happosai has claimed one of the urns to store his 'collection', but Ranma manages to steal it back. Of course, the master takes this as a personal insult, and starts causing considerable trouble for Ranma and the others as they travel up the mountains to find the place that will activate the urns.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E37 - It's a Fine Line Between Pleasure and Pain
1.plot: It's cookie baking time in the home ed. class, and Akane and Kodachi both want Ranma to taste. Not taking no for an answer, the Black Rose falls back on blackmail, causing Akane to become even more determined to get Ranma to eat hers.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E38 - S.O.S.! The Wrath of Happosai
1.plot: When Ranma tries to force Happosai to stop the underwear stealing, the old master gets mad and starts terrorizing the inhabitants of the Tendo Dojo, demanding an apology.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E39 - Kissing Is Such Sweet Sorrow! The Taking of Akane's Lips
1.plot: Furinkan High is entering a theater contest with a performance of 'Romeo and Juliet'. Akane is chosen as Juliet, but Kuno and Happosai both want to be Romeo, and so does Ranma when he hears the first price winners will get to see China.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E40 - Bathhouse Battle! We're in Some Hot Water Now
1.plot: The water heater is broken, so Ranma and co are off to the public bathhouse for a bath. Naturally, Happosai wants to come, planning to pay a little visit to the women's side...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E41 - Ranma Gains Yet Another Suitor
1.plot: Akane is shocked when she witnesses Genma getting attacked by a stranger referring to him as father, wanting revenge for being abandoned. Who is this Ukyo?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E42 - Ryoga and Akane: 2-Gether, 4-Ever
1.plot: Ukyo tries to set Akane and Ryoga up on a date, hoping to get Ranma for herself. Ranma, however, intends to do his best to ruin it...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E43 - Sneeze Me, Squeeze Me, Please Me! Shampoo's Recipe for Disaster
1.plot: Caring and gentle as ever, Shampoo brings Ranma a lunch with a little 'extra spices', causing Ranma to get an irresistible urge to hug anyone who sneezes.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E44 - Rub-A-Dub-Dub! There's a Pervert in the Tub
1.plot: Furious at being prevented from accompanying Akane to the hot-springs, Happosai decides to recover the scroll containing his most deadly attack - The Happofire Burst - to teach them all a lesson. Ranma is however determined to find it first, and it's a battle of wits as they both try to infiltrate the scroll's resting place - an all girls hot-spring...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E45 - I Love You! My Dear, Dear Ukyo
1.plot: Ranma recives a challenge from one Tsubasa Kurenai, a strange girl determined to win back her beloved Ukyo.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E46 - The Witch Who Loved Me: A Japanese Ghost Story
1.plot: Distressed at the frequent panty thefts, the town council turns to their local hero, Soun Tendo, for protection of the town relic - an ancient bra said to contain the ghost of a merciless empress.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E47 - Transform! Akane the Super-Duper Girl
1.plot: After getting beaten by Shampoo, Akane is thrilled to find that Happosai's magic noodles she accidently ate has given her super strength. But can she live with the side-effects?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E48 - The Killer from Jusenkyo
1.plot: The Jusenkyo Preservation Society decides they have stood by long enough, letting Ranma and co abuse their Jusenkyo curses for immoral and selfish purposes, and dispatch a team charged with capturing them and teaching them the error of their ways.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E49 - Am I... Pretty? Ranma's Declaration of Womanhood
1.plot: After a nasty blow to the head, Ranma wakes up believing he's a girl. No more martial arts for her, it's flower arrangement and tea ceremony from now on...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E50 - Final Facedown! Happosai vs. The Invisble Man
1.plot: After being gone for a while, having fled to avoid Happosai's wrath, Soun and Genma return, claiming to have studied ancient ninja techniques that will enable them to beat the master once and for all.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E51 - Les Miserables of the Kuno Estate
1.plot: After getting in the middle of an argument between Kuno and Kodachi, Sasuke is banished from the Kuno estate. When Akane finds the loyal ninja sulking in the park, she feels sorry for him and invites him over to the Tendo Dojo for dinner. Shocked that someone actually is being nice to him, Sasuke starts to reconsider his oath of loyalty to the Kunos.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E52 - Ghost Story! Ranma and the Magic Sword
1.plot: A ghost is terrorizing Furinkan High at night, and Ukyo heads up an effort in getting to the bottom of this. It proves a dangerous task though, when one by one the 'ghostbusting' teams turn up uncouncious.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E53 - All It Takes Is One! The Kiss Of Love Is the Kiss of Death
1.plot: It's a calm day on the beach, until Happosai discovers a bracelet containing three pills capable of making someone fall madly in love with the first person of the opposite sex they lay eyes on.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E54 - The Ultimate Team-up!? The Ryoga / Mousse Alliance
1.plot: Finding Ryoga terribly depressed after getting beaten by Ranma, Mousse suggests they team up, combining their skills to get revenge.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E55 - Back to the Happosai!
1.plot: A magic mirror sends Ranma and co a few centuries back in time to a small Chinese village, where a young girl named Cologne is torn between love and disgust for the 18 year old underwear stealing 'adventurer' running around calling himself Happy.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E56 - Kodachi the Black Rose! The Beeline to True Love
1.plot: Upon hearing that the Tendo's are broke and running out of food, Kodachi offers to move in to give her future husband and his family proper care. Despite Ranma's protests, Genma and Happosai welcome her with open arms.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E57 - The Last Days of Happosai...?
1.plot: A fortune telling classmate of Akane predicts that Happosai hasn't get long to live, and that Ranma and Akane will soon be married. When the old master starts showing signs of weakness, the unwilling fiancees better hope they find a cure - fast.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E58 - Two, Too Violent Girls: Ling-Ling and Lung-Lung
1.plot: Two younger warriors from Shampoo's tribe show up, and are shocked to learn that she hasn't killed Ranma yet. Outraged, they decide to dispatch Ranma themselves, using their fearsome 'Dance of the Great Fire Dragon' technique.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E59 - Ranma and the Evil Within
1.plot: Happosai separates Ranma's girl and boy bodies using a magical incense. However, the girl body ends up with all of Ranma's evil, turning it into a vicious spirit that wants to enslave the male Ranma to her will.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E60 - Enter Ken and His Copycat Kerchief
1.plot: The infamous martial artist Copycat Ken is loose in Furikan, able to not only copy people's moves, but also their appearance and strength and turn it against them.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E61 - Ryoga's Miracle Cure! Hand Over That Soap
1.plot: When Ryoga accidently gets his hands on Shampoo's curse curing soap, he decides it's finally time for him to ask Akane out on a date. But Shampoo wants that soap back, and so does Ranma.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E62 - Fight! The Anything-Goes Obstacle Course Race
1.plot: A giant obstacle course race is being held, and the first prize is a trip to China. Naturally, Ranma intends to win it.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E63 - Ranma Goes Back to Jusenkyo at Last
1.plot: Ranma and Genma steal Happosai's magic mirror, and travel back to Jusenkyo with the old goat tagging along. Much to their surprise they arrive just at the time of their previous visit, giving them a perfect opportunity to stop them from falling into the cursed springs altogether...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E64 - The Return of The Hawai'ian Headmaster from Hell
1.plot: Furinkan High's principal returns from a long trip to 'study' American educational system, unfortunately he turns out to be completely insane. His first order of business is to institute a policy of buzz cuts for boys and bowl cuts for girls unless the students can find the coconut with a 'get out of rules free' note in it...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E65 - Enter Kuno, the Night-Prowling Knight
1.plot: To help him carry out his new position as Furinkan High's Moral Guardian, Kuno turns to Happosai for training.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E66 - Ranma Gets Weak!
1.plot: Furious at Ranma for delivering him into the hands of a mob of angry women, Happosai brands Ranma with ancient mark, causing him to become 'as weak as a mere babe'. Upon hearing this, his enemies start lining up to give him a beating... What's poor Ranma to do?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E67 - Eureka! The Desperate Move of Desperation
1.plot: Just as Ranma is about to give up, Cologne gives him hope in the form of the 'Hiryu Shoten Ha', a devastating technique he can use even in his weakened state... if he can manage to learn it.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E68 - Showdown! Can Ranma Make a Comeback?
1.plot: Armed with the 'Hiryu Shoten Ha', Ranma goes after Happosai. But the old master, knowing something is up, keeps his temper, rendering the attack useless unless Ranma can figure out some way to get him really worked up...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E69 - Ukyo's Skirt! The Great Girly-Girl Gambit
1.plot: Tired of Ranma treating her as 'one of the guys', Ukyo decides to change her clothing and behavior to something more feminine. This causes great commotion at school, both amongst the boys, and among Ranma's other suitors, who do not care for the added competition.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E70 - Here Comes Ranma's Mom!
1.plot: A mysterious woman shows up at the Dojo, having long conversations with Genma. Is it really Ranma's mother, come to take him away to live with her?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E71 - From Ryoga with Love
1.plot: Alone in a cabin in the woods, Ryoga sits pondering the nature of his relationship with Akane.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E72 - My Fiance, the Cat
1.plot: Shampoo shows up with an oversized bell for Ranma, claiming it'll make them fated to stay together forever. The bell however turns out be cursed, carrying the spirit of Maomorin - the giant ghost cat, looking for his bride.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E73 - Blow, Wind! To Be Young Is to Go Gung-Ho
1.plot: The Principal hires a new teacher, who takes it upon himself to get Ranma and Akane to openly express their feelings towards each other while they're still young.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E74 - A Formidable New Disciple Appears
1.plot: A young man is awestruck when he sees Happosai in action, and seeks out the Tendo Dojo, wishing to become a student of Anything Goes Martial Arts. The master accepts, and it soon becomes apparent that he's a very dedicated pupil... at bit too dedicated if you ask Ranma.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E75 - Step Outside!
1.plot: Off to the mountains to find a Christmas tree for the Master, Ranma and Genma become separated. When Ranma and Akane go looking for him, they find him living in luxury as a panda, having been adopted by a rich woman as a playmate for her sickly son.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E76 - Ryoga's Tendo Dojo Houseguest Diary
1.plot: Ryoga decides to try to enroll at Furinkan High, though first he has to pass the placement test. Akane agrees to tutor him, but with all the commotion that happens in the Tendo Dojo on a regular basis, can he manage to keep his mind on his studies?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E77 - Happosai's Happy Heart!
1.plot: Happosai falls head over heels in love with a pre-school teacher, but is he willing to give up the underwear stealing for her sake?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E78 - Extra, Extra! Kuno and Nabiki: Read All About It!
1.plot: A fortunetelling friend of Sasuke's divines that Nabiki is the girl Tatewaki is destined to spend his life with. Still torn over having to abandon Akane and 'the pig-tailed girl', Kuno starts to court Nabiki, who naturally welcomes the opportunity to milk him for everything he's worth.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E79 - Ryoga the Strong... Too Strong
1.plot: After sharing his food with an old hermit, the man repays Ryoga by making him the strongest man in the world. But is it worth the price?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E80 - Close Call! P-chan's Secret
1.plot: Terrified that Akane has figured out that he's really P-Chan, Ryoga tries to leave the town forever. Ranma continues to try to figure out a way to beat Ryoga, while Akane tries to force him to tell her what he knows about the mark shared by Ryoga and P-Chan.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E81 - The Egg-Catcher Man
1.plot: Kasumi seems unusually cheerful after a chance encounter with a stranger, leading Nabiki to speculate that she's found herself a new boyfriend.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E82 - Ranma And Kuno's... First Kiss
1.plot: Kuno's got a magic sword capable of granting 3 wishes, and Ranma smells a cure for his curse. The 'upperclassman' has already used two of them... How far is Ranma willing to go to get the third?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E83 - Shampoo's Red Thread Of Dread!
1.plot: Ranma suddenly falls head over heels for Shampoo when she ties him to her with the magical Red Thread of Fate. Just a few more hours and the effect will be permanent, and Akane doesn't care one bit... does she?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E84 - Mousse Goes Home to the Country!
1.plot: After betting it all on a final fight with Ranma, Mousse loses and is forced to give up on Shampoo and go home to China. But before he leaves, he's determined to make Shampoo happy by forcing Ranma to give up his other suitors.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E85 - The Dumbest Bet in History!
1.plot: 10 years ago, Ranma gambled away the Tendo Dojo. Now the 'Gambling King' has come to collect, and Ranma has to win it back. However, in spite of his name, the King is so bad at gambling he only manages to beat children. Sadly, that provides little comfort as Ranma's even worse...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E86 - Kuno Becomes a Marianne!
1.plot: Azusa becomes convinced Kuno is a tanuki, a legendary creature with magical powers, and promptly adopts him as her 'Marianne'. Ranma and Akane are just happy that the two are keeping each other busy, until Azusa starts to suspect Akane wants to take her new pet away form her again.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E87 - Ranma, You Are Such a Jerk!
1.plot: Akane runs away after Ranma ruins her anniversary dinner, and the entire household has to spend the rest of the night looking for her.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E88 - Gimme That Pigtail
1.plot: Why are there strange small men running around chopping off people's pigtails? And what's the Dragon Whisker? What is Ranma hiding...?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E89 - When a Guy's Pride and Joy Is Gone
1.plot: Ranma gets no peace at all, as everyone's after the Dragon Whisker. Things get even more tense as he learns that if he doesn't get it back soon, he might just run out of hair - permanently.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E90 - Ling-Ling and Lung-Lung Strike Back!
1.plot: Honorbound to remain single until their big sister marries, Ling-Ling and Lung-Lung return to Japan armed with an even deadlier technique, determined to eliminate all of Ranma's other fiancees.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E91 - Ryoga's Proposal
1.plot: After being saved from a pack of wolves by Ryoga, the Ghost Cat decides to repay the debt by possessing him and proposing to Akane.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E92 - Genma Takes a Walk
1.plot: After a disagreement over the rules oh Shogi, tensions between Soun and Genma rise, until Genma moves out of the Dojo, taking Ranma with him...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E93 - The Gentle Art of Martial Tea Ceremony
1.plot: Ranma is kidnapped by Sentaro - a practitioner of Martial Arts Tea Ceremony, looking for a bride. To determine the bride's suitability, she has to defeat his grandmother, and as usual, Ranma's completely incapable of walking away from a challenge.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E94 - And the Challenger Is... a Girl?!
1.plot: A mysterious gang of martial artist using old fashion toys as weapons are about, and one of them, a young girl, challenges Akane for the Dojo's sign... and wins. Can Akane manage to win it back?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E95 - Hot Springs Battle Royale!
1.plot: A hotsprings resort is having a big obstacle course race as a PR gimmick, with the first prize being a trip to another resort of the contestants choice. Seeing a chance to get back to Jusenkyo, the whole gang enters, unaware that the resort is trying their best to stop anyone from winning, since they're broke and can't afford to pay for the prize...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E96 - Me Is Kuno's Daddy, Me Is
1.plot: When the Principal starts going on about his long lost son, Sasuke starts to have his suspicions. But can get to the bottom of this as the school is turned into a war zone by the Principal's 'Get out of all school rules' class tournament fight.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E97 - The Matriarch Takes a Stand
1.plot: Sentaro need's Ranma's assistance once more, as the Daimonji matriarch prepares to do something so dangerous, so unprecedented, that the result is sure to be catastrophic...

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E98 - A Leotard Is a Girl's Burden
1.plot: Out to prove that martial arts rhythmic gymnastics is a manly sport for manly man-like men, a group of boys are stealing the local team's special gymnastics treasures. Naturally, it's up to Ranma to strike a blow for womankind and get the treasures back.

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E99 - The Mixed-Bath Horror!
1.plot: An invitation takes Ranma and the rest to a run-down hot-springs resort. But what are those strange noises in the bathhouse... Is it really haunted?

1.title: FR - Ranma ½ - S01E100 - The Frogman's Curse!
1.plot: A strange old man with a small army of pet frogs comes to town, and he's keeping his eyes on Ranma. Is it really the Frog Hermit, and mysterious stranger with the ability to turn people into frogs?

meta.plot: Ranma Saotome, a teenage martial artist, and his father Genma travel to the 'cursed training ground' of Jusenkyo in China. There, despite the warnings of the Chinese guard, they fall into the cursed springs. From now on, whenever Ranma is doused in cold water, he turns into a girl and a cute, well-built redhead at that. Hot water changes him back into a man again, but only until the next time. To make matters worse, his father engages him to Akane Tendo, a girl who hates boys.
Young Dai embarks on an epic journey to become a legendary hero, training with his loyal companions to save the world from the resurrected Demon King.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E01 - Dai, The Tiny Hero
1.plot: Young Dai lives on Dermline Island, where he dreams of being a Hero. One day, a Hero and his companions come to the island. Dai is excited at first, but their true intent is to steal his best friend, Gomechan, the mythical Golden Metal Slime.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E02 - Dai and Princess Leona
1.plot: Dai must take Leona to the Earth Cave for a ritual. At first, Dai dislikes Leona, but they slowly come to understand each other. Suddenly, a giant Evil Scorpion attacks. Dai defeats it, but Leona is poisoned. As Dai’s wishes to save her...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E03 - The Hero's Tutor
1.plot: A dark power affects Dai’s monster friends, driving them berserk. Brass tries to get Dai to leave. As they argue, a Hero trainer arrives to inform Dai that the Dark Lord has returned. To save those he cares about, Dai undergoes Hero training.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E04 - The Dark Lord Hadlar's Return
1.plot: Avan turned into a dragon and attacks Dai. Dai fights back to no avail. To defeat Avan’s flames requires Wave Slash. As Dai clears his objective, someone enters the island. Who should appear before Avan but the worst possible being...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E05 - The Insignia of Avan
1.plot: Avan is overpowered by Hadlar, who is now stronger than ever. To protect his students and the world, Avan gathers the last of his strength and faces Hadlar. Dai can do nothing but watch. Finally, the showdown between Avan and Hadlar is concluded.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E06 - Crocodine, the Beast King
FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E07 - Maam's Turmoil
1.plot: Thanks to Maam’s help, Dai goes on the offensive against Crocodine. Popp joins in and the battle intensifies. Seeing Dai and Popp fight, Maam remembers Avan’s words to her when she was young and comes to a decision.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E08 - Furfang Full Assault
1.plot: Dai and company arrive late at night to the castle town of Romos. The next morning, Crocodine attacks with the Furfang Legion. In Romos Castle, Dai faces Crocodine. Crocodine decides to use the weapon that Zaboera gave him.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E08 - Furfang Full Assault
1.plot: Dai and company arrive late at night to the castle town of Romos. The next morning, Crocodine attacks with the Furfang Legion. In Romos Castle, Dai faces Crocodine. Crocodine decides to use the weapon that Zaboera gave him.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E09 - A Single Shard of Courage
1.plot: Dai is heavily wounded by Crocodine’s Beast King Anguish Blast. Maam tries to save Dai, but is bound by a Heyedra. Masopho, the Mage from the fake Hero’s party shows this to Popp, who remains paralyzed by fear. Masopho then speaks of his past...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E10 - Onto Papnica Kingdom
1.plot: Having won the battle with Crocodine, Dai and company head to Papnica Kingdom, which is under attack by the Undead Legion of the Dark Army. Upon arrival, Dai sees an unbelievable sight. Meanwhile, Hadlar summons all Legion Commanders, but...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E11 - Hyunckel, the Dark Swordsman
1.plot: Dai’s Avan Strash had no effect on Hyunckel. Hyunckel dons his “Dark Armour Blade” to face Dai and his companions. Just why does Hyunckel hate Avan so much? Hyunckel reveals his past with Avan to answer Maam’s question.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E12 - The Collaborative Raidein
1.plot: Thanks to Crocodine, Dai and Popp managed to escape. Popp says to Dai that if they don’t defeat Hyunckel, they won’t be able save Maam or Leona. Morning comes. Popp has come up with a plan to defeat Hyunckel and suggests the use of a certain spell.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E13 - The Deciding Moment
1.plot: Hyunckel withstands the Zapple spell. His spell thwarted, Dai falls prey to Hyunckel’s Bloody Scryde. At that moment, Maam appears and hands a Soul Shell found in a hidden room to Hyunckel. It contains a shocking truth about Hyunckel’s past.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E14 - Blizzblaze General Flazzard
1.plot: After their fierce battle against Hyunckel, Dai and friends set out to find Leona. They launch signal flares and are met by Amy of the Papnica Troika, who takes them to where Leona is hiding, but Blizzblaze General Flazzard reaches her first...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E15 - The Terrifying Curse Field
1.plot: Dai faces off with Flazzard. His Magic Sword is effective, but Flazzard fires off the rocks in his body in both an attack and a signal to activate the Blizzblaze Curse Field. The surrounding area is encased in a field, and Dai’s group is weakened.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E16 - The Grand Sorcerer Matoriv
1.plot: Matoriv is a Grand Sorcerer living in a cave. At first, he’s resistant to helping, but upon learning that Dai is Avan’s last student, he agrees to help save Leona. Meanwhile, Hadlar’s Dark Army prepares a scheme.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E17 - The Death-Defying Savior
1.plot: Dai and Baduck reach the Dark Flame Spire to find Zaboera, Mystvearn, and their Legion monsters waiting for them. Waiting for Popp and Maam at the Dark Ice Spire is Hadlar. Dai and his friends are in danger. Just then, an unlikely savior appears.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E18 - Hyunckel Versus Hadlar
1.plot: Popp and Maam are shocked by the appearance of Hyunckel. It turns out he was saved by Crocodine. Having come to help the Disciples of Avan, Hyunckel sends Popp and Maam off to Valge Tower and faces off with Hadlar.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E19 - The Final Avan Style Technique
1.plot: Dai, Popp, and Maam reach Valge Tower where they are stopped by Flazzard. Realizing he is at a disadvantage, Flazzard shatters himself into bullets of rocks and launches himself as projectiles. Just then, the words of Avan flash through Dai’s mind!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E20 - Now I Slice Everything
1.plot: With his core destroyed by Dai’s Air Slash, Flazzard splits his body. Mystvearn appears and gives Flazzard the Shadow Legion’s ultimate armour. Flazzard attacks Dai. But having completed his Avan Style Sword Technique, Dai remains unfazed...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E21 - Maam's Decision
1.plot: Dai and his friends prepare for their next battle as Papnica rebuilds. Maam hears the words of Matoriv and comes to a decision. Meanwhile, Vearn’s personal assassin, Killvearn and his companion Piroro appear before Hadlar. What will they say to him?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E22 - Off To the Department Store
1.plot: Dai and Leona head to Bengarna Kingdom to get Dai a new weapon. Freed from her duties as princess, Leona enjoys her shopping. Dai and Popp spend their time amazed by all the new sights. New encounters and new threats await them.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E23 - The Dragon Knight
1.plot: Dai faces the Dragons attacking Bengarna. His sword shatters. Dragons that Popp failed to defeat join in. All prepare for defeat, but Dai unleashes the power of the Dragon Crest. Nabara and Merle realize a truth that Dai himself doesn’t yet know.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E24 - Dragon Master General Baran
1.plot: Baran reveals the duty of a Dragon Knight: to wipe out the humans. Baran explains why Dragon Knights were born. Dai rejects Baran’s words. Growing impatient, Baran blows Dai away with a powerful attack. Baran then reveals a shocking truth…!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E25 - The Terrifying Draconic Aura
1.plot: With the secret to the Dragon Knights’ supremacy, the “Draconic Aura” deployed, Baran is invulnerable to Crocodine’s attacks. Crocodine continues to stand up to Baran. And Dai, as well. They attack Baran together, but Baran forms a plan.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E26 - The Dragon Masters Approach
1.plot: Baran summons the Dragon Masters, three powerful Dragon Riders, and heads to Teran Kingdom to reclaim Dai. Leona and the others shelter Dai in a prison cell. Detecting Baran and the Dragon Masters, the group is at a loss. Just then, Popp acts.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E27 - Land Rider Larhart
1.plot: Popp faces the Dragon Masters alone and falls into peril. Hyunckel arrives to save him. Popp and Hyunckel defeat Galdandy and Borahorn. Popp loses consciousness and Hyunckel faces Larhart. But Larhart is far more powerful than Galdandy or Borahorn.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E28 - Dai's Secret
1.plot: Baran approaches Teran Castle where Dai is kept. Leona gives Dai his knife and encourages him to fight before heading off to face Baran with Crocodine. Meanwhile, Hyunckel lies beaten by Larhart. Larhart tells him Baran’s tumultuous past...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E29 - Baran's Rage
1.plot: With Popp as his hostage, Borahorn threatens Hyunckel. Larhart takes unexpected action. Larhart reveals his past. Meanwhile, Baran appears at Teran Castle. Hearing of Popp’s actions, Crocodine employs a desperate strategy against Baran!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E30 - Popp's Resolve
1.plot: As a Dragonoid, Baran’s power is beyond imagination. Just as everyone prepares to die, Dai appears. When the meeting between father and son that they had hoped to prevent happens, Popp remembers the final moments of his master, Avan.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E31 - A Father and Son Clash
1.plot: The Dragon Crest appears on Dai’s right hand. Is it a miracle brought on by his mother, Soala...? By focusing his power, Dai gains power beyond Baran’s. Baran wields his Draconic Aura and fights back. The two Dragon Knights clash in an epic battle.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E32 - Farewell To the Father
1.plot: With his weapon lost, Dai must defend himself. Baran lacks the Magic Power for his full Gigabreak. Dai is given Hyunckel’s Dark Armour Blade and faces off with Baran one last time. Meanwhile, Popp remains unresponsive to Leona’s Zing spell...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E33 - Zaboera's Scheme
1.plot: With one final chance from Vearn, Hadlar himself heads out with Zaboera to kill Dai. Dai and his friends rest their wounds in Merle’s cottage. As Popp stands guard outside, someone makes an unexpected appearance.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E34 - The Romos Martial Arts Tournament
1.plot: Dai and his friends return to Papnica. They learn of a Martial Arts Tournament in Romos where the winner will receive a legendary weapon. Dai and Popp head to the tournament where a certain contestant’s fighting catches their eyes.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E35 - The Incident At the Finals
1.plot: Dai and Popp were reunited with Maam. Maam promises to win the Sword of Champions. Maam wins her way through the preliminary fights. But an evil plot unfurls behind the scenes... As the finals are about to begin, one man springs into action.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E36 - The Superior Being Versus Chiu
1.plot: A giant body, unbelievable speed, unparalleled strength, and rapid regeneration... The Superior Being, Zamza, is a terrifying threat. Dai faces him but loses stamina too quickly. Dai falls. All hope seems lost. But only Chiu refuses to give up...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E37 - All In An Instant
1.plot: The Refractor Fist is effective against the seemingly invincible Superior Being. Using her nimble skills and the Refractor Fist, Maam succeeds in freeing Dai. Dai sees her fight and discovers a clue. Dai prepares a final counterattack.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E38 - The World Summit
1.plot: To fight the Dark Army, Leona gathers world leaders for a summit. Dai hopes to learn of a new legendary weapon. In Zaboera’s hideout, Hadlar is hooked up inside a large bio-chamber. Hadlar is letting Zaboera perform a certain experiment on him...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E39 - The Landing of Sovereign Rock Castle
1.plot: Lon Beruk, begins forging the greatest sword in the world for Dai. Meanwhile, in Papnica, the world summit of the world’s leaders begins. But the talks drag on without progress, troubling Leona. Just then a giant enemy appears...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E40 - Master of Darkness Against His Pupil
1.plot: With Mystvearn’s declaration of war, the battle begins. The companions fight, but against an endless enemy, they’re slowly forced back. Help arrives, reigniting the weakened flame in everyone’s hearts. At last, Mystvearn himself appears...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E41 - The Strongest Sword
1.plot: Hyunckel unleashes a strike with the Aura of Justice. Enraged, Mystbearn unleashes his Dark Aura to tear Popp and the others apart. Sovereign Rock Castle heads for the Grand Chapel. Meanwhile, Lon Beruk finally completes the sword for Dai.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E42 - The Field of Death
1.plot: The Sword of Dai cuts Sovereign Rock Castle in half. Mystvearn tries to reveal his true power, but Killvearn appears. With Mystvearn’s anger quelled, and the two retreat. Popp gives chase. Popp reaches the dark island known as the Field of Death.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E43 - The Clash of Powerful Swords
1.plot: Hadlar was more powerful than ever. Along with an indomitable Superior Being body and an unbreakable will, he also has the ability to cast spells. Dai could only defend himself. Cornered, Dai unleashes an Avan Strash with the Sword of Dai.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E44 - The Hero Lost in the Glacier
1.plot: Dai and Hadlar’s battle ended in a draw, with Dai lost in the ocean. Killvearn attacks the despondent Popp. Popp remembers the words of Matoriv and retreats, but Killvearn pursues. Can Popp escape? And what happened to Dai...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E45 - The Orichalcum Warrior
1.plot: Popp, Crocodine, and Chiu search for Dai. Zaboera also leads his servants to find Dai, causing the parties to clash. Popp rescues Dai, but Zaboera unleashes his Super Spell. Just then, a mysterious shining warrior appears between them and...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E46 - The Extreme Annihilation Spell, Medoroa
1.plot: The showdown with Vearn is in five days. Dai and his friends head out to spend the remaining time training. Popp visits Matoriv to find a way to counter the Hadlar Royal Guard. Matoriv decides to teach Popp a spell that he himself fears to use.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E47 - To the Final Battleground
1.plot: The members return, having completed their training. Dai and his friends head to Carl Kingdom. There’s a change in the Field of Death and they land with a heightened sense of tension. Meanwhile, in a remote cave, Baran and Killvearn face off...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E48 - The Hadlar Royal Guard
1.plot: Nova is General Bowson’s son. Refusing to fight together with Dai, he heads off to fight the Dark Army. Dai and Popp hurry after him, but Nova arrives first. Nova fights valiantly, but the Orichalcum warriors reveal their true terror...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E49 - The Team Battle Begins
1.plot: Zababa becomes the stage for the battle between Dai, with his friends, and the Hadlar Royal Guard. Our heroes fight using their individual strengths, but the Orichalcum warriors are powerful enemies. Just who will prevail in this fierce battle...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E50 - We're The Beast King Commandos
1.plot: Popp’s Medroa was strong enough to carve out the ground. Dai and his friends celebrate their victory. Meanwhile, Chiu forms the Beast King Commandos and works to uncover the secret of the enemy stronghold. But the evil hand of the enemy closes in.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E51 - The Avan Style Ultimate Technique
1.plot: Popp, Hyunckel, and Crocodine find the wounded Chiu. Hyunckel deduces it was Fenbren who fought him, and Baran who saved him. Hyunckel sends Popp home and calls out to Baran. Sensing a change in Baran’s demeanor, Hyunckel attempts to stop him...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E52 - Father and Son Dragons Set Out
1.plot: Though shocked by Baran’s sudden appearance, Leona decides to accept his assistance. The Hadlar Royal Guard is lured to the surface while Dai and Baran head to destroy the Dark Citadel Gate. But someone awaits them at the Dark Citadel Gate.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E53 - Hadlar's Challenge
1.plot: Popp and his friends face the Hadlar Royal Guard. Meanwhile, Dai and Baran battle Fenbren, and Dai instinctively saves his ally, Baran. The battle with Fenbren ends. Beyond the Dark Citadel Gate, they find Hadlar ready to battle the Dragon Knights.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E54 - Hadlar Verus Baran
1.plot: Hadlar’s Black Core could explode at any moment, leaving Dai and Baran unable to attack. Unaware of his own situation, Hadlar unleashes an even more intense barrage of attacks at the two. To resolve the situation, Baran attempts a risky maneuver.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E55 - The Black Core
1.plot: After putting Dai to sleep, Baran turns into the Dragonoid for the final fight with Hadlar. Hadlar focuses all his strength to combat Baran. Meanwhile, from his throne, Dark King Vearn watches their battle with a cool gaze.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E56 - The Inherited Heart
1.plot: Popp and the others have managed to survive the Black Core’s explosion. Realizing that the explosion happened while Dai and Baran were fighting, the group rushes to find Dai and Baran. There, they see a shocking sight.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E57 - The God of the Underworld
1.plot: Dai and his friends finally face off against Vearn, who uses his Dark Aura to blast Dai away and casts powerful spells with his overwhelming Magic Power. Vearn is in control even against five opponents. Do Dai and his friends stand a chance...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E58 - The Unlikely Savior
1.plot: Dai’s Avan Strash hit Vearn, but it’s not enough to defeat him. Vearn rises again and summons the Staff of Edacity, which converts Magic Power into raw attack power. With Vearn’s Magic Power, its attack is strong enough to shake the heavens and...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E59 - The Survivors
1.plot: Dai and his friends faced absolute defeat. Dai is taken away by the Holy Mother Dragon and Hyunckel and Crocodine are missing. Popp and Maam wash up on a beach in Carl Kingdom. The two learn that Vearn has begun his attack on the Surface World.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E60 - Dai and Popp
1.plot: The missing Hyunckel and Crocodine are prisoners of the Dark Army. A meeting is held in which it’s decided that Dai should rally the forces. Meanwhile, Dai awakens, but is unable to bear the weight of being a Hero and runs. He ends up in...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E61 - Avan, The Hero
1.plot: A story of Avan when Hadlar was still the Dark Lord. The Order of Carl faces the Dark Army with its princess, Flora. A young Avan protects the princess. Hadlar attacks Carl Castle to capture Flora and...? How Avan and Hadlar’s rivalry began...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E62 - The Cave of Trials
1.plot: Seeking the legendary spell Kaglimmer, Leona, Maam, Merle, and Flora brave the Cave of Trials. Dai sets out to train until Leona returns. As they prepare, Flora tells Maam a secret of the Insignias of Avan. When Popp overhears them...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E63 - The Sacred Inheritance
1.plot: Dai trains with Nova and masters both types of Avan Strash, leading him to create a new attack. Leona and the others search the Cave of Trials to attain Kaglimmer. Popp grows desperate that his Isignia of Avan is the only one which will not glow...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E64 - The Night Before the Battle
1.plot: Lon Beruk brings the restored Sword of Dai and new weapons. The group renews their resolve. Maam is shaken by Amy’s feelings for Hyunckel and Popp is frustrated his Insignia of Avan won’t shine. As the final battle approaches, things grow shaky...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E65 - The Dark Hyunckel
1.plot: The execution day has arrived. As noon approaches and Vearn Palace arrives in the sky above, Mystvearn appears before Hyunckel and Crocodine. Mystvearn makes Hyunckel an offer: accept his Dark Aura or die. Hyunckel makes an unexpected choice.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E66 - The Five Colors of Light
1.plot: The five Disciples of Avan have gathered. Mystvearn attempts to intervene, but Lon Beruk stops him. Crocodine and the others fight the army of monsters. The Disciples of Avan prepare the ritual to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp remains uncertain...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E67 - The Peril of the Great Purification Spell
1.plot: The Disciples of Avan try to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp’s Insignia won’t glow. Maam tries to encourage Popp, but only increases his pain. Powerful monsters enter the fray. As Dai and friends begin to panic, Zaboera schemes.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E68 - The Last Challenge
1.plot: Popp’s soul is awakened. He realizes his abilities as a Sage and heals Merle. Dai and friends continue the ritual to cast Kaglimmer and nullify Vearn’s magic field to enter Vearn Palace, where some unexpected individuals appear before them.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E69 - The Clash of Love
1.plot: Maam’s plea for a truce goes unheard and she is attacked relentlessly by Albinass’s true form. Maam sees Albinass’s strong devotion to Hadlar, but soon remembers Avan’s words, which motivate her to fight back...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E70 - Victory Or Annihilation
1.plot: The Disciples of Avan continue to fight the Hadlar Royal Guard. Maam defeats Albinass and Hyunckel defeats Hym. But Popp struggles against Sigma. The two battle over the only spell that has any effect on Sigma, Medroa.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E71 - Battle of True Dragons
1.plot: Popp and the others return to Dai. There, they witness an unbelievable clash between Dai and Haldar. The sight is a recreation of the legendary “Battle of True Dragons.” The others can only stand back and observe. The moment of truth arrives...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E72 - The Last Attack
1.plot: Hadlar rises again out of sheer force of will to face his true final battle. Dai accepts this challenge and chooses his Magic Sword. Though weaker than his Avan Strash Cross, Dai still has one ace up his sleeve...!? Their final attacks clash...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E73 - The Hope in the Flames
1.plot: Killvearn’s trap imprisoned Dai, Popp, and Hadlar. Powerful flames gradually eat away at their stamina and spirits. Dai and Popp begin to lose hope. Just then, a single ray of light shines through. Can they escape this hopeless situation...?!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E74 - Return of the Great Hero
1.plot: It was Avan, returned from the dead, who saved Popp and Hadlar! Dai, Popp, and Maam embrace their Master in tears. But Hyunckel, caught between conflicting emotions, is unable to face Avan. The party welcomes their new ally and heads towards Vearn’s palace!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E75 - The Secret Way of Purification
1.plot: Hyunckel refuses to proceed with Avan and stays behind. Dai and the others are bewildered but advance without him. The party reaches the doors to Vearn Palace. At a loss as to how to breach the doors, Avan steps forward…

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E76 - The Steady Advance of Justice
1.plot: Leaving Hyunckel to guard the rear, Dai and his friends enter Vearn Palace. Avan scouts ahead and asks a favor of Leona. Back on the surface, the humans overcome Zaboera’s monster horde. The tide of battle is turning, then Zaboera executes a plan.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E77 - The Other Hero
1.plot: Zaboera reveals his ace, the Superior Being Zombie. Crocodine and the humans are out of options. As morale fades, Nova, Hero of the North, risks his life to face the enemy.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E78 - The Survivor From Hell
1.plot: After the battle of Loroi Valley, Crocodine finds Zaboera who managed to survive. Meanwhile, Hyunckel battles the monster horde. Then an unexpected individual appears...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E79 - The Silver-Haired Hym
1.plot: Hym returns from hell stronger than ever. Hyunckel faces Hym using only his fists and Aura. Who will be the victor in the clash between fists of fortitude and implacability?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E80 - Checkmate
1.plot: A new enemy, the king Maximum appears with an Orichalcum Army. Hyunckel and Hym are in peril. Hyunckel stands his wounded body up and burns his fortitude to face their enemy!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E81 - The Battle in the White Garden
1.plot: Larhart appears before Hyunckel and Hym, and takes the Dark Armour Spear before leaving to protect Dai. Meanwhile, Dai, Popp, and Maam face off against Mystvearn.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E82 - The Successor of Justice
1.plot: Avan is taken by Killvearn and challenged to a duel. Meanwhile, Dai and his friends challenge Mystvearn in hopes of finding out how to save their Master, but...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E83 - Baran's Last Will
1.plot: Mystvearn captures Popp and Maam and all seems lost. But Land Rider Larhart appears and rescues them before kneeling before Dai and relaying Baran’s last wish to him...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E84 - Rise, Knight of Destiny
1.plot: Leona is captured. Dai chases after her and arrives at a “living engine", the Dark Force Reactor. Dai attempts to rescue Leona, but is stopped. What will happen to her...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E85 - Vearn, The Dark King
1.plot: Dai and Leona reach the top of the Tower of Supremacy. Facing Vearn, Dai recalls his past loss against him and is struck with fear. Vearn is wary of Dai’s Twin Dragon Crests.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E86 - Killvearn's Trap
1.plot: Dai’s power could match or exceed Vearn’s. Vearn invites Dai to serve him. Meanwhile, Avan and Killvearn continue to fight. Can Avan win against the Reaper?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E87 - The Deciding Attack
1.plot: Hym unleashes attacks against the heretofore invulnerable Mystvearn. Dai holds the upper hand against Vearn, but feels overwhelmed by his confidence. How will each fight end?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E88 - The Shadow Raiment
1.plot: The consecutive Doruoras swallowed Dark King Vearn. Popp and the others decide to regroup with Dai. The fallen Mystvearn stands again and removes his Shadow Raiment.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E89 - The Secret Spell of Frozen Time
FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E90 - Myst and Kill
1.plot: With Popp and Brokeena gone, the others lose their will to fight. Then, Killvearn appears, announcing Avan’s death. But something about Killvearn is different...?

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E91 - Vearn's Truth
1.plot: Avan reveals Mystvearn’s true identity and Dark King Vearn’s greatest secret. Meanwhile, in the Tower of Supremacy, dark clouds gather above Dai and Leona...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E92 - The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth
1.plot: Myst tries to make Hyunckel’s body his own. Meanwhile, Dai faces off with Vearn, the True Dark King. Dai’s strongest attack, Giga Strash, is met with an unknown stance...

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E93 - The Eye Jewel
1.plot: The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth beats Dai’s Gigastrash. When Leona refuses to become Vearn’s servant, he takes away her freedom. Just then, Popp and the others arrive!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E94 - On This Bond
1.plot: Popp tries to uncover the secret of the Dark King’s ultimate skill. He stands strong despite being battered by Vearn’s offensive, bolstering the morale of Hym and Larhart.

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E95 - The Greatest, Final Comeback
FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E96 - Like a Bright Flash
1.plot: The Black Cores in the Pillars of Vearn begin counting down to the world’s end. Dai is broken, and Popp loses the will to fight... Suddenly, a voice rings in Popp’s ears!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E97 - The Tear of the Gods
1.plot: To Vearn’s confusion, Dai and Popp rise up again and again. The Dark King tries to detonate the Black Core below, but suddenly the unbelievable happens!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E99 - Victory By These Hands
1.plot: Having become the Dragonoid, Dai pummels Vearn. Meanwhile, Popp and the other heroes have been dropped into the heart of Vearn Palace, where they face a new threat...!

1.title: FR - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai - S01E100 - Farewell, This World That I Love
1.plot: In the conclusion to the epic battle between the Hero and the Dark King, Dai fights with his father’s Demon Dragon Blade, and Vearn counters with beams and his rigid body.

meta.plot: After a painful breakup, a young lawyer dives head first into the confusing world of modern dating, with the unwavering support of her best friends.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E01 - #Situationship
1.plot: Newly single lawyer Leyla starts seeing Feyyaz, a chef she met while on vacation. At work, she takes on the divorce case of entrepreneur Cem Murathan.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E02 - #Lovebombing
1.plot: Leyla realizes there's more to Cem than his wife would have her believe. Her ex Ömer interrupts a lavish date with Feyyaz.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E03 - #Ghosting
1.plot: After Feyyaz ghosts her, Leyla takes steps to cut Ömer out of her life, leading him to file for custody of their dog Buddy.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E04 - #Flashbacking vs fast forwarding
1.plot: The divorce case is wrapped up, but Cem keeps his hooks in Leyla. A New Year's Eve party ends with a sudden trip to the hospital.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E05 - #Benching
1.plot: Cem hires Leyla's firm and asks her to represent him at a winery auction. She keeps her distance but finds herself drawn to him at his hotel's opening.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E06 - #Crosschecking
1.plot: Needing a break from everything, Leyla joins a family gathering where she discovers her parents' marriage isn't as happy as she'd thought.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E07 - #Truthordare
1.plot: Ömer works his way back into Leyla's life, culminating in a proposal. Leyla envisions a future with him but can't stop thinking about Cem.

1.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S01E08 - #Wedding
1.plot: Leyla learns the truth about the men in her life — even as she's found her happy ending.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E01 - #TakotsuboKardiyomiyopati
2.plot: Leyla gets a fresh start when she finally moves into her new home, but Ömer's temper gets the better of him when he lashes out at one of his own friends.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E02 - #FriendZone
2.plot: Defne experiences a tragic loss and reaches out to Cem for help rather than Seyyaz, causing him to question their relationship's sincerity.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E03 - #CatchMeIfYouCan
2.plot: Nil catches Leyla and Cem in a compromising position, splashing their scandalous relationship all over the news. Beliz decides to file for a divorce.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E04 - #MicroCheating
2.plot: Sarp finds Ömer in a bad condition. Leyla begins to feel the worrying repercussions of being Cem Murathan's object of desire.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E05 - #RingRing!
2.plot: Murat spirals when he finds out about Esra's brief rendezvous with an old flame. Leyla takes an unexpected trip to visit her parents.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E06 - #CloudNine
2.plot: Beliz arrives at a New Year's Eve party with a surprise date, while Cem makes an unexpected gesture to get closer to Leyla.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E07 - #TurningPoint
2.plot: Defne's manipulation creates distance between Cem and Leyla, while Leyla feels increasingly out of place in her new home.

2.title: FR - Thank You, Next - S02E08 - #BungeeJumping
2.plot: Cem's real motives emerge as jealousy strikes once more. Defne's role proves more complex than initially apparent.

meta.plot: Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg return in all-new, comedic adventures. They may be super heroes who save the world every day ... but somebody still has to do the laundry!

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E01 - Legendary Sandwich
1.plot: Beast Boy, Robin and Starfire go in search of the ingredients for a legendary sandwich.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E02 - Pie Bros
1.plot: Robin's driving instructor is really a bank robber with a perfect getaway plan, while Raven warns the team that her demon father is coming to visit.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E03 - Driver's Ed
1.plot: Robin takes driver's ed, and his teacher has some tricks up his sleeve.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E04 - Dog Hand
1.plot: Raven's dad cozies up to her friends in hopes of luring her over to the dark side.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E05 - Double Trouble
1.plot: Cyborg has Raven create doubles of himself and Beast Boy.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E06 - The Date
1.plot: To go on a date with Starfire, Robin kidnaps Speedy.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E07 - Dude Relax!
1.plot: The gang try to teach Robin to relax after his high-strung nature begins affecting the team. Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E08 - Laundry Day
1.plot: Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E09 - Ghostboy
1.plot: Beast Boy pretends to be a ghost haunting Starfire so she will do his bidding. When she figures out the ruse, she and the other Titans convince Beast Boy that he's actually dead.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E10 - La Larva de Amor
1.plot: Robin, Cyborg, Beast Boy, and Raven agree to take on the responsibility of babysitting Silkie while Starfire is away.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E11 - Hey Pizza!
1.plot: Cyborg and Beast Boy try to capitalize on Zippy's Pizza's "thirty minutes or its free" deal, but the delivery boy is seemingly unstoppable. It becomes a bit of a challenge as an all-out war of wits between them erupts. Meanwhile, Robin struggles with whether to build a senior center or a pool (leaning toward the pool mostly to see Starfire in a bikini).

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E12 - Gorilla
1.plot: Beast Boy turns into a loud, obnoxious gorilla and refuses to change back driving Robin crazy. Gorilla Beast Boy takes over the leadership of the Titans leading to chaos ranging from not letting a girl get onto Beast Boy's monkey bars, fighting crocodiles, and freeing captive gorillas from the zoo. Cyborg teaches Robin how to be an alpha male so he can take back his role as leader of the Teen Titans.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E13 - Girl's Night Out
1.plot: When Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy won’t let Starfire and Raven come along on their "Boys' Night Out," Starfire and Raven spring Jinx from prison and the three of them have a wild night of their own.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E14 - You're Fired!
1.plot: Beast Boy's behavior causes him to be fired from the Teen Titans and replaced by a pair of shape-shifting twins.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E15 - Super Robin
1.plot: Envious of the other Titans' superpowers following their fight with the H.I.V.E. Five (consisting of Mammoth, Gizmo, Jinx, Billy Numerous, and See-More), Robin wants some of his own. After a disastrous scientific experiment goes awry that merges him with the DNA of the American Robin, he convinces Raven to use her magic to give him superpowers even though she claims that superpowers are a curse.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E16 - Tower Power
1.plot: Cyborg plugs into the control panel of the Titans tower and drives the others crazy.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E17 - Parasite
1.plot: Starfire's new pet is a horribly dangerous parasite, but Robin is the only one who is suspicious of the beast.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E18 - Starliar
1.plot: Beast Boy teaches Starfire how to lie and it backfires as her lies get more and more outrageous.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E19 - Meatball Party
1.plot: Raven eats a bad meatball that causes tentacles to spring from her teeth and devour the other Titans.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E20 - Staff Meeting
1.plot: When Robin's long bo-staff is accidentally broken by the other four Titans, he seeks a new one at the mystical Tree of the Universe.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E21 - Terra-ized
1.plot: When Beast Boy believes that Terra is his new beloved sweetheart and girlfriend, Raven is suspicious of her true motives.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E22 - Artful Dodgers
1.plot: The Titans believe they will win an upcoming dodgeball championship.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E23 - Burger vs. Burrito
1.plot: Cyborg and Beast Boy are in perfect sync, except when it comes to their taste in food. What’s the best food ever created, burgers or burritos? The two friends have an all-out competition to settle things once and for all.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E24 - Matched
1.plot: Cyborg’s Love Matcher 5000 program pairs Raven with Beast Boy and Starfire with Aquaman. While Beast Boy does everything he can to get Raven to love him, Robin tries to be more like Aquaman to win Starfire’s heart.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E25 - Colors of Raven
1.plot: A magical prism causes Raven to fragment into five distinct personalities which wreak havoc around town until the other Titans can figure out how to rejoin her.

1.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S01E26 - The Left Leg
1.plot: When the gang bands together to form a giant robot, Robin is relegated to the left leg, but he makes the left leg count!

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E01 - Mr. Butt
2.plot: Blackfire pays a surprise visit to her sister Starfire, saying she wants to spend some quality time with her. The other Titans think that Blackfire is playing another trick, but Starfire is sure that this time Blackfire is serious about reviving their sisterly love

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E02 - Man Person
2.plot: Despite the Titans' protests, Beast Boy becomes convinced that replacing his body parts with robotic limbs makes him more manly.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E03 - Pirates
2.plot: Aqualad asks Raven out on a date, which makes Beast Boy jealous. Cyborg tries to prove that Aqualad is really a pirate.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E04 - Money Grandma
2.plot: When Robin starts a smear campaign against all of the other Titans so that he can be re-elected  Team Leader, Raven uses a time machine to bring a great leader from the past to teach Robin how to lead.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E05 - I See You
2.plot: Robin brings Starfire on a fake stakeout in an attempt to get a kiss, while Cyborg and Beast Boy hold their own stakeout to discover Raven's dark secret.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E06 - Brian
2.plot: When the Brain captures the Titans to fuel Project B.R.I.A.N., the Titans' little buddies are the only heroes who can save them.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E07 - Nature
2.plot: When Beast Boy loses his ability to change into animals, he realizes that he’s lost touch with his wild side. He goes to the forest to reconnect with his inner beast, but Mother Nature isn't as great as he had hoped.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E08 - Salty Codgers
2.plot: Raven is delighted when the other Titans are magically turned into old people during a battle.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E09 - Knowledge
2.plot: Starfire wants to learn more, but will knowledge make her a bummer?

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E10 - Slumber Party
2.plot: When the other Titans find out that Cyborg is afraid of the dark, they have a slumber party to help him face his fears.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E11 - Love Monsters
2.plot: Raven warns the Titans not to go near a box containing the Twin Destroyers of Azarath. Starfire can't help it and opens the box, giving hugs and snuggles to the tiny and adorable destroyers... but love only makes the destroyers stronger. Now, the Titans must find a way to get the monsters back in the box before Raven finds out that they were released.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E12 - Baby Hands
2.plot: Robin has been hiding something under his gloves.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E13 - Caramel Apples
2.plot: Raven and Starfire clash after Starfire creates a bond with Raven's father, while Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy struggle to return to Earth's surface after falling into a deep cavern.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E14 - Sandwich Thief
2.plot: Robin's perfect sandwich is missing and he will stop at nothing to find it.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E15 - Friendship
2.plot: When Control Freak imprisons the Titans in a Pretty Pretty Pegasus world, the Titans decide to use violence to escape, while Raven decides to use friendship and happiness.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E16 - Vegetables
2.plot: When the team tries to live a vegetarian lifestyle, they learn that living that way is not for everyone.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E17 - The Mask
2.plot: Robin's mask hides both his secret identity and a horrible secret.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E18 - Serious Business
2.plot: When Robin rations bathroom time to five minutes per visit, the other Titans try to show him the magic of the bathroom.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E19 - Halloween
2.plot: Raven tries to get the other titans to enjoy Halloween again.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E20 - Boys vs Girls
2.plot: The Titans compete against each other to prove who is the better gender.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E21 - Body Adventure
2.plot: Cyborg is infected with a cold and the Titans shrink down to fight it off.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E22 - Road Trip
2.plot: Cyborg completely rebuilt the T-Car and takes it out on a road trip.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E23 - Thanksgiving
2.plot: When Raven’s father Trigon shows up for Thanksgiving dinner, Robin’s seating plan isn't the only thing that gets ruined.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E24 - The Best Robin
2.plot: Due to the Titans' laziness, Robin creates another team of himself to battle Brother Blood.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E25 - Mouth Hole
2.plot: Robin wants to gain the power of whistling.

2.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S02E26 - Hot Garbage
2.plot: The Titans try to convince Beast Boy to clean his room, but they learn that there is more to garbage than just trash.

3.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S03E01 - Cat's Fancy
3.plot: Robin is determined to become a cat in order to get Starfire's attention.

3.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S03E02 - Leg Day
3.plot: After a humiliating defeat, Raven and the Titans work on building their lower body strength, becoming the "League of Legs."

3.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S03E03 - Dignity of Teeth
3.plot: After Beast Boy gets money from the Tooth Fairy, the other Titans try to get in on the action by knocking out their own teeth.

3.title: FR - Teen Titans Go! - S03E03 - Dignity of Teeth
3.plot: After Beast Boy gets money from the Tooth Fairy, the other Titans try to get in on the action by knocking out their own teeth.

meta.plot: Après avoir été accidentellement exposé a un produit mutagène, quatre tortues sont recueillies par un rat nommé Splinter qui les élève comme ses propres enfants et leur apprend l’usage des arts martiaux. Le jour de leur 15ème anniversaire, les Tortues Ninja sont autorisés à sortir pour la 1re fois des égouts où elles ont été élevées et peuvent enfin visiter les rues de New York ! Mais la grosse pomme réserve quelques surprises à nos quatre intrépides, les ennuis ne font que commencer !

1.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S01E01 - Rise of the Turtles (1)
1.plot: For fifteen years, four mutant Turtles and their rodent sensei have lived a secret life beneath the sewers of New York. Coming to the surface for the first time, the Turtles soon find their day out interrupted as a young girl and her father become the targets of mysterious, and dangerous, men...
