4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E17 - The Insecta Trifecta
4.plot: Raphael must overcome his fear of insects to lead the team when they are forced to battle Stockman-Fly's new insect minions.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E18 - Mutant Gangland
4.plot: Don Vizioso's gang tracks the Turtles with a slew of Anti-Mutant weapons.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E19 - Bat in the Belfry
FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E20 - The Super Shredder
4.plot: For the first time, the Turtles encounter something they cannot defeat – the Super Shredder!

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E21 - Darkest Plight
4.plot: The Turtle team hunts for their Sensei, but soon realizes they are being hunted as well.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E22 - The Power Inside Her
4.plot: Donatello becomes concerned and decides to test April, only to discover that her psychic abilities are rapidly growing in power.

4.title: FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E23 - Tokka vs. the World
FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E24 - Tale of Tiger Claw
FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E25 - Requiem
FR - Les Tortues Ninja - S04E26 - Owari
4.plot: With the demise of their beloved father and Karai incapacitated, the Turtles, April, and Casey, infiltrate Super Shredder's new lair to put an end to Oroku Saki once and for all, no matter what it takes.

seasonsMeta.name: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

meta.plot: Merlin’s apprentice joins Arcadia’s heroes on a time-bending adventure in Camelot, where conflict is brewing between the human, troll and magical worlds.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E01 - Spellbound
1.plot: After pushing a broom for centuries, Merlin's apprentice, Douxie, springs into action when the great sorcerer asks him to find the Guardians of Arcadia.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E02 - History in the Making
1.plot: Douxie, Claire, Steve and Jim meet the legendary King Arthur and his sister, Morgana, in medieval Camelot — where being a troll is punishable by death.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E03 - Witch Hunt
1.plot: With the future at stake, Douxie and Claire cling to the hope that Arthur and Morgana can reconcile. Meanwhile, humans are hunting trolls in the woods.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E04 - Lady of the Lake
1.plot: Merlin leads his ragtag crew on a quest to restore Excalibur and save Camelot. Elsewhere, Jim tries to convince Blinky that they're on the same side.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E05 - Battle Royal
1.plot: Morgana takes a new title — Mother of Monsters — and vows to usher in an age of reckoning. An epic battle begins in King Arthur's court.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E06 - Killahead, Part One
1.plot: Arthur seeks an alliance with the trolls of Dwoza as Gunmar begins building his army. Merlin and Douxie join forces to forge the amulet.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E07 - Killahead, Part Two
1.plot: With the fateful battle underway, every hero must do their part to stop the Arcane Order, banish Gunmar and ensure that history plays out as it should.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E08 - Wizard Underground
1.plot: After returning to the 21st century, Jim makes a surprising sacrifice ... and a familiar face joins the fight. The Green Knight finally reveals himself.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E09 - Dragon's Den
1.plot: The race is on to find the Genesis Seals as Douxie and Archie look for clues in a notorious dragon's lair. Claire searches the shadows for Jim's soul.

1.title: FR - Mages et Sorciers : Les Contes d'Arcadia - S01E10 - Our Final Act
1.plot: The Arcane Order pushes Douxie to make an impossible choice: save his friends ... or save the planet. Which will he pick? Only time will tell.

meta.plot: After uncovering a mysterious amulet, an average teen assumes an unlikely destiny and sets out to save two worlds.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E01 - Becoming: Part 1
1.plot: As a new day dawns in Arcadia, two trolls are locked in an epic battle with major consequences for the human world -- and one human boy in particular.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E02 - Becoming: Part 2
1.plot: Still reeling from the discovery of the amulet's power, a stunned Jim meets his new mentors and learns he's been tasked with a sacred responsibility.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E03 - Wherefore Art Thou, Trollhunter?
1.plot: Jim and Toby tour Heartstone Trollmarket, where Jim begins his training and the presence of the first human Trollhunter stirs up bitter resentment.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E04 - Gnome Your Enemy
1.plot: While Jim gets a crash course in troll history, big problems -- and a bully -- await him in the human world. What better time for his first mission?

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E05 - Waka Chaka!
1.plot: Jim tries to get closer to Claire on a school field trip to the museum, only to learn that the museum's curator, Ms. Nomura, has an unsettling secret.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E06 - Win Lose or Draal
1.plot: Jim preps for a high-stakes rematch against Draal, the amulet's seemingly rightful heir. But their animosity gives way to a surprising partnership.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E07 - To Catch a Changeling
1.plot: Armed with an ancient troll-hunting tool, Jim and Toby set out to unmask the Changelings living among them. Claire makes Jim a tempting offer.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E08 - Adventures in Trollsitting
1.plot: While Draal settles into his new digs, Jim volunteers to babysit so he can find out whether Claire's little brother, Enrique, is a Changeling.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E09 - Bittersweet Sixteen
1.plot: Jim's 16th birthday is full of surprises, including the arrival of a terrifying new species of troll that's immune to the effects of sunlight.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E10 - Young Atlas
1.plot: Draal gives Jim a troll-made totem to help curb his anxiety about Claire. But Jim's newfound overconfidence leads him to a startling realization.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E11 - Recipe for Disaster
1.plot: As Claire grows increasingly suspicious, Jim's mom invites Strickler over for dinner, where the tension is so thick, you could cut it with a knife.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E12 - Claire and Present Danger
1.plot: The Killahead Bridge is complete, but the door to the Darklands still won't open. Jim is forced to tell Claire the truth when she becomes a target.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E13 - The Battle of Two Bridges
1.plot: Two fateful battles unfold when Bular and Strickler order Jim to unlock the portal and free Gunmar and his Gumm-Gumm Army from the Darklands.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E14 - Return of the Trollhunter
1.plot: Claire gets her first look at Heartstone Trollmarket, and Jim receives a ghostly summons. Elsewhere, Strickler awakens an ancient assassin.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E15 - Mudslinging
1.plot: Jim searches for a way to kill Gunmar so Claire can bring her brother back home. A power-hungry Strickler returns to Arcadia with Angor Rot.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E16 - Roaming Fees May Apply
1.plot: The heroes launch a dangerous quest to find the first Triumbric Stone. Angor Rot concocts a charm that links Strickler and Barbara's fates.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E17 - Blinky's Day Out
1.plot: A barely recognizable Blinky experiences the highs and lows of being human. Angor Rot marks Jim for a fate that's worse than death.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E18 - The Shattered King
1.plot: The heroes' search for the second Triumbric Stone takes them deep into unfamiliar marshlands. Claire asks Jim to be her dance partner.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E19 - Airheads
1.plot: Toby and Claire take on a Trollhunter task so Jim can win a Spring King challenge. In the process, they learn to master new weapons.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E20 - Where Is My Mind?
1.plot: A horde of pixies descends on Arcadia Oaks High, sending the student body into a tailspin. Angor Rot comes to Jim with a surprising proposal.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E21 - Party Monster
1.plot: The Changeling posing as Claire's little brother throws a house party for the trolls of Arcadia. Jim and Toby look for a way to take Strickler's ring.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E22 - It's About Time
1.plot: Every second counts when Jim turns to a time-stopping Kairosect to snatch Strickler's ring, save his mother and find the second Triumbric Stone.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E23 - Wingmen
1.plot: A troll queen arrives from afar to take AAARRRGGHH!!! back to his homeland, revealing his devastating secret. Strickler asks Jim for protection.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E24 - Angor Management
1.plot: A reluctant Jim joins forces with Strickler to keep Barbara alive. Gnome Chompsky returns from the Darklands with important news about Enrique.

1.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S01E25 - A Night to Remember
1.plot: With Barbara's life hanging in the balance, Jim races to break the spell that bonds her to Strickler. Angor Rot attacks Toby and Claire.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E01 - Escape from the Darklands
2.plot: With Jim still trapped in the Darklands searching for Enrique, his friends rally to bring him back. But the Troll Tribunal has other ideas.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E02 - Skullcrusher
2.plot: Claire recruits NotEnrique for a secret mission, while bully Steve stirs up trouble at school. In the Darklands, Jim meets "The Skullcrusher".

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E03 - Grand Theft Otto
2.plot: A familiar foe comes to Jim's aid in the Darklands. Back in Arcadia, Toby's distracting new headgear picks up an important clue.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E04 - KanjigAAARRRGGHH!!!
2.plot: As Gunmar readies to destroy Jim in the Darklands, Blinky and the gang strike a deal with the Janus Order in their quest to revive an old friend.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E05 - Homecoming
2.plot: Hope springs from an unlikely source when Gunmar learns that Jim's friends are in the Darklands on a mission to bring him home.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E06 - Hiss Hiss, Bang Bang
2.plot: Now out of the Darklands and readjusting to life in Arcadia, Jim and the team must face the consequences of their risky actions.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E07 - Hero with a Thousand Faces
2.plot: Multiple problems plague a frazzled Jim when his amulet goes on the fritz and Claire invites him to meet her parents at a family barbecue.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E08 - Just Add Water
2.plot: When an oozy creature shows up in Arcadia, Jim and the gang set out to find it -- while playing parents to two sacks of flour for a school assignment.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E09 - Creepslayerz
2.plot: In a revealing flashback episode, Otto and Dictatious vie for Gunmar's ear while an increasingly paranoid Steve finds an unlikely ally.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E10 - The Reckless Club
2.plot: Señor Uhl sentences Jim and his friends to detention while Queen Usurna gathers evidence of a conspiracy. Draal comes face to face with Gunmar.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E11 - Unbecoming
2.plot: Facing serious accusations from the Tribunal, Jim gets the chance to see what his life would be like if he'd never found the amulet.

2.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S02E12 - Mistrial and Error
2.plot: Jim stands trial for unleashing Gunmar while his friends race to clear his name. If convicted, he'll be sent to "The Deep", a dark realm of no return.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E01 - A Night Patroll
3.plot: With the trolls hiding out in Arcadia, AAARRRGGHH!!! goes undercover to see what Gunmar is up to. A potential rival brings out Jim's jealous side.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E02 - Arcadia's Most Wanted
3.plot: Toby gets caught in the crosshairs when a troll goes missing and the city cracks down on crime. An ancient voice refuses to be silenced.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E03 - Bad Coffee
3.plot: Something strange is brewing at school, where the teachers are more agitated than usual. Claire's illness shows disturbing side effects.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E04 - So I'm Dating a Sorceress
3.plot: Toby and Darci ask Jim and Claire on a double date. Gunmar returns from his travels, now armed with the knowledge to bring forth the Eternal Night.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E05 - The Exorcism of Claire Nunez
3.plot: While Gunmar searches for the Staff of Avalon, Jim and Toby head into the Shadow Realm to rescue Claire's spirit and return it to her body.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E06 - Parental Guidance
3.plot: When Barbara's art obsession leads to an "aha!" moment, she demands Jim tell her the truth. Dictatious reveals Gunmar's plans to resurrect Angor Rot.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E07 - The Oath
3.plot: With the future of two worlds at stake, the team races to find Merlin's Tomb -- and the Staff of Avalon -- before Gunmar can get his hands on it.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E08 - For the Glory of Merlin
3.plot: A long-dormant ally shows Jim and his friends what really happened at the Battle of Killahead. Gunmar awakens Morgana, and Angor Rot plots his revenge.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E09 - In Good Hands
3.plot: Señor Uhl interrupts an important mission with an awkward ultimatum for Jim: help two new students fit in ... or face a repeat of sophomore year.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E10 - A House Divided
3.plot: Merlin has a plan to go to war, but it's Jim's choice to make. Blinky and AAARRRGGHH!!! search for allies. Gunmar uses Barbara to get what he wants.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E11 - Jimhunters
3.plot: A greatly changed Jim renews his Trollhunter training but struggles to accept his new reality. Gunmar and Morgana rally the troops for an attack.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E12 - The Eternal Knight Pt. 1
3.plot: The Eternal Night covers Arcadia in shadow, leading to a long-awaited showdown between Gunmar and the newly transformed Trollhunter.

3.title: FR - Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia - S03E13 - The Eternal Knight Pt. 2
3.plot: An epic battle comes to a head in the darkness as Jim and his friends push back against Morgana. But without Merlin, how will they stop her?

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E01 - Esteban, Child of the Sun
1.plot: Father Rodriguez, who has looked after Esteban since he was a baby, tells him a great secret on his deathbed: somewhere his father may still be alive. So Esteban decides to begin his search in the New World. With the help of Mendoza, a mysterious man who claims to have rescued him as a baby, Esteban hides as a stowaway, aboard the Esperanza. As they are about to set sail, he meets a young Inca girl: Zia.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E02 - Crossing the Atlantic
1.plot: The two children, Esteban and Zia, find out that they both wear the same strange medallion. The Esperanza crosses the Atlantic and nears the entrance of the Straits of Magellan, where wild seas and strong winds create terrible storms. Mendoza, the navigator, prepares to spend four days and nights at the wheel.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E03 - Heroes Again
1.plot: Buffeted by a fierce wind and a wild sea, the Esperanza manages to sail through the Straits of Magellan, under Mendoza's guidance. But now, the ship faces another trial of strength: it is in the grip of a hurricane.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E04 - Adrift on the Endless Sea
1.plot: Esteban and his friends barely cross through the terrible Straits of Magellan before their ship, the Esperanza, sinks in a storm. Tossed around on a small raft and attacked by sharks, they're left in the middle of the ocean, with no provisions. But a seagull overhead guides them towards the closest shores, and they finally reach a small island.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E05 - The Abduction of Zia
1.plot: After a dangerous journey, Esteban and his friends are washed up on a mysterious island. That night, a shadowy figure comes creeping towards them. Silently, the figure steals a chart and a pistol, then snatches up Zia. Esteban gives chase. He discovers a curious house in a tree, where Zia is a prisoner. To Esteban's surprise, the mysterious shadow turns out to be a friendly boy of his own age, called Tao.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E06 - The Ship Solaris
1.plot: On a small island among the Galapagos, Esteban and Zia find a young boy living all alone: Tao. His ancestors left a magnificent ship, the Solaris, which contains their ancient secret knowledge, hidden in a temple on the island. Esteban and Zia want to use the ship to reach the mainland.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E07 - Secret of the Solaris
1.plot: Gomez' Spanish galleon overtakes and attacks the Solaris, the sun-powered ship on which the children are travelling. They manage to outrun the Spanish ship when Tao discovers a wonderful secret solar power boost, just in time. At last, they reach the new continent.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E08 - The New Continent
1.plot: After many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally set foot on the new continent. But there, they meet the soldiers of Governor Pizarro, men who think only of gold. They capture Zia and try to make her tell them the way to the Cities of Gold, but Tao and Esteban help her to escape.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E09 - The End of the Solaris
1.plot: Esteban and his companions escape from Pizarro, but their fabulous ship, the Solaris, is taken by Gaspard and Gomez. They offer to exchange the ship for Zia, and her secret. Trying to save Zia, and the friendly Inca people in the village, Tao blows up Gomez's ship, but sadly the Solaris is also destroyed.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E10 - Secret of the Temple
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are on their way to Zia's village, when they are surrounded by Spanish soldiers. The children manage to escape, and take refuge in an underground temple, where they meet the old priest, Pasha. To help them escape, the priest melts the pillar of ice that supports the temple roof, and it crashes down on top of him. The others just manage to get away.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E11 - Messengers of the Region
1.plot: Gomez captures the children and forces Zia to reveal the secret of the Golden Quipu. It is an Inca message which reveals that the Cities of Gold lie beyond the High Mountain Peak. In the night, Esteban and the children escape. They find a secret underground passage and set off for the High Peak.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E12 - Secret of the Medallions
1.plot: The Spanish army follow Esteban and his friends to the Fort of the Black Eagle. Under cover of darkness, the Spaniards attack the fort, but Tao devises a rocket flare that repels the attackers, saving the fort. The three children leave the fort and at last reach the City of the High Peak, whose chief, Kraka, tells them that the medallions Esteban and Zia wear can open the doors of Sela, one of the Cities of Gold.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E13 - Mystery of the Parents
1.plot: When Esteban arrives at the place called the High Peak, he meets an old man, Mayuka, who seems to know something about his parents.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E14 - Esteban's Medallions
1.plot: Mendoza steals the Spanish army's cannon in order to win the trust of the Indians, but his plan fails. As the three Spaniards are about to be executed, Esteban comes to save them. But he demands that Mendoza give him back the sun section of his gold medallion.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E15 - The Subterranean Secret
1.plot: Gomez and his soldiers attack the Fort of the Black Eagle to try to recapture the cannon Mendoza had stolen. Mendoza uses the cannon to fight back, but cannot stop the Spanish army who storm the fort and drive the Incas out. Esteban, Tao and Zia run away towards the High Peak, following secret underground passages constructed by the Incas.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E16 - The Urubus
1.plot: Searching for the Cities of Gold, Esteban and his friends cross a high plateau up in the Andes. Near Lake Titicaca, they are attacked by the Urubus, a tribe of giants. Tao invents a submarine, and they capture Karuga, chief of the tribe, and hold him prisoner. Karuga tells them that there's a City of Gold on a mountain, guarded by the earth goddess, Pachamama.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E17 - The Great Condor
1.plot: The setting sunlight leads Esteban and his friends to the statue of the earth goddess, Pachamama. The legend goes that when Pachamama takes the sun in her arms, the Gates to the Cities of Gold will open. Estaban and Zia place their medallions in the statue and the mountain opens up to reveal the first City of Gold. Inside they discover a great bird, made of solid gold.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E18 - Maiden Flight of the Condor
1.plot: Inside the first City of Gold, Esteban finds a great Golden Condor. When the volcano on which the Cities are built begins to erupt, the Cities are destroyed. Sheltering inside the body of the Condor, they try to make its mechanism work, using the Medallion of the Sun. Suddenly, the giant bird spreads its wings and takes flight.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E19 - The Nasca Plateau
1.plot: The great Golden Condor, carrying Esteban and his friends away from Pachamama and the erupting volcano, lands in the desert at Nazca. But when Pizarro and his soldiers arrive, Esteban makes sure everyone escapes.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E20 - The Spaniards' Cannon
1.plot: The Golden Condor carries Esteban and his companions to the High Peak, where they encounter the Spanish forces, armed with their cannon. With the help of the Golden Condor, they stop Gomez and Gaspard. And when they had saved their friends, they leave the High Peak, in search of the land of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E21 - The Amazons
1.plot: The group head for the land of the Mayas, on board the Golden Condor, when they are forced to land in the jungle. They are captured by Amazon warriors and taken to their temple, to be sacrificed to the Rain God. But Esteban uses his special powers, and the sun comes out. The Queen is so impressed by his power to command the sun, that she orders their release.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E22 - The Mirror of the Moon
1.plot: Esteban and his friends on board the Golden Condor have to make a forced landing in the jungle, where they're captured by Amazon warriors who want to sacrifice them to their Rain God. After some difficulties, they manage to escape from this dangerous situation. And in the end, the Queen of the Amazons allows them to leave for the land of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E23 - The Jade Mask
1.plot: In the jungle, Esteban and his friends discover some ruins, deserted temples and pyramids. In one of the temples, Pedro and Sancho try to remove a jade mask from the wall when the mask begins to glow. Suddenly the stone beams shoot out of the walls, ceiling and floor and trip them up.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E24 - The Manuscript
1.plot: After solving the secret of the green jade mask, Esteban and his friends find a manuscript which seems to hold the key to the whereabouts of the Cities of Gold. But almost immediately, they are captured by Doctor Fernando Laguerra and his friend, Marinche, who are also searching for the Cities of Gold. However, Kokapetl manages to rescue them all.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E25 - The Lake of Gold
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are captured by Indians who wanted to sacrifice them to purify their sacred lake of gold. Marinche and Doctor Laguerra try to poison the lake so they could get at all the treasure on the bottom. Mendoza foils their plan by breaking through the dam, flooding the village and allowing the children to escape.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E26 - The Swamps
1.plot: The Serpent God of the Mayas was said to have crossed the mountains to build a new city in the east, among the swamps of the Rain God. Setting out to find this second city, Esteban and his friends are tricked by Marinche, and find themselves fighting the alligators in the marshes. After a savage battle, they escape to the other side of the swamp.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E27 - The Doors of Night
1.plot: Esteban and his friends find the second City of Gold, but they are captured by Marinche and the Doctor. The Doctor finds a new manuscript, but is caught in a trap set into the floor of the temple. The children get the manuscript which tells of a third city, to be found near a forest of statues.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E28 - The Forest of Statues
1.plot: After much travelling and many adventures, Esteban and his friends finally discover the third temple built deep inside an enormous cave. A golden statue is holding a third manuscript which mentions a mountain known as "The Burning Shield".

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E29 - The Burning Shield
1.plot: Having found the Burning Shield, Esteban and his friends fall into the hands of the mysterious Olmecs, who possess very advanced technology. They escape from them, but are captured again. So what will happen to them now?

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E30 - The Escape
1.plot: Using their advanced technology, the Olmecs are able to collect energy from the heat of the sun, and from deep inside the Earth. They capture Esteban, Tao and Zia, intent on transplanting their cells to regenerate their elders, so they can become young again. With Mendoza's help, the children manage to escape.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E31 - The Village of the New Sun
1.plot: Esteban and his friends are guests at the Village of the New Sun. But the Olmecs have found the Golden Condor, and prepare to attack the village, with the help of the Doctor and Marinche, who mean to steal the great golden bird for themselves. Meanwhile, Myena discovers that Papacamayo, the old chief, is really Zia's father.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E32 - Attack of the Olmecs
1.plot: With the help of Gomez and Gaspard, Esteban and his friends succeed in getting the Golden Condor to fly. But the Olmecs find the Indian Village of the New Sun, and mount a fierce attack. With the help of the Golden Condor, they are defeated. But Zia's father, Papacamayo, has been seriously wounded.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E33 - The Reunion
1.plot: In the Indian Village of the New Sun, Zia at last finds her father, Papacamayo. But her happiness is short-lived, when he dies from his wounds, after defending the village against an attack by the Olmecs. All the Mayan tribes unite to fight against the Olmecs.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E34 - Revolt of the Mayas
1.plot: The Mayan people arm themselves and attack the Olmecs, who have been tyrannising them for years. A fierce battle takes place near the entrance to the Olmec base. From the Golden Condor, Esteban and the other children bombard the Olmecs with stones, turning the tide of the battle in favour of the Mayas.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E35 - The Olmec Machine
1.plot: Esteban and his friends manage to find their way into the Olmec base. But Kalmec discovers them, and takes Zia prisoner. Suddenly, a gigantic war machine rushes up from deep inside the Olmec underground temple.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E36 - Aerial Pursuit
1.plot: Esteban flies the Golden Condor against the terrible Olmec war machine, to try to rescue Zia. Tao and Esteban manage to leap onto the machine in mid-air, and Zia is saved. But Tao is left behind, a prisoner.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E37 - The City of Gold
1.plot: With Tao as a hostage, the Olmecs force Esteban and Zia to use their medallions to open the doors to the City of Gold.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E38 - The Great Legacy
1.plot: After wounding the High Priest of the Cities of Gold, Kalmec steals the Great Treasure, a concentrated source of the sun's power also called the Sun Power Unit. However, the security systems of the City are activated and destroy the Olmecs' flying machine. Kalmec and Menator make their way back to their base, taking the Great Treasure with them.

1.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S01E39 - End of the City of Gold
1.plot: The Olmecs place the Sun Power Unit at the bottom of their sunlight collecting crystal and activate it. However, the unit does not behave as expected and the Sun Power Unit begins to overheat. The High Priest of the Cities of Gold, who turns out to be Esteban's father, tries to shut it down using Tao's jar which is actually a control unit. But he could be too late.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E01 - Back in Barcelona (1)
2.plot: Six months after their adventures in South America, Esteban, Zia and all the team are back in Barcelona. There, the mysterious Zarès put in jail Mendoza, Sancho and Pedro. But Esteban, Zia and Tao will succeed to help them to escape.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E02 - Back in Barcelona (2)
2.plot: Esteban has disappeared the morning after Mendoza told him the truth about his father. Thanks to Pichu, his friends follow his traces to find him.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E03 - The Secret of the Drum
2.plot: After a long journey, our heroes arrive in the south of China and settle in the region of Guilin. Here, they make the acquaintance of a young Chinese boy called Zhi and his Panda, Yang-Yang who welcome them to their village during the ceremony of the Dragon.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E04 - In the Hands of Pirates
2.plot: Our heroes try to escape the pirates but Esteban and Tao are captured and taken to the pirate camp.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E05 - The Alchemist
2.plot: Will our heroes be able to escape the jaws of Pang-Li's alligator?

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E06 - All Aboard!
2.plot: The pirates attack Ambrosius' ship that transforms itself into an incredible flying Nave!

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E07 - Shaolin
2.plot: On the way to Peking, our heroes find refuge in a Shaolin temple. Mendoza, hurt during a fight, is taken care of by the Great Master. At nightfall, someone sneaks in to leave a venomous snake.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E08 - Treason
2.plot: Our heroes discover that the monk, Tian Li, is able to decipher ancient Chinese similar to that on Ambrosius' book. Tao and Esteban set off to go get the precious text in The Condor.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E09 - The Prophecy
2.plot: After thwarting the attack of The Red Scarves and discovering the treachery of Bao Xing-Ji, our heroes take off for Peking. They must find Ambrosius and get on to the trail of The Yellow Dragon.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E10 - The Black Pearl
2.plot: Learning where the yellow dragon can be found, Mendoza and Ambrosius go off in search of a temple. Meanwhile, the children meet with Mei Li, a young Chinese girl who shows them around Peking.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E11 - In Search of the Yellow Dragon
2.plot: Thanks to Yu Chunhe, the high priest of the Taoist temple, our heroes find the famous Yellow Dragon. Unfortunately, a man who has been spying on them since their arrival, steals the precious Dragon.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E12 - In the Forbidden City
2.plot: While pursuing the man who stole the Yellow Dragon, Esteban finds himself stuck inside the Forbidden City and must pass himself off as the Imperial Prince!

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E13 - Like a Prince
2.plot: Hiding in the Imperial Palace, Esteban finally manages to recover the Yellow Dragon. Tao and Ambrosius concoct a Plan B to help him escape from the Forbidden City.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E14 - The Escape
2.plot: Esteban flees the Forbidden City with the Yellow Dragon thanks to the help of his friends aboard the ship of Ambrosius.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E15 - The Stomach of Buddha
2.plot: While in search of Li Shuang, a friend of Esteban's father, our heroes are separated in a violent sandstorm: Zia is taken away by a young Mongol, Esteban and Tao are imprisoned by Chinese guards.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E16 - The Labyrinth
2.plot: Li Shuang leads our heroes into a secret passage to the Stomach of Buddha. Thanks to their medallions, Esteban and Zia discover an incredible metal labyrinth, whose walls are closing in on them.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E17 - The Sleeping Garden
2.plot: Inside the Stomach of Buddha our young heroes discover an extraordinary lab in which the Yellow Dragon has been charged with energy. While rescuing Tao from a crater, Esteban gets stung by a scorpion.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E18 - The Son of the Sun
2.plot: Stuck inside the Stomach of Buddha, Zia has saved Esteban who was stung by a scorpion. Meanwhile, the grown ups, guided by Ambrosius' compass, explode a hole into the ground to help them escape.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E19 - The Oasis
2.plot: The Pyramid of Mu has put our heroes on to the trail of a fresco depicting The Eyes That See All, near an oasis in the desert. But Zares is there too, and attempts to do away with Mendoza.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E20 - The Fresco of the Evil Eyes
2.plot: While searching for The Eyes That See All in the ruins of a cursed temple, our heroes are attacked by Zares who lashes out on Mendoza, Sancho, and Pedro.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E21 - The Separation
2.plot: After Ambrosius set them free, our heroes learn that the fresco is a copy of The Eyes That See All located in Tibet.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E22 - The Fire of the Dragon
2.plot: At the location of The Eyes That See All, the Yellow Dragon ignited a path of fire to the top of a Himalayan mountain. Back on the ship, Ambrosius and the children notice somebody has come onboard.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E23 - The Expedition
2.plot: In the Himalayas, our heroes discover a frozen Olmec holding a strange map. They meet Lian Li again, who has come to forewarn them of a great danger.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E24 - The Nest of the Condor
2.plot: Our young heroes and Ambrosius have managed to enter the second City of Gold. Esteban and Zia receive a message delivered by holograms of The Sages of Mu and Atlantis.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E25 - The Revelation
2.plot: Our heroes have escaped The City as it was closing in upon itself. So has Ambrosius, who has stolen a matrix of olishark from the City of Gold.

2.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S02E26 - Face To Face
2.plot: Back in the village, the children happily reunite with Ambrosius. Mendoza reveals to Esteban that his father is alive and waiting for him. Esteban meets with his father, but their reunion is cut short.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E01 - Kagoshima
3.plot: After leaving China under the threat of Zares, our heroes finally arrive in Japan. They must absolutely find there the third City of Gold against which the infamous Zarès promises to release Athanaos, the father of Esteban.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E02 - The Daimyo Shimadzu
3.plot: The one who attacks Esteban, Tao and Zia is Yoshi, an old man who keeps fiercely the impressive Orichalcum sphere. Yoshi reveals to the children that it is a utsuro bune, a sacred object, rejected by the sea thousands of years ago and revered since as a gift of the gods.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E03 - The Golden Bird
3.plot: Using his gift to make the sun reappear, Esteban allows Zia to take off the Condor. Under the astonished eyes of Yoshi, the immense golden bird finally emerges from the waves. Mendoza, Sancho and Pedro manage to escape from the castle.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E04 - The Anger Of Nao No Kami
3.plot: Near the temple of Izumo, the children succeed in extracting Esteban from the water, but attract the attention of one of the guards who go after them. Within the walls of the temple, our heroes finally see the mirror shield out for the parade, but an earthquake creates panic!

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E05 - The Mirror-Shield
3.plot: Inside the temple, the shield-mirror leaves the children perplexed: according to the silhouette in the utsuro bune, it is the path and the key to the next golden city. They realize then that the ornaments of the mirror represent a volcano, off Kagoshima. Will the city be underneath?

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E06 - The Return Of Zares
3.plot: At night, as Ichiro goes to take his guard duty at the castle, Esteban follows him and tries to convince him to help him to escape Mendoza and his men. Ichiro refuses, reminding Esteban how his presence and those of his friends already endangers his whole family.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E07 - The Sword of the Samurai
3.plot: Mendoza and his men takes control of the nave and makes the prisoners Gaspard and Ambrosius. They spot the Condor and rediscover the children who introduce Yoshi and his family.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E08 - Unmasked
3.plot: Mendoza narrowly escapes the attack of Ambrosius. The latter claims that it was Mendoza who assaulted him, but he loses his compass, which Esteban picks up and tends to him by reflex.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E09 - The Thallios
3.plot: In the center of the cave, at the top of a pyramid, our heroes discover a sphere of orichalque floating on a lake. Attacked by thousands of giant crabs, they manage to take refuge inside.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E10 - Sundagatt
3.plot: In the treasure chamber of the Golden City, the crowns found by our heroes allow the wearer to control the orichalc cubes by thought. As he goes to look for Tao in the Thallios to show him their discovery, Estéban passes by the statue: he seizes the crystal pearl.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E11 - The Shadows of the Jungle
3.plot: Zarès managed to escape with the crown and the crystal pearl. Aboard the Condor, Esteban explains his plan to his friends. He arranged for Zarès to take the crystal pearl that had guided the Thallios to the golden city.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E12 - The Memorial Temple
3.plot: The mysterious pursuers turn out to be children whose parents were abducted by the men of Ambrosius to work forcibly at the Fort of Pattala. When they learn that our heroes are not friends of Ambrosius and that Esteban's father is also a prisoner, they decide to unite their strength to deliver them all.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E13 - Laguerra
3.plot: At the fort of Pattala, Esteban was spotted by Ambrosius. When escaping, he sees his father in a cell but must flee because he is persecuted by Laguerra, the right arm of Ambrosius, and the guards of the palace.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E14 - The Order of the Hourglass
3.plot: Tao is now in the hands of Ambrosius. The latter tries to return to his good graces, but Tao sees him as a traitor and refuses to give him his confidence. However, Tao discovers the laboratory of Ambrosius and is impressed by all that it reveals to him.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E15 - Ambrosius' Secret
3.plot: According to the plans of Ambrosius, Laguerra and the soldiers find only a deserted village. Laguerra spotted the children hidden in the trees. She hesitates, but does not denounce them and leaves without saying anything with her men in direction of the fort.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E16 - The Black Suns
3.plot: While in the village, the children try to repair the Condor, Pichu sent by Tao finds them and deliver them a message from Atanaos. He reveals that the Rajah was drugged by Ambrosius.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E17 - Free!
3.plot: The fort is taken by assault from all sides: the villagers, Tao and Atanaos are freed. Esteban manages to inject the antidote to the Raja who regains his spirits and realizes the betrayal of Ambrosius. To escape the soldiers of the Rajah, Ambrosius uses the black suns that trigger a fire in the fort.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E18 - Hormuz
3.plot: Esteban spends his own time with his father Athanaos finally found. This one reveals to him well to know Ambrosius, to have been his friend when they were young. For their part, Zia and Tao discover in the Memory Temple a key clue in the search for the fourth golden city.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E19 - A New Beginning
3.plot: Our heroes are surrounded by a troop of Bedouins. Their intrigued chief observed the medallion and then returned it to Zia apologizing for the young thief: a Bedouin never flies. When the children leave, he asks the young boy to follow them to find out what they are doing in Ormuz.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E20 - The Mountain of the Moon
3.plot: On board the condor, Esteban is worried about what happened to Mendoza and his men, but his friends remind him that Mendoza is resourceful and their priority is to prevent Ambrosius from appropriating the muen knowledge and make it Weapons of war like the black suns.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E21 - Up Is The Way Down
3.plot: The children finally managed to penetrate inside the ziggurat. They start their descent in search of the sacred sails of Princess Rana'Ori in the bowels of the pyramid, where, according to the inscription discovered in India, they should be found.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E22 - The Lord of the Desert
3.plot: Zarès aided by Laguerra captures the children and pushes them towards the exit, revealing to them that he possesses, anyway, another track towards the fourth city of gold. They just need them and their medallions to open it.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E23 - The Veils Of Rana'Ori
3.plot: In the desert, the suspected noises heard are produced by none other than Sancho and Pedro lost in the dunes. They finally found their friend Mendoza. In Manfuha, the children try to leave the oasis to reach the Condor, but the compass they steal from Zarès detects something.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E24 - The Chaldean Desert
3.plot: The children reach Condor thanks to Laguerra who confronts the soldiers alone at the risk of his life. Despite the reluctance of Tao, our heroes return to collect it and make it climb aboard. Under the fire of the defensive guns of the fort, they managed with the Condor to recover the box containing the sails.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E25 - The Serpent and the Lion
3.plot: The Bedouin chief presents to the children the second veil they were looking for, transmitted from generation to generation by the Chaldis tribe. They try to read a plan to the city of gold, but the sails do not reveal anything.

3.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S03E26 - Kumlar
3.plot: On board the nave, Laguerra prevented Gaspard from killing Mendoza, arguing that Mendoza would be more useful to their living plan than dead. The children enter the city in search of the tomb of Princess Rana'Ori, but the sumptuous city seems deserted.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E01 - Lalibela
4.plot: After Arabia, our heroes set course for Africa. In pursuit of Ambrosius, the climb Lalibela, in Ethiopia. There, Esteban and Tao explore a church whose walls are covered with religious murals. To their shock, one of them depicts the pyramid of Mu being carries in a procession! But the church hides something else: a strange machine from Mu. Convinced this machine will provide them with a clue leading to the next city of gold, Tao is hesitant to leave, against the advice of Esteban who suspects a trap laid by Ambrosius. Rightly so...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E02 - Zia's Dream
4.plot: At Lalibela, Zia uses all her mental energy to create a force field and free Esteban and Tao from the rubble of the church. As night falls, Zia has a strange, piercing dream, plunging her into an incredible vision of an African mask leading her to a city of gold.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E03 - Chained Up
4.plot: Arriving at the city of Kilwa, out heroes split up to find the famous Cinza. While exploring the city, they discover the sad reality of the slave markets. Moved, Zia convinces Mendoza to help them free the captives.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E04 - The Great Escape
4.plot: After having proposed to Esteban that they join forces to find the fifth city of gold, the deceitful Gomez sends his men to capture our heroes. But only Mendoza and Esteban fall into their hands. So the others are able to execute their plan to help free the captives at Kilwa threatened with being sold into slavery. Finally, Mendoza fights Gomez in a duel while Esteban steals the map leading to the city of gold. Meanwhile, Ambrosius heads for a secret base where a surprising welcoming committee awaits him...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E05 - The Gate of the Ancients
4.plot: Guided by the map stolen from Gomez, our heroes are flying over the city of Zimbabwe when, believing they have been beaten by Ambrosius, Esteban crashes. The children are taken to the palace gardens of the king Neshangwe. Seeing Zia's medallion, the king shows them "The Gate of the Ancients", a very old orichalcum arch. Thanks to their medallions, our young heroes pass through the mysterious arch which teleports them to Francis I, the king of France, in his castle at Chambord...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E06 - The Founder
4.plot: Teleported to Chambord thanks to the gate of the ancients, Zia and Esteban are welcomed by the king of France, meanwhile Tao makes the acquaintance of Nostradamus in the workshop of the founder of the Order of the Hourglass, the late Leonardo da Vinci. Back in Zimbabwe, the two sailors discover some hidden gold and Mendoza speaks with Laguerra, imprisoned on the ship by Ambrosius.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E07 - The Bellowing Smoke
4.plot: Thanks to the clue in the base of the pyramid of My they found in Chambord, our heroes discover the location of the fifth city of gold. But Tao, full of doubt, decides to remain in Chambord to think and find himself, rather than leaving with his friends. So, without him, the Golden Condor takes off in pursuit of Ambrosius. Once again, he has a large head-start. Unfortunately for the alchemist and his companions, the city's defences prove remarkably sturdy...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E08 - Ophir
4.plot: Having rid themselves of the threat of Magon the Olmec, the children are hot on the heels of Ambrosius who has opened the city of Ophir thanks to his medallion. A bitter fight for the city's treasure begins: the stone of Ophir, also known as the philosopher's stone. Meanwhile in Chambord, Nostradamus shows Tao the treasure of Chambord: a double-helix staircase designed by his master Leonardo da Vinci. But what secret does it hide?

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E09 - The Eternity Stone
4.plot: The fifth city of gold is swallowed up as our heroes confront Ambrosius for the Stone of Ophir. A great maelstrom consumes the city and all are swept away. Carried by the flood, they are strewn here and there, all over the banks of the river. While Esteban helps the Olmec Tyrias, Zia is forced to rescue the Eternity Stone from the grip of Ambrosius. Alas, in vain...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E10 - The Smiling Lady
4.plot: Chasing a young boy, who has kidnapped Pichu, back to his village, Esteban and Zia find Mendoza and the sailors safe and sound. Meanwhile, Ambrosius heads for the Olmec base to repair his ship, sabotaged by Magon.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E11 - The Bako
4.plot: En route to Kilwa, Zia finds a stowaway in the hold of the Golden Condor: Temba, still looking for a great feat to accomplish. With his help our hero retrieves the Bako, a sacred mask stolen by Gomez. Placing it over her face, Zia has another vision in which Tao is in great danger. Despite this however, Tao is safe and sound in Chambord where he too has made some discoveries: according to the clues left behind by Leonardo da Vinci, the seventh city of gold does not exist. It is up to them to build it!

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E12 - Farewell, Master!
4.plot: In the Lenje village, Zia, Tao and young Temba are welcomed with great fanfare. Impressed by Zia and her link to the sacred mask, the matriarch confirms that she is the one who must take the Bako back to the place where it was made, the mythical city of Orunigi.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E13 - The Night of Masks
4.plot: After Ambrosius's disappearance, Laguerra and Gaspard are almost killed in the volcanic fault. They manage to escape but the heavily damaged flying ship crashes shortly thereafter. Meanwhile out heroes follow the path of the Bako to the mythical city of Orunigi where, according to the legend, the sacred mask was made.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E14 - The Cliff of Spirits
4.plot: The Leopard-men set fire to the village to create a distraction enabling them to kidnap Zia along with the sacred mask. Out heroes learn that she is being held by the powerful sorceror N'Deye, in the city of Tellem, abandoned for centuries at the foot of the Bandiagara escarpment. Jealous of the link between Zia and the Bako, the sorceror tries to force her secret from her. But, faced with his prisoner's silence, N'Deye has her taken to one of the caves in the Cliff of Spirits. While at the top of the cliff, Esteban and Tao attempt to climb down and save their friend, Zia explores the caves to try to find another exit.

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E15 - The Sorcerer
4.plot: Esteban and Tao find Zia in the caves of the Cliff of Spirits where the sorcerer N'Deye has imprisoned her. Together, our heroes explore the depths of the cliff and find a secret gallery where the statues grouped around Princess Rana'Ori reveal to them the location of the sixth city of gold. Meanwhile, Mendoza, Pedro and Sancho attack the sorceror and his Leopard-men to retrieve the precious Bako. Reunited once again, Esteban and his companions set out for the city of gold. But while using the sacred mask again, Zia unleashes a terrible storm...

4.title: FR - The Mysterious Cities of Gold - S04E16 - Orunigi
4.plot: Caught in a lightning storm, the Golden Condor crashes into the impenetrable forest of the Congo. There, our heroes are met by the guardians of this place, gorillas who escort them to the heart of their kingdom, next to a seemingly bottomless chasm. The Bako then guides Esteban, Zia and Tao to its home: Orunigi, the sixth city of gold, which to the children's great joy, opens to them. At the peak of this incredible tree-city, they find princess Rana'Ori who finally reveals to them the true goal of their mission: use the great heritage of Mu and Atlantis to prevent a great cataclysm which could destroy humanity!

1.title: FR - Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures - S01E07 - Picture Perfect Cake

Follow Babs and Buster Bunny, Sweetie Bird, Hamton J. Pig, and Plucky Duck as they learn what it takes to be a professional toon.

1.title: FR - Tiny Toons Looniversity - S01E01 - Freshman Orientoontion
1.plot: It's the first day of school at Acme Looniversity. Babs and Buster Bunny meet their new friends, Sweetie Bird, Hamton J. Pig, and Plucky Duck.

1.title: FR - Tiny Toons Looniversity - S01E02 - Give Pizza a Chance
1.plot: Rivals Buster and Plucky decide to throw an epic pizza party and are shocked to find out they're actually getting along while Babs and Sweetie get into their first roommate disagreement.

1.title: FR - Tiny Toons Looniversity - S01E03 - Extra, So Extra
1.plot: Babs realizes Acme Loo's school paper has closed so she starts a new one with her pal Sweetie. But when Plucky starts a gossipy tabloid to compete against them, which paper will come out on top?

1.title: FR - Tiny Toons Looniversity - S01E04 - Tooney Ball Lights
1.plot: Buster and Sweetie join the Tooney Ball team during Electives Week while Babs and Plucky tackle the basics in Anvils 101, leaving Hamton on a journey to fix his indecisiveness.

1.title: FR - Tiny Toons Looniversity - S01E05 - Save the Loo Bru
1.plot: Buster meets his nemesis, Montana Max, and must apply a new lesson from Bugs about drag to keep the Loo Bru from demolition.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E01 - Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
1.plot: Homer's Christmas bonus is canceled and the rainy-day funds are needed to pay for Bart's tattoo removal.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E02 - Bart the Genius
1.plot: Bart's labeled a genius and sent to a school for the gifted.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E03 - Homer's Odyssey
1.plot: After being fired from the nuclear power plant for negligence, Homer becomes a safety activist.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E04 - There's No Disgrace Like Home
1.plot: After seeing families being nice to each other at a company picnic, Homer orders the Simpsons to a family therapist.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E05 - Bart the General
1.plot: Terrorized by the school bully, Bart seeks counsel from Grandpa Simpson, who takes him to a warfare expert for basic training.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E06 - Moaning Lisa
1.plot: The meaning of life and second grade have Lisa playing the blues solo--until she jams with a kindred spirit; Homer seeks tutelage to beat Bart at video boxing.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E07 - The Call of the Simpsons
1.plot: The Simpsons put the wild back in the wilderness when their RV goes over a cliff and Homer and Bart go for help, get lost and lose their clothes.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E08 - The Telltale Head
1.plot: Bart pulls a stunt that shocks the entire town, including the new friends he was trying to impress.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E09 - Life on the Fast Lane
1.plot: Homer's bowling-ball gift "for Marge" prompts her to take up the sport--and maybe also a handsome instructor who offers to teach her "many things."

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E10 - Homer's Night Out
1.plot: Shutterbug Bart captures Homer with a sexy entertainer at a bachelor party.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E11 - The Crepes of Wrath
1.plot: A little story about how Bart saves France after blowing up Principal Skinner's mom with a cherry bomb.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E12 - Krusty Gets Busted
1.plot: Bart's TV hero Krusty the Clown is arrested for a convenience-store robbery, and witness Homer must testify against the clown.

1.title: FR - Les Simpson - S01E13 - Some Enchanted Evening
1.plot: Homer takes Marge out for a romantic night, leaving the kids with a sitter--who's profiled on "America's Most Armed and Dangerous."

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E01 - Bart Gets an 'F'
2.plot: Bart fails four consecutive history exams and the school psychiatrist recommends that Bart repeat the fourth grade.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E02 - Simpson and Delilah
2.plot: Homer uses his medical insurance to buy Dimoxinil, a miracle hair-growth formula. After growing luxurious locks, he's given a promotion which allows him to hire a secretary named Karl and makes grand promises to his family at home.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E03 - Treehouse of Horror
2.plot: The Simpson kids hide in the family treehouse and tell each other spooky stories. The first regards haunted houses, the second introduces Kang and Kodos for the first time in an alien abduction, and the third is a Simpson-adapted retelling of The Raven.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E04 - Two Cars in Every Garage and Three Eyes on Every Fish
2.plot: Bart catches a three-eyed fish in a river downstream of the Nuclear Power Plant. This causes the plant to become inspected, and in order to prevent it from being shut down, Mr. Burns decides to run for governor. After a hard campaign which sees Burns rise from being universally despised to running neck and neck with popular incumbent Mary Bailey, it is decided that Burns will have dinner with a random employee the night before the election. Homer is chosen, much to Marge's chagrin.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E05 - Dancin' Homer
2.plot: Homer fires up the crowd at a Springfield Isotopes baseball game and is chosen to be the team's new mascot. He immediately becomes a popular attraction and the Isotopes start a winning streak. As a result, Homer is promoted to a team in Capital City, the Capital City Capitals.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E06 - Dead Putting Society
2.plot: Bart and Todd Flanders decide to enter a miniature golf tournament. Homer becomes confident that Bart will win and makes a bet with Ned that the father of the boy that does not win will have to mow their neighbors lawn in their wife's Sunday dress.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E07 - Bart vs. Thanksgiving
2.plot: Lisa makes a table centerpiece for the Thanksgiving dinner, which Bart accidentally destroys. After he is sent to his room by his parents, Bart angrily runs away from home and experiences a very different kind of Thanksgiving holiday.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E08 - Bart the Daredevil
2.plot: The Simpsons go to a Monster truck rally that features famous daredevil Lance Murdock. Bart immediately becomes enamored and decides that he wants to become a daredevil as well. His first stunt ends in injury, but to gain the respect of his friends, he promises a far more impressive feat to them: to jump the Springfield Gorge.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E09 - Itchy & Scratchy & Marge
2.plot: Maggie attacks Homer with a mallet after seeing it on Itchy & Scratchy. Marge begins a protest outside the production offices, demanding the show be retooled to prevent further violence.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E10 - Bart Gets Hit by a Car
2.plot: After Mr. Burns hits Bart with his car, ambulance-chasing attorney Lionel Hutz persuades Homer and Marge to sue for a million dollars.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E11 - One Fish, Two Fish, Blowfish, Blue Fish
2.plot: After eating poisonous blowfish at a sushi restaurant, Homer decides to live life to the fullest in the 24 hours he has left to live.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E12 - The Way We Was
2.plot: When the TV breaks, Marge and Homer entertain the kids with the story of how they first met.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E13 - Homer vs. Lisa and the 8th Commandment
2.plot: Homer becomes the most popular guy in town when he gets an illegal cable hook-up, but Lisa fears he will go to hell for violating the Eighth Commandment.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E14 - Principal Charming
2.plot: When Marge begs Homer to find Selma a husband, he sets her up with Principal Skinner... who falls in love with Patty instead.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E15 - Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
2.plot: Homer's long-lost half-brother is the CEO of a car company that's wildly successful... until he hires Homer to help design a car for the average man.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E16 - Bart's Dog Gets an 'F'
2.plot: After a series of destructive acts, Homer decides that Santa's Little Helper must go unless he passes obedience school. As the dog's last hours with the family approach, Bart must find a way to get through to him.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E17 - Old Money
2.plot: When Grandpa's new girlfriend at the Springfield Retirement Castle dies, he inherits her savings and must decide the best way to spend his windfall.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E18 - Brush with Greatness
2.plot: Marge rediscovers her interest in art and takes up painting. When Mr. Burns hires her to paint his official portrait, Marge tries but fails to find his "inner beauty."

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E19 - Lisa's Substitute
2.plot: With Miss Hoover out sick, a substitute teacher takes the class and becomes an inspiring role model for Lisa.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E20 - The War of the Simpsons
2.plot: At a lakeside retreat for married couples, Marge is determined to fix her marriage with Homer, but Homer is more determined to catch General Sherman, the freakishly large catfish that lives in the lake.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E21 - Three Men and a Comic Book
2.plot: Bart, Milhouse, and Martin pool their money to buy the new first issue of Radioactive Man, but their investment and their friendship are threatened when they can't agree on who will keep it.

2.title: FR - Les Simpson - S02E22 - Blood Feud
2.plot: When Mr. Burns is saved by a transfusion of Bart's blood, Homer expects a handsome reward but is outraged to receive only a simple thank-you note.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E01 - Stark Raving Dad
3.plot: A deviation from his norm lands Homer in a mental institution, where he shares a room with a man who thinks he's Michael Jackson.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E02 - Mr. Lisa Goes to Washington
3.plot: Lisa's essay wins the Simpsons a trip to Washington, D.C., where her faith in democracy is shaken by her unethical Congressman.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E03 - When Flanders Failed
3.plot: Flanders suffers a failure after Homer wishes him ill.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E04 - Bart the Murderer
3.plot: While working for Fat Tony, Bart gains enough influence with his boss to solve his problems with Principal Skinner--perhaps permanently.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E05 - Homer Defined
3.plot: Homer's averting of a nuclear meltdown earns him employee-of-the-month honors--and a call from Magic Johnson; Milhouse's parents prohibit him from playing with Bart.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E06 - Like Father, Like Clown
3.plot: Bart and Lisa use theological arguments to try to reunite Krusty the Clown and his rabbi father, who disowned Krusty when he turned from rabbi to clown.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E07 - Treehouse of Horror II
3.plot: Maggie uses one of three wishes; a mind-reading Bart rules Springfield; Homer donates his brain to Mr. Burns' science project.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E08 - Lisa's Pony
3.plot: After disappointing Lisa, Homer buys her a pony, solving one problem, but creating others, requiring a second job--at Apu's Kwik-E-Mart.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E09 - Saturdays of Thunder
3.plot: When Homer helps Bart build a soapbox racer, it does little for the car but a lot for their relationship.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E10 - Flaming Moe's
3.plot: Moe steals the drink recipe Homer invented, and the rechristened “Flaming Moe” turns his tavern into a hotspot. When a national franchise wants to buy the recipe, Homer wants revenge.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E11 - Burns Verkaufen der Kraftwerk
3.plot: Burns sells the power plant to a German corporation that doesn't care for Homer's approach to his work.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E12 - I Married Marge
3.plot: A trip down memory lane to the early days of Simpson wedded bliss, when Marge was with child and Homer was without a job.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E13 - Radio Bart
3.plot: Bart fools the town into thinking there's a little boy trapped in a well.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E14 - Lisa the Greek
3.plot: Lisa's ability to pick winning football teams kicks off a strong bond with Homer.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E15 - Homer Alone
3.plot: A stressed Marge vacations alone, leaving Bart and Lisa with Patty and Selma, and Maggie with Homer--until she leaves in search of Marge.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E16 - Bart the Lover
3.plot: Bart's answer to detention from Mrs. Krabappel is to answer her personal ad with letters from a Mr. Wonderful, but his last laugh is more of a guilty whimper.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E17 - Homer at the Bat
3.plot: Burns hires Major League ringers for the plant softball championship.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E18 - Separate Vocations
3.plot: The results from their aptitude tests cause Bart and Lisa to make 180-degree turns in their behavior.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E19 - Dog of Death
3.plot: Santa's Little Helper notices resentment after the Simpsons make sacrifices to fund his life-saving operation.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E20 - Colonel Homer
3.plot: Marge fears a cheatin' heart when a waitress-country singer asks Homer to be her manager.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E21 - Black Widower
3.plot: Bart suspects something rotten when Selma gets engaged to Sideshow Bob.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E22 - The Otto Show
3.plot: Spinal Tap hits Springfield, and Otto the bus driver hits the skids after being fired, taking refuge in the Simpsons' garage.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E23 - Bart's Friend Falls in Love
3.plot: Bart resents Milhouse's new girlfriend; Homer gets the wrong subliminal tape, which has him gaining vocabulary, not losing weight.

3.title: FR - Les Simpson - S03E24 - Brother, Can You Spare Two Dimes?
3.plot: Homer's half-brother asks for a loan after Homer is awarded some cash.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E01 - Kamp Krusty
4.plot: Bart leads an uprising at Krusty's summer camp after he and Lisa are subjected to a Dickensian sweatshop.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E02 - A Streetcar Named Marge
4.plot: Marge is cast in a version of "A Streetcar Named Desire," playing Blanche to Ned Flanders' Stanley.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E03 - Homer the Heretic
4.plot: After skipping church one Sunday morning, Homer decides to quit church altogether and spend Sundays worshiping in his own way -- with cigars and beer.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E04 - Lisa the Beauty Queen
4.plot: Homer enters Lisa into the Little Miss Springfield Pageant to help her feel better about her looks. But when she must choose between the title and her integrity, she realizes that confidence comes from within.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E05 - Treehouse of Horror III
4.plot: A Halloween trilogy includes a murderous Krusty doll; a "King Kong" parody; an invasion of zombies unleashed by Bart's incantation.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E06 - Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie
4.plot: Bart is punished by being barred from the Itchy and Scratchy movie.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E07 - Marge Gets a Job
4.plot: Mr. Burns is instantly smitten when Marge takes a job at the nuclear power plant.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E08 - New Kid on the Block
4.plot: Bart has a crush on his new neighbor, a teenage girl who only has eyes for Jimbo Jones. Bart sets out to prove that Jimbo is not as tough as he seems.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E09 - Mr. Plow
4.plot: Homer and Barney become competitors in the snow-plowing business.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E10 - Lisa's First Word
4.plot: While trying to get Maggie to say her first word, Marge and Homer reminisce about Bart's and Lisa's first words.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E11 - Homer's Triple Bypass
4.plot: Homer sees a discount doctor for a coronary bypass.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E12 - Marge vs. the Monorail
4.plot: When Springfield gets a sudden windfall, a charismatic traveling salesman convinces the town to build a monorail.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E13 - Selma's Choice
4.plot: After seeing Aunt Gladys die alone, Aunt Selma wants to get married and have a baby... until she spends a day babysitting Bart and Lisa at Duff Gardens.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E14 - Brother from the Same Planet
4.plot: When Homer neglects Bart once too often, Bart goes to the Big Brother program to get a new father figure. Stung, Homer replaces Bart with a little brother.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E15 - I Love Lisa
4.plot: Chief Wiggum's son has a crush on Lisa after she gives him a Valentine out of pity.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E16 - Duffless
4.plot: After a DUI, Homer swears off beer for a month. Meanwhile, Bart and Lisa's sibling rivalry plays out in the school science fair.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E17 - Last Exit to Springfield
4.plot: Union president Homer fights to keep the dental plan.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E18 - So It's Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show
4.plot: An April Fools' Day prank provides the jumping-off point for Simpson family flashbacks.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E19 - The Front
4.plot: Lisa and Bart write an Itchy and Scratchy episode; Homer makes up a missing high-school credit.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E20 - Whacking Day
4.plot: Lisa takes a stand against Springfield's annual snake-bashing festival.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E21 - Marge in Chains
4.plot: Overwhelmed by her family's demands during a flu epidemic, Marge accidentally shoplifts at the Kwik-E-Mart and winds up in prison.

4.title: FR - Les Simpson - S04E22 - Krusty Gets Kancelled
4.plot: Krusty's Hollywood pals help when his show is canceled after a new star causes his ratings to plummet.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E01 - Homer's Barbershop Quartet
5.plot: Homer recalls when he, Apu, Barney and Principal Skinner became recording icons.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E02 - Cape Feare
5.plot: The Simpsons go incognito to avoid the newly paroled Sideshow Bob, who's out to get Bart.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E03 - Homer Goes to College
5.plot: Homer takes Nuclear Physics 101 at the local college, where he gets a trio of nerdy tutors expelled for extracurricular activities.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E04 - Rosebud
5.plot: Burns longs for a childhood toy that winds up in the grip of Maggie.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E05 - Treehouse of Horror IV
5.plot: Homer sells his soul; Vampire Burns invites the Simpsons for dinner; Bart sees a gremlin damaging his school bus.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E06 - Marge on the Lam
5.plot: Marge's wild night out with neighbor Ruth includes running from the police in Ruth's car, stolen from her ex.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E07 - Bart's Inner Child
5.plot: Springfield emulates Bart after he's praised by a self-help guru.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E08 - Boy-Scoutz 'N the Hood
5.plot: After a reckless Squishee bender with Milhouse, Bart wakes to the shocking realization that he joined the Junior Campers. Lured by pocketknives and knot-tying lessons, Bart assimilates into the group but then must face the father-son rafting trip.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E09 - The Last Temptation of Homer
5.plot: Homer struggles with his attraction to new coworker Mindy, a beautiful engineer whose love for doughnuts is equal to his own.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E10 - $pringfield
5.plot: Legalized gambling comes to Springfield, and Marge becomes addicted; Robert Goulet entertains at Bart's casino for kids.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E11 - Homer the Vigilante
5.plot: Homer leads a vigilante group to catch the Springfield Cat Burglar, who then robs the museum.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E12 - Bart Gets Famous
5.plot: When an on-air remark catapults Bart to instant stardom, he finds that fame isn't all it's cracked up to be.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E13 - Homer and Apu
5.plot: Homer accompanies Apu to the Kwik-E-Mart home office--in India--after Apu is fired.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E14 - Lisa vs. Malibu Stacy
5.plot: Lisa's outrage over the gender stereotypes reinforced by a new talking doll prompts her to confront the dollmaker.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E15 - Deep Space Homer
5.plot: Homer and Barney compete to be the first "average" American in space.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E16 - Homer Loves Flanders
5.plot: Flanders' extra ticket to the big game makes him Homer's new best friend, a role that sorely tests Flanders' patience.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E17 - Bart Gets an Elephant
5.plot: Bart wins an elephant, but Homer won't let him keep it.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E18 - Burns' Heir
5.plot: Bart is picked to be Burns' heir and moves into the Burns mansion, prompting Homer and Marge to hire a deprogrammer to get him back.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E19 - Sweet Seymour Skinner's Baadasssss Song
5.plot: Bart takes his dog to school, which gets Skinner fired, which in turn leaves Bart missing his archnemesis.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E20 - The Boy Who Knew Too Much
5.plot: Bart can clear Mayor Quimby's nephew of a charge of battery, but only by implicating himself as a hooky player.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E21 - Lady Bouvier's Lover
5.plot: Grandpa Simpson falls for Marge's mother, but loses out to a competitor; Bart gets ripped off shopping at home with Homer's credit card.

5.title: FR - Les Simpson - S05E22 - Secrets of a Successful Marriage
5.plot: Homer teaches a class on marriage, but sharing secrets about his own union gets him kicked out of the house.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E01 - Bart of Darkness
6.plot: Stuck in his room with a broken leg, Bart hears a high-pitched scream. When he looks through his telescope, he sees a guilty Ned Flanders burying the evidence.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E02 - Lisa's Rival
6.plot: Lisa feels threatened when a new girl moves to Springfield: Allison is smart, pretty, a great saxophone player and a crack diorama builder. Lisa tries to befriend her new rival, but she's consumed with envy and competitiveness.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E03 - Another Simpsons Clip Show
6.plot: After reading the weepy best-seller The Bridges of Madison County, Marge sits down with the family and recalls romantic moments, along with temptations from her bowling instructor Jacques and Homer's coworker Mindy.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E04 - Itchy & Scratchy Land
6.plot: The family's trip to Itchy & Scratchy Land takes an unexpected turn when high-tech robots malfunction and become violent.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E05 - Sideshow Bob Roberts
6.plot: Mayor Quimby pardons attempted murderer Sideshow Bob, who then runs against Quimby for mayor.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E06 - Treehouse of Horror V
6.plot: Lack of beer and cable TV make Homer a crazed killer; the present is altered by a time-traveling Homer; and Principal Skinner turns detention students into food.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E07 - Bart's Girlfriend
6.plot: Bart learns that the good Reverend Lovejoy's daughter is really bad.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E08 - Lisa on Ice
6.plot: Lisa's surprising ability at hockey spawns jealousy in Bart and a showdown when their teams meet.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E09 - Homer Badman
6.plot: When Homer gropes for a gummy candy stuck to the babysitter's pants, she mistakes his intentions and turns the town against him.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E10 - Grampa vs. Sexual Inadequacy
6.plot: Grandpa's homemade tonic puts life back in the Simpson bedroom, so he and Homer hit the road to sell the stuff.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E11 - Fear of Flying
6.plot: When they try to go on vacation, the family discovers Marge's debilitating fear of flying. Marge consults a psychoanalyst to find the source of her baffling fear.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E12 - Homer the Great
6.plot: Homer joins the secret society of the Stonecutters and is suddenly exalted when the brethren discover his birthmark. The ancient order is shaken to the core by the ineptitude of its new Chosen One.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E13 - And Maggie Makes Three
6.plot: The story of Maggie's birth is told in flashbacks: after Homer quits the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant to pursue his dream of working at a bowling alley, Marge reveals that she is pregnant.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E14 - Bart's Comet
6.plot: When Bart is forced to assist Principal Skinner in early-morning astronomy observations, he discovers a giant comet heading towards Springfield. Facing impending doom, the entire town shows up at the Flanders family bomb shelter.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E15 - Homie the Clown
6.plot: Krusty the Clown's reckless spending forces him to open a clown college to keep afloat. New graduate Homer discovers the perks and perils of being Krusty.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E16 - Bart vs. Australia
6.plot: After tricking an Australian boy into accepting a collect call, Bart flies Down Under to apologize.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E17 - Homer vs. Patty and Selma
6.plot: A loan from Patty and Selma makes Homer their slave; Bart is forced to take ballet.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E18 - A Star Is Burns
6.plot: Film critic Jay Sherman is among the judges at the Springfield Film Festival, which Mr. Burns conspires to win by bribing some judges.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E19 - Lisa's Wedding
6.plot: A fortuneteller predicts Lisa's engagement and wedding to a fellow student from an upper-crust British family.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E20 - Two Dozen and One Greyhounds
6.plot: The Simpson household's overrun with puppies--the offspring of Santa's Little Helper and his new girlfriend from which Mr. Burns would love to make a greyhound-skin tuxedo.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E21 - The PTA Disbands
6.plot: Bart helps precipitate a teachers strike, but he rues his handiwork when Marge takes over for Mrs. Krabappel.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E22 - Round Springfield
6.plot: Bart winds up in the hospital as a result of eating Krusty cereal, and when Lisa comes to visit him, she is reunited with her sax idol.

6.title: FR - Les Simpson - S06E23 - The Springfield Connection
