1.plot: Rebecca tells Justin that Joe kissed her. Joe tries to confess to Sarah about the kiss, but before he can get enough courage, she receives the news from the most unexpected person. When Nora fails her writing class, her teacher allows her to pass on one condition - she must go on a date with him. And, Kitty has to calm the Senator down after a disastrous helicopter crash.

1.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S01E21 - Grapes of Wrath
1.plot: The vineyard opens up and the whole family attends. Holly also makes a move on Mark when Nora is gone.

1.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S01E22 - Favorite Son
1.plot: Kevin acts as McCallister's attorney when a radio host makes accusations against his war heroism. Also, Tommy and Julia must face a tough decision regarding their newborn babies.

1.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S01E23 - Matriarchy
1.plot: Nora organizes an engagement party for Kitty and Robert. Justin is about to be deployed to Iraq, and he tries to have special time with his family members to say goodbye. Kitty finds it hard to tell her mother that she will be moving out. An old friend of Saul's visits after his divorce.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E01 - Home Front
2.plot: In the second season premiere, we return to the Walker family, who have a variety of different problems.  Nora is now keeping a blog on Iraq.  Meanwhile, a friend of Holly's flirts with Kevin, unaware that he's gay.  Kitty is given advice on how to act now that she and the Senator are engaged.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E02 - An American Family
2.plot: Kevin, Nora and Kitty go to pick up Justin who has just returned home from the war. McCallister finds that he’s getting closer to Walkers. Meanwhile, the truth is revealed between Sarah and Rebecca and Tommy is not able to get the hang of being a father.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E03 - History Repeating
2.plot: Rebecca worries about Justin, Tommy's marriage hits a road block as Julia starts coming out of her depression. Kevin meets an old flame and Kitty prevents a scandal.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E04 - States of the Union
2.plot: Rebecca's suspicions arise after Justin makes an almost miraculous recovery. Kevin pushes Saul to the edge to get some answers. Nora, Sarah and Kitty decide to go to a spa. Tommy tries to make friends but ends up in an embarrassing situation.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E05 - Domestic Issues
2.plot: Sarah becomes embroiled in a difficult battle with Joe for custody of their children. Kitty's Halloween announcement has consequences for the entire Walker family.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E06 - Two Places
2.plot: Kitty gets a visit from an old friend to do some damage control regarding her pregnancy. But it doesn't go as planned. Sarah is struggling with Paige, while Justin is down.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E07 - 36 Hours
2.plot: The Walkers unite as Justin's addiction hits an all-time low. Kitty and Robert build new plans for their future.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E08 - Something New
2.plot: Kitty and Robert takes dance lessons. Tommy gets a surprise visit and Kevin makes a drastic decision.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E09 - Holy Matrimony!
2.plot: Robert and Kitty get married, but not before a political scandal and a severe case of cold feet threatens the wedding. Meanwhile Isaac distracts Nora from her romance with Stan. Holly gets a surprise visit from an old friend and some secrets are revealed.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E10 - The Feast of Epiphany
2.plot: Secrets are the order of the day when the Walkers gather for a family dinner because Nora is too shy to ask Isaac out on her own. Meanwhile, Becca is trying to play matchmaker for her mother.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E11 - The Missionary Imposition
2.plot: Nora and Isaac get closer to each other. Jason makes Kevin to do some soul searching and think about his future.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E12 - Compromises
2.plot: Rebecca gets a new hobby, while Sarah has to make an important decision.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E13 - Separation Anxiety
2.plot: While Robert and Kitty visit a fertility clinic, Rebecca and Justin decide to have DNA tests to see if they really are related.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E14 - Double Negative
2.plot: In an attempt to solve Scotty's financial issues, Kevin offers to file domestic partnership papers with him. Meanwhile, Nora meets with an interior decorator in an attempt to try and make a fresh start and the Walkers' attend a fundraiser for cancer research.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E15 - Moral Hazard
2.plot: After an international business deal goes bad, Holly becomes the saving grace for Ojai Foods; Justin delivers heartbreaking news about a family member; Saul makes a confession; Scotty and Kevin share a life-changing moment.

2.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S02E16 - Prior Commitments
2.plot: Kevin and Scotty make a commitment to be life partners; Saul finally comes to grips with his identity in a public way; the family discovers that William kept yet another painful secret from them.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E01 - Glass Houses
3.plot:
The Walkers go to the beach for a family vacation but things turn ugly; meanwhile, Kevin arranges a getaway weekend for him and Scotty but things take a turn when a face from the past contacts him. 

Trouble awaits the Walkers as one gets fired and one gets blackmailed!

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E02 - Book Burning
3.plot: Much to the chagrin of her mother and siblings, Kitty decides to publish a tell-all memoir about Robert's unsuccessful Presidential race and the trials and tribulations of the Walker family. Meanwhile, Justin slows his relationship with Rebecca to a near stand still.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E03 - Tug of War
3.plot: Two Walkers leave Ojai Foods. While on a dinner with Justin and a fellow soldier, Rebecca begins to question Justin's sobriety as he does not mention anything about his time in Iraq. Kevin faces uncomfortable questions from a very important client and the client's wife; meanwhile, Nora finds herself drawn to someone.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E04 - Everything Must Go
3.plot: Nora gets ready for a new charity venture by getting rid of all of William’s belongings. Meanwhile, Robert begins to interview possible replacements for Kitty; Holly looks into the location of William’s son; and a time capsule brings two of the siblings closer together.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E05 - You Get What You Need
3.plot: Rebecca begins to doubt her mother when she finds a file on Ryan Lafferty in Holly's possession. Meanwhile, Kevin finds himself to be in an uncomfortable situation as he meets Scotty's very conservative parents.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E06 - Bakersfield
3.plot: Nora sets out to find as much as she can about William's son in order to beat Holly. Meanwhile, Kitty and Robert await news on a potential birth mother.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E07 - Do You Believe in Magic?
3.plot: Tommy and Julia celebrate their wedding anniversary in a magical way while Justin and Rebecca get spooked about their own romance, and Kitty's neuroses endanger the McCallisters' shot at adoption.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E08 - Going Once... Going Twice
3.plot:
Kevin overcompensates for his recent pay cut by snatching Nora’s dream house out from under her as a gift to Scotty.

Meanwhile Justin cooks up a plan to set Saul up with an unlikely candidate for a date.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E09 - Unfinished Business
3.plot: Nora recruits the family to deconstruct her new charity money pit; Kitty & Robert take a huge & overwhelming step in adoption; Sarah takes a big risk with her new business partners by eating crows; Holly pushes Tommy to his limits when she does something in the winery without consulting him.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E10 - Just a Sliver
3.plot: The Walkers encounter some conflicts in the schedules on Thankgiving; leaving Nora & Sarah alone to celebrate; Elizabeth endures a medical emergency that brings the family together.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E11 - A Father Dreams
3.plot: Elizabeth's illness & her uncle's sacrifice cause a volatile & emotional confrontation between Kevin & Tommy that could make or break their relationship as brothers; Saul reintroduces a high school crush to Nora; Justin finally decides to leave the nest. Kitty prepares for her upcoming promotional tour for her book by doing mock interviews with some of Robert's employees.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E13 - It's Not Easy Being Green
3.plot: Just as Greenatopia gets the green light Sarah's business partner breaks some startling personal news; Nora rekindles a romance with an old flame.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E14 - Owning It
3.plot: Marc Wilson the president of Wexley University offers Kitty a job as a principle. Tommy goes behind Holly's back with Rebecca on his trail. Nora and Sarah surprise Kitty with a baby shower.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E15 - Lost & Found
3.plot: Kitty finds out someones killed her interview with Times Magazine. Nora invites Ryan to her house. Holly discovers what Tommy's been up to and the ownership he has in Ojai Foods.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E16 - Troubled Waters, Part 1
3.plot: As the Walkers welcomes in a new life, they must also face the terror of losing one of their own. Meanwhile, Rebecca asks her father for help when she comes across new information that may spell disaster for the company.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E17 - Troubled Waters, Part 2
3.plot: As the Walkers welcomes in a new life, they must also face the terror of losing one of their own. Meanwhile, Rebecca asks her father for help when she comes across new information that may spell disaster for the company.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E18 - Taking Sides
3.plot: In the wake of a medical crisis, Robert continues strong on his campaign for governor. Meanwhile, Saul and Sarah work to hide Tommy's legal problems from Nora.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E19 - Spring Broken
3.plot: Kevin and Justin take Tommy on a trip in order to help him make a decision about his future. Meanwhile, Kitty and Evan head to Nora's to meet the new half-brother.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E20 - Missing
3.plot: Desperate to get through to Tommy before his legal troubles worsen; Nora reaches out for help to the person whom he hurt most deeply. Meanwhile, Ryan Lafferty gets a bit too close to Rebecca for Justin's comfort

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E21 - S3X
3.plot: Sarah reclaims her Ojai office and meets Cal, a staffer in accounting. He helps her unpack; Even in the heat of the moment; Sarah's business savvy remains; When David, Holly, Rebecca and Ryan have dinner; David can't help but notice Ryan's behavior around his daughter; Scotty, Kevin and Chad share drinks.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E22 - Julia
3.plot: Out of patience waiting for Tommy to return home, Julia makes a life-changing decision about the future; Robert discovers what Kitty has been keeping from him; Holly & Sarah finally find balance in their relationship.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E23 - Let's Call the Whole Thing Off
3.plot: When Kitty & Robert reach a crossroads in their marriage, she is forced to reflect on her father's past indiscretions and decide what's most important in life. Meanwhile, Ryan makes a discovery about his mother's death and takes a huge leap in the wrong direction to vie for Rebecca's affection.

3.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S03E24 - Mexico
3.plot: When the Walker family reaches out to Tommy, they're devastated to find that he may be unwilling to accept their help. Robert & Kitty reach a crossroads in their marriage that they may not be able to successfully navigate; Justin makes plans for the future, with or without Rebecca; and Saul makes a shocking admission about Ryan Lafferty's mother.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E01 - The Road Ahead
4.plot: Kitty guards a devastating secret that could change the Walker family forever. Meanwhile, Nora and Holly work together to thrown an engagement party for Justin and Rebecca; Tommy remains in Mexico; and Sarah heads to France.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E02 - Breaking the News
4.plot: As Robert worries about news of his recent heart attack leaking to the press, Kitty struggles with an untold secret that will deeply affect their marriage and bring the Walker family together like never before. Meanwhile, Kevin and Scotty discuss the real possibility and challenge of surrogacy.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E03 - Almost Normal
4.plot: Kitty, Robert and Nora struggle to accept Kitty's cancer and to come to an agreement on the best possible treatment, but as they prepare to share the news with the entire family, a surprise visitor from afar makes the burden a bit easier to bear.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E04 - From France With Love
4.plot: After returning from France, Sarah manages to distract Kitty through her chemo treatments by using tales of her romance with a French artist. Meanwhile, Justin has problems with his anatomy class and seeks his professor for help with surviving the semester with his teenage genius lab partner.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E05 - Last Tango in Pasadena
4.plot: The Walker family, with the exception of Nora, are surprised by the charms and tango lessongs of Luc Laurent, Sarah's new lover. However, Nora quickly uncovers that her French houseguest is a very good comfort during a very difficult time. Meanwhile, Robert needs to distract Kitty from the cancer, and he uses his most romantic efforts into the situation.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E06 - Zen and the Art of Mole Making
4.plot: In the throes of chemo, Kitty is thrilled when a surprise visitor comes to town, while Sarah finally realizes that she has to tell her kids about Luc (Gilles Marini as Luc Laurent). Meanwhile, with Ryan and Rebecca’s help, Holly finds a way to keep her financial future from unraveling, and Kevin and Scotty finally agree on a possible surrogate.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E07 - The Wig Party
4.plot: Kitty is devastated when she must face the aftereffects of her cancer treatment. Meanwhile, Nora makes an unexpected friend; and Scotty's father shares some shocking news about his marriage.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E08 - The Wine Festival
4.plot: Ojai's newest wine is submitted at a local festival; Justin and Rebecca keep life-changing secrets from themselves; Nora has a crush on a younger man; Sarah and Luc may not be as compatible as they thought they were.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E09 - Pregnant Pause
4.plot: Rebecca has a secret that could make or break her relationship with Justin; Holly's financial situation worsens; Sarah becomes jealous of Nora's new romance.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E10 - Nearlyweds
4.plot: Justin and Rebecca's beachside wedding has the Walker family stunned. Tommy risks everything to have his daughter beside him.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E11 - A Bone to Pick
4.plot: Kitty's life is in jeopardy as the Walkers frantically search for a bone marrow donor.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E12 - The Science Fair
4.plot: A divorced dad at Paige's school piques Sarah's interest, while Justin uncovers the key to his learning challenges. Meanwhile, Nora reunites with her eyes wide open.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E13 - Run Baby Run
4.plot: Sarah has a new romantic interest for the first time since her divorce; Scotty and Kevin await the results of their first try at surrogacy; Kitty and Robert reach another impasse over politics.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E14 - The Pasadena Primary
4.plot: Robert and Nora get to work as guest chefs in Scotty's struggling restaurant to boost business, Kitty puts her idea to run for Robert's senate seat up for a Walker family vote, and Sarah reaches a point of frustration with Roy but is quickly rewarded for speaking up.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E15 - A Valued Family
4.plot: The Walker family shares love and loss on Valentine's Day as Sarah rediscovers the love of her life, Kitty makes a grand but heartfelt entree in to politics with her family and new campaign manager by her side, Justin and Rebecca face the struggles of impending parenthood and Holly makes a tough decision about what to do with her shares of Ojai.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E16 - Leap of Faith
4.plot: Luc’s visa issues cause monumental problems for Sarah, who not only struggles with her feelings for him, but worries that she might lose him again – this time to another woman. Meanwhile, Rebecca wrestles with Justin and with herself to move on after a huge loss, Kevin discovers breaking up with Robert is hard to do, and Holly thinks she has found the hidden value of Ojai Foods.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E17 - Freeluc.com
4.plot: Kitty's newfound fame creates havoc for Luc and Sarah, as Luc faces possible deportation. Meanwhile, Nora swallows her pride and reaches out to Tommy to help her save the company from the Walkers' longtime nemesis, Dennis York.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E18 - Time After Time Part 1
4.plot: In an effort to get to the root of the secret that William's nemesis, Dennis York, holds over their heads, the Walkers recall their memories, both good and horrifying, of their family's days at Ojai Foods in 1986. Then, as they continue to flashback to their younger days, they finally recall the shocking secret and the shameful cover-up that led to York's power play, and are forced to deal with the remorse of a tragic event. Meanwhile, Nora and Holly take an uncharacteristic trip, a la "Thelma & Louise," to search for answers about Ojai's hidden worth, and Justin and Rebecca finally get their happily ever after.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E19 - Time After Time Part 2
4.plot: In an effort to get to the root of the secret that William's nemesis, Dennis York, holds over their heads, the Walkers recall their memories, both good and horrifying, of their family's days at Ojai Foods in 1986. Then, as they continue to flashback to their younger days, they finally recall the shocking secret and the shameful cover-up that led to York's power play, and are forced to deal with the remorse of a tragic event. Meanwhile, Nora and Holly take an uncharacteristic trip, a la "Thelma & Louise," to search for answers about Ojai's hidden worth, and Justin and Rebecca finally get their happily ever after.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E20 - If You Bake It, He Will Come
4.plot: Still reeling from his discovery of Nora’s buried secrets about his childhood, Kevin refuses to attend his own birthday party. Meanwhile Justin, Tommy and Kevin confront Dennis York.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E21 - Where There's Smoke...
4.plot: More than one member of the Walker family suspects she might be pregnant, Nora offers to take her aging mother in when it's discovered she has dementia, and Luc gets an exciting delivery in the mail.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E22 - Love All
4.plot: The Walkers seem to all being going through an adjustment period, as Cooper acts out against Sarah while Luc becomes a member of the family, Justin has trouble finding the same passion for medicine that he had while serving in Iraq, and Kevin struggles with his newfound unemployed status.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E23 - Lights Out
4.plot: The Walkers are heartbroken as they prepare to shut the doors of Ojai Foods for good, but new opportunities and secret alliances develop as a result of the family's loss.

4.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S04E24 - On the Road Again
4.plot: As the Walkers try to cope with the sadness and financial ruin that lingers as a result of the closure of Ojai Foods, they discover a small ray of hope in one of William Walker’s many secret investments. Meanwhile, Robert’s health and the safety of his family are compromised when he finds himself in way over his head in a subversive business deal, and newlyweds Justin and Rebecca consider a trial separation.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E01 - The Homecoming
5.plot: It's been a year since the Walker family was torn apart by a tragic car accident, and in a very un-Walker like fashion, everyone has been avoiding everyone else. Truths and reality only start to set in when the family is forced to come together for Justin's homecoming party: Nora tries to prepare for the party, but is not acting like the mother she used to be; Sarah is consumed with the Narrow Lake deal; Kevin has a new career as public defense attorney; Saul and Scotty are running their restaurant; and Kitty's life has become a taboo subject for everyone.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E02 - Brief Encounter
5.plot: The Walkers attend a swanky launch party for Luc’s underwear advertising campaign where 14-year-old Paige falls in with the wrong crowd; despite several visits from Justin, Holly still struggles to remember the things that were once most important to her; Kevin is saddled with a runaway juvenile delinquent; and just as Nora very publicly admits that she’s taken a part-time job as a florist, she’s approached by a radio show producer with a job offer.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E03 - Faking It
5.plot: Kitty continues her stay in Ojai, trying to reinvent herself, when she meets a handsomely rugged handyman, Jack. As Kitty fakes her persona to seem like a local, she winds up in a situation that proves that honesty usually is the best policy. Meanwhile, the rest of the Walkers are in on a little surprise birthday celebration for Sarah; what they all don't know is that Sarah has been lying to Luc about her age to appear younger... It's hard to keep up with the truth.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E04 - A Righteous Kiss
5.plot: Justin and Rebecca reach an impasse in their relationship; Holly has a breakdown over her inability to remember her own daughter; Sarah struggles to keep up with the Joneses when Cooper lands the lead role in "Romeo & Juliet"; Saul takes a huge risk to make a romantic connection with a dear friend; and Kitty struggles with an affair of the heart.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E05 - Call Mom
5.plot: Nora's motherly skills and advice catch the attention of a radio producer who invites her to audition for a new show. But when Nora follows through with the invite, she suddenly finds herself out of her league, competing with a famous personality, Dr. Alexandra Kirby. Meanwhile, as Kevin and Justin go through some life lessons of their own, Kitty heads back into the dating game with her Ojai handyman, Jack.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E06 - An Ideal Husband
5.plot: Everyone in the Walker family is willing to forgive and forget Scotty's infidelity. But when the family all put their best foot forward to help them reunite, things end up in a fist fight. Meanwhile Jack is reinvigorated by being back in the city and starts to pursue new ventures, but Kitty can't seem to picture herself in this new life, and Sarah and Luc share some exciting news with the family.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E07 - Resolved
5.plot: Justin suddenly takes a much more keen interest in Holly's recovery after a nurse (guest starring Odette Yustman as Annie) at the hospital catches his eye; Nora's fellow radio host, psychiatrist Dr. Karl, finds his way into Nora's heart when he helps Sarah and Kitty resolve some old sisterly squabbles; and Paige helps Kevin and Scotty find forgiveness.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E08 - The Rhapsody of the Flesh
5.plot: The charms and well intended matchmaking antics of Luc's visiting mother, Gabriela, quickly turn to high drama as she sticks her nose in Nora's romantic affairs.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E09 - Get A Room
5.plot: Both Kitty and Nora very reluctantly make new romantic connections in unexpected places, Kevin's nerves about the adoption drive him to a disastrous bout of overindulgence, and Sarah's plans to spend one last romantic night alone with Luc go horribly awry.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E10 - Cold Turkey
5.plot: The relationship between Justin and Annie gets more serious as he brings her to a family dinner. Nora has doubts about him being ready for a serious relationship since he just broke up with Rebecca.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E11 - Scandalized
5.plot: A scandal like no other hits the Walker family which causes Kitty to over-think her future.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E12 - Thanks For the Memories
5.plot: In this 99th episode the family looks back to the events who made them who they are now. Tommy returns with surprising news, while his siblings all have to make very difficult choices. Kitty needs a break from her Life.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E13 - Safe at Home
5.plot: The Walkers are excited when Tommy comes down for a visit, but his new girlfriend's enthusiasm for Walker family history rubs the family the wrong way.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E14 - One That Got Away
5.plot: The Walkers' plans to celebrate Valentine's Day go horribly wrong when Tommy tells Sarah about another secret that Nora has kept buried since they were kids, and Saul's hopes for a romantic evening with Jonathan are dashed by a visiting high profile food critic.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E15 - Brody
5.plot: Though Nora tries her best to keep Brody at bay, she can’t help but feel the long lost connection between them, and Justin reaches out to a homeless vet reluctant to accept help getting back on his feet.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E16 - Home Is Where The Fort Is
5.plot: Nora and Sarah fly out to Washington DC to "surprise" Evan for his birthday, but what they're really after is the truth behind Kitty's extended trip to the east coast. Meanwhile, Kevin and Scotty are thrilled to have officially signed the papers to be Olivia's parents, but the excitement quickly fades when Olivia seems a little nervous about moving in and starting a new life.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E17 - Olivia's Choice
5.plot: When Olivia's brother shows up and sets out to gain custody of her from Kevin and Scotty, the Walkers struggle amongst themselves to determine what's best for Olivia.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E18 - Never Say Never
5.plot: Emotions are running high in the Walker family when Nora and Saul find out their mother, Ida, has passed away.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E19 - Wouldn’t It Be Nice
5.plot: Nora finally gives in to her feelings for Brody, which leads to a spontaneous romantic getaway. Meanwhile Sarah and Luc closely consider growing their family, and a chance encounter with Michelle raises Scotty's suspicions about her whereabouts for the past several months.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E20 - Father Unknown
5.plot: Parenthood is questionable for more than one member of the Walker family, as Justin keeps a closely guarded secret about the true paternal identity of one of his siblings and Scotty makes a shocking discovery that will bring a new life into the Walker family fold.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E21 - For Better Or For Worse
5.plot: After Sarah confronts Brody about his being her father, she decides she no longer wants him to be a part of her life or Nora's, but Nora just can't seem to let him go. Meanwhile, Olivia struggles with the new addition of baby Daniel to the family.

5.title: FR - Brothers and Sisters - S05E22 - Walker Down The Aisle
5.plot: As Sarah and Luc’s nuptials approach, plans go horribly awry and the Walkers learn several surprising lessons about the real meaning of family, on the Series Finale of “Brothers & Sisters”.

meta.plot: The close-knit Walker family deals with struggles and triumphs.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Badly in debt, a man hesitantly joins a mysterious show and meets seven other eclectic strangers. Their first goal? Figure out the rules.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Realizing that an activity rewards them with time, the eight coordinate a plan. But soon, chaos erupts as their strategy doesn't last.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: A participant approaches 3rd Floor with a proposal to steer the next activity selection. After, a strategic vote takes place to pick the bathroom location.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: One participant establishes rank on the others, making them desperate. Soon, a new game of dares begins — and a savage hand-to-hand fight ensues.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: A few floors strategically band together to get an upper hand on the others. But the victims see their salvation in a potential uprising.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Now with the tables turned to their favor, the lower floors plan their endgame. However, the clock keeps winding up as strange, brutal events unfold.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: An act of altruism backfires, putting some participants in danger. But a shocking move changes everything — switching the dynamic up once again.

1.title: FR - The 8 Show - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: One participant suggests an idea to turn the tides back in their favor. But the show falls into disarray when the result turns out duplicitous.

meta.plot: Eight individuals trapped in a mysterious 8-story building participate in a tempting but dangerous show where they earn money as time passes.

FR - Les Espions de la terreur - S01E02 -

FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E01 - A Master of Circumstance
1.plot: Stripped of aristocratic privilege, Count Alexander Rostov is sentenced to life imprisonment at the Metropol Hotel. Contending with allies and foes alike, it’s nine-year-old Nina and her unexpected friendship that changes his life.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E02 - An Invitation
1.plot: The Count reckons with his past when old friend Mishka turns up at the hotel; he meets Anna Urbanova for the first time, embarking on a passionate affair; his friendship with Nina deepens, but their time together may be cut short.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E03 - The Last Rostov
1.plot: As his old life crumbles, the Count receives some devastating news; blinded by hurt, he embroils his friends in a dangerous plan; his disregard for the state may have consequences; Nina makes a surprise return, as Anna's career takes a turn.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E04 - Good Times
1.plot: The Count must undertake a dangerous political mission to save a friend.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E05 - An Arrival
1.plot: The Count's life at the hotel is turned upside down by a startling arrival.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E07 - An Assembly
1.plot: Russia stands on the brink of change in 1953, as someone close to the Count is granted a major opportunity. But when the return of an old friend makes the Count see clearly, he's confronted with a difficult choice about the future.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E07 - An Assembly
1.plot: Russia stands on the brink of change in 1953, as someone close to the Count is granted a major opportunity. But when the return of an old friend makes the Count see clearly, he's confronted with a difficult choice about the future.

1.title: FR - A Gentleman in Moscow - S01E08 - Adieu
1.plot: The Count and Anna devise an elaborate plan, with huge consequences should it fail. However, things quickly start to unravel. An inevitable showdown is set between the Count and an old enemy.

meta.plot: Count Alexander Rostov finds himself going from riches to rags following the Russian revolution. A Soviet tribunal banishes him to the attic room of an opulent hotel, where, oblivious to the world outside, he discovers the true value of friendship, family and love.

FR - Lucky Luke - S01E02 - Tenderfoot
1.plot: Badmington, a young Englishman, accompanied by his butler, comes to take possession of the ranch bequeathed to him by his uncle. Lucky Luke is responsible for protecting him against Jack Grabbit, an unscrupulous man who also covets the property...

1.title: FR - Lucky Luke - S01E03 - Barbed Wire on the Prairie
1.plot: Vernon Felps, a farmer, decides to settle in the middle of a cattle-raising region, which does not seem to be to the taste of the local ranchers. Cass Casey takes the lead of a group determined to drive out the intruder. Lucky Luke then helps Felps.

Joined by the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., a humorously dysfunctional group of teammates who double as family, Hulk tackles threats that are too enormous for any other heroes to handle.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E01 - Doorway to Destruction (1)
1.plot: Hulk’s best pal Rick Jones begins making a web-series to show the world Hulk is a hero and Big Green gets his first chance to prove it when Annihilus invades Earth!

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E02 - Doorway to Destruction (2)
1.plot: The newly formed Agents of S.M.A.S.H. -- including a Hulked-out Rick Jones aka A-Bomb -- invade the Negative Zone to stop Annihilus once and for all.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E03 - Hulk Busted
1.plot: When the Leader hijacks Iron Man's Hulkbuster suits to destroy the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., the team and Iron Man must learn to trust each other and work together to defeat the Leader.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E04 - The Collector
1.plot: Perceived by the public as "menaces," Hulk and Spider-Man are the only ones left to save the planet from destruction when The Collector captures every last hero on earth.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E05 - All About the Ego
1.plot: The Hulks face their biggest foe yet when they travel into space to battle Ego the Living Planet, who threatens to tear Earth apart! To survive, they have to tackle the second biggest ego in the galaxy -- Red Hulk's.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E06 - Savage Land
1.plot: A-Bomb is eager to prove himself to an over-protective Hulk and finds an unlikely mentor in Red, but when Sauron and his army of dinosaurs begin to flood Earth with lava, A-Bomb finds himself facing a true trial by fire.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E07 - Incredible Shrinking Hulks
1.plot: A-Bomb's birthday calls for a celebratory game of mini-golf, but thanks to the Leader, it's the Hulks who are miniaturized. Now the one-inch heroes must stop the towering Leader from shrinking every city on Earth.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E08 - Hulks on Ice
FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E09 - Of Moles and Men
1.plot: The Hulk's presence in Vista Verde may be doing the city more harm than good. In order to prevent any danger to its citizens, the Hulk goes underground and becomes the savior to the Moloids but the Hulk soon learns that he might be the one who needs saving!

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E10 - Wendigo Apocalypse
1.plot: As the curse of the Wendigo begins spreading across the team. A-Bomb narrates this heroic episode turned horror flick joined by Marvel's biggest clawed Hero, Wolverine. Together, they must all stop the curse from spreading and do everything in their power to prevent from becoming Wendigos themselves.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E11 - The Skaar Whisperer
1.plot: Skaar gets a lesson in civility from Doc Sampson while the Hulks battle Absorbing Man, who takes on Gamma energy to turn himself into an unstoppable force.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E12 - Into the Negative Zone
1.plot: Hulk begrudgingly teams up with The Thing to take the fight to the Leader's doorstep when his arch-nemesis puts the lives of the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. on the line.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E13 - Red Rover
1.plot: An irritated Red Hulk accidentally drops Devil Dinosaur in Dr. Doom's backyard, prompting the mad dictator to launch a full assault on the Hulks.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E14 - The Venom Inside
1.plot: Venom is on the prowl and has his sights set on big targets. Hulk must save the day...without smashing as his friends are possessed by Venom. How will the Hulks take on this menacing parasitic villain who's only goal is to destroy Spider-Man?

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E15 - Galactus Goes Green
1.plot: Hulk thinks Galactus is coming to Earth to consume it. But he's really in search of a new Herald and finds great potential in the under-appreciated She-Hulk!

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E16 - The Trouble with Machines
1.plot: The Hulks have crashed their Jump Jet more times than they can count, and it's out for revenge now that the Leader has given it artificial intelligence.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E17 - Abomination
1.plot: Abomination, a villain from Red Hulk's past, plans to take out the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. one-by-one so he can exact the ultimate revenge and frame the team for destroying Vista Verde.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E18 - Mission Impossible Man
1.plot: The Hulks meet their biggest fan -- Impossible Man! But he also proves to be their biggest problem when he summons the giant dragon, Fing Fang Foom, to battle them.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E19 - For Asgard
1.plot: Skaar accidentally triggers Ragnarok and incites the ire of Asgard. Detained by the all-seeing, all-knowing guardian of the Bifrost, Heimdall, the Hulks must save Skaar and battle Thor. Soon the heroes find they must put aside their differences to fight against Malekith and save the realm.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E20 - Stranger in a Strange Land
1.plot: To help the aspiring magician, A-Bomb get a lesson in hard work, Hulk puts him under the tutelage of the Sorcerer Supreme Dr. Strange -- but when the dreaded Dormammu abducts his teacher, A-Bomb has to use what he learned to save Earth!

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E21 - Deathlok
1.plot: When the Hulks thwart a villain from attacking a girl in the mall, they unintentionally start an alien invasion Deathlok was sent to stop.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E22 - Inhuman Nature
1.plot: A-Bomb's crush on a mysterious girl leads the Hulks to the secret home of the Inhumans, an isolationist race that threatens to wipe out mankind.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E23 - The Hunted
1.plot: Annoyed with his fellow Hulks, Hulk takes off for some alone time and stumbles onto an island of monsters where he inherits a family that's far peskier than his own.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E24 - Monsters No More
1.plot: The world finally accepts the Hulks as heroes, but before they can enjoy their success, a surprise attack from The Leader and his agents of CRASH threaten to destroy Vista Verde and the Hulk's reputation.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E25 - Planet Leader
1.plot: Battling The Leader becomes more than the Hulks bargained for when they get transported to Skaar's home planet, Sakaar, where they must stop The Leader from controlling the entire planet and the Hulks themselves.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S01E26 - It's a Wonderful Smash
1.plot: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Guardians of the Galaxy must break free of a simulated paradise created by the Collector.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E01 - Planet Hulk (1)
2.plot: While looking for a way back to Earth, the Hulks discover the Leader stowed away on board the ship. Retribution must wait as the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. have to fight Ronan the Accuser and his Kree soldiers to save an old foe: Ego the Living Planet. But when Galactus comes to consume Ego the Living Planet, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. must put themselves at risk to save the lives of their two enemies.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E02 - Planet Hulk (2)
2.plot: The Hulks want retribution against the Leader, who is stowed away on their ship, but their plans change when they realize their old foe, Ego the Living Planet, is in danger from Ronan the Accuser and his soldiers looking to destroy him.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E03 - The Hulking Commandos
2.plot: The S.M.A.S.H. Agents find themselves working with the Howling Commandos of Nick Fury in order to stop the next attack from Dormammu, who plans to break into their dimension and turn everyone into Mindless Ones and help expand his forces.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E04 - Fear Itself
2.plot: The Hulks must face each of their greatest fears in order to stop the Null from crossing through a worm hole to reap ruin upon Earth.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E05 - Guardians of the Galaxy
2.plot: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. team up with their old friends the Guardians of the Galaxy to stop the Skrulls from using the Hulks' gamma powers to create super-powered Skrulks!

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E06 - Future Shock
2.plot: The Hulks finally return to Earth only to discover that they're centuries too late as the High Evolutionary devolved all humans into primitive beasts. He devolves the Hulks too, but Skaar is unaffected and steps up to save the team and all of mankind.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E07 - A Druff is Enough
2.plot: When A-Bomb brings an alien aboard the ship, he puts the team at risk when it starts taking over, jeopardizing the team's only shot at getting back to Earth.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E08 - Homecoming
2.plot: When the team triumphantly returns to Earth, despite being accused of destroying Vista Verde, they find the town under rule of a new general: General Abomination.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E09 - Spidey, I Blew Up the Dinosaur
2.plot: When the Leader blows Devil Dinosaur up into gigantic proportions and lets him loose on New York City, it's up to Spider-Man and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. to stop him.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E10 - The Strongest One There Is
2.plot: When the other Hulks try to leave A-Bomb out, he starts to doubt his strength as an agent of S.M.A.S.H., and realizes that he must use his other attributes to help the team when the Hulks are challenged by Xemnu the Titan, an intergalactic fighting champion. Find out if the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. can defeat Xemnu and prevent him from destroying the Earth.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E11 - The Dopplesmashers
2.plot: When the Hulks are framed by Abomination for attacking the S.H.I.E.L.D. Tri-Carrier, they must face evil gamma-powered doppelgangers of themselves in order to save Nick Fury.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E12 - The Big Green Mile
2.plot: The Hulks are locked up by Abomination in the super villain prison where many of their enemies now reside.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E13 - The Green Room
2.plot: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. track the Leader to a deserted island but get stuck in a deadly maze, where they are forced to battle the Hulk's dark side -- in physical form.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E14 - The Defiant Hulks
2.plot: Hulk reluctantly fills in as Mayor of Vista Verde while Red and Skaar leave the team to start their own webcast as super villain bounty hunters - their first target: Abomination.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E15 - Enter, The Maestro
2.plot: While saving Earth from a potentially catastrophic meteorite, the Hulks come face to face with a future version of Hulk who might not be the hero they think he is.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E16 - The Tale of Hercules
2.plot: The Hulks travel to ancient Greece and team up with Hercules to stop Pluto from turning everyone on Earth to stone.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E17 - Banner Day
2.plot: Hulk allows himself to be turned back into Bruce Banner but then struggles with the decision when Ronan launches an alien attack.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E18 - Wheels of Fury
2.plot: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. attempt to help Iron Man subdue Mainframe in a gladiatorial roller derby game for the fate of the planet, but are faced with a challenge when they discover only She-Hulk knows how to skate.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E19 - Days of Future Smash: Part 1 - The Dino Era
2.plot: Hulk chases Leader back in time to the Jurassic era, but their actions result in present Earth being taken over by dinosaurs. Hulk battles Leader in the past to save all of time.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E20 - Days of Future Smash: Part 2 - Smashguard
2.plot: Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Viking Era and teams up with young Thor and Loki. The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to stop "All Father" Leader from taking over the planet.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E21 - Days of Future Smash: Part 3 - Dracula
2.plot: Hulk follows Leader back in time to the Victorian era and unites the Howling Commandos against Dracula, who wants to shroud the Earth with Leader's gamma cloud, allowing vampires to prey night and day.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E22 - Days of Future Smash: Part 4 - Year of the Hydra
2.plot: Chasing Leader through time to WWII, Hulk teams up with Captain America to stop Red Skull. In the present, the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. fight to free the world from HYDRA.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E23 - Days of Future Smash: Part 5 - The Tomorrow Smashers
2.plot: Hulk reunites with Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and is whisked into the future.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E24 - Spirit of Vengeance
2.plot: While escorting Abomination to stand trial for his crimes, the Hulks run into Ghost Rider, who has come to make both Abomination and Red atone for the wrongful deeds of their past.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E25 - Planet Monster (1)
2.plot: Hulk is torn between his two teams -- the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Avengers -- as both team up to save Earth from a Kree armada led by the Supreme Intelligence.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. - S02E26 - Planet Monster (2)
2.plot: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Avengers must work together to free Hulk from the Supreme Intelligence and prevent the destruction of Earth.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E01 - Chapter 1: Quinceañera
1.plot: On the day of Maya's coronation, an uninvited guest from the Underworld arrives with shocking news about her origins — then delivers a dire ultimatum.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E02 - Chapter 2: The Prophecy
1.plot: A crushing loss sheds new light on an age-old prophecy, sending Maya on a far-flung quest to find three warriors who will help her save the world.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E03 - Chapter 3: The Rooster
1.plot: On Luna Island, Maya looks for the Rooster Wizard but winds up with the seemingly ordinary Rico, who's said to be "The Greatest Wizard Who Ever Lived."

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E04 - Chapter 4: The Skull
1.plot: A search for the Jungle Lands' legendary Skull Archer leads Maya and Rico to a gifted warrior: the reclusive Chimi, known to locals as "Monstruo Blanco."

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E05 - Chapter 5: The Puma
1.plot: A burly Golden Mountain Barbarian named Picchu joins Maya's party as the third foretold warrior. Later that night, Zatz confronts Maya about her motives.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E06 - Chapter 6: Maya and the Three
1.plot: Lord Mictlan’s army attacks Teca, but Maya and her friends fight back. When the gods return, a second battle reveals strengths they didn't know they had.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E07 - Chapter 7: The Divine Gate
1.plot: Help springs from a surprising source when Maya and the Three come face-to-face with Lord Mictlan. In the end, a noble friend makes a selfless sacrifice.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E08 - Chapter 8: The Bat and the Owl
1.plot: After flying from danger, a devastated Maya sends her friends to warn their kingdoms that Lord Mictlan is coming. Lady Micte opens her heart.

1.title: FR - Maya, princesse guerrière - S01E09 - Chapter 9: The Sun and the Moon
1.plot: A fateful battle begins in Teca between Lord Mictlan and his army and Maya and her allies. But how will it all end? In epic fashion.

meta.plot: Dans un univers fantastique divisé en quatre royaumes où règne la magie, la rebelle Maya, courageuse princesse guerrière, s'apprête à être couronnée pour son quinzième anniversaire. Mais tout bascule quand les dieux du monde des morts réclament sa vie comme tribut au dieu de la guerre, le prix à payer pour racheter le passé trouble de sa famille. Si Maya refuse, le monde entier subira la vengeance des dieux. Afin de sauver sa famille, ses amis et sa propre vie, Maya se lance dans une quête épique pour accomplir une ancienne prophétie annonçant l'arrivée de trois puissants guerriers qui l'aideront à vaincre les dieux et à sauver l'humanité.
For employees of the Deep State, conspiracies aren't just theories — they're fact. And keeping them a secret is a full-time job.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E01 - Unpresidented
1.plot: As Reagan prepares to replace the president with a robot, she finds her hard-earned promotion threatened by a clueless but likeable new colleague.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E02 - Clone Gunman
1.plot: When an expensive blunder forces budget cuts at Cognito Inc., J.R orders Reagan and Brett to decide which of their co-workers should be fired.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E03 - Blue Bloods
1.plot: After a lizard people-related PR disaster, the team must do damage control at the swanky Reptoid Gala, where - to Reagan's dismay - hugs are required.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E04 - Sex Machina
1.plot: After Cognito Inc. buys a dating app, Reagan bets her team she can find a boyfriend - and creates a robot version of her perfect match to practice on.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E05 - The Brettfast Club
1.plot: Brett hopes to have a blast in the past as the team embarks on a nostalgia-laced mission to a small town that's permanently stuck in the '80s.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E06 - My Big Flat Earth Wedding
1.plot: Reagan conspires to keep her dad from finding out about her mom's wedding, while J.R. ropes Brett into a personal mission to help offload his mega-yacht.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E07 - Ghost Protocol
1.plot: Reagan sets up an elaborate plan in motion to ghost a debonair British secret agent who grows too attached after a fling.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E08 - Buzzkill
1.plot: Desperate to get some space from her father, Reagan volunteers for a dangerous mission to the moon to make contact with a rogue colony.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E09 - Mole Hunt
1.plot: Exciting changes are afoot at Cognito Inc., but first, Reagan and her team must find the mole behind a security breach that could take down the company.

1.title: FR - Inside Job - S01E10 - Inside Reagan
1.plot: To find a forgotten password and save Cognito Inc., Reagan goes deep into her mind and accesses memories from her dysfunctional childhood.

meta.plot: A boy's superhero dreams come true when he finds five powerful cosmic stones. But saving the day is harder than he imagined — and he can't do it alone.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E01 - Kid Cosmic and the Rings of Power!
1.plot: After Kid discovers five powerful cosmic stones, he turns to teen waitress Jo for help in figuring them out — and keeping them out of the wrong hands.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E02 - Kid Cosmic y la Niña Gigantica
1.plot: When 4-year-old Rosa transforms into a 40-foot giant after finding one of the rings, it's up to Kid and Jo to keep the destructive tot out of trouble.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E03 - Kid Cosmic and the Precognitive Cat
1.plot: Sensing danger, newly superpowered cat Tuna Sandwich sets off on a quest to save Kid, whose attempt to lead a team mission goes all kinds of wrong.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E04 - Kid Cosmic and the Local Heroes
1.plot: As Kid and the self-proclaimed Local Heroes confront a wave of alien invaders, everyone starts to get the hang of their powers. Well, almost everyone.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E05 - Kid Cosmic and the Big Win
1.plot: Kid and the Local Heroes try to protect their family, friends and favorite place to eat when a pack of demonic alien dogs invades the diner.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E06 - Kid Cosmic and the Epic Fail
1.plot: Pushed to the edge by Chuck’s nonstop taunts, Kid decides to steal the other four rings and go it alone in a desert showdown with Chuck's Great Leader.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E07 - Kid Cosmic and the Invaders from Earth
1.plot: When the mysterious man in black and his army take over the town, Tuna Sandwich partners with a former foe in order to bring the team back together.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E08 - Earth Force Enforcement Force
1.plot: While an elite new squad of government-sponsored superheroes faces down an alien threat, Kid begins to wonder if he's misjudged the entire situation.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E09 - Kid Cosmic and the Bad Good Guys
1.plot: Kid may be down, but he's definitely not out. With a wild plan in place, he and the Local Heroes suit up and race into danger to stop the alien battle.

1.title: FR - Kid Cosmic - S01E10 - Kid Cosmic and the Day is Saved!
1.plot: Things aren't looking good for the team, but that won't stop Kid from trying to save the day as he finally learns what being a real hero is all about.

meta.plot: Camila trouve son prince charmant sur une application de rencontres. Après une folle histoire d'amour, elle décide de le surprendre... et se retrouve coincée dans un faux paradis.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E01 - Flesh and Bone
1.plot: Camila is swept off her feet by handsome Fernando. After a dreamy night out, they end up at his hotel suite… unaware they’re being watched.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E02 - Panic in Paradise
1.plot: A misunderstanding allows for Camila and David to move into Riviera Esmeralda. Pedro tests Miguel. Camila is hell-bent on uncovering the truth.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E03 - Even If It Hurts
1.plot: Camila is furious after finding out what’s making the rounds online. David questions her desire to stay. A question from Lucas catches her off guard.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E04 - Breathless
1.plot: Ángela extracts a promise from Lucas, but what he asks in return startles her. Pedro tells Tina that Miguel has taken the bait. Camila acts dismissively.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E05 - Dangerous Images
1.plot: The incident at Camila’s home triggers vivid flashbacks for her. Lucas warns Ángela about what the police might find. Pedro calls a meeting.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E06 - Red Velvet's Secret
1.plot: Ángela makes a decision about her marriage. Visions of Inti haunt Adrián. One of Miguel’s past lovers shares intimate details of their relationship.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E07 - Inside the Wolf's Mouth
1.plot: Someone surprising comes to Camila’s defense. Inti’s seduction attempts persist. Camila leaves a party alone — and puts herself in imminent danger.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E08 - Temptation in the Dark
1.plot: Ángela becomes increasingly cynical. Camila receives a word of caution from an unlikely character. Cris spices things up with Adrián.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E09 - Night of the Executioners
1.plot: Camila refuses to assist with an event, and is promptly reminded of what’s at stake if she doesn’t. What Pedro discovers provokes a hellish response.

1.title: FR - Fake Profile - S01E10 - Don't Say Anything
1.plot: An accident leaves the community mourning. Something unthinkable comes to light as a visit to Ángela culminates in a calamitous scene.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E01 - The Forbidden Dream
2.plot: Ahead of her wedding to David, Camila finds herself haunted by memories of Miguel. Ángela's celebration of her newfound freedom is short-lived.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E02 - Losing Control
2.plot: Camila reminisces about the past and resists temptation as Miguel preys on her emotions. Sparks fly during Laura's first date. Ángela points fingers.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E03 - Anatomy of an Obsession
2.plot: As the killings rattle Riviera Esmerelda, Miguel tries to make amends with his kids. David proposes a chilling theory. Detective Indira questions Inti.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E04 - The Man That Never Was
2.plot: With her marriage to David on the rocks, Camila takes out a restraining order against Miguel. Indira uncovers a common thread between the murders.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E05 - Pleasure's Edge
2.plot: In Mexico, Camila mixes business with pleasure. Miguel takes his meddling to the next level. Laura and Matteo grow closer despite her son's disapproval.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E06 - The Girl Who Knew Too Much
2.plot: Passion and betrayal collide when Camila gets a deceiving invitation. Ángela reasserts her control of the company. For Inti, freedom comes at a cost.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E07 - He/She Knows You're Alone
2.plot: Fueled by her desire for vengeance and reeling from the events of Mexico, Camila returns to Riviera Esmerelda to find Red Velvet — and goes rogue.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E08 - What Eyes Can't See
2.plot: Jealousies flare as Camila recovers and new evidence puts Miguel under police scrutiny once more. Inti comes forward with a damning discovery.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E09 - Death Playing Golf
2.plot: The hunt for the killer narrows, testing relationships and triggering old wounds. Ángela lashes out. Camila's therapy session takes a harrowing turn.

2.title: FR - Faux profil - S02E10 - Blood & Hope
2.plot: True colors come to light as Indira makes a break in the case, Ángela does damage control and Camila learns just how far a master manipulator can go.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E01 - The Edge of Desire
3.plot: Camila and Miguel befriend a young couple on their honeymoon, to Miguel's alarm. Indira receives shocking news that'll change everything.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E02 - Female Survivor
3.plot: Camila and Miguel attend a different kind of therapy as the Riviera Esmeralda gets a new resident. A new killer targets one of Camila's own.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E03 - Temptation Knocks at Your Door
3.plot: Unexpected guests drive a deeper wedge between Miguel and Camila. Eva overhears a private conversation that threatens to disrupt it all.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E04 - For Fans Only
3.plot: As temptation sets in, Camila's urges threaten to consume her. Police close in on a murder suspect, as Ángela gets a taste of freedom through pain.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E05 - Truly Decent People
3.plot: Rodrigo and Juanita receive a nasty surprise as Camila and Miguel try to repair their marriage. Laura discovers betrayal is closer than she thought.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E06 - The Man with a Thousand Faces
3.plot: Miguel unleashes his past – and secrets — to Camila. As another death rocks Riviera Esmeralda, Ángela's trial changes everything. A copycat runs free.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E07 - This Was Never Love
3.plot: Doubts cloud Camila's mind as an attack causes a rift at Golden Lips. Inti crashes an intimate gathering, and Vannessa's jealousy becomes a threat.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E08 - Hidden Urges
3.plot: Indira makes an arrest in Alberto's death. When a trap goes awry, Camila smells a rat. Miguel's debts and lies catch up to him. Alonso is attacked.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E09 - Remorse
3.plot: Inti's obsession resurfaces as Noa meets Ángela. Vannessa bows to pressure, and an innocent party becomes the scene of a devastating disappearance.

3.title: FR - Faux profil - S03E10 - It's All Fake
3.plot: The search for Eva continues, and so do Ángela's schemes. An arrest gives Indira a wealth of information, and a special show has a terrible fallout.

meta.plot: 21 Jump Street revolves around a group of young cops who would use their youthful appearance to go undercover and solve crimes involving teenagers and young adults.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E01 - Pilot (1)
1.plot: Hanson gets assigned to the Jump Street unit, a special division of the police force which uses young cops to go undercover and stop juvenile crime, when his youthful appearance causes him to be underestimated while on patrol. His first case involves catching drug dealers.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E02 - Pilot (2)
1.plot: Hanson gets assigned to the Jump Street unit, a special division of the police force which uses young cops to go undercover and stop juvenile crime, when his youthful appearance causes him to be underestimated while on patrol. His first case involves catching drug dealers.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E03 - America, What a Town
1.plot: Hoffs goes undercover to keep a wild Eastern Bloc exchange student out of trouble. Hanson and Penhall enroll in a shop class suspected of being a chop shop for an auto theft ring.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E04 - Don't Pet the Teacher
1.plot: A woman with car trouble whom Hanson helps out and makes a date with turns out to be a teacher who has been getting threatening messages and whose class he has been assigned to undercover.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E05 - My Future's So Bright, I Gotta Wear Shades
1.plot: Hanson and Penhall infiltrate an exclusive preppie clique to investigate a prank that left a girl dead.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E06 - The Worst Night of Your Life
1.plot: Hoffs is not convinced that the captured suspect in an arson case at a Catholic girls school is the guilty party and believes that the real culprit will strike again at the school's prom.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E07 - Gotta Finish the Riff
1.plot: Jenko is killed by a drunk driver and is replaced by Captain Fuller who has his hands full dealing with a vengeful gang leader whom has taken his principal and several others hostage, including an undercover Hanson.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E08 - Bad Influence
1.plot: Hanson and Penhall try to locate some missing juveniles while Ioki tries to find a link between a teenage prostitution ring and a series of burglaries.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E09 - Blindsided
1.plot: The daughter of a policeman who claims her father is sexually abusing her tries to hire Hanson-- undercover with Penhall as one of the drug dealing McQuaid brothers-- to kill her father.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E10 - Next Generation
1.plot: Hanson who is out to catch a loan shark finds his cover threatened when his high school quiz team makes it to the semi finals which are to be broadcast on TV.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E12 - 16 Blown to 35
1.plot: Hoffs enrolls in a teen modeling school after several of its graduates end up appearing in pornography.

1.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S01E13 - Mean Streets and Pastel Houses
1.plot: Hanson goes undercover as a punk rocker in an effort to stop a feud between two rival gangs from turning into a war.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E01 - In the Custody of a Clown
2.plot: The Jump Street unit discovers that a boy who was being used as a pawn by his feuding parents faked his kidnapping with the aid of his grandfather to get away from his parents.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E02 - Besieged (1)
2.plot: Hanson and Hoffs go undercover in order to put a crack ring out of business. Penhall, working on the same case, returns to squad car and becomes convinced that his new partner killed a drug pusher.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E03 - Besieged (2)
2.plot: Hanson and Hoffs go undercover in order to put a crack ring out of business. Penhall, working on the same case, returns to squad car and becomes convinced that his new partner killed a drug pusher.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E05 - After School Special
2.plot: Hanson is unable to keep his mind on the investigation of a shooting of a teacher at an inner city school when he learns that his mother is moving in with her boyfriend.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E06 - Higher Education
2.plot: A pregnant school girl fingers Ioki as the father to be.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E07 - Don't Stretch the Rainbow
2.plot: Racial violence threatens to break out at an integrated school when word leaks out that a white student got a black student pregnant.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E08 - Honor Bound
2.plot: Hanson and Penhall find the military code of honor hampering their undercover investigation of a military academy where the cadets are suspected of killing homosexuals.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E10 - How Much is That Body in the Window?
2.plot: Penhall gets close to a football player suspected of using steroids at a school where an olympic hopeful gymnast died after a performance due to steroid abuse. Hanson considers becoming a big brother.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E11 - Christmas in Saigon
2.plot: Ioki faces being dismissed from the force when internal affairs discovers that he is a Vietnamese refuge who is using an alias. Flashback sequences show his escape from Saigon.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E12 - Fear and Loathing with Russell Buckins
2.plot: Hanson contemplates leaving the force and leaves town instead of going to a refresher course at the police academy he and Penhall had been assigned to take after they went drag racing to try to catch a hit and run driver.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E13 - A Big Disease with a Little Name
2.plot: Dorothy an old girlfriend of Penhall's, who walked out on him two years ago, returns and decides to move in with him. Hanson gets assigned to protect a student with AIDS who is being made to feel unwelcome in class.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E14 - Chapel of Love
2.plot: Past romances that didn't have happy endings are the subject of conversation at a Valentine Day Eve poker game.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E15 - I'm OK- You Need Work
2.plot: Hanson becomes trapped in a private drug clinic where he had himself placed in order to investigate claims of patient abuse made by a kid he once busted on drug charges.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E16 - Orpheus 3.3
2.plot: Hanson blames himself for failing to prevent the shooting death of his girlfriend in a convenience store robbery and becomes obsessed with revenge.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E17 - Champagne High
2.plot: Penhall & Hanson go undercover as the McQuaid brothers in a suburban high school, that recently has had inner city kids bused in, to investigate the theft of a Porsche. Meanwhile, Judy must deal with a love-sick teenage boy.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E18 - Brother Hanson & the Miracle of Renner's Pond
2.plot: When a small-town teacher refuses to teach the theory of evolution after his son has a near-death experience, Hanson infiltrates the school to try to discover who's behind the recent burning of the science books.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E19 - Raising Marijuana
2.plot: Penhall and Ioki go undercover as the ""Swark Twins"" to get in with teenage boys working for drug smugglers. Meanwhile, Hoffs becomes romantically involved with the head drug smuggler.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E20 - Best Years of Your Life
2.plot: The suicide of a popular student, whom Hanson and Penhall had arrested the night before, leaves his family, fellow students and Hanson in a state of depression and forces Penhall to relive bitter childhood memories.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E21 - Cory and Dean Got Married
2.plot: Hoffs and Penhall must deal with a pursuing husband when they are assigned to escort a girl arrested for killing her father when he tried to prevent her from eloping.

2.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S02E22 - School's Out
2.plot: Hanson goes undercover to find a student who is blowing up toilets. Meanwhile, Fuller must convince the higher-ups that the Jump Street program, which is scheduled to be deactivated over the summer, should be reactivated in the fall, and Doug decides it's time to grow up.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E02 - Slippin' Into Darkness
3.plot: Hoffs and Ioki go undercover in a Guardian Angel-type street patrol whose members have a vendetta out for a drug dealer who Hanson is trying to set up for a bust.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E03 - The Currency We Trade In
3.plot: A popular sports writer finds his whole life ruined when Penhall believes his ex-wife's allegations of his being a child molester.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E04 - Coach of the Year
3.plot: Penhall and Booker join a high school football team in attempt to prove that the coach's negligence led to the paralyzing injury of one of the players.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E05 - Whose Choice is it Anyways?
3.plot: Hoffs goes undercover as a pregnant teen to investigate threats of violence being made to a family planning center by anti-abortionists.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E06 - Hell Week
3.plot: Hanson and Ioki must endure hell week as fraternity pledges in order to gain the confidence and get evidence on a gang rape which occurred at a frat party.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E07 - The Dragon and the Angel
3.plot: While working undercover in a Vietnamese streetgang, Ioki learns of a communist businessman who may be able to help his grandmother who is still in Vietnam.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E08 - Blu Flu
3.plot: Everyone in the Jump Street unit gets blue flu when the police force goes on strike forcing Captain Fuller to team up with a rookie cadet.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E09 - Swallowed Alive
3.plot: Hanson becomes an inmate in a juvenile detention hall in order to investigate the murder of one of the inmates.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E10 - What About Love?
3.plot: Dorothy and Penhall split up forcing Penhall to move in with Ioki. Hoffs becomes involved with a city inspector, who is auditing Jump Street's records.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E11 - Woolly Bullies
3.plot: Penhall's encounter with a bully while undercover causes the members of the Jump Street unit to reminisce about their dealings with bullies while they were in school.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E12 - The Dreaded Return of Russell Buckins
3.plot: Hanson goes after an old friend who wrote an article exposing the Jump Street program causing Hanson to get suspended from duty.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E13 - A.W.O.L.
3.plot: An old Army buddy comes to Fuller seeking the Jump Street unit's help in bringing in an AWOL soldier who will be classified a deserter if he doesn't return to base within two days.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E14 - Nemesis
3.plot: Booker is laiden with guilt when after he infiltrates a gang of drug users that kill one of their own whom they suspect is an undercover cop.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E15 - Fathers and Sons
3.plot: Fuller and the Jump Street unit are given a lot of flak and told to pull off the case when city hall learns Hanson and Penhall are about to bust the mayor's son on drug dealing charges.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E16 - High High
3.plot: The Jump Street cops enroll in a performing arts school to bust a drug ring being run there.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E17 - Blinded by the Thousand Points of Light
3.plot: Undercover looking for a person who has been preying on homeless teens, the Jump Street cops learn what it is really like to live on the street.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E18 - Next Victim
3.plot: Booker goes undercover as a radio DJ to discover who killed a controversial college radio personality by planting a bomb in his car.

3.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S03E19 - Loc'd Out (1)
3.plot: Hanson finds himself on the wrong side of the law after he decides to seek revenge on members of a street gang who shot and seriously wounded Ioki.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E01 - Draw the Line
4.plot: Booker resigns from the police force after solving a case that gets Hanson out of prison.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E02 - Say It Ain't So, Pete
4.plot: Penhall gets caught up in the excitement as he and Hanson go undercover to bust a college gambling operation.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E03 - Eternal Flame
4.plot: Hanson meets an old flame now married to the owner of a 80's nightclub suspected of providing LSD to high school students.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E04 - Come from the Shadows
4.plot: Penhall finds himself falling for an illegal immigrant from El Salvador when the Jump Street unit is sent in to investigate a priest suspected of selling babies.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E05 - God is a Bullet
4.plot: The Jump Street team intervenes when a tough new principal goes too far in his attempts to clean up a drug and crime infested inner city school.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E06 - Old Haunts in a New Age
4.plot: During a Halloween string of high school fires, Hanson becomes a bit skeptical of a teen age psychic claiming to be able to predict where the next fire will occur.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E07 - Out of Control
4.plot: Penhall and Ioki become rent a cops while Hanson becomes a member of a clique of thrill seeking kids who break into houses to annoy the rent a cops.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E08 - Stand by Your Man
4.plot: While trying to expose a drug ring at a prestigious medical school, Hoffs is raped while on a date with one of the suspects who later claims that she seduced him.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E09 - Mike's P.O.V.
4.plot: Hanson and Penhall investigate the murder of a high school teacher's wife and discover that the teacher hired one of his students to kill her.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E10 - Wheels and Deals (II)
4.plot:
Working on a tip from Booker, the Jump Street cops join a motorcycle caravan in order to bring Raymond Crane to justice.

The crossover starts on Booker S01E08 Deals and Wheels (I).

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E11 - Parental Guidance Suggested
4.plot: While observing a family suspected of operating a burglary ring, Hoffs begins to suspect that a boy is being abused.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E12 - Things We Said Today
4.plot: Ioki is confronted by a teenage boy with a gun, who three years earlier Ioki had talked into turning in his drug abusing family.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E13 - Research and Destroy
4.plot: The Jump Street Cops are sent to investigate a college chemistry lab where it is suspected that new designer drugs are being manufactured.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E14 - A Change of Heart
4.plot: A lesbian student makes a pass at Hoffs when she and Capt. Fuller go undercover at a high school to learn the identity of a student who was a witness to a teacher's murder.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E15 - Back from the Future
4.plot: In the 21st century a young cop hoping to revive the Jump Street program interviews the retired officers who were there when it all started.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E16 - 2245
4.plot: Hanson tries to convince a juvenile inmate on death row to appear in a film intended to keep his peers out of prison.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E17 - Hi Mom
4.plot: Hanson and Penhall expose a point shaving scheme when they go undercover to investigate the drug related death of a college basketball star.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E18 - Awomp-Bomp-Aloobomb, Aloop Bamboom
4.plot: Hanson and Penhall find a way to get out of the cold while remaining on the job as they trail a suspected bomber to Florida during spring break.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E19 - La Bizca
4.plot: Penhall ends up taking his nephew back to America after he and Hanson travel to El Salvador in order to find Penhall's wife, whom they learn was killed in the fighting.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E20 - Last Chance High
4.plot: Donning their McQuaid brother aliases for one last time Hanson and Penhall discover a teenage girl who has kidnapped her baby sister to get her away from their abusive parents; while Penhall adjusts to becoming a father figure.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E21 - Unfinished Business
4.plot: A handicapped policewoman asks Fuller to send her undercover to investigate a series of attacks on handicapped women; however, Fuller also send in Hoffs in a wheelchair.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E22 - Shirts and Skins
4.plot: When the leader of a neo-Nazi group is murdered, Hoffs & Ioki go undercover in the liberal group suspected of the killing. While Penhall joins the Nazis to learn if they plan a violent reprisal.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E23 - How I Saved the Senator
4.plot: The Jump Street cops each relate a different version (with the teller as the hero of a film from their favorite genre), to a reporter investigating the foiled attempt to kill a senator.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E24 - Rounding Third
4.plot: After volunteering to become a Little League coach Penhall learns that one of the players was kidnapped by his father, from his mother and step-father.

4.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S04E25 - Everyday is Christmas
4.plot: After botching an assignment, Penhall is transferred to a different precinct where he learns the cops routinely accept bribes and finds himself the subject of a Jump Street investigation.

5.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S05E01 - Tunnel of Love
5.plot: Hoffs and Garrett must deal with a DEA officer while working undercover at a massage parlor suspected of being a front for a drug operation.

5.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S05E02 - Back to School
5.plot: Garrett attempts to infiltrate a high school drug ring by dating the sister of the ring's suspected leader.

5.title: FR - 21 Jump Street - S05E03 - Buddy System
