FR - Who killed him? - S01E01 - JORGE
1.plot: On the day of Paco Stanley's murder, Jorge Gil misses a family event to have breakfast with him and talk to him about an idea for a new TV show. After surviving the killing, guilt and post-traumatic stress send him into a spiral of paranoia, convinced that these people want to kill him too.

1.title: FR - Who killed him? - S01E02 - MARIO
1.plot: Holed up in a hotel, Mario Rodríguez tells his lawyer a version of events in which his friendship with Paco threatens his marriage, but seeing him going down a dark path, he does everything to help him.

meta.plot: Through the points of view of the six people closest to him, the story of the unsolved murder of Mexican TV host Paco Stanley in 1999 is revealed behind the scenes where fame, betrayal and excess point to different suspects.

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E01 - Nothing Special
1.plot: Pauline just wants to go to university. A pregnancy is the last thing she needs.

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E02 - Are You Ready?
1.plot: While Pauline tries to get rid of her problems, she gets the feeling that she is going crazy.

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E03 - Chaos and Control
1.plot: Pauline has to get her new power under control. Only Lukas can help her.

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E04 - Who Was My Father?
1.plot: Pauline flees to her father's forest cabin. However, she is not alone there.

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E05 - Trust
1.plot: Pauline finally gets help. But can she trust the Sonnenseite people?

1.title: FR - Pauline - S01E06 - Team Pauline
1.plot: To get her old life back, Pauline comes to an arrangement with Lilith.

meta.plot: Pauline gets pregnant after a one-night stand with Lukas. Something is very wrong with the pregnancy. When Luke reveals that he is the son of the devil incarnate and heir to hell, nothing is ever the same again. Between the fronts of demons and angels, Pauline's pregnancy also gives her supernatural abilities. She becomes the decisive force in the epic battle between good and evil.
Investigator Jan and profiler Louise constantly move around in the thrilling periphery of a murderer's view as they link a series of killings.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Jan Michelsen is investigating the disappearance of a young woman called Julie Vinding from a Copenhagen suburb. Six months later, Jan is the only one who believes that she is still alive.  Jan finds a ten-year-old case from the same neighbourhood where a 17-year-old girl, Natasha, disappeared on her way home from a party. Jan discovers the remains of Natasha in a lake. She was murdered. Suspecting a link between the two crimes, Jan brings in an expert on serial killers, Louise Bergstein.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Jan and Louise’s investigation into Natasha’s death leads them to suspect Anders Kjeldsen, a man who has been arrested before for violent crimes including rape. Trapped in a basement, Emma tries to comfort a traumatised Julie, but soon needs comforting herself.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Jan and Louise find an unsolved murder case in Sweden that has similarities with Natasha's, although this one has an unusual signature: the victim's ring finger was cut off. Louise doesn't believe that the murder has been committed by Anders Kjeldsen.  Meanwhile, on a farm that Anders Kjeldsen stayed at as a child, the police make a gruesome discovery. Stine is forced to help Anders with the women in the basement, who are planning to escape.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Louise realises that Anders Kjeldsen does not kill alone but has a partner who is the dominant of the two. In the basement, Emma tries to persuade Stine to help her to escape.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Jan and Louise find a dress belonging to Natasha – the first victim – which Anders Kjeldsen had hidden. That same night, Anders tries to kidnap another woman. Stine Velin attends her big brother Mikkel's 40th birthday party and reveals a dark family secret.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The public appeal for information on Anders Kjeldsen leads to the identification of the third victim from the farm and an explanation of how all the women met their killer. Louise suspects he has a female accomplice.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Stine Velin is taken into police custody, but insists that she is also one of Anders Kjeldsen’s victims and does not know where either Anders or Emma are.

1.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Jan and Louise find Anders Kjeldsen. Louise fears that Stine’s family is in danger and places them in a safe house.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Five years ago, Alice Ejbye's 18-year-old son Markus was murdered by a serial killer who was never found. Alice is now seriously ill and asks criminal profiler, Louise Bergstein, the daughter of her best friend, to help solve the case. At the same time, elsewhere on Funen, a man named Peter Vinge receives a fatal message from his wife Masja.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: A young man has been found in the woods, tortured and stabbed to death. Profiler Louise Bergstein and the head of the investigation Karina Horup try to find evidence for whether the murder can be attributed to a serial killer who, after a five-year hiatus, may now be active again. They slowly work their way towards the killer's highly unusual motive. Meanwhile, Peter Vinge struggles with being a single parent to his son, Johannes, and looks for his next victim.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Louise Bergstein and Karina Hørup discover that the serial killer has a claimed a new victim, William Fjeldby, who was kidnapped and abducted in his own car. William's father, multimillionaire Gorm Fjeldby, clings to the hope that his son has been kidnapped for a ransom and is therefore still alive. As the police search for William, Peter Vinge tries to celebrate Johannes's birthday without Masja. It dawns on Johannes that his father is hiding something from him.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Alice Ejbye receives some bad news from the doctor. At the same time, despite two new victims, the police have yet to find the man who killed her son Markus. Desperate, Alice posts a video on social media offering a reward which has consequences for her relationship with Louise. The police are inundated with information from people who are after the reward, and Karina and Louise struggle to determine whether there is anything useful among all the information. Peter takes his frustration out on his next victim.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Seven weeks after Alice's death, Louise is in mourning and wants to go home as Karina issues her with an ultimatum regarding the case. Alice's death raises a new suspicion which takes the investigation in a new direction. Peter Vinge focuses on his work at a local sawmill, where he receives an unexpected offer from Leif. At the same time, Peter is in conflict with Johannes who remains in a stage of teenage revolt against his father.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Louise Bergstein continues to assist the investigation to find the serial killer, who now has six brutal murders to his name. With Karina Hørup, Louise returns to the first victims in an attempt to find out where they may have met their killer. Peter notices that the police are closer to him than ever before, and at the same time happens to meet Louise again.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Unaware of who he really is, Louise gets far too close to Peter. But the terrible truth lurks beneath the surface. Karina tries to find new evidence for the investigation on her own, and an earlier clue resurfaces, moving the case forward. Peter sorts his life out and gives Johannes a message that his son has a hard time coming to terms with.

2.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The police take Johannes to the station, and Louise fears that the truth about her and Peter Vinge will be revealed. Meanwhile, Peter meets his ex-wife Masja, who has returned from Singapore without notice in order to set things straight. Karina, Søren and Torben desperately try to find Peter before he can claim another victim.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Louise is determined to continue working as a profiler and when a couple is found brutally murdered, she takes on the case. She assists Detective Inspector Frederik Havgaard, who believes he knows who the killer is.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Louise locates Bjørn’s little sister Maria. Maria's caseworker suggests that Louise mentor the young woman, who is faced with the prospect of having her child taken away from her. Meanwhile, Bjørn is in hiding.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: The police hunt for Bjørn is intensified. Following a search of Pelle’s home, Frederik and Louise uncover truths about Bjørn’s past, and a decision is reached on the forced removal of Maria’s child.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Another crime is committed. Frederik is convinced that Bjørn is the perpetrator, but Louise's investigations point to a different suspect. Bjørn turns to Louise and shares a secret with her that might close the case.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Three years on, Louise has moved to Aarhus to make a fresh start, but the past catches up with her when she meets Frederik again. He involves her in a new case in which a disabled woman has been found dead. Frederik thinks she was murdered, and the ensuing investigation seems to suggest that the dead body is a part of a larger pattern.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Louise and Frederik discover a connection between Bjørn and Alberte, who both grew up in the Breidablik commune. Louise visits the commune undercover in order to assist the police in their investigation and quickly notices the charismatic leader, Jon, who has a special relationship with Alberte.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: Louise tries to get closer to Jon. Alberte becomes jealous and challenges Louise’s cover story. Meanwhile, Frederik discovers that one of Jon's old friends, who also owned Breidablik, perished in a mysterious fire.

3.title: FR - Darkness: Those Who Kill - S03E08 - Episode 8
3.plot: Louise and Frederik put pressure on Jon to accept responsibility for his actions, but once again he takes advantage of his relationship with Alberte. Louise decides to confront the past.

meta.plot: The misadventures of a knight and a healer begin in this new fantasy comedy series!

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E01 - In this world where monsters are rampant...
1.plot: A knight and a foul-mouthed healer meet and are going to have a hard time together!

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E02 - Forced to travel with Carla, a healer...
1.plot: ...Alvin resumes his original quest to gather antidote herbs, but on the way he ends up getting attacked in a graveyard by ghosts which they manage to escape unexpectedly, but then he falls into a trap set by goblins and basically the first half of the episode is filled with great suffering but Carla's curse is still in effect so he can't get away from her and there's even more suffering in store nevertheless and anyway these titles are really long and kind of serve double-duty as next episode previews and we're pretty curious about how many people actually listen to the whole thing and that's the deal with episode 2.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E03 - Despite the terrible time he's been having...
1.plot: While trying to demonstrate their skills, Alvin and Carla encounter a delicious and dangerous enemy.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E04 - The first dungeon Alvin tackles with Carla is designed for...
1.plot: Just when Alvin and Carla are about to face their first dungeon experience, it turns out to be pure beginner's fun and so even Alvin is convinced that he can master it in no time.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E05 - The owner of the inn they visit seems very nice, but...
1.plot: After leaving the dungeon, Alvin and Carla go to rest at an inn, but the healer doesn't seem to like the establishment or the attendant very much. Then they meet a somewhat suspicious old lady.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E06 - As usual, Alvin and Carla have to overcome a series of crises...
1.plot: Rejuvenated, the witch gives Alvin and Carla the herbs they need. The two leave for the guild and obviously have another problem.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E07 - This show is fairly unique in that Carla is the only recurring female character...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla decide to help a zombie get his revenge by confronting a powerful necromancer.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E08 - Thanks to Altargaia (reminder: this is the mushroom's name)...
1.plot: Released from prison, Alvin reunites with Carla, who has decided to help Maria summon a particular soul.

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E09 - This Episode Features Even More Female Guest Characters Hot on the Heels...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla meet in the forest the Medusa and Dryad. What are they planning to do with them?

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E10 - In the second half of this episode, we enter the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla visit the adventurers' guild and meet an old companion of Alvin's there, who isn't particularly fond of our party...

1.title: FR - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E11 - So, this is Part 2 of the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin once again finds himself in an awkward position from which he cannot free himself. Can Carla help him this time, or is she just making it worse?

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Struggling comedian and barman Donny meets a lonely woman claiming to be a lawyer. He offers her a cup of tea on the house, and she's instantly obsessed.

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: On a date with Teri, Donny opens up about his stalker. Trying to be kind, he gives Martha false hope, which only encourages her further.

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: As Donny reports Martha to the police, it triggers the memory of a traumatic experience he had with a man he met at the Edinburgh Fringe years before.

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Liz learns the truth about Martha and asks Donny to move out. It's a fresh start for him and Teri, but his memories stop them from getting truly close.

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Martha finds new ways to get to Donny: by hurting the people he loves. With the police still failing to intervene, he takes matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Mon petit renne - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: For the first time in his career, Donny feels like he's going somewhere. Until he makes one careless mistake that lets Martha explode back into his life.

meta.plot: Quand un humoriste fauché manifeste un peu de gentillesse envers une femme fragile, il déclenche une obsession étouffante menaçant de détruire leur vie à tous les deux.
Rejoignez Gobo, Maggie, Wembley, Béa, Boubeur et de nouveaux amis fraggle dans des aventures drôles et épiques où l'enchantement naît de la passion et de l'amour pour notre monde interconnecté.

1.plot: During a diving game, Red pressures Wembley to the point that he's literally frozen in fear. A run-in with Junior Gorg changes Red's perspective.

1.plot: During the First Frost, Gobo and Wembley retrace the trek of a heroic adventurer and learn she may not be quite what they expected.

1.plot: Jamdolin and the Troubadours visit the Rock for New Day's Day. Boober wrestles with his anxiety when he finds himself at the center of the action.

1.plot: Determined to make the displaced Craggles feel at home in Fraggle Rock, Mokey insists on playing wild games with their new guests.

1.plot: Fast-talking Doozer Jack Hammer picks Wembley as the spokesfraggle for the new Doozer sticks. Wembley finds himself at a crossroads.

1.plot: Red finds the pond is too full of goo to dive, so she tries zip-vining and hurts her baloobius. Mokey tries to help Red find a new outlet for her energy.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E12 - Into the Trash
1.plot: When Marjory falls ill, Boober is called to a special task: venture into the deep mountain of trash in order to heal her.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E13 - All of Us
1.plot: To bring water back to Fraggle Rock and set things right, Gobo convinces the gang to work with an unlikely ally.

1.plot: While working on Candice's class quilt, Josh and Emily get trapped in the underbelly of the Los Angeles fabric district, while Alex and Bridgette prove to be incompetent babysitters.

1.plot: In a last-ditch attempt to prove they can still party, Emily, Josh, and Alex follow Bridgette to a hot new nightclub.

1.plot: When Josh volunteers at Candice's school, Emily becomes suspicious that another parent is trying to seduce him.

1.plot: Emily tries to roll with the "cool moms" at Candice's school, while Josh and Alex help Randy find his mom.

meta.plot: When a struggling comedian shows one act of kindness to a vulnerable woman, it sparks a suffocating obsession which threatens to wreck both their lives.

Mauro Larrea and Soledad Montalvo are two strangers whose destinies cross in the second half of the 19th century, leading to their lives changing forever. A history of glories and defeats, of silver mines, family intrigues, vineyards, wineries, and fascinating cities whose splendor faded over time.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E01 - Episode 01
1.plot: Tragedy strikes Mauro Larrea’s life, and he will be forced to emigrate to Mexico and work in the silver mines. On the other side of the world, Soledad Montalvo, the wealthy heiress to a family of Jerez winemakers, will also see her life change dramatically.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E02 - Episode 02
1.plot: Mauro and Soledad, each from their side of the world, must face their new situations. Mauro knows that his daughter Mariana's upcoming wedding could be in jeopardy; so, he must hide his lack of money from Mexican society until after the ceremony. For her part, Soledad must face her past when her cousin, Gustavo shows up in London and tries to resume the romance of their youth.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E03 - Episode 03
1.plot: Mauro arrives in Havana in order to carry out the request of delivering money to Carola Gorostiza, a member of his future family by marriage. However, he is the one who is the subject of the most unexpected business proposition one can imagine.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: After his terrible decision to invest in the business of the slave ship, Mauro must deal with the moral consequences. Ultimately, he decides that he will betray Carola and collaborate with the abolitionists so that the slaves cannot be sold. For her part, Soledad will have to face her stepson, Alan from whom she must hide Edward's mental illness.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E05 - Episode 05
1.plot: Luis's death has a profound impact on all the characters, both in Cuba and in London. Mauro and Gustavo engage in a game of billiards, on which their respective futures depend. Sol decides that she and Edward must flee from London to Jerez before Alan declares her husband legally unfit and takes the entire family fortune.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E06 - Episode 06
1.plot: Mauro and Santos arrive in Jerez to take possession of their newly acquired possessions. This is where Mauro finally meets Sol, who - far from contesting what once were her family's assets - will ask Mauro to help her in a matter of life and death.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The arrival of Carola Gorostiza from Havana puts Mauro and Sol in a dilemma, and they are forced to detain her so that she cannot threaten them. But Carola will not be the only threat that our protagonists will have to face. The appearance of Alan Claydon will put Soledad's life in danger when he threatens her to get the inheritance money.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E08 - Episode 08
1.plot: After saving Sol from Alan's assault, Mauro expedites the sale of La Templanza. On the other hand, to protect Edward from her son, Soledad finds a perfect hiding place for her husband: the convent where Inés lives in seclusion. But Sol does not imagine that she has placed her husband in the hands of greater risk, since the flames of an old love will be rekindled with unforeseeable consequences.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: A terrible confrontation between Mauro and his son will cause a rupture that Carola Gorostiza will exploit to recover the possessions to which she believes she is entitled. On the other hand, Soledad - unable to accept the consequences of her love affair with Mauro - decides to flee Jerez taking her husband with her.

1.title: FR - La Templanza - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: After being responsible for the death of Santos Huesos, Alan Claydon discovers Edward's whereabouts. He commits one last desperate act and - to force Edward out - sets fire to the convent where he is staying. Sol and Mauro will risk their lives to try to save him. Will they succeed... or will they pay with their lives in the attempt?

meta.plot: As Havana slowly revolves through the year, wistful detective Mario Conde probes the sultry heart of the city to investigate dark and deadly crimes.

1.title: FR - Four Seasons In Havana - S01E01 - The Winds of Lent
1.plot: The brutal slaying of a fiery young teacher sets Conde on the trail of a drug kingpin with ties to the high school he once attended.

1.title: FR - Four Seasons In Havana - S01E02 - Past Perfect
1.plot: The investigation into a missing businessman takes a personal turn when Conde discovers that the man's wife -- and prime suspect -- is an old flame.

1.title: FR - Four Seasons In Havana - S01E03 - Masks
1.plot: The investigation into a missing businessman takes a personal turn when Conde discovers that the man's wife -- and prime suspect -- is an old flame.

1.title: FR - Four Seasons In Havana - S01E04 - Autumn Landscapes
1.plot: As a fierce hurricane bears down, Conde works to solve the murder of a former civil servant with suspicious connections to priceless works of art.

meta.plot: The hard working, kind and timid Kim Mi Young has little in the way of education, beauty or wealth, but all that changes after a fateful night of accidental passion with the spoiled, rich heir of a family company, Lee Gun. Her insignificant existence completely transforms when she finds out she is pregnant and must tie her life to his in a shot-gun wedding. The couple decides to make the best of a bad situation, but just when Lee Gun begins to show his growing affection for Kim Mi Young, his first love re-enters the picture to stake her claim.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Lee Gun who is a successful businessman was ready to propose to Sera, his girlfriend. Then he met a girl named Kim Mi Young.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Fallen into a trap, Gun and Mi Young drank beverages with drugs in it. Then they somehow entered the same hotel room.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Mi Young was shocked that she was pregnant and, to make matters worse, it was also discovered by her mother.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Having been pressured by their families, Gun and Mi Young decided to get married.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Mi Young was baffled between her mother-in-law who was absolutely sweet and Gun who was very cold to her. At last, she decided to get divorced.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the problem became worse and worse for Gun and Mi Young, Sera, the ex-girlfriend of Gun, came back to Korea.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Gun started to get anxious after seeing Mi Young with Daniel. Meanwhile, Mi Young felt betrayed by Gun.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Gun and Mi Young were perplexed when Sera made a sudden appearance in front of them.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Mi Young started to have more genuine affections with Gun and he as well became more fond of Mi Young.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Divorce papers of Gun and Mi Young's contractual marriage were disclosed to the public by the press.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Collapsed and unconscious momentarily, Gun did not recognize Mi Young and thought Sera as her lover.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Mi Young was absolutely confused with the situation that she decided to leave Korea with Daniel.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Mi Young had the successful debut of her exhibition with Daniel. Gun was completely jealous that she was with Daniel.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: Daniel finally found his missing sister and formally proposed to Mi Young.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Encountering Gun, Mi Young asked him not to visit her. But they were to collaborate together at his company.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Gun tried to go out with Mi Young again but Sera became anxious that Mi Young spent time with Gun.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Having decided to leave Korea at once, Mi Young became startled with the news that Gun had been waiting for her for three years.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Mi Young decided to stay by Gun's side. And Gun decided to resign.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Mi Young's mother persuaded Mi Young and Gun in order to break them apart. But all of a sudden, they disappeared.

1.title: FR - Fated to Love You - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: Gun and Mi Young had a great time together and what happened in Macao was about to take place for the second time.

meta.plot: The Benny Hill Show is a British comedy television show that starred Benny Hill and aired in various incarnations between 15 January 1955 and 30 May 1991 in over 140 countries. The show focused on sketches that were full of slapstick, mime, parody, and double-entendre. Thames Television cancelled production of the show in 1989 due to declining ratings and large production costs at £450,000 per show.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E02 - Chapter 2

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E03 - Chapter 3
1.plot: Harriet makes a bold fashion choice for her meeting with Wilbur and gets posing tips from a pro — but her career may be over before it's even begun.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E04 - Chapter 4
1.plot: The stakes are high for Wilbur as he hunts for Yuji's new model. Will Harriet and Nat have what it takes to walk for one of fashion's biggest names?

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E05 - Chapter 5
1.plot: Harriet and her dad arrive in Canada. The show's just hours away, but there's still time to hang out with Nick — and his jealous "girlfriend".

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E06 - Chapter 6
1.plot: Everyone wants to speak to Harriet at the party, which amps her anxiety up to 11. Meanwhile, Nick confronts Poppy, and Yuji makes a decision.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E07 - Chapter 7
1.plot: Harriet struggles with how to break the news to Nat. But when she gets back to school she learns that Nat — and everyone else — knows the whole story.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E08 - Chapter 8
1.plot: After an unsuccessful detour, the Manners family head to the perfume shoot. Poppy makes an announcement on social media, and Harriet posts her own video.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E09 - Chapter 9
1.plot: While Harriet tries to put her social slip-up behind her, chaos reigns at Infinity. Nick arrives at school as the students prepare for the talent show.

1.title: FR - Geek Girl - S01E10 - Chapter 10
1.plot: Harriet resolves to stay true to herself, no matter what. When Wilbur visits the Manners', they all hatch a plan to get Harriet back on the catwalk.

meta.plot: Awkward teen Harriet has always wanted to fit in. Until she gets scouted by a top London model agent and learns that some people are meant to stand out.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Vincent's son Edgar has an idea for Good Day Sunshine's new puppet. But before he can convince his father, the boy disappears on the way to school.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Vincent's convinced that bringing Eric to life will help his son come home. Detective Ledroit makes an arrest, while Cassie has her own suspicions.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: While Vincent frantically gets ready for the pitch, Ledroit arrives with some more questions for him. Cassie meets the mother of another missing child.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Following shocking news from both Lennie and Cassie, Vincent continues to spiral — until he sees a sign from Edgar and hatches a new plan.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: edroit makes headway in both investigations. Cassie gets a phone call that changes everything, and Vincent continues to follow the map.

1.title: FR - Eric - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the city's unhoused people are forced onto the street, Vincent meets the one with answers. An old friend helps Ledroit bring buried evidence to light.

meta.plot: A desperate father battles his demons on the vibrant, dangerous, and intoxicating streets of '80s New York in a race to bring home his missing son.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E01 - The Pecking Order
1.plot: One by one, a hundred contestants arrive in a room filled with plaster torsos of their competitors. The first challenge is introduced.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E02 - Lose It and You Lose
1.plot: After the test of their basic physical abilities, the contestants pair off and go head-to-head in the next round — with each bout’s loser going home.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E03 - One You Wish to Avoid
1.plot: The fight to stay in the competition continues. Contestants find ways of defying their own physical limitations in order to beat opponents.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E04 - The Underdogs
1.plot: After the winners celebrate and bond over their shared athleticism, they're split into groups for the next round. Who will form the strongest team?

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E05 - The Uninvited Guests
1.plot: Teams engage in a multi-step challenge to test strategy, synergy and strength. Those who survive the intense game are met with a surprise.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E06 - The Weight of Survival
1.plot: The competition gets heated as the winners move on to the next round, where they'll be required to form alliances.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E07 - The Possibility of the Impossible
1.plot: It's every man for himself in the following trial. Who will manage to survive and come out victorious?

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E08 - A Merciless Punishment
1.plot: A step closer to the finals, the determined remaining competitors give their all to make it to the top five.

1.title: FR - Physical: 100 - S01E09 - 1/100
1.plot: The finalists share stories of their life journeys over a feast. They face their last set of games for the finale, each more demanding than the last.

meta.plot: In this fierce fitness competition, one hundred contestants in top physical shape compete to claim the honor of best body.

Every last Thursday of the month at an all-girls high school, the students of Class 2–5 cast their votes in a popularity poll. The results classify them into Grades A, B, C, D, and F. If they fall into Grade F, they become legitimate victims of school violence.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E01 - Sung Soo Ji: The Transfer Student
1.plot: Soo Ji transfers to Baekyeon Girls’ High School and discovers that her class plays a game called the Pyramid Game in which the students decide on a hierarchy based on a popular vote. As Soo Ji ends up in the lowest rank, she devises a plan to get back on her feet.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E02 - The Mastermind of the Pyramid Game
1.plot: Soo Ji is determined to figure out the characteristics of her classmates and the mastermind behind the Pyramid Game. She also tries to join forces with other girls who seem vulnerable. She even asks her homeroom teacher for help, only to be disappointed. Meanwhile, the 14th Pyramid Game begins, and Ja Eun, who kept skipping school, shows up.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E03 - The Birth of a Trio
1.plot: Soo Ji moves up to Grade C, and the treatment she gets changed completely overnight. She breaks the promise she made with Ja Eun, but she decides to join hands with her and help the new girl in Grade F, Pyo Ji Ae. Soo Ji, Ja Eun, and Ji Ae come up with a plan to destroy the pyramid altogether.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E04 - The Leaked Plan
1.plot: Soo Ji begins to feel uneasy about the unfolding events, suspecting that her plan may have been compromised and that Ha Rin is catching on. Learning this, Pyo Ji Ae worries she may have made a mistake and dreads the potential consequences. Meanwhile, Soo Ji hints to Hae Jun that she holds leverage over her, coercing Hae Jun into assisting her. Soo Ji recruits a hacker to join her team.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E05 - Parent Observation Day
1.plot: During the parents' visit to the school, Soo Ji gets caught up in Ha Rin's trap. While Soo Ji tries to make a pact with Do Ah,  Seung Yi puts on a show to put Soo Ji on the spot. Although the parents witness the ordeal, Ha Rin turns the situation to her advantage and even has her grandmother, the chairwoman of Baekyeon Group. Meanwhile, Soo Ji switches to her Plan B.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E06 - Tables Turned
1.plot: With no Grade F in the 15th game, Soo Ji changes gears to eliminate the game with Ye Lim's help. First, she suggests voting to revoke Grade A privileges and puts Ha Rin on the spot. Meanwhile, Ha Rin doesn't give in to Soo Ji's hindrances and thinks of a plan to demolish Soo Ji's game.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E07 - Shattering Friendship
1.plot: Baekyeon Girls’ High School goes on a school retreat. While practicing diving, someone pushes Ha Rin into the water, and Ja Yeon jumps in to save her. The next day, Class Five plays a survival game using paint guns. The last five standing, Soo Ji, Ja Eun, Jae Hyung, Eun Jung, and Ji Ae are put in danger of ending up in Grade F.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E08 - The Majority
1.plot: Soo Ji decides to recruit more girls to end the game and Ha Rin for good. When Da Yeon is about to be punished for what she did to Eun Jung, their teacher tells everyone that Da Yeon has to transfer to another school. Meanwhile, right before the Pyramid Game is held, Ye Lim gets taken to the hospital.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E09 - The Final Vote
1.plot: The 16th Pyramid Game begins, and Ha Rin suggests choosing a classmate who will become a permanent Grade F. Before the voting takes place, Soo Ji tells the class that Ye Lim was attacked and hospitalized. The class decides to vote on whether to stay. playing or not, and the entire process is broadcast live, causing the school to be in an uproar. Meanwhile, Ja Eun tells Soo Ji what she did to Ha Rin when they were little.

1.title: FR - Pyramid Game - S01E10 - The Verdict
1.plot: Ja Eun reveals what she used to do to Ha Rin, but Soo Ji thinks Ha Rin is just using it as an excuse to make Ja Eun's life miserable. The school and Baekyeon Group decide to blame Soo Ji and her group for the violence at school, but Ms. Yoon Na Hee takes action and reveals the video of Soo Ji being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ji reveals the corruption behind the teacher recruitment.

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E05 - Episode 5

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E06 - Episode 6

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E07 - Episode 7

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E08 - Episode 8

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E09 - Episode 9

1.title: FR - Mindhunter - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E09 - Episode 9
2.plot: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

meta.plot: V.C. Andrews' Landry Family follows Ruby Landry, who after being raised by her loving spiritual healer grandmother in the Louisiana bayou, is ensnared in a world of dark family secrets and betrayal, upon discovering that she has another family living in New Orleans.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E01 - Ruby
1.plot: Watched over by her loving Grandmère Catherine, Ruby Landry is filled with hope as love blooms with her high school sweetheart Paul Tate, but lingering thoughts of her mysterious father and her mother's death often creep into Ruby's mind. As dark family secrets begin to reveal themselves when Paul's parents forbid him from seeing Ruby, Ruby is further devastated when her beloved Grandmère passes away. Forced to flee to New Orleans from the Bayou, Ruby searches for her estranged father, one of the richest men in the city, as she clings to her memories of Paul and their forbidden love.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E02 - Pearl in the Mist
1.plot: Pearl in the Mist finds Ruby still struggling to find true happiness, after a year of living at her father's lavish mansion. When Ruby and her twin Giselle are sent away to an exclusive all girls boarding school, Ruby is hopeful for a new start with her sister. But when Ruby is once again shamed for her backwater upbringing, and her cruel Headmistress, Mrs. Ironwood, along with her stepmother Daphne and Giselle continue to plot against her, Ruby must endure torturous punishments and public humiliation. Ruby holds out hope and continues to dream of a better future until tragedy leaves her alone in a world of deceits.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E03 - All That Glitters
1.plot: All That Glitters picks up as Ruby is driven from the Dumas mansion and returns to her beloved childhood home in the bayou where she's intent on creating a new life for her baby girl, Pearl. Ruby's high school sweetheart, Paul, once again is there to support her, and when he moves her into his impressive home, she has new hope for the future. However, Ruby can't escape the judging eyes of Paul's mother Gladys who knows Ruby and Paul's dark secret and Giselle continues to torment Ruby when she reveals news about Beau, Pearl's real father and Ruby's true love. Ruby longs for another life. The web of deceit continues when Giselle falls into a coma and Ruby finds herself lured into a twisted plan to be with Beau.

1.title: FR - V.C. Andrews' Landry Family - S01E04 - Hidden Jewel
1.plot: Hidden Jewel finds Ruby trying to find a new life for her children and desperate to protect her beloved daughter from the dark secrets she harbors. Raised amidst the privileges in New Orleans, Pearl aspires to become a doctor, but when an unfortunate accident occurs to one of her twin brothers, Pearl's dreams are threatened and Ruby runs, once again back to the bayou. And when one of Pearl's younger brothers becomes deathly ill, she must journey to the backwaters to find her mother and uncover the mysterious secrets of her past.

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Seven very different strangers begin their community payback sentences, renovating a derelict building in Bristol. But can any of these ‘outlaws’ really reform?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The outlaws find a bag of cash, clearly the proceeds of crime. But who does it belong to?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The outlaws find themselves in choppy waters. A campaigner is rejected by the very cause to which she dedicated her life, and a decision is made about the outlaw’s sudden windfall.

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A lifelong scoundrel reflects on his past mistakes, the police recruit a surprising new deputy, and a young woman makes a decision which could endanger the lives of all of the outlaws. Can the outlaws launder their dirty money before the gangsters track them down?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The outlaws must hustle on two fronts — with a captain of industry, and a member of the landed gentry. An audacious break-in is planned, and an imposter is heartbreakingly exposed.

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Even with redemption seemingly in reach, the outlaws find their time running out, and the net closing around them. They face a stark choice — die apart, or survive together?

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: The Outlaws are moving on with their lives, but Rani’s shock return and the discovery of a dead body sends them hurtling back into mortal danger.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: As the police investigate the crime and Rani's involvement, the other outlaws don't know who they can trust.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Whilst Gabby considers motherhood, the Dean's defence is winning his case, and the police are closing in on the gang. Can the outlaws clear their names before it's too late?

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: The outlaws unmask a traitor. Whilst reconciling their personal battles, they plan an audacious heist to steal evidence and take down the Dean.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: The outlaws must race against time to prove their innocence and keep the Dean behind bars. Will they finally be able to free themselves from a life of crime?

meta.plot: Seven strangers from different walks of life - people who would never normally interact - are forced to work together to renovate a derelict community centre. They resent the menial physical labour and they resent each other. But when one of their number gets dragged into a dangerous world of organised crime, they unite in ways none of them thought possible.
When a 17-year-old reports a sexual assault at her high school, an investigation upends her life and tests her relationships.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: At 17, Alma is going through a tough time. One day, she shocks her high school with a banner reporting a sexual predator within its walls.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E02 - Ground Zero
1.plot: While her parents frantically search for her, Alma's night out morphs into a blur of disappointment. An unexpected person catches Alma off guard.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E03 - I Do Believe You, Sister
1.plot: As Alma grapples with disturbing flashbacks, Greta meets a captivating new acquaintance. Nata delves into her darker side.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E04 - A**hole Baby
1.plot: Cryptic online messages torment Alma with memories she'd prefer to forget. A heartfelt conversation brings two friends closer.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E05 - 8M
1.plot: As Alma and her mother make plans to celebrate International Women's Day, Nata's bond with Alberto is shaken. Greta's actions put her family at risk.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E06 - Berta
1.plot: At the hospital, Alma encounters a familiar face, who reveals something terrible. Nata stands her ground as Greta comes clean to David.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E07 - How to Hunt a Sexual Predator
1.plot: Alma and Berta devise a plan to expose the school's dark underside. Nata gains a fresh perspective, using it to her advantage.

1.title: FR - Raising Voices - S01E08 - Blood or Tears
1.plot: Authorities begin an investigation into the abuse allegations made online. Amid skepticism and a profound loss, Alma takes justice into her own hands.

meta.plot: In the Warring States Period of ancient China (475–221 BCE), Shin and Hyou are war-orphans in the kingdom of Qin. They dream of one day proving themselves on the battlefield. One day, however, Hyou is taken to the palace by a minister. Winding up on the losing side of a power-struggle, Hyou manages to return to the village, barely alive. Shin then meets a boy who closely resembles Hyou, Ei Sei. For now he is the king of Qin; later he will become the emperor Shi Huangdi.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E01 - The Boy With No Name
1.plot: Shin and Hyou are two slaves who have grown as sword training buddies and pseudo brothers with a common dream of growing up to be great generals.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E02 - Fated Meeting
1.plot: Xin discovers Ying Zheng, the young King of Qin, who's fleeing his half-brother's uprising. Piao's killer arrives to murder Ying Zheng. Xin, who's learned that Piao died serving as Zheng's stand-in, must decide which to help and which to kill.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E03 - Friend!
1.plot: Xin and Zheng entrust their escape to young Diao, who knows a secret way out of Heibei Village. Xin still blames Zheng for Piao's death, and even as this simmering conflict boils over, a new and deadly pursuer takes up the chase.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E04 - The King and the Sword
1.plot: Fleeing pursuit, Zheng and Xin struggle with exhaustion and with each other. When they reach the appointed meeting site, there's no sign of Zheng's sole supporter, Lord Changwen . . . and the murderous tracker Mu Ta is hot on their trail.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E05 - An Unbreakable Heart
1.plot: Xin, who's vowed in the name of his own ambitions to help the King, must singlehandedly face the treacherous assassin Mu Ta. Meanwhile, General Wang Yi brings a piece of tribute to the Court that seems to spell the end for all young King Zheng's hopes.

1.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S01E06 - The Path to a Great General
1.plot: Xin hears a tale of Piao's heroism during Wang Yi's ambush, but he also learns that King Zheng has even fewer allies than he'd been told. With little time left to forestall a civil war, Zheng decides on a dangerous path, to seek out unlikely allies.

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E01 - New Era
2.plot: Former servant Xin now commands 300 troops in the formidable Fei Xin Force--and the big battle he's itching for may be right around the corner.

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E02 - A Quiet Battlefield
2.plot: Zhao's master tactician Li Mu is forced into negotiations with Qin's crafty Lü Buwei. What will the outcome mean for the future of their kingdoms?

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E03 - A Tumultuous Banquet
2.plot: Xin confronts Li Mu, the man who orchestrated Wang Yi's battlefield defeat, while Diao touches base with Kaine. Zheng reveals his future plans.

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E04 - Kings and Ants
2.plot: Xin gets a lead on a big battle that could propel him up the ranks to general, but soon learns he's not the only young, ambitious warrior around.

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E05 - A Third Force
2.plot: As the Fei Xin and Yu Feng Forces play at one-upmanship, Si Shi proposes a surprising potential ally in Zheng's power struggle with Lü Buwei.

2.title: FR - Kingdom 2019 - S02E06 - Beautiful Venom
2.plot: Zheng's supporters discuss the pros and cons of bringing the Queen Dowager onto their side, while Zheng takes matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E05 - Everything Is Copy
