meta.plot: A Las Vegas team of forensic investigators are trained to solve criminal cases by scouring the crime scene, collecting irrefutable evidence and finding the missing pieces that solve the mystery.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: It's 1995 and 11-year-old hip-hop loving Eddie Huang has just moved with his family from Chinatown in Washington D.C. to suburban Orlando. They quickly discover things are very different there. Orlando doesn't even have a Chinatown -- unless you count the Huang house.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E02 - Home Sweet Home-School
1.plot: Jessica thinks school must be too easy for the boys and gives them extra homework; Louis tries to get Jessica to ease up on her strict approach.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E03 - The Shunning
1.plot: When the cul-de-sac plans a block party to celebrate NASCAR, Louis urges the family to use the event to make new friends (and promote Cattleman’s Ranch Steakhouse). But Jessica has problems fitting in, especially after she befriends a beautiful trophy wife the roller blade moms don’t like. Meanwhile, Eddie schemes to win the respect of the neighborhood kids

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E04 - Success Perm
1.plot: A visit from Jessica's sister and her affluent husband creates out-of-control family rivalry.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E05 - Persistent Romeo
1.plot: Louis has to hire a professional instructor to give the restaurant staff a sexual harassment seminar after Jessica's attempts fall flat. Meanwhile, Eddie tries to pass off the seminar's instructional tape as a "dirty movie" to his friends in an attempt to impress them and get them to come to his house for a sleep over

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E06 - Fajita Man
1.plot: Eddie takes a job at the restaurant so he can earn money for a new video game.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E07 - Showdown at the Golden Saddle
1.plot: A billboard for the restaurant is struck by vandalism. Eddie tries to get a girl's attention.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E08 - Phillip Goldstein
1.plot: Eddie tries to befriend the only other Chinese kid in school, but he's in for a letdown after he finds out that they have nothing in common; Louis feels betrayed when Mitch accepts a job at the rival Golden Saddle.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E09 - License to Sell
1.plot: Jessica worries she can't compete with a top realtor and puts off taking the exam for her license.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E10 - Blind Spot
1.plot: Jessica's college boyfriend, Oscar Chow, comes to visit. She's a bit miffed that Louis isn't a little more jealous....but she's got a blind spot and is completely oblivious to the fact that Oscar is gay. Meanwhile, Eddie goes to great lengths to get out of the school science fair.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E11 - Very Superstitious
1.plot: Jessica’s superstitions get the best of her when she sells a house with the address 44 West 44th Street – the number 4 being bad luck in Chinese culture. At the urging of the new school counselor, Eddie decides to run for school president, but Jessica’s bad luck gets the best of him too when a white lie spirals out of control.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E12 - Dribbling Tiger, Bounce Pass Dragon
1.plot: Louis and Jessica get pressured into volunteering at the kids’ schools because of budget cuts. Eddie sees a whole other side of his dad when Louis – a former semi-pro basketball player back in Taiwan — coaches the basketball team, while Emery and Evan see a side of Jessica they wish they hadn't when she grudgingly takes on producing their school play, and puts her own spin on it.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E13 - So Chineez
1.plot: Jessica fears her family has assimilated so much to life in Orlando that they’ve lost their Chinese identity. So she drives everyone nuts making them reconnect with their culture, from Louis, who she insists decline an invite to join the country club, to Eddie, who she makes do a report on China for his World Day project.

meta.plot: A '90s-set single-camera comedy about a hip-hop-loving Asian kid growing up in suburban Orlando, being raised by an immigrant father obsessed with all things American and an immigrant mother often bewildered by white culture.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E01 - They Say I'm Different
1.plot: Nella meets Hazel, a new coworker at Wagner Books, who may not be exactly what she seems.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E02 - After the Storm
1.plot: After the blow up with Colin, Nella has to decide whether or not to apologize, and whether or not she can trust Hazel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E03 - I Know a Place
1.plot: Nella and Hazel try to start over, while Nella digs deeper into the mystery of Kendra Rae Phillips.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E04 - What About Your Friends
1.plot: Nella meets Diana Gordon, a famous author and her hero, and Nella invites Hazel over to meet her friends.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E05 - Don't You Want Me
1.plot: A leak of Colin’s book causes pandemonium at Wagner, and tensions boil over between Nella and Vera.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E06 - Fake Smile
1.plot: As Hazel maneuvers her way deeper into Nella's life, Nella begins to feel overwhelmed by mounting responsibility at work and growing suspicion of Hazel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E07 - Caught in the Rapture
1.plot: Hazel invites Nella and Malaika to her house for a girls' night, but the more of Hazel's life they see, the more uneasy they feel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E08 - The End of Love
1.plot: Nella's worst fears begin to come true as she tries to put all the pieces together before the launch of Diana's new imprint.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E09 - To Be Young, Gifted and Broke
1.plot: We learn more about Hazel and exactly what happened in Boston.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E10 - Down with Disease
1.plot: Nella faces the ultimate decision and must choose between everything she's worked for and the safety of everyone she loves.

meta.plot: Nella, an editorial assistant, is tired of being the only black girl at her company, so she’s excited when Hazel is hired. But as Hazel’s star begins to rise, Nella spirals out and discovers something sinister is going on at the company.

meta.plot:
Babar is a Canadian/French/Japanese animated television series produced in Quebec, Canada by Nelvana Limited and The Clifford Ross Company. It premiered in 1989 on CBC and HBO, subsequently was rerun on HBO Family and Qubo. The series is based on Jean de Brunhoff's original Babar books, and was Nelvana's first international co-production. The series' 78 episodes have been broadcast in 30 languages in over 150 countries. Episodes of Babar currently air on Ion Television and Qubo.

While the French author Laurent de Brunhoff pronounces the name Babar as "BUH-bar", the TV series in its first five seasons pronounces the name as "BAB-bar".

In 2010, a computer-animated sequel series spin-off of Babar titled Babar and the Adventures of Badou was launched. The new series focuses on a majority of new characters.

1.plot: This story begins to tell the classic tale of Babar's early life with his mother and all the other elephants in the jungle, and how his life is shattered when a hunter kills his Mother and he must cope on his own.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E03 - Babar Returns
1.plot: Babar leaves the Old Lady and City to return to the jungle so he can bring the other elephants his newfound knowledge. However, he discovers that despite the fact that his old friends are still running from the Hunter, they resist trying out any of his â€˜new' ideas.

1.plot: When Babar organizes a world class ballet to be performed in Celesteville, the star of the show, a temperamental prima ballerina, makes problems for his friends in the cast and crew and turns Babar's production into a disaster.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E11 - To Duet Or Not to Duet
1.plot: Babar is scheduled to perform a duet with a great pianist at a concert. However, he refuses to admit that the piece of music is too hard for him, so he procrastinates practicing until he feels so guilty that it begins to affect his job as King.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E12 - The Missing Crown Affair
1.plot: When Babar's crown goes missing, amateur sleuth Zephir decides to help Babar solve the mystery. However they both get panicky when all the clues point out that Babar's closest friends stole the crown as the first step to taking over his kingdom.

1.title: FR - Babar - S01E13 - The Phantom
1.plot: When Babar discovers that the â€˜Phantom' in an abandoned theater is really a lonely Old Musician who lives there, Babar decides to try and help him come out of seclusion. Unfortunately, the Phantom resents the meddling and scares Babar's friends away to the point where they decide the theatre should be torn down.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E01 - A Fresh Start
1.plot: As America reckons with a pandemic and racial injustice, Bubba Wallace is moved to perform an act of resistance and make a name for himself in NASCAR.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E02 - Great Expectations
1.plot: After his bold statement on CNN, Bubba teams with an icon and a competitor.  Expectations run high at the Daytona 500 as the races comes to a fiery finish.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E03 - Driving While Black
1.plot: Feeling immense pressure to win, Bubba aims for Victory Lane in Atlanta and Bristol.  At Martinsville Speedway, he debuts a special message on his car.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E04 - The Inner Voice
1.plot: Bubba reveals his struggle with depression amid personal rough patches on and off track.  A disturbing discovery leads to a show of NASCAR unity.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E05 - The Road to Success
1.plot: After the results of an FBI investigation open Bubba to more criticism, road courses in Austin and Sonoma present their own set of challenges.

1.title: FR - Race: Bubba Wallace - S01E06 - Engine of Change
1.plot: With sponsors lined up and several races left in the season, Bubba tries to manage his emotions and make the playoffs as NASCAR works to embrace change.

meta.plot: This docuseries follows Bubba Wallace, the only Black driver currently in NASCAR's Cup Series, as he uses his voice and talent to change the sport.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Hungry Christine; Mel Loves Ruby
1.plot: Roarke welcomes a local morning show host, Christine Collins, who has a simple fantasy: she wants to eat. And eat. And eat. But when Christine gets to Fantasy Island, she'll realize that she's hungry for much more than food. Roarke's other guests include Ruby Akuda who is afflicted with a terminal illness and is given a new lease on life.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - His and Hers; The Heartbreak Hotel
1.plot: Two adventurers, whose marriage has grown stale want to have the ultimate adventure together. Meanwhile, after sleeping for 35 years, widower Brent, must decide if he is ready to face his grief awake.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Quantum Entanglement
1.plot: Flamboyant, eccentric Eileen wants to spend time with her estranged daughter and her family, but they refuse to see her. Disillusioned physics professor Charles wants to know if there is something more out there.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Once Upon a Time in Havana
1.plot: Percussionist Alma wants to be accepted by her tight-knit Cuban family, but to understand why they disapprove of her musical career, she must revisit their history.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Big Five Oh
1.plot: When old friends Nettie, Camille and Margot come to the island to celebrate their 50th birthdays, their fantasies expose fault lines in their friendship.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - The Romance & the Bromance
1.plot: A bookworm who wants to say yes to life goes back in time to meet her favorite author, and a competitive survivalist learns that the ultimate challenge is something he hasn’t trained for.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Día del los Vivos
1.plot: A young artist Ramon wants to see his mentor, Jasper, again and Jasper realizes he may not have been the best influence on Ramon.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Welcome to the Snow Globe (1)
1.plot: A businesswoman's fantasy of a perfect Christmas and to meet "Mr. Right" tests Roarke in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Mr. Jones faces his past, while a new Secret Santa tradition has Ruby and Javier looking to the future.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Welcome to the Snow Globe (2)
1.plot: A businesswoman's fantasy of a perfect Christmas and to meet "Mr. Right" tests Roarke in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Mr. Jones faces his past, while a new Secret Santa tradition has Ruby and Javier looking to the future.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Tara and Jessica's High School Reunion; Cat Lady
2.plot: Longtime best friends, Tara and Jessica, want to rule their 30th High School Reunion, but their plans go sideways when everyone is forced to tell the truth. Andi wants to know if her cat BoBo loves her as much as she loves him. Roarke juggles a secret romance, as Ruby and Gina spend more time together.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Hurricane Helene; The Bachelor Party
2.plot: In the wake of her mother’s passing, Helene visits the island in search of her biological father. Roarke and Javier grow closer. Ruby gives herself a spiritual cleanse with a bonfire and a night swim, where she encounters an old friend.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Paymer vs. Paymer
2.plot: Empty nesters Dolly and Dutch seek clarity on how to spend their next chapter. Meanwhile, Helene helps Ruby tap into her newfound youth. Javier opens up to Roarke as he wrestles with his new role.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Mystery in Miami
2.plot: Three best friends set out to track down the missing fourth member of their squad... in 1980s Miami, Roarke confides in Segundo about letting people in, Ruby's cabin fever is an itch that needs to be scratched.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - The Urn
2.plot: After an urn comes off the plane, three siblings must work through their past resentments in order to spread their mom's ashes and fulfill her last fantasy. As the kids wrestle with their past, Roarke remembers their mom, her very first guest as the host of Fantasy Island. Meanwhile, Ruby is surprised to discover how little she knows about Isla.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Forever and a Day
2.plot: Oliver's fantasy is to surprise his boyfriend Emilio with the perfect proposal, but when Emilio says no, Oliver finds himself reliving that day over and over again. Meanwhile, Roarke, also caught in the time loop, must confront her fears about her relationship with Javier.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - #Happy
2.plot: Amber's fantasy is to have her actual life be as perfect as her Instagram life. But when Amber's family transforms into the perfect Insta-versions of themselves, she soon realizes something about all this perfection is very wrong. Meanwhile, Roarke presents another guest, Isaiah, with an envelope that reveals the date of his death.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E08 - Walk a Country Mile
2.plot: A country music star with writer's block, Shay, fantasizes about being anonymous so she can focus on finishing her next album. Her beleaguered assistant, Beau, is surprised when Roarke offers him a fantasy too. When their fantasies begin, Shay and Beau realize they've traded places: Shay is a complete unknown and Beau is the star. Javier learns something new about Helene's life before her mother's death.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E09 - Gwenivere of Glendale
2.plot: Gwen's fantasy is to go back in time and be the Princess she longs to be—pampered, rich, and cared-for. At first, the fantasy is everything she dreamed of—the gowns, the pageantry, everyone bowing to her. But Gwen soon finds out the King is preparing to marry her off to a cruel, ambitious Prince. With the marriage looming, Gwen has no choice but to flee. She befriends a Soldier and together they hatch a dangerous escape plan. Ruby isn't feeling like herself and Roarke suspects it has something to do with Isla.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E11 - Peaches & the Jilted Bride
2.plot: Jilted bride Laura arrives on the island still in her wedding dress, having just been stood up at the altar. She's never felt worse in her entire life, and her fantasy is to just feel better. The Island surprises her with her childhood imaginary friend, Peaches, in real human form and helps Laura rediscover that her inner child is exactly who she needs to move on from her heartache. Isla tells Ruby about the complicated past between her people and the Roarkes.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E12 - Girlboss, Interrupted
2.plot: The Island gives single mom Courtney the ability to read minds in order to impress her charismatic boss, Julia. But when Courtney becomes overwhelmed with her new power, she risks everything she has worked so hard for. Meanwhile, Roarke is worried that Ruby is becoming more and more distant and enlists Javier to help.

2.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S02E12 - Girlboss, Interrupted
2.plot: The Island gives single mom Courtney the ability to read minds in order to impress her charismatic boss, Julia. But when Courtney becomes overwhelmed with her new power, she risks everything she has worked so hard for. Meanwhile, Roarke is worried that Ruby is becoming more and more distant and enlists Javier to help.

meta.plot: Sur une île paradisiaque, des vacanciers vivent un incroyable séjour. Les événements, qui ne se déroulent jamais comme prévu, les amènent à se remettre en question. Ils ignorent encore à quel point le voyage dans ce cadre magique va les transformer. Ces personnes de passage partagent leurs histoires émouvantes et leurs rêves. Intendante de cette île mystérieuse, Elena Roarke a mis de côté ses propres ambitions - et même l’amour de sa vie - pour préserver l’héritage de sa famille.

meta.plot: In February 2022, at the turn of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, therapist Lydia is trying to divorce her husband. Instead of following her daughter’s advice and fleeing the country, Lydia starts helping strangers, becoming a source of transport.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E01 - Outlaws
1.plot: When Robyn Loxley's life is turned upside down by a police shooting, she turns to her friends, from underground rappers to daring outlaws, to save her mother's life from John Prince and the Sheriff.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E02 - Beast
1.plot: After stealing Prince's car and saving her mother from the Sheriff, Robyn hopes the worst is behind her, until the Sheriff shows up in Sherwood under an umbrella of surveillance drones, using them to identify suspects and lock down the community.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E04 - Dope
1.plot: When John Prince bribes a pharmaceutical magnate to cut off Sherwood's medical supplies, he threatens Tressie's delicate health and drives Robyn and The Hood to a daring heist.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E05 - Rager
1.plot: When Chet Prince mistreats Alan's friend Elmore, Robyn and The Hood decide to crash his birthday party and steal from the richest playboy in town.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E06 - Peace
1.plot: Lionheart Day kicks off with a surprise as John Prince offers to bargain with Tressie over Sherwood's future; while Tressie and Prince negotiate, Robyn starts to suspect things are not what they seem when Guy Gisbourne returns to crash the party.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E07 - Joint
1.plot: The sheriff imprisons Robyn and her friends in a black site, determined to uncover The Hood by any means necessary; Prince pressures the mayor; Robyn puts her faith in a dowdy social worker who seems completely out of her depth.

1.title: FR - Robyn Hood - S01E08 - Sieged
1.plot: With Prince's purchase of Sherwood complete, the Sheriff gives Robyn and her friends mere hours to evacuate; instead, Robyn joins forces with Tressie, Jill and her neighbors to make a final stand against the Sheriff.

meta.plot: Follows Robyn Loxley and anti-authoritarian masked hip-hop band, The Hood, as they call out injustices and fight for freedom and equality in the city of New Nottingham.

A gifted woman's intellect brings chance to lead covert European police force. But it backfires, costing her everything. Following murder at her home and kidnapped heiress, her ex-supervisor enlists a policeman's aid to reinstate her.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E01 - A Leap
1.plot: Antonia Scott is the most intelligent woman in the world –a virtue and a curse at the same time. Her intelligence allowed her to become the "Red Queen" of a secret experimental police project. But a personal tragedy removed her from active duty. Now, Jon Gutiérrez, a police officer in trouble, has to get her out of her seclusion to solve a case that will put her abilities and her past to the test.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E02 - A Tattoo
1.plot: Ezequiel has assassinated Álvaro Trueba and has kidnapped Carla Ortiz, both the firstborn of the most powerful families in Spain. Jon agrees to be Antonia's squire. Even though they started off with the wrong foot, they're about to catch Ezequiel after a fast-paced chase that has everyone on edge. In her cell, Carla finds out that she is not Ezequiel's only prisoner.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E03 - A Pill
1.plot: Antonia and Jon have barely started and they have already got the Kidnapping Unit, Ramón Ortiz, Laura Trueba and the shadow leader of Reina Roja, Mentor, against them. During the course of the investigation, everyone lies. Antonia and Jon realize that what Ezequiel has asked of Ortiz and Trueba is an admission of guilt. But Ezequiel is always one step ahead and now his threat looms over Antonia.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E04 - A Spanish Tortilla
1.plot: Antonia wakes up alone facing a mural. Why didn't Ezequiel kill her? The assassin wanted to deliver a message. A message that leads Antonia and Jon to a taxi car and to discover the true identity behind Ezequiel. The Kidnapping Unit has also found Ezequiel's address and taxi car, but Antonia notices that the pieces don't fit together as neatly...

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E05 - A Choice
1.plot: Antonia and Jon find out Ezequiel's daughter is helping him, but things don't add up. They have committed too many mistakes. But when the Kidnapping Unit falls into a trap, they realize they weren't mistakes. Carla discovers the truth about the kidnapped woman in the other cell. Jon makes a blunder that causes Mentor to close the case and remove Antonia from her position as the Spanish Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E06 - A Disguise
1.plot: Antonia's father accuses her of kidnapping her own son and is about to get her arrested, but Jon helps her escape. Alone and with all the city police behind her, Antonia seeks to hide in order to think of a rescue plan for her child. With the help of her memories, her mind, her old friends... and a costume, Antonia is about to take on the most important mission of her life.

1.title: FR - Reine rouge - S01E07 - A Mirror
1.plot: Jon and Antonia get back together. The Queen and her squire have little time left and must go to underground tunnels riddled with traps and bombs. Sandra and Ezequiel are waiting for them and the lives of Jorge and Carla are at stake. But Antonia knows this is not over. Sandra is not who she says she is, but just a prophet of someone more powerful who already destroyed what Antonia loved most.

1.plot: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E02 - The Reason You're Going to Hell.
1.plot: Yee-jae doesn't understand why he's being punished and protests as he continues to face Death's retribution.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E03 - Death Can't Take Anything Away.
1.plot: As he continues to undergo Death's unpredictable trials, Yee-jae decides to take steps to prepare for his next life, unbeknownst to Death.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E04 - The Reason You're Afraid of Death.
1.plot: Death mocks humans, asserting that they desperately struggle to live only after they have died. In this life, Yee-jae reunites with someone he's missed dearly.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E05 - It Is Impossible to Break Free and Fight against Death.
1.plot: Death warns that it will intervene if Yee-jae ever attempts to kill someone, but Yee-jae dismisses the warning as he prepares his revenge.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E06 - Memory
1.plot: Yee-jae plans to accomplish what the world has failed to do, while Tae-u begins his counterattack.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E07 - Opportunity
1.plot: Yee-jae realizes that no matter how many times he's reborn, it's meaningless if he doesn't live as himself.

1.title: FR - Le Jeu de la Mort - S01E08 - Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.
1.plot: Just one final bullet remains. Will Yee-jae be able to evade death and survive?

meta.plot: Blanca Ferrando is a young woman who became blind at the age of twelve, due to a dramatic fire in which her older sister Beatrice died and which was caused by her violent boyfriend, Sebastian. This tragedy made her develop a very strong sense of justice to the point of pushing her to join the police. Blanca is helped by her most trusted friends: her guide dog Linneo, a female bulldog who protects and comforts her in the most difficult moments, and her beautician friend, Stella. After overcoming her work challenges, she finds herself facing sentimental ones: torn between two men, Inspector Michele Liguori, a man of many secrets, and Nanni, a young cook.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E01 - Eyeless
1.plot: The San Teodoro police station in Genoa is turned upside down by the arrival of Blanca, the new intern with blindness and incredible intuition.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E02 - Ghosts
1.plot: The body of a boy is found in an ancient noble palace that belongs to the family of Liguori, Blanca's charming colleague.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E03 - I dance by myself
1.plot: Just when Blanca tries to convince herself that she doesn't care about Liguori, having discovered his relationship with journalist Marinella, her son disappears.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E05 - Spots
1.plot: The disappearance of a young doctoral student in engineering reopens a loose end in Liguori's past and brings to the surface his conflicted relationship with his mother.

1.title: FR - Blanca - S01E06 - Going back home
1.plot: The new case Blanca is investigating interests her closely: it concerns Carmine Russo, the father of the boy she had indicated as her sister's murderer.

FR - Creepshow - S03E01 - Mums / Queen Bee
3.plot: Jack’s life is upended when his mother is taken from him, but her garden leaves him more to remember her by than he first thought. Trenice and her friends are obsessed with pop star Regina. When they hear she has been admitted to a local hospital, they take the chance to try to meet Regina in person… but she’s even more larger-than-life than they imagined.

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E02 - Skeletons in the Closet / Familiar
3.plot: Lampini loves movies more than anything, and can’t wait to show off his prop collection to the world… but when a rival collector arrives, the machetes and chainsaws could become more than just props. A drunken visit to a psychic leaves Jackson on edge. As time goes on, he realizes he is being followed by a dark force… will the psychic’s advice help, or leave him worse off?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E03 - The Last Tsuburaya / OK I'll Bite
3.plot: An art collector purchases the last painting from an artist famous for creating terrifying works, but he never anticipated the ways the painting would change his life. Life in prison is tough, and Elmer’s pet spiders make him an easy target on the cell block. Luckily, when Elmer reaches a breaking point, he knows at least his 8-legged friends will have his back.

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E04 - Stranger Sings / Meter Reader
3.plot: Barry can’t believe his luck when a cute girl invites him to her place for a drink, but he quickly learns he was duped by a siren and he’s in for way more than he bargained for. When a demonic pandemic strikes, a teenager fights to keep her family safe. But when she realizes they may have been infected, can she find the strength to fight the Devil’s plague?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E05 - Time Out / The Things in Oakwood's Past
3.plot: Tim finds the answer to always wishing there were more hours in the day, but the success he can now achieve might not be worth the cost. The town of Oakwood has a storied past, and the opening of a time capsule is an exciting moment of remembrance. But can a local librarian keep a darker part of the town’s history from repeating itself?

3.title: FR - Creepshow - S03E06 - Drug Traffic / A Dead Girl Named Sue
3.plot: A young girl and her mother must cross the border to access life-saving medication. But when they get detained and can’t access her medicine, the symptoms are much more distressing than the guards originally thought they’d be. When the dead rise from their graves, it’s every man for himself… and the local townsfolk have some justice that they’d like to serve.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E01 - Twenty Minutes with Cassandra / Smile
4.plot: Cassie is being chased by a monster, and endangers a kind stranger when she asks for help- but what can they do? Then, a celebrated photographer is tormented after an award-winning photograph has more consequences than just fame.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E02 - The Hat / Grieving Process
4.plot: A horror novelist's agent offers him help overcoming his writer's block, and the struggling author can't resist. Then, Richard's wife is attacked and becomes a shell of the woman he loved. He'll do anything to help her feel better.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E03 - Parent Deathtrap / To Grandmother's House We Go
4.plot: Lyle is a disappointment, and when his parents meddle in his life and their plan backfires, he must deal with the aftermath. Then, Marcia takes her stepdaughter to her grandmother's house to claim their inheritance, and nothing can stand in her way.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E04 - Meet the Belaskos / Cheat Code
4.plot: The Belaskos get more than they bargained for when they move in next door to a vampire-hating suburbanite. A father and son bond by playing an old video game, but soon find out there’s a reason it was abandoned.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E05 - Something Burrowed, Something Blue / Doodles
4.plot: A young couple are gifted everything they could ever wish for... but there's a catch. Then, an aspiring comic artist keeps hitting roadblocks. As she doodles away her frustrations, she realizes she might have more power than she thinks.

4.title: FR - Creepshow - S04E06 - George Romero in 3-D! / Baby Teeth
4.plot: A struggling bookstore owner finds unpublished works of George Romero, but the comics lead to new troubles. Shelby’s mom struggles to accept that her baby is growing up, but hanging on to childhood relics isn’t as harmless as she thinks.

meta.plot: A young boy's horror comic book comes to life in this anthology series of terrifying tales.

40-year old political leader Birgitte Nyborg secures her party a landslide victory through her idealism and huge effort, then faces the biggest challenge of her life: how most effectively to use the newly won seats, and how far she is willing to go in order to gain as much influence as possible.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E01 - Decency in the Middle
1.plot: Three days before an election, party leader Birgitte Nyborg shakes up her campaign by denouncing her closest ally, sensitive information about the prime minister's shopping expenses lands in the wrong hands, and the rising star of the evening news is shaken by an unexpected death.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E02 - Count to 90
1.plot: After a successful election, Birgitte Nyborg looks set to become Denmark's first female prime minister, but allies and opponents do their best to block her way.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E03 - The Art of the Possible
1.plot: A few months into her term the new prime minister faces her first political crisis, and journalist Katrine Fønsmark considers how to deal with her unexpected pregnancy.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E04 - 100 Days
1.plot: The revelation of an American prisoner transport in Greenland causes scandal upon the new government's first one hundred days in office.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E05 - Men Who Love Women
1.plot: The government's agenda on equal opportunities in corporate business brings pressure from the media as well as the country's most powerful businessman.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E06 - State Visit
1.plot: An official visit by the president of a former Soviet republic makes headlines when the president demands the arrest of a prominent political activist visiting Denmark at the same time.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E07 - See No Evil, Hear No Evil, Speak No Evil
1.plot: The discovery of illegal surveillance of a left-wing party brings into question the prime minister's friendship with the party's spokeswoman as well as her faith in her own minister of justice.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E08 - The Silly Season
1.plot: While the prime minister tries to take a family vacation, the publication of a tell-all by a former politician puts spin doctor Kasper Juul on the edge.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E09 - Divide and Rule
1.plot: Allegations of corruption in connection with military spending has consequences even for the prime minister's husband, who has accepted a new job.

1.title: FR - Borgen - S01E10 - The First Tuesday in October
1.plot: A year after taking office, the prime minister's approval ratings are low, her government is in internal conflict, and her marriage is hanging by a thread. As she prepares for another year in parliament, what can be saved?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E01 - 89,000 Children
2.plot: A year has passed since we last saw Prime Minister Birgitte Nyborg. In the season opener, Birgitte is visiting soldiers stationed in Afghanistan when their encampment is attacked, and several soldiers are killed. Now she must choose: send the troops home or stage a counterattack?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E02 - In Brussels No One Can Hear You Scream
2.plot: Prime Minister Birgitte Nyborg must appoint a new EU Commissioner. Sejro would seem the obvious choice, but Birgitte is surprised when he not only turns down the post but sees it as a personal slight. Who can she appoint?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E03 - The Last Worker
2.plot: The coalition government is preparing to introduce a new reform package - "A Common Future". But attempts to get agreement on the reforms causes Labour leader Bjørn Marrot serious problems - in the media and within his own party.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E04 - Battle Ready
2.plot: Troels Höxenhaven exploits the hijack of a Danish ship by Somali pirates to try and raise his profile. However, compromising photos of Höxenhaven turn up at the Ekspres.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E05 - Plant a Tree
2.plot: Birgitte Nyborg is about to negotiate the environmental element of the new reform package, but she must face the reality of parties unwilling to compromise. Kasper convinces her that underhanded tactics can help win her a majority for the reform. Meanwhile, Katrine receives an unusual job offer that tests her personal beliefs. And at home, Birgitte's children are clearly affected by their mother's stress; Laura in particular.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E06 - Them and Us
2.plot: Kasper's past returns to haunt him as he clears out his parents former home, whilst the Freedom Party suggest lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 12. A move that reveals fundamental differences in the coalition parties.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E07 - What is Lost Inwardly Must Be Gained Outwardly (Part I)
2.plot: Birgitte's government is losing steam -- internal differences are growing and only compromise legislation is being passed. Just as opinion polls indicate Birgitte may lose the next election, financier Joachim Crohne emerges with an idea that could save her political career. But can his motives be trusted? Meanwhile, Kasper and Katrine are growing close again, but their jobs are at odds: Katrine's role is to uncover secrets, while Kasper's is to conceal them.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E08 - What is Lost Inwardly Must Be Gained Outwardly (Part II)
2.plot: The eyes of the world are on Copenhagen and Birgitte Nyborg as peace talks draw near between North and South Kharun. Everyone has been working around the clock, and although Kasper is now living with Katrine, they rarely see each other. When Birgitte realizes Denmark is only a small piece in a major international power game, her negotiation skills are put to the test. Can she end the bloody civil war?

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E09 - The Sanctity of Private Life
2.plot: Laura's illness has worsened over the past few months, and Birgitte now feels terrible about failing to recognize it. When Laura's psychiatrist suggests admitting her to a private psychiatric hospital, Birgitte and Phillip immediately agree. This move becomes problematic when Birgitte's own tax reforms force her to pay out of pocket for the hospital cost. At home, Birgitte and Phillip are rediscovering some of their lost love, despite Philip's continued relationship with Cecilie.

2.title: FR - Borgen - S02E10 - An Extraordinary Remark
2.plot: In the season finale, Birgitte is on a month leave from her post as prime minister to focus on family, and Hans-Christian Thorsen, Labor Party chairman, has positioned himself to be her possible successor. Birgitte is torn about whether or not she will return to work. Meanwhile, as Kasper and Katrine hunt for apartments together, their plan is derailed by an argument about the possibility of having children. Will one of them relent?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E01 - A Child of Denmark
3.plot: Two and half years later, Birgitte is traveling the world out of politics when suddenly the changing Moderate Party makes her want to return. The problem is, Krause, whom she sent away to EU, is the leader of the party now, and does not want her back. Sojro however tells Birgitte to oust Krause as a leader. Birgitte hires Kathrine to help her, and they try to get the votes together so Birgitte could once again become the leader of the Moderate Party.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E02 - The Land is Built on Law
3.plot: Birgitte is keeping her plan to herself initially, but one by one she involves people. While some are enthusiastic, Sejro does not take the news well, even calling Birgitte a traitor. Meanwhile, Kathrine is struggling with the role of being a (working) mother.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E03 - The Right Shade of Brown
3.plot: Birgitte has attracted lots of followers to her party, but the policy has not been set yet and there is no money. A banker offers a donation of one million but is there a catch? Meanwhile the team is searching for a spokesperson on immigration to debate on TV and Kathrine struggles with her feelings for Kasper.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E04 - Their Loss…
3.plot: Birgitte struggles to get her party recognized particularly by other politicians, but might have a chance to change it when her boyfriend gets sick and is exposed by the media. Meanwhile, Kathrine continues to struggle with her feelings for Kasper who has difficult time understanding why her behavior has changed.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E05 - Thou Shalt Not Commit Adultery
3.plot: Being accepted as a political party, New Democrats must take a stand on a controversial issue of banning buying sex. Through learning about the issue both Birgitte and Kathrine face their prejudices and their views on the issue change as they get personally more involved. It also affects their personal relations.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E06 - Sons of the Past
3.plot: The ex-communist professor joins The New Democrats Party.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E07 - The Fall
3.plot: When the New Democrats are invited to join a broad coalition of opposition parties they think it is the recognition they have been seeking. But Birgitte soon finds she has no bargaining power whatsoever, much to Nete's disgust.

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E08 - If You Never Change Your Mind
3.plot: Birgitte quickly realizes that the New Democrats are now minor players in the opposition coalition and she pulls them out of it. The Moderates seem to be proposing things that Birgitte has privately discussed - is there a mole?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E09 - Sense and Sensibility
3.plot: After the leaks to the Moderates, Birgitte decides that the New Democrats need to distinguish themselves from the Moderates. So in a debate she launches a bold attack on their leader Jacob Kruse - will her strategy work?

3.title: FR - Borgen - S03E10 - The Election
3.plot: Kruse's outburst in the pre-election debate proves fatal to the Moderates and the New Democrats pick up more than double the predicted seats. Suddenly, Birgitte is being courted by both the left and right wing coalition groups.

meta.plot: Mehdi, a qualified robber, and Liana, an apprentice thief, get involved in a turf war between drug dealers, and have to collaborate in order to save their loved ones.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Small-time hustlers Shaïnez and Liana land in hot water with a tough Brussels drug dealer after stealing from one of his men. Anissa asks Mehdi for help.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Mehdi and his men search for the missing drugs. Chris sends the Djeblis a warning. Impressed by Mehdi's skills, Saber blackmails him into taking a job.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As they gear up for a risky heist, Mehdi and Liana's gangs join forces. Hassan confronts Saber. Coralie reveals a terrible family secret to Sofia.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A furious Chris prepares to wage war on the Djeblis — and everyone else involved in the heist. Hassan sends Danique to cover Saber's tracks.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Mehdi tries to protect Anissa and Shaïnez. Fueled by revenge, Sofia underestimates what Chris is capable of. Liana acts carelessly.

1.title: FR - Ganglands - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the war with Chris reaches a boiling point, Mehdi and Tony seek vengeance while the Djeblis plan their next move against the Antwerp enemy.

meta.plot:
Kahina Zadi, 32, a French police officer travels to Kiruna in Sweden to investigate the bestial murder of a French citizen. Together with Anders, a Swedish prosecutor of Sami origin, she begins an investigation. Soon new killings start to happen and the first victim turns out to be the tip of a very dark iceberg. The victims seemingly have nothing in common more than that they are all being killed in a well-planned and vicious manner.

In their hunt for the truth, both Kahina and Anders are forced to deal with their own past that they have repressed. A personal journey through a painful past becomes the key to succeed in preventing the violent killings that affects the small mining community of Kiruna.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The brutal murder of a French citizen sees French homicide investigator Kahina Zadi go to Kiruna, Sweden - a small town in the Arctic Circle where the sun doesn't set. Together with Rutger Burlin she begins an investigation that soon takes on staggering proportions.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kahina Zadi and Anders Harnesk are desperately looking for a connection between the bestial murder of Frenchman Pierre Carnot and the helicopter pilot Kambo. On a notice board in a shop Anders happens to see a note with Kambo’s name and the number 20 on it. A note with Carnot’s name and the number 21 is also found. Anders and Kahina realise that this is just the beginning.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: It is clear that the horrific murders committed in Kiruna are part of a hit list. Three men are already dead, and when Anders studies the murder scenes more closely he finds evidence pointing towards the Sami. If this becomes public the small mining community might be torn apart by hatred and conflict. The autopsy report shows that Chief Prosecutor Burlin was poisoned with rare herbs. Shaken, Anders visits a shaman on the mountain to find out who could supply the herbs. Noaidi gives him a name.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Injured and exhausted, Kahina is held captive by the confused and intoxicated Bangkok Jori who admits that he sold the herbs that killed prosecutor Burlin. Back in Kiruna, Kahina is approached by a threatening Frenchman who demands that she keeps him informed about everything in the investigation. Kimmo and his miner colleagues all receive a video on their mobile phones that shocks them. Someone knows what they have done.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Anders receives information about another murder, and is becoming increasingly concerned about Kahina’s whereabouts. Waiting outside the police station is a young Frenchman who claims that he is Kahina’s son. Sparen considers going to the police to tell them everything he knows, but first he calls a meeting.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Anders and Kahina find unexpected and unpleasant links between the murder victims, and some of the residents of Kiruna. Kahina’s boss in Paris orders her to report her findings directly to the mysterious Frenchman. This is no longer an ordinary murder investigation, and Kahina begins to fear for her son’s life.

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: What dark secrets did Sparen confide in the Sami girl Evelina? Kahina is determined to find Evelina’s body and sends divers down to the stream where she was last seen. The case was closed as a suicide, but there are too many clues in the investigation that lead back to her. In Eddie Geatkis’ abandoned house, Kahina and Anders find the last pieces of the puzzle in a horrific plan. But where’s Eddie?

1.title: FR - Jour Polaire - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Eddie starts a fire in the depths of the mine, as Kahina races to stop his plan coming to fruition.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E01 - The Girl with the Big Suitcase
1.plot: Jacky's daughter arrives in Kaboul. She wants to do humanitarian work, but he wants her back on the plane...

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E02 - The Swimming Pool
1.plot: Jacky's fundamentalist neighbour is outraged by what's going on at the Kabul Kitchen and gets him embroiled in a long argument with the Afghan authorities. Sophie plans to open a school for girls.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E03 - The Panther & the Printer
1.plot: Jacky's having trouble sourcing alcohol. Relations with his regular suppliers are rather tense and he has serious doubts about the seemingly easy solution that Colonel Amanullah offers by way of help.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E04 - Dollars and Passion
1.plot: When Jacky is seduced by a customer, it may have serious financial consequences for the restaurant. Sophie contacts election candidate Hamida about opening her girls' school in a poor neighbourhood.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E05 - Fear in Kaboul
1.plot: When rockets hit Kabul and the restaurant is UN blacklisted, profits take a hit so Jacky hires some mercenaries. What could possibly go wrong? Sophie wants Axel's help with the girls' school campaign.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E06 - Vice and Verses
1.plot: Colonel Amanullah asks Jacky to hide his mistress Djamila when she is discovered by his wives, but Sophie objects to Djamila's confinement in her room. Then Jacky finds himself arrested for procuring.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E07 - Sophie's Departure
1.plot: Sophie wants to return to France after the opening of her girls' school gets no publicity and few pupils turn up. Jacky fears he has cancer, but is hesitant about being treated in an Afghan hospital.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E08 - White Lies Between Friends
1.plot: Amanullah is inspired to improve his media profile when BBC reporter Nigel, an associate of Jacky, turns up. But Jacky doesn't want a journalist uncovering his connection to the drug lord colonel.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E09 - Martine in Kaboul
1.plot: Outraged by Nigel's report, in which Jacky's lifestyle is exposed, Sophie's mother Martine rushes to Kabul to ask for the child support she never received and hires an Afghan lawyer to represent her.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E10 - Crisis of Faith
1.plot: When the daughter of Hakim, Kabul Kitchen's cook, leaves the country with help from a German NGO, he turns to religion and coaxes his workmates to adhere to strict Muslim precepts, threatening profits.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E11 - Cool in Kaboul
1.plot: On election day, Jacky threatens Amanullah over the Halli brothers' deaths. Sophie is delighted to get a job at Kabul's new humanitarian association. Westerners are threatened as riots shake the city.

1.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S01E12 - Not Cool in Kaboul
1.plot: Jacky manages to get his customers evacuated from the bar - after they've paid, of course. Amanullah and Axel try to find Sophie, who's been kidnapped. Damien wants to send the riot photos to France.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E01 - Plague and Cholera
2.plot: After three months, Jacky finally 'escapes' his kidnappers, but is shocked to find a crumbling shell where Kabul Kitchen used to be and a landlord chasing unpaid rent. Can he make it a hotspot again?

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E02 - My Name Is Robert, Jacky Robert
2.plot: If Jacky's contract with the CIA seems too good to be true, that's because it is, which becomes clear when he's given his first assignment. Meanwhile, Sophie secures funding for a new sports stadium.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E03 - The Third Gulf War
2.plot: Sophie meets Amanullah's daughter Lala and admires her tenacity so much they decide to organise a female football team to help fund the stadium. CIA agent Harvey Stein is still giving Jacky headaches.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E04 - The Gangster of Kabul
2.plot: Stein arranges for a team of pole dancers to work at Kabul Kitchen as part of a plan to trap a corrupt UN official, landing Jacky in trouble with local brothel owners. Meanwhile, Sophie goes missing.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E05 - Don't Shoot the Barman
2.plot: When Damien's scoop poses a threat to the CIA, Jacky arranges for him to hide out at Habib's house while he leaks the story elsewhere. But Damien gains recompense via Habib, who has his own secrets.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E06 - The Ex-Woman of My Life
2.plot: When an ex-lover of Jacky's arrives on a diplomatic mission and insists on using Kabul Kitchen for a sensitive ministerial meeting, the CIA bug the place and Jacky struggles to balance his loyalties.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E07 - Top Secret
2.plot: Jacky finds himself working for the CIA and French secret service, who both insist on him wearing a wire to a meeting organised by Colonel Amanullah at his palace, but will he crack under pressure?

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E08 - The Locker Room of Fear
2.plot: On the day of the football final, Stein tells Jacky to inspect the contents of a briefcase in the locker room containing information relating to Amanullah's position, leading to a dangerous stand-off.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E09 - The Road to Jalalabad
2.plot: Under increasing pressure from the CIA, Jacky finds himself in need of a quick getaway, but escaping without a passport is tricky. Paul Braque has the right contacts, but wants something in return...

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E10 - The Man with the Pearl Pistol
2.plot: The CIA threaten Jacky with a one-way ticket to Guantanamo if he doesn't help with their investigation. Jacky must retrieve the murder weapon, an ivory-handled gun, but it's easier said than done.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E11 - The Traitor, the Brute and the Fiancee
2.plot: Amanullah is tipped off by a member of the Afghan police that they have the murder weapon and he's convinced one of his staff is responsible. Jacky is ordered to lure the colonel away from his palace.

2.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S02E12 - Jacky Unchained
2.plot: Amanullah vows to kill Jacky for his betrayal, sending him a warning that he will have him murdered at 6pm. With help from Habib, Jacky arranges an escape route, but will his plan be short-lived?

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E01 - I'm Jacky
3.plot: Sophie has been running Kabul Kitchen on her own since she believes her father died fleeing Kabul. When the police call her to tell her that they have arrested her father, Sophie fails to fail. At the police station, however, it is not Jacky that she discovers, but Michel, a small worldly crook who becomes encrusted in Kabul Kitchen. Amanullah comes out of prison, ruined. He had time to think in his cell. And he has a big project for his country...

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E02 - Russians and roses
3.plot: Michel receives a visit from patibular Russians: he owes them a colossal sum of money. Accused, Michel offers his services to Victor, in charge of the humanitarian program "Roses against Opium", in the hope of discreetly diverting funds. Amanullah gathers his children to announce his great project: he will be the next president of Afghanistan! Lala collapsed. Axel meets Jamal, the colonel's disabled son and the naughty duckling of the brood.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E03 - Colonel Cash Cash
3.plot: Michel convinces Amanullah to get involved in the rose program: it's good for the image of the future president. Jamal, Amanullah's disabled son, takes over the heads of the rose perfume labs. Damien learns that Sophie is pregnant, which doesn't really please him as he embarks on his new business: an extreme bus for thrill-seeking tourists. Lala, determined to keep the family tradition alive, began to traffic in arms.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E04 - Chicks and men
3.plot: The humanitarian program is stalling. Michel has a bright idea: we must organize an "Afghanton" for the benefit of drug victims. For the com', Amanullah will burn his opium production live. Habib, propelled on stage against his will, sings and makes a hit. A true Machiavelli, Amanullah's son reveals his true face.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E05 - The nose
3.plot: Michel brings from France a world-famous nose, an old friend whom Amanullah will fall madly in love with. Michel discovers Jamal's true designs: the perfume lab financed by Europe is actually a heroin lab. To please Sophie, Damien agreed to let Lala accompany her on her excursions; but Lala secretly uses her expat bus to pass the roadblocks and ferry her weapons.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E06 - Bamboo Shot
3.plot: The NGO "The Bamboo's Solution", supported by Angelina Jolie, is likely to win grants at the expense of the rose programme. Michel uses all his talents to convince the representative of the European Commission to support the roses, in vain. The Russian mobsters lend a hand to Michel: they eliminate the European official. Lala's arms trade is uncovered. Damien understands that he was fooled. Jamal, the unloved son of the Amanullah clan, takes power. The colonel is thrown out into the street.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E07 - The speech at the UN
3.plot: Amanullah is invited to give a speech at the UN. Since burning his opium in front of the cameras, the repentant drug trafficker has been a star. Problem: Amanullah has been depressed at Kabul Kitchen since he was kicked out of his palace by his son. Habib, pushed by Michel who sees it as a possible source of income, joins the cast of the "Afghan Star", the "New Star" Afghan version. There he meets Pissenlit, an attractive competitor. It's love at first sight. Problem: The girl's father is a fearsome warlord.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E08 - Afghan therapy
3.plot: Amanullah leaves Kabul, covered in shame after crying in front of the world's cameras at the UN. He takes refuge in the Mountains of Logar, at the home of Monadjat, a "war lady", a long-time friend. Axel, against Lala's advice, decides to adopt Aklamash, a 12-year-old orphan who has been following him everywhere since they met. As for Michel, he was arrested by the anti-drug squad which forced him to work together to bring down Jamal's business. For Michel, it's an opportunity to get rid of the Russians by making them take the blame.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E09 - Afghan-led robbery
3.plot: Amanullah discovers that his son Jamal is about to sell his drug to Russians. That's one too many for the colonel. He takes Michel on board to storm the heroin convoy and destroy it. Damien decided to leave Kabul without telling Sophie, who is due to give birth shortly. But on the way to the airport, Axel needs him: Lala is in danger. They all end up at the place of the deal with the Russians. But they don't know that Michel has made a deal with the police, and nothing goes according to plan... Meanwhile, Habib, threatened by Pissenlit's father, flees with his dulcinea.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E10 - Sophie's choice
3.plot: The Russians force Sophie to hand Michel over to them against Damien's release. Amanullah and Lala, deprived of the army, steal a stockpile of weapons and a mysterious safe. Victor finds himself with an international arrest warrant on his back; Jamal's heroin trafficking fell on him. Amanullah learns that Sophie and Michel are in mortal danger. The whole little "family" of Kabul Kitchen board Damien's bus to fly to their rescue.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E11 - So spoke Amanullah
3.plot: The stolen safe contains a large amount of enriched liquid uranium. If they want to sell this precious cargo and pocket $100 million, they have to go to Kandahar. The epic continues towards the mountains. So here they are not only pursued by the Russians who want Michel back, but also by Yazad who wants his safe back, and by Pissenlit's father who wants his daughter back. Suddenly, Sophie has her first contractions... The bus must stop again.

3.title: FR - Kaboul Kitchen - S03E12 - Valiant Michel
3.plot: Sophie gives birth, with the help of Michel. But the Russians caught up with the bus. Michel, the one responsible for all their problems, sacrifices himself. The Russians are recovering the uranium and Michel. The latter owes his salvation to providence... and his talent. Back in Kabul, nothing will be the way it used to be: Sophie realizes that Afghanistan is not a country to raise a child, she leaves Kabul with her daughter. Damien himself, stays, preferring the party to his new responsibilities. Sophie entrusts the Kabul Kitchen to Michel. Axel and Lala split up. As for the colonel, he embarked on the presidential campaign.

meta.plot:
Kaboul Kitchen is a French comedy television series broadcast by Canal+. It was created by Marc Victor, Allan Mauduit and Jean-Patrick Benes. The series is based on the true story of Radio France Internationale journalist Marc Victor, who ran a restaurant for French expatriates in Kabul until 2008. The first series premiered on February 15, 2012 on Canal+ and ended on March 5, 2012. It set a ratings record for comedy series in the primetime slot on Canal+. A second series, which will have 12 episodes, has been commissioned.

The series depicts the life of French expatriate Jacky who runs the popular restaurant Kaboul Kitchen in Kabul, Afghanistan. His daughter Sophie, who he has not seen in 20 years, arrives to do humanitarian work, while he is interested only in making money.

The series won two Golden FIPA Awards at the 2012 Festival International de Programmes Audiovisuels: one for Best TV Series and one for Best TV Screenplay. It was screened at MIPTV and named fourth on The Hollywood Reporter's list of "MIPTV A-List Projects" for the most promising series screened at the event.

Desperate to deal with a chronic digestive problem, stand-up comedian Blanche Gardin decides to consult a naturopath, who explains that her self-mockery on stage is sending her brain a negative message about herself. Blanche accepts this diagnosis with the faith of a new convert, decides to give up humor and embarks on the road to personal development.

Stuntman Cha Dal-geon gets involved in a tragic airplane crash and ends up discovering a national corruption scandal in the process. Go Hae-ri, the oldest daughter of a deceased marine, decides to work for the National Intelligence Service as a secret ops agent in order to support her mom and younger siblings, although all she wanted to do is to become a civil servant.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Cha Dal-geon encourages his nephew to go to Morocco with the taekwondo demonstration group. Go Hae-ri walks in late to a meeting at the Korean embassy.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Cha Dal-geon makes a disquieting announcement to the other bereaving families and implores Go Hae-ri for help, but she seems to be hiding something.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Hae-ri remains skeptical about the flight-deck voice recording but is told that the evidence points to a faulty aircraft. Dal-geon is ambushed.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dal-geon gets a call from someone out of the blue and is approached by a journalist, who claims to be pursuing a story about the plane crash.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Dal-geon attempts to alert the press about what he knows -- but someone interferes. Hae-ri contacts Gi Tae-ung to get answers about the flash drive.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The NIS takes Dal-geon to a safe house. Tae-ung questions O Sang-mi about her husband’s involvement in the plane crash but is ordered to release her.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Dal-geon sees someone who’s supposed to be dead. Hae-ri and Tae-ung head to Morocco to capture their suspect. The NIS takes Jessica Lee into custody.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Dal-geon runs into trouble while trying to carry out his own search. Tae-ung is displeased that the operation in Morocco doesn’t go as planned.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Dal-geon and the agents try to keep Kim Woo-gi alive, and request NIS backup. Jessica moves to pin the plane crash on someone else.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: After running from the embassy, Dal-geon and the others head back to Korea another way. Min Jae-sik confronts Gang Ju-cheol.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Dal-geon and Hae-ri make contact with Jae-sik. Jessica and Yun Han-gi see a big win at the National Assembly. Tae-ung undergoes scrutiny.

1.title: FR - Vagabond - S01E12 - Episode 12

The story of the Venezuelan Ilich Ramirez Sanchez known as "Carlos", who was, for almost twenty years, one of the most wanted terrorists in the world.

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Ilich Ramírez Sánchez, a Venezuelan-born militant who fought with the Palestinians in Jordan, commits a series of bombings in London. He then moves to Paris, where the PFLP (Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine) has assigned responsibility and command of its European branch to Michel Moukharbal, "Andre", a militant Lebanese. He coordinates several operations by activists from the Japanese Red Army, in particular the taking of hostages at the embassy of France in The Hague. When Andrew was arrested, the French agents of the DST begin to address Ilich, who adopts the nom de guerre Carlos. To escape arrest, Carlos kills three policemen. Then he then joins the South Yemen leader of the PFLP, Wadie Haddad, who gives him a mission of rare audacity...

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Heading up a group of six militants, consisting of leftist Revolutionary Cells of both German and Palestinian militants, Carlos takes over the OPEC building, holding hostage the ministers and their accompanying delegations. Although the terrorist is at the peak of his media fame, by releasing the ministers to Algiers airport in exchange for a large ransom, he fails in the mission entrusted to him by Wadie Haddad. This is the basis of a rupture between the two men with Carlos later becoming a mercenary in the service of the highest bidder. First Syria and then Iraq. He sets up his base on the other side of the Iron Curtain between Budapest and East Berlin under the protection of the Stasi...

1.title: FR - Carlos - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Carlos group, based in Budapest and protected by Syria, establishes ties with different customers interested in their particular expertise, such as Ceausescu's Romania and Libya. Carlos makes a fortune trafficking weapons and appears as a major figure in European terrorism. However, the fall of the Berlin Wall soon puts an end to this frantic activity. Carlos sees his supporters and his flexibility dramatically reduced. He finds refuge in Sudan, where he becomes a hunted man, being tracked by several secret services. Eventually the authorities in his home country arrest him and extradite him to France, where he must answer for his actions...

meta.plot: A troubled war veteran is assigned to protect a controversial politician who may be the target of a terror plot.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E01 - Episode 1

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Another terrorist attack raises the UK threat level to severe. Home secretary Julia Montague holds secret meetings with the director general of the security service, freezing out the police and her own minister of state for counter terrorism.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As the capital shudders in the wake of two terrorist attacks, specialist protection officer PS David Budd is more under pressure than ever to keep the home secretary Julia Montague safe. The threat to her life does nothing to curb Julia's political ambitions, as her counterterrorism bill takes another step towards being made law, provoking political rivalries.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Traumatised by the events of the last 24 hours, PS David Budd falls under suspicion. Pushed to breaking point, David is helped back on his feet by his estranged wife, Vicky, and is determined to play an active role in the investigation.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Determined to push the investigation forward, PS David Budd targets enemies of home secretary Julia Montague. As he delves into Julia's political manoeuvring before the attack, David’s theories about a conspiracy at the heart of government look increasingly plausible.

1.title: FR - Bodyguard - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Principal Protection Officer David Budd has made a major breakthrough in the investigation into the attack on the home secretary, but his enquiries have put him in mortal danger. With the clock ticking and no-one left who believes him, David attempts to prove his innocence. But the evidence against him begins to stack up.

1.title: FR - Paris Police 1900 - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Tension is mounting in the streets of Paris days before the opening of the Dreyfus trial while Lepine manages to resolve trap set for his wife to his own advantage. The Berger case continues.

1.title: FR - Paris Police 1900 - S01E05 - Episode 5

1.title: FR - Paris Police 1900 - S01E06 - Episode 6

1.title: FR - Paris Police 1900 - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Prefect Lepine gets help from the anarchists while Guerin organises the riots planned for Rue Chabrol.

1.title: FR - Paris Police 1900 - S01E08 - Episode 8

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After reporter Lisa Wallace publishes an article on her mother’s murder, the killer resurfaces hinting at a kidnapping. Lisa and Detective David Burkely start investigating, connecting the killer to the disappearance of a women named Amy Reynolds.

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Lisa’s article is leaked, criticizing the Gardaí for not acting on Amy’s disappearance. David and Detective Brennan chase a lead, Mark Bulger, in Castlemoy. Impatient with the police’s pace, Lisa risks her life to uncover what Bulger is hiding.

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: David tries to get a statement from Teresa and a confession from Bulger, while Lisa investigates if Bulger could be the killer. Susan pleas for information from the Gardaí when an anonymous caller claims to have information on Amy.

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Lisa has to choose who to save: Susan or Mandy? Chris learns new information that takes Lisa to a strange address, where she discovers incriminating information that someone tries to cover up. The killer calls later that evening for Lisa’s decision.

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: David and Brennan target Gough as the potential killer while Lisa tries to connect him to the kidnappings. Gill threatens to blackmail David if he continues his investigation of Gough. Lisa faces her worst fear with a hospital call about her father.

1.title: FR - The Vanishing Triangle - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The investigation is halted. David confronts Gardaí’s top officials to expose Gill and Gough but finds no support. He reveals a long-hidden secret to his family. Lisa and Brennan follow a lead on the killer, investigating an abandoned slaughterhouse.

meta.plot: Gala is a New York City socialite on the run in a quaint Spanish town with her mother and daughter. Gala's new life brings her into the path of a brash but charming winery owner—and a deep well of family secrets.

1.title: FR - La terre des femmes - S01E01 - Chapter 1
1.plot: When a betrayal comes to light, Gala whisks Julia and Kate off to Spain for a girls trip—only for Julia and Kate to discover they're actually all on the run.

1.title: FR - La terre des femmes - S01E02 - Chapter 2
1.plot: Amat complicates Gala's plans to lay low. Kate tries to return home, unaware of the danger she's in. Julia confesses the truth about Gala's father.

1.title: FR - La terre des femmes - S01E03 - Chapter 3
1.plot: Gala dives into making the winery successful. Meanwhile, Julia resorts to blackmail, further straining her relationship with Mariona.

1.title: FR - La terre des femmes - S01E04 - Chapter 4
1.plot: Hank and Kevin close in on Gala's whereabouts just as she makes a troubling discovery about the extent of Fred's misdeeds.

1.title: FR - La terre des femmes - S01E05 - Chapter 5
1.plot: Amat senses something's up with Gala and uncovers her connection to Hank and Kevin. Chaos erupts at the winery.

meta.plot: Unexpected excitement charging romance between Ji-hwan, a big build former gang member who has cleared his dark past, and Eun-ha a mini woman who plays with children for her job.

1.title: FR - 놀아주는 여자 - S01E01 - The Ex-Con CEO and Ms. Mini
1.plot: Ji-hwan, the former boss of the Bulldog Gang, is now the CEO of Thirsty Deer Corporation, a company that specializes in making all sorts of charcuterie. Eun-ha tries her best to become more famous as a WeTuber called Ms. Mini, who creates online video content for kids. The two seem like they would never belong in the same world, but by chance, they keep running into each other.

1.title: FR - 놀아주는 여자 - S01E02 - The Misunderstandings
1.plot: Ji-hwan ends up in the hospital because of Eun-ha. She comes to apologise, but she is still afraid of what Ji-hwan and his employees might do to her. Meanwhile, Director Lee and Mr. Ma at Macaron Soft upload a maliciously edited video of Ji-hwan’s employees. This time, Ji-hwan misunderstands the situation and blames Eun-ha.

1.title: FR - 놀아주는 여자 - S01E03 - Life is Transitory
1.plot: After being publicly shamed for promoting a milk brand that caused havoc to customers, Eun-ha takes down her channel to repent. Ji-hwan watches from the sidelines and desires to get close to her. Meanwhile, Ye-na offers Eun-ha a job cleaning house to humiliate her, but Eun-ha swallows her pride and takes it.

1.title: FR - 놀아주는 여자 - S01E04 - The Uninvited Guest
1.plot: Eun-ha gets fired and kicked out of her apartment. Having nowhere to go, she wanders around in the rain. She goes to Ji-hwan’s house to return his coat and ends up staying there for the night. Ji-hwan goes to Yoon-taek’s house to look for him, and Eun-ha tags along to talk to his little sister. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo also heads to Yoon-taek’s house, only to run into Ji-hwan and Eun-ha.

1.title: FR - 놀아주는 여자 - S01E05 - Episode 5

meta.plot: A love story about an actress falls to the bottom overnight, and a producer's effort to try and get her back on her feet because he loves her. A cheerful family drama that reveals the truth of the case and restores love and justice through revenge and a family's desire going through confusion due to family conflicts.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E01 - Do Ra Meets Dae Chung
1.plot: Do Ra comes from a poor family, and they are always on the run as the creditors are chasing after them. On top of that, her mother, Mi Ja, is adamant about making her an actress to earn a living. One day, Do Ra runs into Dae Chung on her way home and falls in love at first sight.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E02 - Forced Breakup
1.plot: Sun Young forces Dae Chung and Jung Mi to break up, and Dae Chung loses his temper. As the argument gets out of hand, Geum Ja blurts out the hurtful truth behind Dae Chung's birth in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Mi Ja tries stealing food from Dae Chung's family but gets caught by them.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E03 - Jun Sub And A Woman
1.plot: Geum Ja witnesses Jun Sub with a woman on the street. She shares the news with Sun Young right away, but Sun Young doesn't believe her words and gets mad at her instead. Meanwhile, Do Ra calls Dae Chung for help, saying she ran into bullies again, so he runs to her to save her.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E04 - Pil Seung’s New Main Lead
1.plot: Director Jang asks Pil Seung to take his colleague's place and work on the new drama. The moment Pil Seung finds out that Do Ra is the main lead in the drama, Do Ra refuses to take the role to get some rest, and the main investor is about to drop out.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Out of spite, Do Ra plans to get back at Bi Bi by flirting with Bong Soo. Pil Seung sees Do Ra making her moves on Bong Soo and is disappointed. Then, out of the blue, Bi Bi comes to the filming set full of rage, and the set turns into chaos.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: After telling Hyun Chul that she would help him get the money for the new business he wanted to start, Geum Ja puts on a grim face to meet with Mi Ja. Meanwhile, at the filming site, Pil Seung works his butt off catering to Do Ra and Bong Soo to maintain peace. But Do Ra mistakes his kindness and feels a strange attraction and excitement.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Pil Seung apologizes to Do Ra for talking behind her back, but she is not willing to forgive him. Furthermore, Myung Dong witnesses how Do Ra treats Pil Seung on set and is about to let the family know about it. Meanwhile, Jin Dan meets Mi Ja and asks her to set him up with Do Ra.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: After Do Ra realizes Pil Seung is Dae Chung, her childhood crush, she makes up with him. Mi Ja is determined to marry Do Ra off to Jin Dan, so she sets them up for a date. However, Do Ra only feels uncomfortable around him. Meanwhile, Do Ra and Pil Seung travel to an island for the drama shoot.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: After Dae Sook finds out about Soo Yeon's past, she asks Madam Cho to reveal the truth to Jin Taek as well. Do Ra and Pil Seung safely return home, but Do Ra can't stop thinking about Pil Seung, just like back when she was 12. Meanwhile, Ae Kyo is worried about Jin Dan as he is determined to marry Do Ra, so she meets her in person to end the relationship for him.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Do Ra confesses her feelings to Pil Seung and asks him out, but he turns her down on the spot. Even though Pil Seung made himself clear, Do Ra cannot accept his rejection. Meanwhile, Do Jun comes back to Korea and runs into Ma Ri on his way home.

1.title: FR - 미녀와 순정남 - S01E11 - Episode 11

meta.plot:
Siberia is an American mockumentary series about a reality television show where 16 contestants must survive in the Siberian territory of Tunguska. The show was filmed in Birds Hill Provincial Park just north of Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada. It premiered on NBC on July 1, 2013.

The first season was met with generally favorable reviews from critics and viewers, with average viewership per episode coming in around 2.03 million viewers. Metacritic scored the show with a 63 out of 100. The series concluded its first season on September 16, 2013.

With only the clothes on their backs, they must try to survive with no help from producers or the outside world to win a big cash prize. They are soon faced with frightening events and unexpected situations that go horribly awry.

**1810:** Renata Plancher, cousin of Napoleon, Jean Plancher, and their son Baptiste run an inn, "Chez Bonaparte," in Paris, Faubourg Saint-Honoré. Jean complains that the Emperor has shown them no regard since coming to power.

**1695:** Count Philippe Honoré de Roche Saint-Pierre, cousin of Louis XIV, was dismissed from Versailles by the king. He lives with his wife Marie-Louise at the Château de La Croûtinière, 250 kilometers from Versailles.

**1430:** François d'Arc is the cousin of Joan of Arc. He lives in Domrémy, Joan's birthplace, with his wife Ysabeau and Gaspard, a sheep breeder. François tries by all means to free his cousin, who is imprisoned by the Burgundians.

**1:** Yorik is the cousin of Vercingetorix. He lives at the salt mine of Marsal, in Gallo-Roman Moselle, with his wife Maëlle, his son Briac, his daughter Gwénola, Burgal, Maëlle's brother, and Lena, Yorik's mother.
