Inspector Carlo Guerrieri, a veteran police officer from Rome, finds himself partnered with a rookie who was born in Ivory Coast but raised in the capital.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E01 - Looks Can Be Deceiving: Part 1
1.plot: After finding a frozen body during a drug-related chase at an outdoor market, Inspector Carlo Guerrieri fixates on finding a man he saw at the scene.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E02 - Looks Can Be Deceiving: Part 2
1.plot: A breakthrough in the case leads Carlo and Malik to a community of immigrants living in an old factory. Malik goes on a risky mission alone.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E03 - Once Too Often
1.plot: As the team investigates the murder of a young woman found inside a piece of luggage at the airport, Carlo contends with buried secrets from his past.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E04 - A Night Without Stars
1.plot: The hunt for a killer who stabbed a nun inside a sex shop takes a perilous turn. Back at the station, the team meets Santagata's successor.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E05 - Sisters
1.plot: One mystery leads to another when DNA from the body of a recently murdered woman is traced to a man who's been dead for months. Guilt weighs on Alba.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E06 - For Love
1.plot: After Alba finds a young man's body in a banged-up car, Carlo spots a familiar name among the victim's belongings. Malik reconsiders Carta's request.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E07 - A Song for You
1.plot: A case involving a young female rapper strikes a nerve for Repola and forces Muzo to work alongside his estranged wife. Alba's boss offers her advice.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E08 - A Quiet Family
1.plot: While Malik juggles his secret assignment and a homicide at a jewelry store, Alba realizes she can't hide her true feelings from Riccardo any longer.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E09 - Just Married
1.plot: An unsettling discovery stokes tensions between Alba and her father. A woman receives a graphic video on her phone showing her husband being murdered.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E10 - Hidden Truths
1.plot: Carlo defies Carta's orders while investigating the death of an heir to a pasta empire. Meanwhile, Malik debates whether to hand over the bullets.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E11 - Unfinished Business: Part 1
1.plot: Desperate to help her dad, Alba reaches out to Riccardo. Cantabella finds himself in hot water after subduing a paranoid man wielding a broken bottle.

1.title: FR - Carlo et Malik - S01E12 - Unfinished Business: Part 2
1.plot: As the team races to connect the dots between all the players in the Bosca case, a new crisis forces Carlo and Malik to work together once more.

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E01 - The Memory Box
1.plot: One year after a devastating flood kills five locals in a country town, a mysterious new plant is found growing where they died with the power to transform the residents’ lives.

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E02 - Back To Life
1.plot: Rejuvenated to her youth, Gwen’s desire to amend a deep regret threatens to pull her and Ray apart, while Sam’s affair with Tina continues as his criminal past returns to haunt him.

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E03 - Redemption
1.plot: With Gwen’s plant destroyed and on the cusp of aging back, she and Sam race to find another plant, however will Gwen’s compulsion for a baby make her betray the man she loves?

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E04 - Little Miracle
1.plot: Young Gwen and Max rejoice in her miraculous pregnancy, leaving a devastated Ray on the outer, while two more residents discover their secret and are compelled to fix their pasts.

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E05 - The Kick Inside
1.plot: Gwen’s unnatural pregnancy escalates rapidly as Max’s growing paranoia puts her life in danger, while Sam’s attempt to help Tina makes him the lead suspect in Griffo’s murder.

1.title: FR - Bloom - S01E06 - Super Sam
1.plot: Ray’s desperation to keep Gwen young and alive pushes him beyond his moral boundaries and pits him against a vengeful Farida, while Rhonda closes in on Sam and his secret.

2.title: FR - Bloom - S02E01 - Blip
2.plot: Three months on, a new family arrive in Mullan with a startling secret and a hidden agenda that could alter the course of human existence.

2.title: FR - Bloom - S02E02 - Fruit Of The Earth
2.plot: After learning how the new plants grow, Gwen’s desperation to rejuvenate Ray drives her back to her ex-boyfriend, Max – but will Max pay the ultimate price?

2.title: FR - Bloom - S02E03 - Hand Of God
2.plot: John attempts to prove the miracle to the church, while Ray realises that the side-effects of this new berry are far worse than he imagined.

2.title: FR - Bloom - S02E04 - Truer Lover
2.plot: With Gwen at breaking point, Ray and Gwen turn to John for help... but can faith in a higher power save Gwen from herself?

meta.plot: One year after a devastating flood kills five locals in an idyllic country town, a mysterious new plant appears with the power to restore their youth.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E01 - In Other News
1.plot: As a child, Kate Ashby was rescued from the horrific aftermath of the Rwandan genocide. She was adopted and brought up in Britain by Eve Ashby, a world-class international lawyer. Kate has long struggled to escape the shadow of her past, but is now returning to work as a legal investigator in the same chambers as Eve, under leading international lawyer Michael Ennis. Kate and Eve's relationship is strained to breaking point when a controversial militia leader, who had once fought to stop the genocide, is captured in the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Eve takes on his prosecution at the International Criminal Court.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E02 - Looking at the Past
1.plot: Eve's case prosecuting Simon Nyamoya begins at the International Criminal Court, but a shocking incident changes everything. To try and uncover the truth behind these events, Michael Ennis launches a new case and turns to Kate for help. They will be defending Alice Munezero, a Rwandan government official and an old friend of Michael and Eve's. Alice stands accused of a historic war crime - the murder of a French priest in Rwanda in 1994.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E03 - A Ghost in Name
1.plot: Still struggling with grief, Kate works with Michael to defend Alice Munezero from the charges laid against her in France. As shadowy forces try to prevent the truth being unearthed, Kate faces threats to her personal safety. Meanwhile Michael struggles with his health back in London. Can they both continue forward to gain an acquittal for Alice?

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E04 - A Bowl of Cornflakes
1.plot: Kate and Michael finish their work on Alice's case in France but are shocked when an indicted Rwandan and Congolese war criminal, Patrice Ganimana, implicated in the Genocide, arrives in the UK. Excited by the chance to prosecute him, Michael is unsettled to learn that an old rival is handling his defence. Meanwhile this new arrival prompts Alice Munezero to delay her own return to Rwanda. As difficulties multiply for an extradition of Ganimana to the International Criminal Court, Kate and Michael's relationship begins to fray.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E05 - The Eyes of the Devil
1.plot: Blake Gaines, who has been handling Ganimana's defence, seems in danger of falling foul of those paying his legal fees. Alice Munezero tells Michael, for the first time, of her connection to the Rwandan president - Bibi Mundanzi. Meanwhile, Kate's rift with Michael deepens, and she becomes increasingly driven to help extradite Ganimana to face justice.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E06 - The Game's True Nature
1.plot: Patrice Ganimana's warnings about Kate's safety are borne out when Kate and Alice are both attacked. But Kate, nevertheless, continues her search for the case file her mother had prepared against Ganimana years before. But are establishment forces somehow closing ranks to impede bringing Ganimana to justice?

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E07 - Double Bogey on the Ninth
1.plot: Kate and Florence return to the UK to continue the search for Eve Ashby's case file against Patrice Ganimana. But someone is ahead of them, stopping at nothing to kill and terrorise their way to the missing evidence. Meanwhile Michael in the UK, Alice Munezero in Rwanda and Eunice Clayton in the US believe the time has finally come to reveal the truth about a long-buried crime, which in turn exposes Kate to a dark truth about her own past.

1.title: FR - Black Earth Rising - S01E08 - The Forgiving Earth
1.plot: In Rwanda, Alice Munezero languishes in custody. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kate fights against hostile locals as well as international forces to prove the truth of her personal history. Meanwhile in London, Michael delves into a deep political and financial conspiracy. Can he expose this in time, while Kate fights for her very life in an explosive climax?

meta.plot: As a child, Kate Ashby was rescued from the horrific aftermath of the Rwandan genocide and brought to the UK. But the tragic shadow of her past proves impossible to escape.

meta.plot: Sur une route sinueuse des Pyrénées, un spectaculaire accident de voiture s'avère miraculeux : la réapparition de Anna, une ado disparue il y a 5 ans. La capitaine Alix Stern et le commissaire Balthus sont déployés aux côtés de Victor Ferrer, le chef de la gendarmerie locale, pour se lancer dans une course contre la montre. Retrouver la trace de Lucie, une jeune fille enlevée en même temps qu’Anna et qui, elle, n'a pas réapparu.

Kate Kane, armed with a passion for social justice and a flair for speaking her mind, soars onto the streets of Gotham as Batwoman, an out lesbian and highly trained street fighter primed to snuff out the failing city's criminal resurgence. But don't call her a hero yet. In a city desperate for a savior, Kate must overcome her own demons before embracing the call to be Gotham's symbol of hope

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Kate Kane returns to Gotham when a gang targets her father and her ex-girlfriend Sophie Moore.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E02 - The Rabbit Hole
1.plot: Jacob Kane and the Crows up the stakes; Kate continues to look to Bruce Wayne's legacy for guidance as Luke Fox inadvertently gets pulled into Batwoman's vigilante heroics; Sophie and Kate are forced to team up.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E03 - Down, Down, Down
1.plot: The city waits for another visit from who they think is Batman. Alice continues to taunt Kate. Mary gets an unexpected new friend. As Batwoman faces a new enemy, Kate realizes she must make a decision.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E04 - Who Are You?
1.plot: A new villain with an eye for all things that sparkle drops in on the city; Kate attempts to find a balance between her personal life and her new role as Gotham's guardian; Luke continues to fine-tune Batwoman's arsenal of weapons.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E05 - Mine Is A Long And A Sad Tale
1.plot: Alice takes Kate down the sad, winding road of her life in the days after the accident as Jacob and Sophie attempt to track them. Mary has an argument with Catherine which sends her looking for Kate at Wayne Tower, but instead she becomes unwelcome company for Luke.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E06 - I'll Be Judge, I'll Be Jury
1.plot: A disturbing death has Gotham reeling and the city reaches out for their new vigilante hero. Luke confides in Kate, while Sophie asks Jacob for a special assignment. Alice continues her nefarious plot against the Kanes, with Catherine being a conduit to part of her plan. Batwoman pays another visit to Mary.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E07 - Tell Me The Truth
1.plot: Kate and Sophie must reconcile with their past as Kate questions just how much she can trust her former lover. Kate and Luke have an encounter with an old friend. Mary grapples with the fate of the Kane family as Catherine seeks Jacob's help. Alice and a new cohort are in on yet another nefarious plan, but her motives are more than they seem.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E08 - A Mad Tea-Party
1.plot: Kate and Alice continue their sister/nemesis dance, while Alice and Mouse construct their most evil plan yet. Mary invites Kate to a special event honoring Catherine and Jacob makes a decision that leaves Kate perplexed.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E09 - Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part Two (II)
1.plot:
The group uses Ray's invention to track new recruits to help save the universe. The Monitor sends Iris, Clark and Lois in search of a mysterious Kryptonian, while Kate and Kara head out to find Bruce Wayne. In addition, Mia challenges Sara, Rory discovers a hidden talent, and Lex Luthor returns.

This crossover begins on Supergirl S5E09, and continues on The Flash S6E09,  Arrow S8E08, and Legends of Tomorrow S05E01.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E10 - How Queer Everything is Today!
1.plot: While Gotham busies itself reacting to Batwoman’s  awkward encounter, Alice celebrates her ultimate act of vengeance with Mouse. A devastated Mary focuses on Jacob Kane’s trial, while Sophie seeks advice about her love life from someone unexpected. As they tackle the newest threat to Gotham, Luke prioritizes protecting Batwoman’s secret, and Kate must decide what she is willing to do to honor Batwoman’s identity...and her own.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E11 - An Un-Birthday Present
1.plot: On the Kane sisters’ birthday, Kate and Alice contend with demons from the past, and an unexpected guest makes a surprise appearance in Gotham.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E12 - Take Your Choice
1.plot: With the hunt for Alice heating up, Kate faces a difficult decision.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E13 - Drink Me
1.plot: A new villain sinks her teeth into Gotham and The Hold Up opens in grand fashion. Sophie reluctantly requests that Batwoman keep her distance knowing their interactions could compromise her career.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E14 - Grinning From Ear to Ear
1.plot: Batwoman and Luke are on the trail of a villain targeting social media mavens. Sophie gets an unexpected visit from her mother, and Mary offers her expertise to assist Kate. Jacob Kane is approached to make good on a favor, while Alice focuses on her plans for retribution.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E15 - Off with Her Head
1.plot: More of Alice’s dark past is uncovered when Cartwright shares a twisted story with Kate while Jacob goes searching for his wayward daughter. Mary and Luke follow a lead on Beth's killer.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E16 - Through The Looking-Glass
1.plot: Kate begins to question her instincts and Luke gets upsetting news. Alice seeks her sister’s help with a special task.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E17 - A Narrow Escape
1.plot: Batwoman encounters a new challenge when an old villain resurfaces, testing the heroics of Gotham’s most stand-up citizens. Alice’s limits are tested.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E18 - If You Believe In Me, I'll Believe In You
1.plot: Batwoman enlists Luke and Julia for an undercover mission to recover one of the most important items from her cousin’s arsenal. While Alice continues developing her devious plans within Arkham’s walls, she gets an unexpected visit from Jacob Kane who needs her help. Meanwhile, Mary tries to prove herself to Kate. As Sophie gets closer to a co-worker, Kate reunites with an old flame.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E19 - A Secret Kept From All the Rest
1.plot: When members of Gotham's intelligentsia begin disappearing, Commander Kane, Sophie and the Crows go searching for the newest homicidal threat to the city. In the meantime, Kate is consumed with someone’s betrayal and starts questioning the loyalty of everyone around her just when she needs them most. So when Luke and Julia go missing, Batwoman must rely on Mary and a former foe to deploy her rescue mission. Meanwhile, Alice enlists Tommy Elliot to help acquire an elusive item that her sister also seeks.

1.title: FR - Batwoman - S01E20 - O, Mouse!
1.plot: When one of Gotham's former heroes returns to his old stomping grounds to settle a score, both Batwoman and Commander Kane find themselves on the defensive. Meanwhile, Alice has uncovered what could finally take down Batwoman, but she is losing hold on her henchman Mouse and Hush, sending her spiraling into her most wicked self. Luke immediately focuses on finding a way to protect Batwoman from Alice, and Mary has a chance to be the sister Kate has needed all along. New information surfaces, forcing Julia to warn Sophie about the person pulling the strings. And in a final standoff, when Commander Kane refuses to retreat from his war on Batwoman, Kate may find herself more than heartbroken by her father’s choices.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E01 - What Happened to Kate Kane?
2.plot: A homeless 25-year-old named Ryan Wilder stumbles upon Kate's batsuit.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E02 - Prior Criminal History
2.plot: After her quick spin in the Batgear, Ryan Wilder is back to facing the daily challenges of life as herself. Meanwhile, Alice has a new, devious plan to get the attention of both Gotham and Safiyah. With Kate still missing and the city in an uprising, Luke and Mary are desperate to find a stand in. In a pinch, Ryan dons the suit again and comes face-to-face with Alice for the first time. Back at Crows Headquarters, Sophie and Commander Kane try to uncover who may have had a vendetta against Kate.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E03 - Bat Girl Magic!
2.plot: As Ryan Wilder continues to prove herself as Batwoman, she encounters the challenge of every superhero - living a double life. Meanwhile, Victor Szasz is slashing his way through the city streets, and Commander Kane has The Crows trying to stop the flow of Snakebite through Gotham. Safiyah takes notice of Alice's antics and Sophie finds herself in unexpected circumstances.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E04 - Fair Skin, Blue Eyes
2.plot: As Batwoman attempts to fight the proliferation of Snake Bite through Gotham, a random encounter forces her to revisit her painful past. Empowered by her new role, Ryan Wilder is determined to ensure others like her don't go unnoticed. Meanwhile, those closest to Kate are given a good reason to believe she is still alive, forcing unexpected alliances and betrayals.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E05 - Gore on Canvas
2.plot: Batwoman is approached by Commander Kane and Agent Moore to boost an infamous work of art that reveals the way to Coryana - and Kate. Despite her reservations, Luke and Mary convince Ryan to take the assignment, causing tensions within the Bat-team to escalate. Meanwhile, as Alice attempts to fulfill Safiyah's insidious request, she slowly discovers that she may not remember everything about her time on Coryana.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E06 - Do Not Resuscitate
2.plot: As Ryan Wilder's kryptonite wound grows more severe, it hinders Batwoman's ability to protect Gotham. Alice's reunion with a fellow Coryana inhabitant presents unexpected complications.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E07 - It's Best You Stop Digging
2.plot: As Ryan’s condition worsens, she questions Batwoman’s "no killing" code when she realizes the opportunity to avenge her mother is slipping away. Tatiana fills in the gaps for Alice about her time on Coryana and her history with Ocean.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E07 - It's Best You Stop Digging
2.plot: As Ryan’s condition worsens, she questions Batwoman’s "no killing" code when she realizes the opportunity to avenge her mother is slipping away. Tatiana fills in the gaps for Alice about her time on Coryana and her history with Ocean.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E08 - Survived Much Worse
2.plot: Batwoman's abilities are tested like never before, while Alice's search for Kate continues. Sophie and Jacob set their sights on Coryana, and Luke and Mary contend with an unexpected guest.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E09 - Rule #1
2.plot: Batwoman confronts Gotham's biggest foe, while new information forces those closest to Kate to make some difficult decisions. Ryan's feelings for Angelique puts her partnership with Luke and Mary at risk, while Alice goes on a warped walk down memory lane.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E10 - Time Off For Good Behavior
2.plot: As Batwoman focuses even more effort on taking down Black Mask, a new foe emerges, diverting the Bat team's attention to a distressing issue in Gotham. Continually haunted by the mistakes of his past, Jacob travels down a dangerous path in an attempt to eradicate them. Alice and Julia discover they have an enemy in common.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E11 - Arrive Alive
2.plot: With Batwoman and The Crows each hot on the trail of the False Face Society, their efforts collide, and tension escalates. Alice seeks out Enigma, and Sophie and Ryan find some common ground.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E12 - Initiate Self-Destruct
2.plot: Ryan is faced with a difficult decision that could expose her as Batwoman, creating a rift in the Bat Team. Meanwhile, Black Mask's plans for Kate Kane begin to unfold. Alice is reunited with someone from her past, and Sophie must decide where her loyalty lies.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E13 - I'll Give You a Clue
2.plot: When Sophie must face a foe from her rookie days with The Crows, Ryan, Mary and Luke are also pulled into the villain's game. Meanwhile, the tables turn on Alice when she finds herself in dire circumstances, and Jacob continues to revisit the past.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E14 - And Justice For All
2.plot: Batwoman is faced with a new challenge when Gotham's Snakebite addicts become ravenous for more than the next fix.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E15 - Armed and Dangerous
2.plot: As Luke Fox's life hangs in the balance, repercussions from the devastating event are the catalyst for some life-changing decisions for those around him.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E16 - Rebirth
2.plot: When a familiar foe descends upon Gotham, Batwoman and Mary find they must rely on each other more than ever. Alice has a has a new mission - and gets an unexpected ally to join her.

2.title: FR - Batwoman - S02E18 - Power
2.plot: Ryan questions her place as the city's hero as she, Luke, Mary and Sophie must join forces when Black Mask instigates chaos in the Gotham streets. Meanwhile, Alice's attempt to rescue her sister means another encounter with Circe. In an epic standoff, unexpected alliances and transformations will upend Gotham as we know it.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E01 - Mad As A Hatter
3.plot: As Batwoman continues to keep the streets of Gotham safe, Batwing joins in on the action, but Luke quickly realizes he hasn't quite mastered his suit. When Ryan pays Alice a visit to ask about the bombshell she dropped, Ryan must decide if she should go down the rabbit hole of her past. As Mary prepares to finally graduate from medical school, she feels the absence of her family more than ever. When an Alice admirer stumbles upon one of the missing Bat Trophies, Gotham and the Bat Team get mixed up in the madness, culminating in a shockingly gruesome graduation... and an equally shocking new partnership.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E02 - Loose Tooth
3.plot: When a new incarnation of Gotham's swamp slumming Killer Croc surfaces and starts racking up a body count, the inaugural team-up of Batwoman and Alice is put to the test. But Alice isn't the only unwanted intrusion into Ryan's life when Jada Jet shows up at Wayne Enterprises, insisting on meeting the company's new CEO. Luke and Mary's relationship is strained under the weight of a secret Luke is keeping, while Sophie finds herself becoming part of Ryan's inner circle.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E04 - Antifreeze
3.plot: When Ryan makes Gotham’s “30 Under 30” list, Luke worries about how Marquis's involvement in Ryan’s rising popularity as Wayne Enterprises’ acting CEO will land with Jada. Mary returns from a late night out not feeling quite herself, while Alice’s hallucinations grow stronger. And when Sophie’s sister, Jordan, goes missing, she and the Bat Team quickly realize that Freeze’s missing weapon hasn’t been fully contained.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E05 - A Lesson From Professor Pyg
3.plot: Ryan asks Sophie to accompany her to a dinner at Jada’s to do recon on what her estranged mother knows about Wayne Enterprises, but the evening takes a turn when an uninvited guest drops in on the intimate gathering. As the terrifying evening unfolds, Ryan witnesses another side to Marquis and her mother.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E06 - How Does Your Garden Grow?
3.plot: An unnerving discovery in a garden shed sends Renee Montoya rushing to Ryan to ensure the city is on high alert. Her terrifying theory — a Bat Trophy has entangled a new host, and her thorny ways are weaving their way through Gotham. Alice is suspiciously eager to help the Bat Team, and Sophie seeks vengeance for an incident involving her sister.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E07 - Pick Your Poison
3.plot: As Ryan’s family dynamic grows more complicated, she also finds herself in the middle of a Bat Team stand-off between Luke and Mary. Meanwhile, Alice finds a new sidekick to do her bidding.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E08 - Trust Destiny
3.plot: While Mary and Alice continue their sisterly bonding, Ryan, Luke and Sophie are desperate and willing to do almost anything to stop them. Renee is forced to revisit her heartbreaking past. Meanwhile, Marquis grows more unhinged and throws a spectacularly sinister soiree at Wayne Tower... and everyone is invited.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E09 - Meet Your Maker
3.plot: Ryan, Sophie and Luke attempt to track down the OG Poison Ivy when all signs point to Pamela Isley’s reappearance in Gotham. At the same time, Mary feels drawn by a powerful force and Alice suddenly feels very protective of her stepsister. Meanwhile, Jada hasn't given up on rehabilitating Marquis and seeks the help of an old friend.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E10 - Toxic
3.plot: Batwoman’s hands are full as she juggles Jada’s demands, Mary’s ever-increasing power and a new romantic entanglement. Loyalties are tested and motives come into question as Batwoman races against the clock to once again save the city and those closest to her.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E11 - Broken Toys
3.plot: Just when it seems things can’t get worse... Batwoman’s identity is once again at risk of being exposed, and some of Gotham’s most villainous unite. Sophie joins Luke on a mission and Alice gets into Mary’s head.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E12 - We're All Mad Here
3.plot: Ryan, Sophie and Jada come together to formulate a plan to stop Marquis, while Mary seeks to make amends for the harm she did as Poison Ivy. Meanwhile, Alice continues to spiral out of control and contend with her mental demons.

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E13 - We Having Fun Yet?
3.plot: Joining forces with Jada, Batwoman and a panicked Bat Team must race against the clock as Marquis's nefarious plan balloons into something Gotham would never have suspected...and won't see coming. And as Alice reaches her breaking point, an empathetic Mary makes another appeal on behalf of her sister for the Joker's buzzer, but everyone wonders - is Alice beyond saving?

3.title: FR - Batwoman - S03E32 -

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E01 - Chapter 1: Doors
1.plot: An intruder attacks Sanctuary 573, forcing Eva above ground. Alone, she relies on her survival skills and a cryptic note labeled "WondLa."

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E02 - Chapter 2: Lifeforms
1.plot: Eva discovers she’s on a planet called Orbona, where she meets a telepathic water bear named Otto and a surly alien named Rovender.

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E03 - Chapter 3: Bargain
1.plot: Determined to find other humans, Eva enlists Rovender's help—but getting her first real lead comes at a high price.

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E04 - Chapter 4: Ghosts
1.plot: Eva visits a sage and learns a grim fact about humans. Undeterred, she doubles down on her quest as Besteel the bounty hunter closes in.

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E05 - Chapter 5: Captive
1.plot: Despite Muthr's protests, Eva follows through on a daring plan and forms a friendship with an unlikely ally.

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E06 - Chapter 6: Bridge
1.plot: With a possible human civilization finally in sight, Eva and her friends face their most dangerous mission yet.

1.title: FR - WondLa - S01E07 - Chapter 7: Ruins
1.plot: Eva learns the truth about humankind as Besteel tracks her down for a cataclysmic face-off.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E01 - Home
2.plot: Eva arrives at the hidden city of New Attica, where she learns humans believe the worst about Orbona.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E02 - Family
2.plot: Eva chases a mysterious figure deep into New Attica, leading to the discovery of a group of outsiders.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E03 - Discovery
2.plot: Desperate to locate her friends, Eva is horrified to find them in the clutches of a sinister threat.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E04 - Lesson
2.plot: After a narrow escape, Eva, Eight, and Hailey trek the perilous wastelands to bring an injured Rovender home.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E05 - Truth
2.plot: The Caeruleans refuse to let a dying Rovender back into their community. To save him, Eva seeks a mystical creature to restore his honor.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E06 - Connection
2.plot: During a Caerulean celebration, Eva connects with a powerful entity. Cadmus and his warbots bear down on Faunas.

2.title: FR - WondLa - S02E07 - Heart
2.plot: Eva risks her life to protect the Heart of the Forest.

meta.plot: Forced to flee her underground sanctuary for Earth’s surface, Eva discovers a world unlike anything she expected. As she journeys across perilous terrain and unknown civilizations, Eva searches to answer the ultimate question: Is she the last human?
When five ordinary South Londoners discover they have extraordinary powers, it's down to one man to bring them together to save the woman he loves.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E01 - Michael
1.plot: Delivery driver Michael has big plans for the future with his girlfriend. Until something odd starts happening to him and others across South London.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E02 - Tazer
1.plot: Four Londoners reel from the discovery of their powers, while another knows exactly how to make the most of his. Michael desperately looks for answers.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E03 - Sabrina
1.plot: Sabrina and Sharleen plan a night out after a long day. The Tower Boys get into a fight that leaves Tazer swearing revenge. Michael comes up with a plan.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E04 - Andre
1.plot: Andre makes a dangerous decision after the bailiffs pay him a visit. Rodney's business slows down, and Dionne meets the mother of a missing girl.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E05 - Rodney
1.plot: With his best friend in hospital, Rodney has a change of heart. Michael resolves to telling Dionne everything — but first he has to find the others.

1.title: FR - SupraCell - S01E06 - Supacell
1.plot: The stakes are high as Tazer and Sabrina both search for Krazy. With powers pushed beyond their limit, the five must unite to save the ones they love.

meta.plot: Working undercover as a sex worker in Nigeria, a young journalist out to expose corruption fights for her life as she forges a path to Europe.

1.title: FR - Òlòtūré : Le périple - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After an attempted escape, Òlòtūré finds herself in the middle of a gang war. Beauty desperately tries to make her way back home.

1.title: FR - Òlòtūré : Le périple - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Finally out of hiding, Òlòtūré puts her faith in a local community. With her life in ashes, Beauty falls into the hands of an old enemy.

1.title: FR - Òlòtūré : Le périple - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Òlòtūré faces new threats as she continues her journey, but the only way out is through the treacherous desert and toward an uncertain fate.

meta.plot: A whirlwind power clash between the prime minister and deputy prime minister unravels the day the president suffers an assassination attempt.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Determined to turn the tables, Park Dong-ho attempts to assassinate the president. But Jeong Su-jin swiftly steps in to execute her own agenda.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Armed with leverage, Kang Sang-un approaches Dong-ho with an offer. Dong-ho's attempt to initiate a no-holds-barred investigation encounters a hiccup.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Dong-ho risks everything to reinitiate the investigation before the president awakes. In response, Su-jin resorts to a ruthless tactic to turn the tides.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dong-ho turns his attention to the presidential election campaign — and sets a trap for Su-jin. He later enlists questionable support for a leg up.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Facing calls to resign, Dong-ho confronts Su-jin privately. He soon debates Jo Sang-cheon, where the issue of North Korea plagues Dong-ho's campaign.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Although Su-jin gains possession of Dong-ho's Achilles' heel, Dong-ho reveals he has a trick up his sleeve. Su-jin then hones in on Park Chang-sik.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Dong-ho enacts a scheme to completely expose Su-jin to the public. But she aims to turn Lee Jang-seok against Dong-ho before her hearing begins.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: With Su-jin in the prime minister's seat, Dong-ho meets with Chairman Kang in a ploy to take her inner circle down — forcing her to plan her own revenge.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Su-jin coaches Sang-un to give a damning testimony against Dong-ho and sway public opinion. Facing impeachment, Dong-ho turns to Chairman Kang.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Dong-ho exposes himself to bring his foes to justice, putting himself at risk for prosecution. In turn, Su-jin stops at nothing to have Dong-ho arrested.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Su-jin derails the investigation into Daejin and turns the scrutiny back onto Dong-ho. As a strike threatens Dong-ho's power, he uses his silver bullet.

1.title: FR - Déferlante - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Dong-ho's final act forces Su-jin to make the ultimate choice — reveal the truth or go down in disgrace. In the end, will justice prevail?

1.title: FR - Dead in the Water - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: 1978. 25-year-old childhood sweethearts Chris Farmer and Peta Frampton are travelling through Central America sending tapes and letters home with details of their travels. A chance encounter with an American skipper and his two sons changes their plans and the nightmare back home, begins.

1.title: FR - Dead in the Water - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Chris and Peta's bodies have been found floating off the coast of Guatemala. The killer is on the loose, and a key witness, fights to be heard. The case goes cold for four decades until, Chris' sister Penny turns online sleuth and discovers a truth much darker than they'd ever imagined.

1.title: FR - Dead in the Water - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: 2016. With the suspected killer in custody, Prosecution and Defense prepare for an epic courtroom battle that hinges on the credibility of the key witness. Justice is within reach when both families are dealt a cruel blow and are forced to face another agonising twist in a long journey for answers.

meta.plot: A young British couple's dream trip through remote Central America, turns into a chilling nightmare when they are brutally murdered and the trail for their killer goes cold. Four decades later, failed by law enforcement, their family take up the manhunt and make a shocking discovery.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A new adventure awaits as DI Humphrey Goodman and Martha leave London for Devon. Humphrey dives into his first case, which involves an unusual prime suspect: a 17th-century witch.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Humphrey and his team are baffled by the mysterious disappearance of an entire family. Martha prepares for the launch of her café but is thrown when a face from the past shows up.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The community of Shipton Abbott is rocked when a beloved painting disappears in a seemingly impossible heist. Humphrey tries his best to find some common ground with Archie.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Humphrey investigates the death of an unidentified man found in the centre of a crop circle. Meanwhile, Archie helps Martha prepare for a visit from a food critic.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Panic spreads when an arsonist targets three businesses, bizarrely invoking the Three Little Pigs fable. Meanwhile, Martha has some serious thinking to do.

1.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A house is burgled but the prime suspect was locked up in a police cell at the time. It’s up to Esther to rally a devastated Humphrey and solve this impossible crime.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: The Shipton Abbott Players rope in Humphrey to play a detective, but the fictional crime becomes real when the amateur murder victim gets a real knife in his back.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: When an amateur psychic’s unsettling predictions for a grieving woman’s future start to come true, Humphrey must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: When a dying woman goes missing from a local fishing trawler, Humphrey suspects there’s more to her disappearance than meets the eye.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: When a priest at a Catholic boarding school goes missing, Humphrey’s team explores a connection between his disappearance and an ancient local legend.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: On a moor outside of Shipton Abbott, a woman is found with an arrow in her back and no sign of who might have shot her.

2.title: FR - Meurtres au paradis anglais - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: It's finally Humphrey and Martha's wedding day – what could possibly go wrong? Other than a museum heist, cyber crime and an unexpected arrival.

meta.plot: After leaving paradise and seeking a quieter life, Humphrey has taken a job as Detective Inspector in his fiancée Martha's hometown. But with the high crime rate, maybe things will be louder than expected.

A disgraced, 75-year-old ex-sheriff, whose life ends at the hands of corrupt cops, is brought back to life and given a second chance by a pair of young tech scientists, as a 35-year-old with unpredictable near-superhuman abilities.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E01 - A Suitable Donor
1.plot: After Jimmy Pritchard is killed in a robbery at his son's home, Pritchard is brought back to life in the body of a younger man by a billionaire and a bioengineer.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E02 - One More Notch
1.plot: Due to the power surge that Mary and Otto caused in bringing Pritchard back to life, two notorious murderers escape from prison. Still determined that this is his city to protect, Pritchard goes on the hunt for them, and Mary - who believes she's partially responsible for the fugitives' escape - offers assistance.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E03 - From Darkness the Sun
1.plot: Jimmy attempts to prove that he was a better police officer and man than Duval ever realized. A deadly psycho and another father-son duo cause problems.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E04 - Admissions
1.plot: A former case ends up becoming relevant as Pritchard and Duval take a look into some murders involving young prodigies.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E05 - Scratch That Glitch
1.plot: A dead pool makes a prediction that Mary will die on the same day as the launch of an important Lookinglass product. Pritchard ends up at the hospital following a brawl.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E06 - Palimpsest
1.plot: Pritchard and Duval attempt to catch a killer who mutilates and disfigures victims.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E07 - That Time in the Car
1.plot: Pritchard needs to try and hide his history with Wally, who is now dating his daughter, Helen, after it is discovered that Wally is being coerced by a prisoner planning an escape.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E08 - May Old Acquaintance Be Forgot
1.plot: An important drug dealer is responsible for a murder 20 years before, which Pritchard helped to cover up.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E09 - When You Have to Go There, They Have to Take You In
1.plot: Pritchard and Duval team up to chase a serial killer. Meanwhile, Mary and Pritchard's bond grows stronger, but Otto wants to make sure she'll always be by his side; and Gracie tries to get to the bottom of Pritchard's identity.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E10 - Geworfenheit
1.plot: Albert Lin's real identity and who created him present a dilemma for Pritchard and Duval, who also frantically search for Gracie after she goes missing. Meanwhile, Otto's relationship with Mary is strained by the investigation, and he mulls the risk of destroying everything they've built, including Pritchard, by siding with Connor Graff.

1.title: FR - Frankenstein Code - S01E11 - Gelassenheit
1.plot: Gracie's life is in danger unless Pritchard and Duval can reach her in time and rescue her from Connor and Otto's experiment. Meanwhile, Mary and Alexa search for a way to save Pritchard since he can no longer regenerate in the tank; and Otto struggles to come to grips with his decisions that have touched so many lives.

meta.plot: Freed after 20 years in prison, the child killer Guy Beranger found refuge with the monks in Vielsart, a small village in Belgian's Ardennes. He is placed under the protection of a young Federal Police's inspector, Chloé Muller. A little while after his release, a little girl disappears.

meta.plot: It takes place in the Galicia (Spain) of the 80s, when the fishing sector was transformed and many of the shipowners became indebted. This situation will be favorable for the start of activities such as contraband and drug trafficking.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E01 - 1981
1.plot: A young Sito Miñanco has an opportunity in the business contraband of tobacco, a profit business in Galicia but soon he will know a better business, the fariña, aka cocaine.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E02 - 1982
1.plot: Sito Miñanco sees the dark side of cocaine when he has troubles to complete the first job. The smugglers talk about traffic with drugs.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E03 - 1983
1.plot: The law force increase the pressure in the smugglers with new laws and new law force. The drugs enter in the game.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E04 - 1984
1.plot: As Sito Miñanco continues his cocaine business, sergeant Darío Castro is progressively tracking him down.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E05 - 1985
1.plot: After Sito's sentence at the Carabanchel Jail, he returns to Galicia to make a deal with the Cali and Medellín Cartels.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E06 - 1986
1.plot: After Braulio is found murdered under the Colombian necktie method and the smugglers abandon tobacco in favor of cocaine, things start getting ugly around Galicia's base levels.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E07 - 1987
1.plot: The drug trade brings addiction to Galicia. The Charlín family takes the risk of partnering with the Colombians, using a human life as a guarantee.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E08 - 1988
1.plot: Carmen Avendaño and fellow mothers of drug addicts get vocal in their protests. In prison, one of the smugglers secretly writes a transaction record.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E09 - 1989
1.plot: Judge Garzón in Madrid receives Portabales's notes and calls Darío. The shot Colombian sicario dies before he can be made to talk, but all is not lost.

1.title: FR - Fariña - S01E10 - 1990
1.plot: The smugglers face trial and Portabales testifies against them. Sito offers Ballesteros one last shipment in exchange for help fleeing from Europe.

meta.plot: Notorious serial killer Joe Carroll, after being found guilty of murdering 14 female students on the Virginia college campus where he taught literature, escapes from death row. The FBI calls former agent Ryan Hardy to consult on the case, as he was the one responsible for Carroll’s capture in 2003. Ryan, working closely with an FBI team, including Mike Weston and FBI Specialist Debra Parker, piece together the ever-growing web of murders orchestrated by the devious Carroll.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Former FBI agent, Ryan Hardy is called out of retirement to track down Joe Carroll after he escapes from prison. Hardy works closely with an FBI team, which includes young, razor-sharp Mike Weston. The investigation also leads Hardy back to Claire Matthews, Carroll's ex-wife and the mother of the criminal's young son, Joey. Hardy soon discovers that Carroll has an ever-growing cult of followers.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E02 - Chapter Two
1.plot: Ryan Hardy, Agent Mike Weston and FBI Specialist Debra Parker, who is brought in to lead the investigation into Joe Carroll and his followers, dive deeper into the history of Carroll's psyche. To do so, they enlist the help of Carroll's ex-wife, and Hardy's former love, Claire Matthews. Meanwhile, Emma, Jacob and Paul keep Claire's son Joey at a house in the country as they prepare for their next move

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E03 - The Poet's Fire
1.plot: A new follower is found in Rick, who is on a determined path to follow through on Carroll's orders. Hardy and the FBI attempt to predict Rick's course of revenge, which leads to a surprising outcome. Meanwhile, Paul's jealousy over Emma and Jacob's relationship leads to a breaking point, and the origin of Hardy and Carroll's relationship.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E04 - Mad Love
1.plot: Maggie devises a plot to put an end to Hardy. Meanwhile, tension rises as Paul reveals a secret that Jacob has been keeping from Emma and more information about Hardy and Claire's past relationship is revealed.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E05 - The Siege
1.plot: When Claire receives a phone call that may lead her to find her son, the FBI and Ryan Hardy set their next move into motion, causing panic at the farmhouse. Meanwhile, Joe Carroll seeks a lawyer from his past to send a message that has deadly results.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E06 - The Fall
1.plot: Joe Carroll's true intentions are revealed through a new follower, Charlie. As Ryan learns of Joe's plans, he tries to stall Emma, Jacob and Paul by taunting them in hopes of turning them against each other. Meanwhile, Emma makes a shocking decision.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E07 - Let Me Go
1.plot: With the help of attorney Olivia Warren, Joe Carroll makes a case against Ryan and the FBI to be transferred to a different facility, but Ryan suspects a larger plan may be at play. Meanwhile, Emma and Joey arrive at a meeting point and come across another one of Roderick's men who has a secret of his own.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E08 - Welcome Home
1.plot: With Joey Matthews still missing and the search for Joe Carroll escalating, the FBI brings in Nick Donovan to run lead on the case, much to Ryan and Parker's dismay. Meanwhile, a follower from the past meets up with Joe Carroll, and their plans have a life-threatening result.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E09 - Love Hurts
1.plot: With Weston still in the hospital, Ryan and Parker attempt to outsmart their new leader Nick as a way to continue their search. In a surprising move, Joe reaches out to Ryan to demand Claire's location and reveals that he will go to great lengths to lure her out of FBI custody. Meanwhile, followers from the past make a shocking return.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E10 - Guilt
1.plot: After discovering Claire's location, Joe sends two followers to capture her, but Ryan may be one step ahead. Meanwhile, Jacob struggles with recent decisions causing his reunion with Emma to be less than ideal. Also, a relationship from Ryan's past plays a significant role in his future.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E11 - Whips and Regret
1.plot: After losing Claire to Joe's followers, Ryan and Parker attempt to recover while the FBI tracks down an undercover location that may have dark ties to Joe's following. Meanwhile, Claire adjusts to life at the follower's mansion and has an unexpected reunion, while Emma and Jacob continue to deal with Emma's betrayal.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E12 - The Curse
1.plot: Ryan and the FBI discover a follower who might be able to lead them to Joe Carroll's location. Agent Weston returns to the case but his run-in with the cult may have had a bigger impact on him than anyone originally thought. Meanwhile, Claire and Emma come face-to-face for the first time since Joey's kidnapping.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E13 - Havenport
1.plot: The Havenport Police Department is brought onto the case and Roderick's role as sheriff is called into question, which leads him to make a shocking decision that threatens the safety of Joey. Meanwhile, Ryan goes against the FBI, hoping to gain the trust of one of Joe's followers.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E14 - The End is Near
1.plot: Ryan, Parker and Weston prepare to storm the follower's mansion, but Joe already has an escape plan in action. Meanwhile, disguised followers create a diversion at the town evacuation center, which causes panic among the residents and leads to a dangerous kidnapping of one FBI official.

1.title: FR - The Following - S01E15 - The Final Chapter
1.plot: In the explosive Season One finale, Ryan races to stop Joe Carroll before his endgame reaches a deadly conclusion. Meanwhile, Joe leads Claire to a special location and the ultimate showdown between good and evil takes place.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E01 - Resurrection
2.plot: One year after Ryan Hardy's pursuit of serial killer Joe Carroll, a healthy and healed Ryan is living in New York City. On the surface, it appears Ryan's gotten his life back together. But deep down, his obsession with Joe continues to grow. Then, on the anniversary of Joe's death, a new murderous rampage leaves everyone shocked and determined to discover the truth.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E02 - For Joe
2.plot: After the tragic subway killings, Ryan’s obsession with the case becomes stronger than ever. Soon, mysterious phone calls bring him face-to-face with what may be his biggest threat yet. Meanwhile, revelations surrounding Joe’s new life are brought to the surface.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E03 - Trust Me
2.plot: Ryan continues his search to find the correlation between the recent tragedies in New York City and Emma and the existing members of the Havenport cult, while the FBI becomes increasingly aware of his undercover agenda. Meanwhile, a shocking event leads Joe to put a new plan in action.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E04 - Family Affair
2.plot: After the latest shocking revelation in the case, Ryan and Max attempt to put the pieces together and stay two-steps ahead of the FBI, despite Weston's constant warnings to stay out of the way. Meanwhile, Emma becomes even closer to Mark and Luke, while Joe and Mandy meet up with a follower in search of assistance.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E05 - Reflection
2.plot: In an attempt to learn new information, Ryan and Max capture a suspect. But complications lead to a game of dangerous cat and mouse. Also, Joe grows accustomed to his surroundings and establishes a plan of his own, while Emma realizes she is in dangerous company.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E06 - Fly Away
2.plot: Looking for back-up and hoping to execute their plan, Ryan and Max contact the FBI. But Weston has other ideas, leading to a standoff between good and evil. Meanwhile, Joe's new relationship escalates into uncharted territory, and Luke finds himself in a troubling situation.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E07 - Sacrifice
2.plot: Ryan and the FBI continue their hunt for Lily Gray, and are forced to redirect their search when a new threat enters Max's life. Meanwhile, Joe, Emma and Mandy arrive at their latest hideout, but quickly realize things aren't what they seem.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E08 - The Messenger
2.plot: After a tragic turn of events, Ryan attempts to find the man who originally taught Joe to kill, in hopes of finding new answers. Meanwhile, at the compound, Joe tries to get his bearings, while Emma and Mandy wait for him to reveal his new plan.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E09 - Unmasked
2.plot: Ryan, Max and Weston discover information that leads them closer to uncovering the mole within the FBI - which results in complications of its own. Meanwhile, Joe and Micah execute a plan that threatens the Korban cult in order to announce a message to Ryan and the world.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E10 - Teacher's Pet
2.plot: As his power over the Korban cult grows, Joe sets a deadly plan in action using new acolytes to carry out his demands. Meanwhile, Ryan and Max devise a plan to contact Joe, in hopes of tracking down his whereabouts, and Weston meets with a face from the past.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E11 - Freedom
2.plot: A deadly massacre, thought to be sparked by Joe Carroll, leads Ryan and Mike into very dangerous territory. But as more details are revealed, they realize another leader might be on the rise. Meanwhile, Joe continues to train the Korban cult and confirms his new plans with Emma and those who doubt him.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E12 - Betrayal
2.plot: After a series of public condemnations of Joe and his followers, Joe targets the son of a man who stands against him. Meanwhile, Ryan is faced with the shocking news of Claire's reappearance and Mandy makes a decision that leads her to a familiar face which could undo all that Joe has been working for.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E13 - The Reaping
2.plot: Ryan tracks down the location of the Korban compound with hopes to infiltrate the cult and capture Joe Carroll, but all doesn't go exactly as planned. Meanwhile, Claire asks Carrie to deliver a message to Joe, and Weston makes a decision that will change the course of his life forever.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E14 - Silence
2.plot: Joe Carroll puts his final plan into action, threatening the lives of many, as Ryan and Mike go to great lengths to stop him and prevent more innocent lives being lost. Meanwhile, Claire makes a decision that leads her into dangerous territory, and Mark and Luke attempt to figure out their next move.

2.title: FR - The Following - S02E15 - Forgive
2.plot: Mark and Luke turn the tables on both Ryan Hardy and Joe Carroll, forcing the two sworn enemies to come together to save the woman they love.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E01 - New Blood
3.plot: With Joe Carroll awaiting execution on death row and all signs of his following erased, Ryan Hardy has moved on from the dark events of his past. But his newfound happiness is shattered when a series of brutally staged tableaus threatens to tear open old wounds. Ryan and his team are forced to unravel a twisted web of violence before it destroys them all - leading them to face a terrifying truth: Joe Carroll was just the beginning.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E02 - Boxed In
3.plot: Ryan believes he has found the connection between Andrew and Mark, but he and the FBI are still unsure if - and how - Joe Carroll might be connected. Meanwhile, tension between Mark, Kyle and Daisy mounts and Ryan soon finds himself in a dangerous situation, in which facing the truth is the only thing that will set him free.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E03 - Exposed
3.plot: After a devastating loss, Ryan, Weston and Max aim to hunt down who is responsible and make them pay, leading Ryan to take a risk with deadly consequences. Meanwhile, Mark questions the loyalty of Kyle and Daisy, causing tensions to rise amongst the group.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E04 - Home
3.plot: As Mark, Kyle and Daisy plan to make a personal attack on Ryan, the FBI receives a tip leading them to a secret location, which gives them a leg up in the case.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E05 - A Hostile Witness
3.plot: On the day of an important trial, things go awry, causing the FBI to split up to hunt down a missing person. With his team breaking apart, Ryan enlists the help of a former enemy to defeat a greater one.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E06 - Reunion
3.plot: With their latest target on the run, Ryan and Mike follow a tip to a small town to investigate and confirm he isn't seeking protection. While in town, they both discover an even larger threat who has managed to avoid suspicion up until now. Meanwhile, Max struggles to make a confession.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E07 - The Hunt
3.plot: With only a few days before Joe Carroll's execution, Ryan and Mike shift their focus to a new threat. Meanwhile, after being approved to start work again, Max rejoins the task force and comes dangerously close to a deadly menace.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E08 - Flesh & Blood
3.plot: The FBI closes in on a suspect whom they believe to be the culprit behind the latest murders, but Ryan believes the killer is still out there, leading him to dig deeper into dangerous territory. Meanwhile, Joe undergoes evaluation in the days leading up to his execution and a new threat tries to cover his tracks.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E09 - Kill The Messenger
3.plot: After the latest shocking discovery, Ryan finds himself being tracked by the new illusive killer and a game of cat-and-mouse begins leading them both back to Joe Carroll, for different reasons. Meanwhile, Max and Mike look for a stolen clue and Mark makes a shocking decision.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E10 - Evermore
3.plot: With Joe Carroll's execution day upon them, the team remains on edge, expecting that he won't go easily. Their fears are realized when a hostage situation at the prison forces Ryan to go in alone, as the whole world watches.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E11 - Demons
3.plot: The investigation leads the team to a dangerous serial killer linked to Theo, while Theo and Penny seek refuge from an unknown source with the means of helping them disappear. Meanwhile, Ryan struggles with recent events, sending him into a downward spiral, and the search continues into which agent has been accessing Daisy’s laptop from inside the FBI.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E12 - The Edge
3.plot: An increasingly reckless Ryan continues his search for Theo, as Mark and Daisy discover information that leads them closer to the FBI than ever and puts Mike in a dangerous situation.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E13 - A Simple Trade
3.plot: A deadly deal is made, but things don’t go as planned, and Ryan makes a decision for his future.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E14 - Dead or Alive
3.plot: The FBI hunt for Theo continues and the stakes are higher than ever as some of their own come under attack.

3.title: FR - The Following - S03E15 - The Reckoning
3.plot: As suspicions rise alliances are shaken and no one is safe in the harrowing final heart-stopping moments.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Hayes Morrison needs to dig herself out of what could be a publicly embarrassing situation. She makes a clandestine deal with her adversary, Conner Wallace, to take on the Conviction Integrity Unit and justice system in order to save face for herself and her family. The first case Hayes pushes her team to consider is that of Odell Dwyer, a handsome former high school football player who has been in prison for eight years for murdering his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E02 - Bridge and Tunnel Vision
1.plot: Wallace's career-making case is reexamined by CIU team, but there are unforeseen complexities in this rape and robbery case, and the woman at the center of the crime becomes victimized again, this time by the press.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E03 - Dropping Bombs
1.plot: The CIU team tries to exonerate a political activist with suspect views who is serving a life sentence for bombing a mosque and killing an influential Imam and three followers.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E04 - Mother's Little Burden
1.plot: Hayes and the team tackle the case of a mother convicted in the death of her autistic son.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E05 - The 1% Solution
1.plot: Hayes launches into damage-control mode following her controversial nationally televised interview, seeking to limit the repercussions within her family and to her mother's Senate campaign. Meanwhile, the CIU takes on the case of a young man from the wrong side of the tracks, convicted for killing a wealthy woman whose privileged family took him in and treated him as one of their own.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E06 - #StayWoke
1.plot: The accidental death of a young African American boy, shot by a cop, sparks a racial firestorm and inspires Hayes to re-examine the controversial case of Porscha Williams. Williams, a devoted African-American civil-rights activist and leader, is serving time for killing a white female cop at a race equality rally five years ago.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E07 - A Simple Man
1.plot: The next case Hayes accepts for the CIU is that of Leo Scarlata, a man with diminished mental capacities, imprisoned for burning down his family’s restaurant with fatal repercussions. Hayes realizes she may have taken on more than she bargained for, especially when a documentary crew approved by Wallace begins following the team.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E08 - Bad Deals
1.plot: CIU revisits the case of Sierra Macy, a teenage girl who was kidnapped ten years ago and assumed dead—until she manages to escape her captor’s home after he suffers a heart attack and dies.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E09 - A Different Kind of Death
1.plot: Wallace brings the case of a death-row inmate, Earl Slavitt, to the CIU. Earl was convicted of murdering federal prosecutor Tom Simon, one of Wallace’s best friends. Simon did not believe in the death penalty, and Wallace, along with Simon’s widow, want to ensure that Earl did in fact commit the crime. With only days left before the execution, the CIU team shifts into high gear, looking for possible errors in the case.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E10 - Not Okay
1.plot: After Hayes and Wallace share a passionate night together, Hayes returns to reality and cautiously considers sticking her toe into relationship waters with Wallace. Simultaneously, she also tries to make amends for her bitter loss in the death penalty case of Earl Slavitt. Hayes implores the CIU team to aggressively pursue the case of Sophie Hausen, a young woman serving a life sentence for murdering a popular college basketball player, whom she accused of raping her.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E11 - Black Orchid
1.plot: While Hayes and Wallace struggle to balance their professional and personal lives, they are summoned to a crime scene that fits the M.O. of the infamous “Black Orchid Killer.” Is the latest murder the work of a copycat? Or is the man now in prison for the earlier crimes actually innocent? As the investigation accelerates, the CIU team, spearheaded by unlikely serial-killer expert Tess, closes in on a suspect who may have committed all the murders – but will it be too late?

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E12 - Enemy Combatant
1.plot: Former President Morrison pays Hayes an unexpected visit and lobbies her (and CIU) to take on the case of Omar Abbas, a Muslim-American citizen held for years without trial in a military facility for allegedly planning a chemical attack on Manhattan. But taking on the federal war on terror is a hot-button issue, and Hayes and the CIU find themselves battling the authorities in their search for the truth.

1.title: FR - Conviction - S01E13 - Past, Prologue & What's to Come

meta.plot: A brilliant young attorney, who is also the daughter of a former U.S. president, is blackmailed to head up LA's new Conviction Integrity Unit. She and her team investigate cases where people may have been wrongly convicted.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Under Way
1.plot: When his verbal joust with presidential hopeful Éric Andréï goes viral, Stéphane finds himself in the limelight — and reluctantly running for office.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - Under Construction
1.plot: As Éric covertly tries to sabotage his campaign, Stéphane and his newly-formed team dodge old scandals and collect signatures to seal his candidacy.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Uncharted Territory
1.plot: Thanks to Mo’s security cameras, Stéphane identifies the arsonists. Later, they head to Corrèze, a rural town unlikely to appreciate team Blé’s vibe.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - Under Threat
1.plot: Éric tries to capitalize on Stéphane’s injury. Yasmine begins to suspect Will has an ulterior motive. Lamine finds himself in hot water.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E05 - Live on Air
1.plot: After the email scandal, Stéphane and Corinne face off in a televised debate — but pointed questions and "surprise guests" dominate the evening.

1.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Final Hurdle
1.plot: With election day around the corner and Lamine on the run, Stéphane tries to salvage his marriage and his campaign. Will he succeed?

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E01 - In the Palace
2.plot: With no agenda, no party, no wife and a series of escalating threats, Stéphane and the team prepare for his upcoming inauguration at the Élysée Palace.

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E02 - In Sync
2.plot: As Stéphane and Mo secretly handle a diplomatic incident, a royal visit is announced. Lamine inspires housing reform ahead of a celebratory garden party.

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E03 - On the Throne
2.plot: With his father in hospital and Marion in Guadeloupe, Stéphane attempts to strike a deal with a demanding Queen of Norway, making Corinne very unhappy.

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E04 - On a Mission
2.plot: As Stéphane and the team land in Guadeloupe in search of Marion, they are greeted by angry citizens. Back in Paris, Andréï prepares a military operation.

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E05 - In Truth
2.plot: With his back against the wall, Stéphane prepares to make a big announcement. As he faces Cognard live on TV, protestors approach the presidential home.

2.title: FR - Represent [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E06 - On the Run
2.plot: As rioters storm the Élysée Palace, the team takes cover in a bunker. With Andréï desperate to take him down, can Stéphane survive his rival's coup?

meta.plot: An idealistic educator is inadvertently thrust into the French presidential race.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Give Us a Laugh!
1.plot: While struggling comic Nezir weighs a tricky job offer, his friend Aïssa tries out racy new material, and club owner Bling has a wild night onstage.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - A Successful Touch
1.plot: As Aïssa's fame grows, so do the tensions at home. Nezir and Bling start on their secret project. Apolline signs up for a beginner's set at the club.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Black Goes with Everything
1.plot: Bling gets a shot at writing for TV, Aïssa draws inspiration from a run-in with the police, and Apolline asks Nezir to help her polish her act.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - Go, Pistachio!
1.plot: More good news leaves Aïssa torn between two worlds. Nezir juggles a new job and a neighborhood comedy show. Apolline gets a confidence boost.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E05 - A Streetcar Named Nezir
1.plot: A mishap brings Nezir and Bling closer. Aïssa grapples with unexpected news and an uncomfortable on-air moment. Apolline's deceptions begin to unravel.

1.title: FR - Standing Up  [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E06 - Good Evening, Olympia...
1.plot: As Aïssa prepares for her biggest show yet, Nezir plots revenge on Tifflot, Apolline deals with a family crisis, and Bling starts to get his mojo back.

meta.plot: From odd jobs to the hunt for viral fame, making a career in stand-up comedy isn't easy, but four friends risk everything to make the world laugh.
Tensions erupt when two filmmakers infiltrate an area ruled by gangs to shoot a music video for a rapper in this gritty found-footage series.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Spielberg
1.plot: In the south of France, Franck and Thomas drive to the hood to work with aspiring rapper Tony when a shootout erupts.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - Blow By Blow
1.plot: Tony and a label executive push the filmmakers to continue the project. Moussa's mother inadvertently puts everyone in an awkward spot.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Crackhead
1.plot: Steve's demands cause Moussa to clash with Tony, who doesn't want a war. Franck tries to persuade Thomas to focus on the unique opportunity ahead.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - ARAH!
1.plot: Worried about the footage, a youth worker pleads with Tony to use his influence wisely. As cops raid the block, Tony rushes to help Kylian.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E05 - Green
1.plot: The police puts pressure on Tony to rat on Steve. Tony's sister Jess levels with him. Franck and Tony bond over their career aspirations.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E06 - Freestyle
1.plot: Steve gives Tony an ultimatum. When the label dismisses Franck's footage, Kylian offers to help him go after shocking material.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E07 - Bash
1.plot: Kylian puts himself at risk to film the transaction between Tony and Steve. Later, while the hood celebrates, Steve's men exact revenge.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E08 - Snitch
1.plot: Grappling with the attack on their turf, Moussa rages while Tony offers Jess a way out. Under threat, Franck tells Moussa everything he knows.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E09 - Hitmen
1.plot: Moussa and Tony wage war on Steve's gang. As the conflict escalates, Franck and Thomas desperately seek safety.

1.title: FR - Dealer [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E10 - Big Shot
1.plot: As the gang rivalry reaches a boiling point, Franck and Thomas are caught in the crossfire while the cameras are rolling.

meta.plot: The dramatized World War II adventures of US Major Gregory "Pappy" Boyington and his Marine Attack Squadron 214, AKA The Black Sheep Squadron.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E01 - Flying Misfits
1.plot: Maverick WW2 Marine aviator forms his own fighter squadron.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E02 - Best Three Out of Five
1.plot: While in temporary command, Lard uses his powers to cut the supply lines to the Black Sheep, in order to have their unit shut down for no combat activity, but Boyington finds a way around that and all the Black Sheep are on leave. Things go awry when Boyington and crew return and finds the man Boyington stole the Corsairs from, now in charge of the 214.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E03 - Small War
1.plot: While on patrol Pappy is accidentally shot down by T.J. He hits the silk and winds up on a Japanese occupied island. The squadron's morale hits rock bottom while he is MIA and Jim is unsure of his abilities to command. Pappy soon discovers he is not the only one trying to survive on the hostile island.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E04 - High Jinx
1.plot: The Japanese have a new special modified armored Zero with the best Japanese pilots in the air. If Pappy or any of his men come up against them they are to disengage and get home. This doesn't sit well with Pappy or the rest of the squadron. Pappy pulls strings and has newly 'returned to service' Ace pilot Doug Rafferty assigned to his squadron. His father is an Admiral...but Jim remembers him from previous missions and believes him to be a jinx. Pappy won't have this kind of superstitious talk going around and tells Jim to keep his mouth shut.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E05 - Prisoners of War
1.plot: During an early morning strafing attack by Japanese Zeros Pappy manages to shoot one down. After taking the pilot prisoner they begin to discover it's hard to hate him. He has lived in the U.S. and speaks perfect English and begins to warm up to the Squadron. But what Pappy really wants to know is what the sonar device was doing in his plane and what his mission has to do with the Japanese task force which is on the move.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E06 - Presumed Dead
1.plot: Presumed dead, flying ace Charles Dobson is found afloat on a raft at sea, after being released by the Japanese. The Meatheads try to unlock the secret to why the Japanese have set up shop with anti-aircraft batteries overnight on an island seemingly with no importance. Dobson's strange behavior brings about suspicion in Boyington.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E07 - The Meatball Circus
1.plot: The navy whisks Boyington and other squadron leaders away and tells them to pick five men for a top secret mission where five men from each will have fly until out of gas and ditch in the ocean, hoping to be picked up. Angered, Boyington comes up with an alternate plan and enlists the help of his flying meatball circus. But Boyington isn't sure what is more dangerous, flying a mission over multiple Japanese carriers, or his men butting heads with professionally dressed, by-the-book Navy men.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E08 - Up for Grabs
1.plot: General MacArthur is visiting everyone in the Pacific and Boyington's men are his next stop. On the day he is suppose to arrive, some Japanese soldiers show up and take everyone captive, with the intent to grab MacArthur. But fortunately Wiley and Casey went fishing so they weren't captured. So they must try and find a way to stop them.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E09 - Anyone for Suicide?
1.plot: Boyington, just recovered from malaria, gets no volunteers for a dangerous mission after Doc Lindsay tells the Black Sheep to ground Pappy or he'll send him stateside. Pappy decides to fly the mission anyway, with four strangers. After bad weather keeps the replacements from flying in, the mission is scrubbed. To get back into Pappy's good graces, the Black Sheep decide to fly with Pappy, but the mission doesn't go as planned.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E10 - New Georgia on My Mind
1.plot: A marine Colonel arrives on the island and informs Boyington that he and his squad are going to join him on a raid. Boyington is not pleased when he learns that the Colonel is taking command of his squad so he goes to General Moore who tells him to suck it up. And things between the marines and the black sheep get tense. And when the Colonel pushes them too far, Boyington snaps.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E11 - The Cat's Whiskers
1.plot: Boyington is looking at facing the court martial Lard has been after, but with the war at a stand still for no apparent reason, Boyington finds out why and plans a mission to bring good graces upon the Black Sheep.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E12 - Love and War
1.plot: Nothing is fair in love or war when Bragg and Casey both fall for the same pretty nurse.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E13 - The War Biz Warrior
1.plot: A movie hero discovers war is different than the way it is portrayed on film when he is sent on a combat mission in order to improve morale.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E14 - The Deadliest Enemy of All: Part 1
1.plot: When French gets flamed in a hailstorm of flak, Pappy guides the pilot to safety but is injured in the process.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E15 - Deadliest Enemy of All: Part 2
1.plot: Pappy receives an entirely new kind of wound when a nurse that he's fallen for reveals that she's married.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E16 - Devil in the Slot
1.plot: Gutterman breaks under pressure of a hostile air attack, and a mechanic sees his opportunity to takeover the planes...and the men.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E17 - Five the Hard Way
1.plot: When French's father pressures his son to become an ace pilot by downing a fifth plane, Pappy takes a stand against the overeager newspaper publisher.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E18 - The Last Mission Over Sengai
1.plot: Friendly fire or fatal strafing? That's the question facing a military court when Pappy is accused by a new Black Sheep pilot.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E19 - Trouble at Fort Apache
1.plot: A new experimental bomber has two generals giving conflicting orders and, unfortunately, Pappy is stuck in the middle.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E20 - Poor Little Lambs
1.plot: Twenty-four hours before a planned Marine attack, Pappy and two of his pilots are shot down over a targeted island occupied by enemy soldiers, missionaries, and orphans.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E21 - W*A*S*P*S
1.plot: The battle of the sexes lands on the frontline when a Woman's Airforce Pilots squad arrives at the base.

1.title: FR - Les Tetes Brulées - S01E22 - Last One for Hutch
1.plot: During a Japanese attack, one of the men is killed. Because of the Japanese forces, the Black Sheep and hospital staff are relocated to another island and all of them are re-asigned, but Boyington has a plan to fix everything.
