meta.plot: Toronto’s only female private detective in the 1920s takes on the cases the police don’t want or can’t handle. From airplanes and booze running to American G-men, Communists and union busters, Frankie’s fearless sense of adventure gets her into all kinds of trouble, but she always manages to find her way out.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E01 - Mother of Pearl
1.plot: Frankie is forced to partner with an unlikely ally when she’s the number one suspect in a jewellery heist.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E02 - Ladies in Red
1.plot: Frankie and Trudy are hired by a factory owner to root out communists at his plant, but things soon take an explosive turn.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E03 - Summer in the City
1.plot: When a body turns up in the luggage of a young man, Frankie and Trudy must join forces with reporter Ernest Hemingway to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E04 - Healing Hands
1.plot: When Trudy gives shelter to a faith-healing preacher’s daughter, she and Frankie find themselves investigating Toronto’s Jazz scene.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E05 - Out of Focus
1.plot: Frankie and Trudy go undercover in the glamorous world of film in order to solve a seemingly impossible murder on a silent movie set.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E06 - Whisper Sisters
1.plot: After a shooting injures the young son of a friend, Frankie and Trudy’s investigation leads them into the dangerous world of bootlegging.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E07 - Ties That Bind
1.plot: Mary recruits Frankie and Trudy to find a missing teacher, but their investigation leads them to family secrets, Chinatown and murder.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E08 - The Pilot
1.plot: A day off turns into a day at the office for Frankie and Trudie when the infant son of a charismatic aviator is kidnapped during an air show.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E09 - Ghosts
1.plot: The horrors of war haunt Frankie when the investigation of a soldier's murder reunites her with a friend left traumatized by his tour of duty.

1.title: FR - Frankie Drake Mysteries - S01E11 - Once Burnt Twice Spied
1.plot: When Frankie gets a mysterious call from a British spy, Mary discovers how she and Trudy met and how Drake Private Detectives was formed.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
1.plot: On his first day on a new job DCI Tom Mathias investigates a blood soaked bathroom and the disappearance of 64 year old Helen Jenkins. The inquiry focuses on an old Children's home above the ravine spanned by the Devil's Bridge.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
FR - Hinterland - S01E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
1.plot: At a remote farmhouse, sixty-nine year old Idris Williams is discovered bludgeoned to death, and the investigation into his murder reveals the mountain’s bloody past.

1.title: FR - Hinterland - S01E04 - Episode 2: Part 2

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
2.plot: Mathias is under pressure. His wife Meg has turned up in Aberystwyth and he's under investigation by the IPCC following the death of Mari Davies at the end of the last episode. When a bus driver is found shot dead on an isolated mountainside, the investigation provides a welcome escape.

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
FR - Hinterland - S02E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
2.plot: The murder of a local dignitary and barrister leads to the uncovering of a tragic story of love and loss fuelled by mistrust and suspicion in the depths of the Hinterland. Why were Nora and Daniel living such a secluded life? What has Mathias discovered in the garden? Will he find Daniel before Glyn Powell gets hold of him? The clock is ticking, but Mathias knows that the relationship between Branwen Powell and Daniel is key to uncovering the truth.

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E04 - Episode 2: Part 2
2.plot: The murder of a local dignitary and barrister leads to the uncovering of a tragic story. Why were Nora and Daniel living such a secluded life?

2.title: FR - Hinterland - S02E05 - Episode 3: Part 1
2.plot: The discovery of a body in a remote lake leads Mathias and the team to investigate the complicated private life of a teacher missing from a small rural school.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E01 - Episode 1: Part 1
3.plot: DCI Tom Mathias and DI Mared Rhys are confronted by a family in grief and a community in shock when they investigate the violent death of a local minister.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E02 - Episode 1: Part 2
3.plot: As the investigation into the murder of a local minister continues, the net tightens around the minister's daughter. And as the case is brought to a shattering close, Chief Superintendent Prosser is forced to confront an old foe.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E03 - Episode 2: Part 1
3.plot: Laura Dean, a curator, is discovered in a shallow grave in remote woodland. Mathias and his team must delve into the young victim's life to unearth some shocking secrets. Meanwhile, Prosser - still reeling from the death of Iwan Thomas - calls on the help of retired Chief Inspector Robert Owen.

3.title: FR - Hinterland - S03E04 - Episode 2: Part 2
3.plot: With time running out, Mathias must solve the mystery of Laura Dean's death whilst trying not to get distracted by his personal problems.

meta.plot: Tom Mathias comes to Aberystwyth having abandoned his life in London. He's a brilliant but troubled man. Despite his faults he is an excellent detective, who knows that the key to solving the crime lies not in where you look for truth, but how you look.

After 17 years in captivity, Israeli soldiers Nimrode Klein, Uri Zach, and Amiel Ben Horin return home to the country that made them national icons. They work to overcome the trauma of torture and captivity while settling back into their interrupted family lives. Meanwhile, the military psychiatrist assigned to them finds discrepancies in the soldiers' testimonies, and launches an investigation to discover what they are hiding.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E01 - Homecoming
1.plot: The negotiations for the release of three Israeli soldiers has ended successfully, and after 17 years in captivity, Nimrod Klein, Uri Zach and Amiel Ben Chorin are coming home.

1.title: FR - Hatufim, prisonniers de guerre - S01E02 - The Facility, part 1

meta.plot: When a brilliant drone engineer, Victoria, is taken hostage in her own home, a series of dangerous events are set into motion in this high octane thriller.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E01 - The Takeover
1.plot: This high-octane thriller follows the events leading up to a terror-attack in Scandinavia. Borgen's Birgitte Hjort Sørensen stars as Victoria, a brilliant drone engineer who is taken hostage by terrorists in her own home, while the Secret Services in Denmark and Sweden are fighting against the clock to prevent an attack.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E02 - First Mission
1.plot: Victoria wakes up confused, scared and with her hands tied on her back. Iyad shows her a live feed of her son, Oskar. If she doesn’t do what he asks her to, Oskar will be killed. Victoria sees no other way than to do what he tells her. Under heavy surveillance,Victoria and Iyad travel to Victoria’s workplace SparrowSat, a drone company in Stockholm. It’s time for Victoria to complete her first assignment for Iyad.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E03 - The Return
1.plot: In order to have full control of Victoria and start next phase of the plan, Iyad has taken Victoria hostage in her own home. They drive to the airport, to pick up her son, Oskar, who has returned from Paris unexpectedly. She introduces Iyad to Oskar as an old friend, who will stay with them for a few days. Back at the apartment, Iyad forces Victoria to show him how to control a drone, using the software for the flight controller that Victoria has developed.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E04 - A Chance
1.plot: The dead driver from Gothenburg harbour has several times earlier travelled on the same flights between Copenhagen and Stockholm as Victoria Rahbek, and Jesper is determined to question her. Under false pretences, he visits Victoria - against Eva’s orders. Eva is furious with Jesper and their collaboration hangs by a thread. Henrik cautions Jesper but keeps his promise and arranges a meeting between Jesper and a former source.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E05 - Recruited
1.plot: Victoria tests the flight controller. Its security system prevents it from flying over nofly zones. In order to make it fully functional, she needs a security code from her Swedish colleague Linda. PET and SÄPO now have Victoria under constant surveillance and in the Copenhagen airport Eva makes contact with Victoria. Victoria tells her that Iyad is keeping her and Oskar hostage and Eva promises to get them both out alive.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E06 - Double Agent
1.plot: As Eva and Jesper close in on Iyad’s terrorist cell, they force Victoria to act as a double agent. She is to act as if nothing has happened and continue to steal equipment from SparrowSat, while reporting back to Jesper and Eva about Iyad’s terrorist network. One misstep can have fatal consequences for Victoria and Oskar. Victoria continues to prepare the flight controller while discreetly trying to get as much information from Iyad about the terror plans as possible.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E07 - The Sacrifice
1.plot: Victoria manages to establish audio surveillance on Iyad’s phone. PET and SÄPO are now able to track everything he does. While Victoria once again travels to SparrowSat, Iyad stays at home with Oskar. A close bond is slowly growing between Iyad and Oskar , which worry Victoria. At SparrowSat Victoria gains access to the servers, and manages to transfer the drone software to an external hard drive. But her colleague Linda surprises her in the middle of the transfer.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E08 - Survival Skills
1.plot: Iyad contacts Al-Shishani, worried that Victoria isn’t able to complete the task. PET and SÄPO also question Victoria’s mental health. They need to work fast if they don’t want to lose her. With an imminent attack planed to happen within two days, Eva and Jesper continue to map out the possible terror targets. But suddenly and without warning, Iyad leads Victoria and Oskar to his car and drives off to an unknown destination.

1.title: FR - Greyzone - S01E10 - A New World
1.plot: SÄPO and the PET are on high alert. Both police authorities locally and nationally have been activated and the military is on standby. They know where the attack is planned to happen, and everyone is working feverishly to locate Victoria and Iyad. Al-Shishani, Iyad, Victoria, Oskar and Claes have escaped Copenhagen and arrive at their final destination; a desolate Swedish country house. They gather in the control room where Victoria sees the drone for the first time. She has more adjustments left before the drone can take off with the warhead and fly towards the target. While she hesitantly prepares the drone, Jesper and Eva desperately try to find the terrorists before it’s too late.

Adding to her distress is the possibility of another woman deeply embedded in Woo Jae's life. Bewildered and frightened, Jung Won struggles to comprehend the gravity of the situation.

1.title: FR - Nothing Uncovered  [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5

Meanwhile, Woo Jae learns about Tae Heon and Jung Won's former romantic involvement and cautions Tae Heon against revisiting it.
